rogue_2_relic_fight_145.usage: When Life Point is at 1, all Operators recover an additional 1 SP every 2 seconds

rogue_2_relic_fight_146.name: King's Crown
rogue_2_relic_fight_146.description: O Nameless King, may you continue to bless Iberia, even should your kingdom fall to ruin.
rogue_2_relic_fight_146.usage: When Life Point is at 1, all friendly units have +50% ATK, increased to +150% ATK if you have collected 3 or more King's Collectibles

rogue_2_relic_fight_147.name: 'Glory Pack'
rogue_2_relic_fight_147.description: A special betting method set up by the organizers for the duration of the knight competition season. Choose from a variety of complementary betting packages to minimize your losses on any particular match.
rogue_2_relic_fight_147.usage: When an Operator is defeated, it will Stun all enemies in the four adjacent tiles for 6 seconds
rogue_2_relic_fight_147.unlockCondDesc: Select 'Support Squad' and complete your adventure.

rogue_2_relic_fight_148.name: Timeworn Poetry Strips
rogue_2_relic_fight_148.description: 'Drunk far beyond all mounts that list the realm, all beings take on souls as they demand.'
rogue_2_relic_fight_148.usage: Summons will no longer use Deployment slots
rogue_2_relic_fight_148.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader 'Lingering Pathshaper' once

rogue_2_relic_fight_149.name: Derivative Terminal - Supercharged Mod
rogue_2_relic_fight_149.description: A product of Raythean Industries. The latest remote-control operation terminal, capable of connecting to the signals of most existing remotely-operated units on its own, complete with customization options and performance upgrades. Not yet available on the market.
rogue_2_relic_fight_149.usage: Summons have +30% HP, +30% ATK, and +30 ASPD

rogue_2_relic_fight_150.name: Mercenary Insurance
rogue_2_relic_fight_150.description: Special insurance offered to independent mercenaries, indemnifying against mission failure or excessive loss.
rogue_2_relic_fight_150.usage: All friendly units gain 10% Sanctuary, increased to 35% if Light is below 50.

rogue_2_relic_fight_151.name: Uncle Vought Total Care Kit
rogue_2_relic_fight_151.description: A complete care kit produced by the Columbian old salon product manufacturer, 'Uncle Vought.' Provence has modeled for this product. 'Take good care of your tail and your ears - after all, they're your second face.'
rogue_2_relic_fight_151.usage: All friendly ranged units take 40% less Elemental Injury
rogue_2_relic_fight_151.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, allow 5 [Skimming Sea Drifters] to enter the Objective Point

rogue_2_relic_fight_152.name: Ursus Felt Rug
rogue_2_relic_fight_152.description: The people of Ursus will spread this special felt rug across their cellars when storing grains for the winter, in order to absorb water and prevent moisture. When the cellar becomes a hiding place, it also helps shelter the occupants from the wind and snow for a while.
rogue_2_relic_fight_152.usage: All friendly melee units take 40% less Elemental Injury
rogue_2_relic_fight_152.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, defeat a total of 200 'Baleful Broodlings'

rogue_2_relic_fight_153.name: Broken Wand - Learning
rogue_2_relic_fight_153.description: When you have taken in the wisdom of all the land, ignorance becomes the enemy's weakness.
rogue_2_relic_fight_153.usage: For every collectible owned, [Caster] ATK +2%, ASPD +1

rogue_2_relic_fight_154.name: Broken Wand - Light of Wisdom
rogue_2_relic_fight_154.description: Knowledge and experience should not remain untapped. They should be the key to victory.
rogue_2_relic_fight_154.usage: For every collectible owned, [Caster] ATK +3%, ASPD +2

rogue_2_relic_fight_155.name: Broken Wand - Solving
rogue_2_relic_fight_155.description: A caster's greatest enemy is another caster.
rogue_2_relic_fight_155.usage: For every [Caster] Operator on the field, enemy RES -12
rogue_2_relic_fight_155.unlockCondDesc: Win Emergency Op [Mutual Aid] without losing any Life Points

rogue_2_relic_fight_156.name: Iron Guard - Wall
rogue_2_relic_fight_156.description: No one is stupid enough to ram a wall with their body, right?

rogue_2_relic_fight_157.name: Iron Guard - Tower
rogue_2_relic_fight_157.description: It rises into the clouds, looking down at the enemies jumping up and down by its feet.
rogue_2_relic_fight_157.usage: [Defender] Operators gain DEF +70%, RES +20, Elemental Injury taken -60%

rogue_2_relic_fight_158.name: Survivor Contract
rogue_2_relic_fight_158.description: A very long contract, in which every term and condition is the result of experience, leaving no room for chance or sentiment. Satisfy them all to be the final survivor.
rogue_2_relic_fight_158.usage: At the start of battle, a random Operator gains +20% ATK and DEF, plus an additional +20% at the end of each battle
rogue_2_relic_fight_158.unlockCondDesc: Unlock [Matter from Mind] in Cognitive Shaping

rogue_2_relic_fight_159.name: Fosterer Genotype
rogue_2_relic_fight_159.description: Collective evolution is driven by individual mutation. Individual problems are solved by collective intelligence. Lu is highly confident in this model. If the Fosterer Project has enough time, perhaps...
rogue_2_relic_fight_159.usage: An Operator with Rejection will assimilate 2 nearby normal Operators. When assimilation is complete, the Operator with Rejection temporarily gains [Evolution]: Rejection has no effect, gains 35% Sanctuary, attacks ignore 35% RES and DEF

rogue_2_treasure.name: Drifting Cache
rogue_2_treasure.usage: A few small items can be found inside.

You carefully admired the oil painting.
You asked the person their name.
You opened the doors and walked in.
You listened to the old lady's stories <color=#ffb525>{0}</color> times.
You dived into the heap of trash <color=#ffb525>{0}</color> times.
You defeated the Big Sad Lock.

rogue_2_treasure.name: Trust in fate
rogue_2_treasure.usage: Spend 1 Die Roll (Must roll 5 or higher)

rogue_2_treasure.name: Brute force it with a weapon
rogue_2_treasure.usage: I'll open this damn thing, even if nothing's inside!

grandPrizes.displayDiscription:
The clan of doomwatchers have been living by the edge of the icefield for a millennium.
They have seen their fate, and only despair remains.
Since tragedy has already been foreordained—
where will Valarqvin from the far reaches of the north lead you to?

A figure who used to appear in dreams, and in the reflections of the ice and snow.
The silvery permafrost is blessed by Its gaze, Its horns the extensions of thousands of fates.
The woods are still lush, and the creatures of the earth still remember Its loving eyes.
You still remember.

People employ the most romantic imagery to fight against the harsh winter nights, for life with nature as your companion is not simple at all. Light candles and lamps for your dreams, and sleep peacefully under the shelter of the forest, earth, and rocks.

The Icefield Survey Project has confirmed a stable route, and hunters of the wilderness have also joined the expedition team as escorts. But the first step of the formal process has her stumped: What is this 'Lecture on Sami Survival Skills and its Regional Cultures'?

Deepening your knowledge is extremely risky,
but you have already decided to keep in contact with Sami civilization and icefield ecology.
A set of strange symbols, a unique way of communication.
An all new possibility for the future.

Starting with gathering around a fire, people have gradually learned to live in the bitter cold of the Myrkwood. Revere nature, while hiding within it. Over this long years, only Sami has yet to ever change.

The integration of data content is the essence of systems engineering.
It can improve the abilities of operators, or assist in adjusting their combat methods.
Are you already starting to think about how to put this to use?
Or will you keep it in your back pocket, saving it for a more suitable opportunity?

A cast rises from the horizon. 
Eyes that mutually glimpse into the abyss. 
An artifact bears witness to a long-lasting destiny. 
The door to humanity's move towards the future.

The shaman who commands the wind and snow is just an ordinary being under the rays of the southern sun.
She is, perhaps, more fearful of the heat than her southern friends.
She accepts her friend's advice and puts aside the thoughts burdening her mind for the time being.
The 'past' is destined to fade away, but branches still sprout on this great land.

The little expeditioner devotes all their efforts, 
throwing open the door to the future. 
From silver to gold, 
humanity of today shares the same battlefield with eternal legends.

The seeds of destiny were buried long ago, deep under the silverfrost.
A ring of silence has done away with the ice, waiting to once more look towards the distant shore.
There will always be the unknown, there will always be possibility, and there will always be the echoes of a star.
There is no end to mankind's quest.

month_team_1.teamDes: Only when I was just about to reach my destination did I remember where I started.

month_team_2.teamDes: Dreams are just another kind of journey granted by Sami.

month_team_3.teamDes: Those from the past will depart.

month_team_4.teamDes: All the Cyclops sees is doom.
month_team_4.taskDes: Use Valarqvin's 'After All I See Has Withered' 10 times

month_team_5.teamDes: Should we continue to press forward, knowing that there will be no end?

month_team_6.teamDes: Here, the past and future converge.

month_team_7.teamDes: She has long been unable to balance the scales, but they still carry her weights.

month_team_8.teamDes: Time does not flow in a certain direction, but naturally, this is something a little Messenger wouldn't know right now.

chatItemList.chatDesc: Crawling through years of snow.
Fleeing into the mesh of rivers and trees.
Stepping into Sami's shadow.
What if she loses to someone she considers a companion while on a hunt?
What if she loses to the weapon she relies on for survival while on a hunt?
She never asks herself. She looks on forward.
The old tree's demise is witnessed once again.
The wish from the past may just be to bury the past itself.
But we will all understand. That the past is the present, and the future.
After the expeditioners reach the end of the icefields.
At a time when the impact from the calamity spreads day by day.
Before the Cyclops exits from the cave.
To face one's mistakes requires courage, each step of the way.
Instead of charging ahead blindly, trust the people around you.
But in the end, you can only trust yourself.
After enduring tremendous hardships to find her kin, she decides to leave.
In an era of change, the Elves cannot stand alone.
May our past also become our future.
Cooperation need not begin from trust.
Passing by rugged roads, leaving every footprint behind.
Don't stretch your hand too far out.
She will save a package that foretells an 'advent.'
She will deliver a letter that foretells a 'departure.'
T-Symmetry Interpreter 55414534154526152145

ro3_n_1_1.name: Prisoners' Night
ro3_n_1_1.description:
The worthless, shackled Columbian death-row inmates sink into Sami's swamp. Afterwards, the strange sound of chains being dragged on the ground can be often heard in the wetlands.
<@rolv.rem><Defensive Barricades> that can block the enemy's route are present on the field</>

ro3_n_1_2.name: Ghosts of the Resort
ro3_n_1_2.description: The elder brother drowned in the bathtub, the younger brother choked to death on an apple, the mercenary guarding the door was impaled by thorns, and this house was abandoned.

ro3_n_1_3.name: Hands of Moss
ro3_n_1_3.description: Handprints made of moss appear on walls, tree trunks, and clothing. The Siracusan Mafia's favorite way of leaving their mark has shown up in Sami, in a unique form.

ro3_n_1_4.name: Beasts Awaiting Slaughter
ro3_n_1_4.description: At some point, the leader of the beast pack was replaced by a monster of a human. The beasts tremble with fear, but still they obey the boss's orders.

ro3_n_1_5.name: No More Than Four
ro3_n_1_5.description: Following three, preceding five—a certain number has become taboo here. The mere mention enrages those present, and they will vent their anger with violence.

ro3_n_2_1.name: Path with No End
ro3_n_2_1.description: Outsiders find it hard to distinguish Sami's environments, so they walk circles through what they believe are the same areas over and over, never finding an exit.

ro3_n_2_2.name: Low-Altitude Maneuvering
ro3_n_2_2.description:
This patch of forest has been transformed into a low-altitude flight test site, and the person in charge warmly invites you and your research team to participate in their maneuvering exercise.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Jetstreams> that generate airflow currents are present on the field</>

ro3_n_2_3.name: Shadows With Ghosts
ro3_n_2_3.description: The projector left behind in the forest occasionally reflects a few familiar looking phantoms, but no one notices, and one by one the shadows walk out of the device and into the forest.

ro3_n_2_4.name: Unwell
ro3_n_2_4.description:
It's said that there will always be someone on the team who the others don't care for, and they will be quietly replaced as the squad walks a few extra rounds through the mountain forest, their teammates completely unaware.
<@rolv.rem><Roadside Emergency Reserves> that grant Max DP are present on the field</>

ro3_n_2_5.name: Don't Turn Around, Sluggies
ro3_n_2_5.description: The Originium slugs crawl forward, completely unaware that something is following them from behind.

ro3_n_2_6.name: Payback
ro3_n_2_6.description:
Many years ago, foreigners devastated the woods with heavy machinery. Many years later, foreigners flee the woods frightened by phantom rumbling. 
<@rolv.rem>There are <Command Terminals> on the map that will deplete Life Points when destroyed</>

ro3_n_3_1.name: Pretense Turned True
ro3_n_3_1.description: Don't spread lies in Sami. When someone takes one as truth, it becomes reality.

ro3_n_3_2.name: Altar of Craving
ro3_n_3_2.description:
It is precisely because of the fuel it extracts from every passerby that this Sarkaz altar has thus far been able to operate unattended.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Altars> that deal damage to both allies and enemies are present on the field</>

ro3_n_3_3.name: Crafty Beasts' Nine-Caves
ro3_n_3_3.description: There is a kind of wild beast that, according to rumors, prepares nine exits in its lair for escape purposes. But the problem right now is that you're stuck in its den and don't know where the enemy will emerge from.

ro3_n_3_4.name: Shady Frozen Sea
ro3_n_3_4.description:
You're certainly aware that the ocean and sailors won't show up on the icefield, and yet you don't think anything is off. Cognitive errors are the most common Collapsal Paradigm to manifest.
<@rolv.rem><Corrosive Ground> tiles that reduce the DEF of allied units by half are present on the field</>

ro3_n_3_5.name: So Close and Yet So Far
ro3_n_3_5.description: The relative distances between the mountains have been folded and stretched. What originally would take only a single step to reach now takes a long time.

ro3_n_3_6.name: Rational Fracture
ro3_n_3_6.description: The enemy in front of you is moving so fast they resemble a high-latency image. You fret over how to deal with the matter, but just as you're about to scratch your head, you realize the hand you just raised is already on your back.

ro3_n_3_7.name: Harass With Strength
ro3_n_3_7.description: Five lumberjacks got together and cursed their fellow workers to turn into slugs. The good news is that the workers did indeed become Originium Slugs. The bad news is that they will never get to see humanity ever again.

ro3_n_4_1.name: Company Entanglement
ro3_n_4_1.description: Even though Columbia's tech giants have signed a contract for a joint-expedition of the icefield, their long-standing grievances will inevitably have some wanting to employ unfair means to attack their rivals.

ro3_n_4_2.name: Practical Test
ro3_n_4_2.description:
This Rhine research station is currently stress-testing their technology in the cold environment. Your team has the privilege to be among the first batch of practical testers.
<@rolv.rem><Power Armors> that activate by absorbing experimental products are present on the field</>

ro3_n_4_3.name: Collapsals' Afternoon
ro3_n_4_3.description:
You feel as if your team resembles a giant Originium slug that has been dropped onto a beach in Dossoles, and those Collapsals were originally tourists here on vacation.
<@rolv.rem><Corrosive Ground> tiles that reduce allied units's DEF by half are present on the field</>

ro3_n_4_4.name: The Big Migration
ro3_n_4_4.description: The animals just want to avoid the disasters in the north, and you're the only thing standing in their way to the south.

ro3_n_4_5.name: Defense Substituting Offense
ro3_n_4_5.description:
The husks have you trapped within a heavily battered fortress, but perhaps the resources scattered around here might let you survive this next wave of attacks.
<@rolv.rem><Roadblocks> that can block the enemy's route are present on the field</>

ro3_n_4_6.name: Noise Disturbance
ro3_n_4_6.description:
Ever since you got communication access on the icefield, you've always been able to hear a handful of nonsense words mixed in with the other person talking, but you didn't take it seriously—until the other expedition team took you for a pack of beasts.
<@rolv.rem><Mobile Tactical Hangars> that deploy enemy mercenary drones are present on the field</>

ro3_n_4_7.name: Restricted Zone
ro3_n_4_7.description:
Ursus will not listen to your excuses: as long as you enter their established restricted area, they will use force to expel you.
<@rolv.rem><Bushes> that prevent allied units from being targeted by ranged enemy attacks are present on the field</>

ro3_n_4_8.name: Where Ice Condenses
ro3_n_4_8.description: As long as there is even a trace of warmth flowing in your veins, you should not come here. For this place is only for the cold-blooded.

ro3_n_5_1.name: Musical Disaster
ro3_n_5_1.description:
The tragically distorted tunes and sounds have become the group that in your mind best understands the music. They will use this string removed from the score to slice you up alive.
<@rolv.rem>Allied units have their natural SP recovery speed reduced by <Waste Energy Interference>, but can be restored to normal with <Realigned Flux></>

ro3_n_5_2.name: Stay Away From Strangers
ro3_n_5_2.description:
Trees rotting in the ground, steel and dead flies in the sky. Life is not welcome here.
<@rolv.rem><Twigs That Crave> that produce Rot Eaters are present on the field</>

ro3_n_5_3.name: Confusing Appearance
ro3_n_5_3.description: Don't be deceived by their irregular appearance. Hold onto your thoughts and the battlefront, and don't give them an opening.

ro3_n_5_4.name: Requested Enemies Obtained
ro3_n_5_4.description: When you see a group of indistinct shadows on the icefield from a distance, never imagine the worst case scenario. After all, you don't want your 'Wish Fulfilled' in such an environment.

ro3_n_5_5.name: March of the Dead
ro3_n_5_5.description: Your most life-enriching understanding of death comes from the never resting Dublinn army.

ro3_n_5_6.name: Where be No Mounts and Seas
ro3_n_5_6.description:
The land is vast, the sea is endless, and Feranmuts naturally exist in places other than Yan. So these people cross the snowcapped mountains and sail the rivers, all to look for the ancient beings hiding in the cracks.
<@rolv.rem><Shanhaizhong Cipher Machines> that strengthen enemies are present on the field</>

ro3_n_5_7.name: Instinct Contamination
ro3_n_5_7.description:
The husks treat all living things equally.
<@rolv.rem><Active Originium> tiles that cause units on them to gradually lose HP but greatly increases their ATK and ASPD are present on the field</>

ro3_n_5_8.name: Manmade Carnival
ro3_n_5_8.description: The living stay away! Non-persons also stay away! The machines have become their own masters, and are hunting down every carbon-based organism without a microchip!

ro3_n_6_1.name: Frost and Sand
ro3_n_6_1.description: Two races living at the entrance to the land's end have appeared here in the form of husks. Perhaps the ends of both the icefield and the desert are not dissimilar.

ro3_n_6_2.name: Terminus of Life
ro3_n_6_2.description:
The existence of 'Frozen Monstrosities' is itself a warning: If you don't fight for your life, you will end up just like it.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Jetstreams> that generate airflow currents are present on the field</>

ro3_b_1.name: Blade Signifier
ro3_b_1.description:
It spreads a black carpet of death, and those unable to kill it shall walk alongside it.
<@rolv.rem>This node will always be in a regular state and node type cannot be changed</>

ro3_b_1_b.name: Breathing
ro3_b_1_b.description:
Breathe in fear, exhale despair, and so the Dominion spreads on towards Ursus.
<@rolv.rem>This node will always be in a regular state and node type cannot be changed</>

ro3_b_2.name: New Tribe
ro3_b_2.description:
A clan without a tree or a name takes form. A former leader of many still remains as chief. They are the demons' vanguard forces.
<@rolv.rem>This node will always be in a regular state and node type cannot be changed</>

ro3_b_2_b.name: Tree-Snatcher
ro3_b_2_b.description:
It draws in the husks, preparing to rot every last Sami clan tree. And afterwards, Sami will sink into nothingness.
<@rolv.rem>This node will always be in a regular state and node type cannot be changed</>

ro3_b_3.name: Nature's Wrath
ro3_b_3.description:
Lava bursts forth from Sami's surface, and the plants awake from their slumber to attack all foreign enemies. All signs point to Sami's unrestrained anger.
<@rolv.rem>This node will always be in a regular state and node type cannot be changed</>

ro3_b_3_b.name: The Earth Wakes
ro3_b_3_b.description:
The most ancient of plants have also uprooted themselves and are heading north. Perhaps, when the time is ripe, the land itself will rise up to destroy the threat from the north.
<@rolv.rem><Roadblocks> that can block the enemy's route are present on the field</>
<@rolv.rem>This node will always be in a regular state and node type cannot be changed</>

ro3_b_4.name: Lofty Silverfrost
ro3_b_4.description:
The earth rises, testing the will of those who have come. Only by gaining the earth's approval will we be able to head further north.
<@rolv.rem>This node will always be in a regular state and node type cannot be changed</>

ro3_b_4_b.name: Ice-Cold Image
ro3_b_4_b.description:
Cold and ice are merely manifestations of nature. How can the land invite you to face the unconventional enemy in the north if you can't even overcome this? 
<@rolv.rem>[Surge of Nature] becomes a <Blizzard> that inflicts Cold throughout the entire map, <Silvernwhite Bulwark> gain increased HP 
This node will always be in a regular state and node type cannot be changed</>

ro3_b_5.name: Sami's Entropy
ro3_b_5.description:
The hero of Sami has failed, and become the peoples' greatest threat. If the demons are not eliminated quickly, such a cycle will only continue until Sami is destroyed.
<@rolv.rem>This node will always be in a regular state and node type cannot be changed</>

ro3_b_5_b.name: Hollow Visage
ro3_b_5_b.description:
No matter what long-cherished aspirations this Sami hero once had, he is now but a collapsed symbol stripped of his self—just like the thousands of Ursus behind him. 
<@rolv.rem>This node will always be in a regular state and node type cannot be changed</>

ro3_b_6.name: Gardener
ro3_b_6.description:
It burrows through the cracks in the circular plate, sowing seeds of 'nothing' into things of 'being.' Driving it away will allow you to walk through the garden safe and sound, to the land's end.
<@rolv.rem>This node will always be in a regular state and node type cannot be changed</>

ro3_b_6_b.name: Sentinel
ro3_b_6_b.description:
It opens its vacuous eye, examining everything in this dimension. Only when the eye shuts will humanity get to chance a glimpse at the secret beyond the ends of the earth. 
<@rolv.rem>This node will always be in a regular state and node type cannot be changed</>

ro3_b_7.name: Sands of Time
ro3_b_7.description:
At the end of all existence, time and space have lost meaning, leaving two kings, two armies, and an endless struggle. 
<@rolv.rem>This node will always be in a regular state and node type cannot be changed</>

ro3_b_7_b.name: Enter Eternity
ro3_b_7_b.description:
The footnotes of time have been removed, and the strife bears no fruit. Their war will continue on, but where will you go? 
<@rolv.rem>This node will always be in a regular state and node type cannot be changed</>

ro3_t_1.name: Half-baked Trip
ro3_t_1.description: Encouraged by his detective uncle, he summons his courage and follows his boss to Sami. But after he accidentally gets separated from the others, he immediately returns to his original submissive persona.

ro3_t_2.name: Moneymaking from Nothing
ro3_t_2.description:
The Duck Lord manipulated these Collapsals to congregate here, roving around in a circle. A patch of land that should not be in Sami does appear dead-center in the altar, but has yet to bring any riches.
<@rolv.rem><Heat Pump Passages> that periodically deal damage to units above them are present on the field</>

ro3_t_3.name: Luxurious Fleet
ro3_t_3.description: A slew of personal bodyguards to wealthy men emerge from the cars, but you know very well the biggest threat is not them.

ro3_t_4.name: 'Envoy of Justice'
ro3_t_4.description: And thus, you let out a huge yell, and jump into a Columbian production crew currently filming on location in Sami.

ro3_ev_1.name: Halfway on Khaganquest
ro3_ev_1.description: These shadows all come from the same persistent Nightzmora. He has long since gone astray, but the shadows left by his obsession still relentlessly march northward on a punitive expedition.

ro3_ev_2.name: Long-sought Compensation
ro3_ev_2.description: The audience are not demons, so they should be able to reach that beautiful happy end in their heads. Well, at least they lived and died together, so what more can they ask for?

ro3_ev_3.name: Penalty
ro3_ev_3.description: The master of this house is clearly an expert at teaching disobedient guests a lesson.

ro3_ev_4.name: Nameless Hero
ro3_ev_4.description: After being corrupted, some powerful Sami will turn into terrifying symbols of inhumanity, wantonly scattering the seeds of nothingness. But the most threatening are the heroes who have been stripped of all their qualities and reduced to mediocrity.

ro3_ev_5.name: Rock and a Hard Place
ro3_ev_5.description: You are sure that this place has been influenced by the Collapsals. But the question is, how do you deal with invisible and intangible enemies hiding within the hearts of others?

ro3_ev_6.name: Long-term Trial
ro3_ev_6.description: You file an application with Cannot to 'try out' these items until the end of the current expedition. He doesn't seem so willing to agree? No matter, you will always have ways to make him nod.

ro3_ev_7.name: Nature's Clause
ro3_ev_7.description: You signed an agreement with Cannot without his knowledge, the terms allowing you to take all his goods. After all, nature is all about survival of the fittest, and since we're in Sami, Cannot will agree.

ro3_ev_8.name: Illusions In The Sand
ro3_ev_8.description:
The Banshee doesn't wait for your response before placing you in the heart of a desert devastated by the winds. In the distance, a golden garden seems to appear with scarlet army tents. 
<@rolv.rem>A <Sandstorm> will be blowing in a random direction, but <Reinforcement Devices> can reinforce <Dirt Mounds> to make them immune to the effects of sandstorms. This stage also has a <Detector> that can disable the Invisibility effect of nearby enemies</>

ro3_ev_9.name: Ancient Enemies
ro3_ev_9.description: Ancient nightmares appear from the gate, and there are three of them.

ro3_e_1_1.name: Prisoners' Night
ro3_e_1_1.description:
The worthless, shackled Columbian death-row inmates sink into Sami's swamp. Afterwards, the strange sound of chains being dragged on the ground can be often heard in the wetlands.
<@rolv.rem><Defensive Barricades> that can block the enemy's route are present on the field</>
ro3_e_1_1.eliteDesc: Condition: More Elite enemies will appear, and enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP

ro3_e_1_2.name: Ghosts of the Resort
ro3_e_1_2.description: The elder brother drowned in the bathtub, the younger brother choked to death on an apple, the mercenary guarding the door was impaled by thorns, and this house was abandoned.
ro3_e_1_2.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new Elite enemies will appear

ro3_e_1_3.name: Hands of Moss
ro3_e_1_3.description: Handprints made of moss appear on walls, tree trunks, and clothing. The Siracusan Mafia's favorite way of leaving their mark has shown up in Sami, in a unique form.
ro3_e_1_3.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new Elite enemies will appear

ro3_e_1_4.name: Beasts Awaiting Slaughter
ro3_e_1_4.description: At some point, the leader of the beast pack was replaced by a monster of a human. The beasts tremble with fear, but still they obey the boss's orders.
ro3_e_1_4.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP; and more enemies will appear

ro3_e_1_5.name: No More Than Four
ro3_e_1_5.description: Following three, preceding five—a certain number has become taboo here. The mere mention enrages those present, and they will vent their anger with violence.
ro3_e_1_5.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new Elite enemies will appear

ro3_e_2_1.name: Path with No End
ro3_e_2_1.description: Outsiders find it hard to distinguish Sami's environments, so they walk circles through what they believe are the same areas over and over, never finding an exit.
ro3_e_2_1.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased DEF, HP, and Movement Speed

ro3_e_2_2.name: Low-Altitude Maneuvering
ro3_e_2_2.description:
This patch of forest has been transformed into a low-altitude flight test site, and the person in charge warmly invites you and your research team to participate in their maneuvering exercise.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Jetstreams> that generate airflow currents are present on the field</>
ro3_e_2_2.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK and HP; new Elite enemies will appear

ro3_e_2_3.name: Shadows With Ghosts
ro3_e_2_3.description: The projector left behind in the forest occasionally reflects a few familiar looking phantoms, but no one notices, and one by one the shadows walk out of the device and into the forest.
ro3_e_2_3.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK and HP; new Elite enemies will appear

ro3_e_2_4.name: Unwell
ro3_e_2_4.description:
It's said that there will always be someone on the team who the others don't care for, and they will be quietly replaced as the squad walks a few extra rounds through the mountain forest, their teammates completely unaware.
<@rolv.rem><Roadside Emergency Reserves> that grant Max DP are present on the field</>
ro3_e_2_4.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new Elite enemies will appear

ro3_e_2_5.name: Don't Turn Around, Sluggies
ro3_e_2_5.description: The Originium slugs crawl forward, completely unaware that something is following them from behind.
ro3_e_2_5.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP; and more enemies will appear

ro3_e_2_6.name: Payback
ro3_e_2_6.description:
Many years ago, foreigners devastated the woods with heavy machinery. Many years later, foreigners flee the woods frightened by phantom rumbling. 
<@rolv.rem>There are <Command Terminals> on the map that will deplete Life Points when destroyed</>
ro3_e_2_6.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK and HP, ally and Command Terminal SP Cost increased

ro3_e_3_1.name: Pretense Turned True
ro3_e_3_1.description: Don't spread lies in Sami. When someone takes one as truth, it becomes reality.
ro3_e_3_1.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK and HP; new Elite enemies will appear

ro3_e_3_2.name: Altar of Craving
ro3_e_3_2.description:
It is precisely because of the fuel it extracts from every passerby that this Sarkaz altar has thus far been able to operate unattended.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Altars> that deal damage to both allies and enemies are present on the field</>
ro3_e_3_2.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased HP and Movement Speed; the configuration of devices on this stage will be changed

ro3_e_3_3.name: Crafty Beasts' Nine-Caves
ro3_e_3_3.description: There is a kind of wild beast that, according to rumors, prepares nine exits in its lair for escape purposes. But the problem right now is that you're stuck in its den and don't know where the enemy will emerge from.
ro3_e_3_3.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have greatly increased ATK, DEF, and HP

ro3_e_3_4.name: Shady Frozen Sea
ro3_e_3_4.description:
You're certainly aware that the ocean and sailors won't show up on the icefield, and yet you don't think anything is off. Cognitive errors are the most common Collapsal Paradigm to manifest.
<@rolv.rem><Corrosive Ground> tiles that reduce the DEF of allied units by half are present on the field</>
ro3_e_3_4.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have greatly increased ATK, DEF, HP, and Movement Speed

ro3_e_3_5.name: So Close and Yet So Far
ro3_e_3_5.description: The relative distances between the mountains have been folded and stretched. What originally would take only a single step to reach now takes a long time.
ro3_e_3_5.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP

ro3_e_3_6.name: Rational Fracture
ro3_e_3_6.description: The enemy in front of you is moving so fast they resemble a high-latency image. You fret over how to deal with the matter, but just as you're about to scratch your head, you realize the hand you just raised is already on your back.
ro3_e_3_6.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new Elite enemies will appear

ro3_e_3_7.name: Harass With Strength
ro3_e_3_7.description: Five lumberjacks got together and cursed their fellow workers to turn into slugs. The good news is that the workers did indeed become Originium Slugs. The bad news is that they will never get to see humanity ever again.
ro3_e_3_7.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP. Additionally, the abilities of certain enemies are enhanced

ro3_e_4_1.name: Company Entanglement
ro3_e_4_1.description: Even though Columbia's tech giants have signed a contract for a joint-expedition of the icefield, their long-standing grievances will inevitably have some wanting to employ unfair means to attack their rivals.
ro3_e_4_1.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new Elite enemies will appear

ro3_e_4_2.name: Practical Test
ro3_e_4_2.description:
This Rhine research station is currently stress-testing their technology in the cold environment. Your team has the privilege to be among the first batch of practical testers.
<@rolv.rem><Power Armors> that activate by absorbing experimental products are present on the field</>
ro3_e_4_2.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased DEF and HP; new Elite enemies will appear

ro3_e_4_3.name: Collapsals' Afternoon
ro3_e_4_3.description:
You feel as if your team resembles a giant Originium slug that has been dropped onto a beach in Dossoles, and those Collapsals were originally tourists here on vacation.
<@rolv.rem><Corrosive Ground> tiles that reduce allied units's DEF by half are present on the field</>
ro3_e_4_3.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased HP, ASPD, and attack range

ro3_e_4_4.name: The Big Migration
ro3_e_4_4.description: The animals just want to avoid the disasters in the north, and you're the only thing standing in their way to the south.
ro3_e_4_4.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new Elite enemies will appear

ro3_e_4_5.name: Defense Substituting Offense
ro3_e_4_5.description:
The husks have you trapped within a heavily battered fortress, but perhaps the resources scattered around here might let you survive this next wave of attacks.
<@rolv.rem><Roadblocks> that can block the enemy's route are present on the field</>
ro3_e_4_5.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased HP; new Elite enemies will appear

ro3_e_4_6.name: Noise Disturbance
ro3_e_4_6.description:
Ever since you got communication access on the icefield, you've always been able to hear a handful of nonsense words mixed in with the other person talking, but you didn't take it seriously—until the other expedition team took you for a pack of beasts.
<@rolv.rem><Mobile Tactical Hangars> that deploy enemy mercenary drones are present on the field</>
ro3_e_4_6.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK and HP; new Elite enemies will appear

ro3_e_4_7.name: Restricted Zone
ro3_e_4_7.description:
Ursus will not listen to your excuses: as long as you enter their established restricted area, they will use force to expel you.
<@rolv.rem><Bushes> that prevent allied units from being targeted by ranged enemy attacks are present on the field</>
ro3_e_4_7.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new Elite enemies will appear

ro3_e_4_8.name: Where Ice Condenses
ro3_e_4_8.description: As long as there is even a trace of warmth flowing in your veins, you should not come here. For this place is only for the cold-blooded.
ro3_e_4_8.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP. Certain enemies are also Invisible

ro3_e_5_1.name: Musical Disaster
ro3_e_5_1.description:
The tragically distorted tunes and sounds have become the group that in your mind best understands the music. They will use this string removed from the score to slice you up alive.
<@rolv.rem>Allied units have their natural SP recovery speed reduced by <Waste Energy Interference>, but can be restored to normal with <Realigned Flux></>
ro3_e_5_1.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK and HP; new Elite enemies will appear

ro3_e_5_2.name: Stay Away From Strangers
ro3_e_5_2.description:
Trees rotting in the ground, steel and dead flies in the sky. Life is not welcome here.
<@rolv.rem><Twigs That Crave> that produce Rot Eaters are present on the field</>
ro3_e_5_2.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP; the configuration of devices on this stage will be changed

ro3_e_5_3.name: Confusing Appearance
ro3_e_5_3.description: Don't be deceived by their irregular appearance. Hold onto your thoughts and the battlefront, and don't give them an opening.
ro3_e_5_3.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new Elite enemies will appear

ro3_e_5_4.name: Requested Enemies Obtained
ro3_e_5_4.description: When you see a group of indistinct shadows on the icefield from a distance, never imagine the worst case scenario. After all, you don't want your 'Wish Fulfilled' in such an environment.
ro3_e_5_4.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased HP and Movement Speed; unable to deploy on some tiles

ro3_e_5_5.name: March of the Dead
ro3_e_5_5.description: Your most life-enriching understanding of death comes from the never resting Dublinn army.
ro3_e_5_5.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new Elite enemies will appear

ro3_e_5_6.name: Where be No Mounts and Seas
ro3_e_5_6.description:
The land is vast, the sea is endless, and Feranmuts naturally exist in places other than Yan. So these people cross the snowcapped mountains and sail the rivers, all to look for the ancient beings hiding in the cracks.
<@rolv.rem><Shanhaizhong Cipher Machines> that strengthen enemies are present on the field</>
ro3_e_5_6.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, DEF, HP, and stronger skills

ro3_e_5_7.name: Instinct Contamination
ro3_e_5_7.description:
The husks treat all living things equally.
<@rolv.rem><Active Originium> tiles that cause units on them to gradually lose HP but greatly increases their ATK and ASPD are present on the field</>
ro3_e_5_7.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP; unable to deploy on some tiles

ro3_e_5_8.name: Manmade Carnival
ro3_e_5_8.description: The living stay away! Non-persons also stay away! The machines have become their own masters, and are hunting down every carbon-based organism without a microchip!
ro3_e_5_8.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK and HP, and greatly increased DEF and RES

ro3_e_6_1.name: Frost and Sand
ro3_e_6_1.description: Two races living at the entrance to the land's end have appeared here in the form of husks. Perhaps the ends of both the icefield and the desert are not dissimilar.
ro3_e_6_1.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, DEF, HP, and Movement Speed

ro3_e_6_2.name: Terminus of Life
ro3_e_6_2.description:
The existence of 'Frozen Monstrosities' is itself a warning: If you don't fight for your life, you will end up just like it.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Jetstreams> that generate airflow currents are present on the field</>
ro3_e_6_2.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK, RES, HP, and attack range

zone_1.name: Brisk Marshlands
zone_1.description: From here you step into nature. Pure white snow falls onto the water, a chill breeze pushes your boat, and roaming around always makes one lose track of time.
zone_1.endingDescription: The giant tree roots form a harsh suggestion that you have drifted too far off, and nature has not yet become your friend.

zone_2.name: Placid Forests
zone_2.description: The Hornbeasts in the thick forest lie down, inviting the visitors to rest together. The pitch-black shadows of the trees silently stain the snow, but the prey is completely unaware.
zone_2.endingDescription: The lost expeditioner tumbles into the abyssal depths of the woods, their compass no longer able to point the way forward.

zone_3.name: Dawning Frostbounds
zone_3.description: The bitter cold pierces through your marrow, with the forest gradually thinning as the black tundra separates the sparse specks of light. The roadmap is already blank, and whose guidance can we trust?
zone_3.endingDescription: The expeditioner was once walking in a blur, and now tumbles into the permafrost. Sami speaks of only one, yet also final, prophecy concerning you.

zone_4.name: Gelid Rockshelves
zone_4.description: The expeditioners' line of sight has been cut off by the darkness of the north. Resilient Sami lifts Its mountain range as the cold, stone-hearted warriors construct towering walls. Do you still wish to continue onward?
zone_4.endingDescription: The courage to cross the boundary may be dismissed as foolhardy by ordinary people, but nature never says a word, no matter what it takes in.

zone_5.name: Immaculate Garden
zone_5.description: Across the mountains, life is silent. Since antiquity, the solid ice has sealed up countless lives, propagating flower-like crystals.
zone_5.endingDescription: There is no need to hammer again with your staff of ice. You have already fallen deep inside, covered by the shadows along with the past, and the icefield will never end.

zone_6.name: Clairvoyant Carcass
zone_6.description:
An inescapable fate has stood at the end of the icefield for a long time, 
and now, everyone can see it.
zone_6.endingDescription: That vision to you, is still the future.

zone_7.name: Dust of Eternity
zone_7.description: Finite lives measure infinite time, the expeditioners' footsteps lifting sand and dust from antiquity.
zone_7.endingDescription: A grain of sand is still too heavy. You have never anticipated nor regretted this.

zone_s_2_1a_1.name: Secluded Passage
zone_s_2_1a_1.description:
A remote corner of the deep forest ushers in yet another batch of visitors. Nature never welcomes them, but never refuses them either.
In this place, allied units have <color=#9ed9fd>increased HP and ATK</color>, but <color=#9ed9fd>a large amount of [Dominion]</color> will appear in battles
zone_s_2_1a_1.buffDescription: Allied units have <color=#9ed9fd>increased HP and ATK</color>, but a <color=#9ed9fd>large amount of [Dominion]</color> will appear in battles
zone_s_2_1a_1.endingDescription: And thus, as you fall into the soil, as you turn into nourishment, nature still chooses to stand by and watch.
