scene_ro3_sacrifice1_enter.title: Lowland Market
scene_ro3_sacrifice1_enter.description: A huge clan tree sits submerged in a swamp, with Sami traders all over the trunks, the roots, and by the banks. Branches move back and forth between the stalls, as animals cry out to peddle goods or transmit information. Wooden puppets trudge between the ground and swamp to store their cargo. Everything just feels so exotic!

scene_ro3_sacrifice1_1.title: Lowland Market
scene_ro3_sacrifice1_1.description: A small musbeast on a branch takes away the item you offered in its mouth before returning with some goods from within the branches for you to choose from.

scene_ro3_sacrifice1_2.title: Lowland Market
scene_ro3_sacrifice1_2.description: A puppet fully covered in vines emerges from the swamp and takes away your item as it also drags a chest out from the water, placing the item you picked inside.

scene_ro3_sacrifice1_3.title: Lowland Market
scene_ro3_sacrifice1_3.description: A shaman manipulates a branch as he walks down it, and takes away the item you brought to trade. As he recites a spell, the branches bring you some precious goods for you to choose.

scene_ro3_sacrifice1_4.title: Lowland Market
scene_ro3_sacrifice1_4.description: You obtain much needed supplies from the Sami people and can now continue your expedition. Before you leave, you let an accompanying research team member take a few more photos, so you'll have something to silence your skeptical associates with when you brag about this later.

scene_ro3_sacrifice1_5.title: Lowland Market
scene_ro3_sacrifice1_5.description: This place is just too strange, so you quickly urge the research team members to leave.

scene_ro3_sacrifice1_6.title: Lowland Market
scene_ro3_sacrifice1_6.description: You see a shaman apprentice being pestered in the market and decide to help him out. As you talk, you learn about him and his tribe. Seeing your interest in their history, the apprentice ponders for a moment before handing you the two Foldartals he's holding. He does not know how to decipher them, so he decides to ask you to bring them to their leader.

scene_ro3_sacrifice1_7.title: Lowland Market
scene_ro3_sacrifice1_7.description: A burdenbeast by the pier raises its head and roars loudly. It is a ship heading off to war, and a group of Sami warriors are already seated onboard. You join them as the boat sails down the narrow tributary towards the battlefield.

scene_ro3_sacrifice1_8.title: Lowland Market
scene_ro3_sacrifice1_8.description: The horn erected on the main trunk of the clan tree only sounds when the market is in danger. Warriors who respond to the call will be handsomely rewarded.

scene_ro3_sacrifice1a_enter.title: Fence of Wood and Snow
scene_ro3_sacrifice1a_enter.description: In a corner of Sami lies a clearing surrounded by snow-covered thorns, and you don't know when exactly you ended up inside. The light of the twin moons descend from the sky, and although it gives off no heat, it is as dazzling as the sun. You search for shade from the bright light, but find only an old tree/a human/a giant crow. While they are far from you, their shadow reaches your feet. You need only offer a word as tribute and you will receive their shelter. You blurt out—

scene_ro3_sacrifice1a_1.title: Fence of Wood and Snow
scene_ro3_sacrifice1a_1.description: The word pops out of your mouth before you can think, and in your hands lie the very item you want to trade with. 'The value of the past ends right here. What do you want?'

scene_ro3_sacrifice1a_2.title: Fence of Wood and Snow
scene_ro3_sacrifice1a_2.description: The word pops out of your mouth before you can think, and in your hands lie the very item you want to trade with. 'The value of the present sparkles bright. What do you desire?'

scene_ro3_sacrifice1a_3.title: Fence of Wood and Snow
scene_ro3_sacrifice1a_3.description: The word pops out of your mouth before you can think, and in your hands lie the very item you want to trade with. 'The value of the future is unpredictable. What do you wish for?'

scene_ro3_sacrifice1a_4.title: Fence of Wood and Snow
scene_ro3_sacrifice1a_4.description: The value has already been determined. You walk into the shadow, and up next to your teammates.

scene_ro3_sacrifice1a_5.title: Fence of Wood and Snow
scene_ro3_sacrifice1a_5.description: The word pops out of your mouth before you can think, and it represents your lack of understanding of Sami. And so, the thorns reach out from the snow, pushing you back to your teammates.

scene_ro3_sacrifice1a_6.title: Fence of Wood and Snow
scene_ro3_sacrifice1a_6.description: The word pops out of your mouth before you can think, and afterwards you walk into the shadow. You walk towards the three-in-one being, but at the end find a wooden door half ajar. You enter, and are back with your teammates. The two door panels turn into Foldartals, and fall into your hands.

scene_ro3_sacrifice1a_7.title: Fence of Wood and Snow
scene_ro3_sacrifice1a_7.description: The word pops out of your mouth before you can think, but as you walk into the shadows, enemies appear from within.

scene_ro3_sacrifice1a_8.title: Fence of Wood and Snow
scene_ro3_sacrifice1a_8.description: The word pops out of your mouth before you can think, and just as you consider stepping into the shadow, you realize enemies are already ready and waiting, illuminated by the moonlight.

scene_ro3_sacrifice2_enter.title: Ammataru
scene_ro3_sacrifice2_enter.description: You had thought this was just another path made by a beast, but halfway through you realize your companions are not your team members, but a herd of hornbeasts. At the end of the path is a huge white hornbeast sleeping soundly in a flower bed. The hornbeasts frolic and graze around It, and a spring flows right by Its side. A thought suddenly pops into your mind—It does not live here, but the woodland exists because It rests here.

scene_ro3_sacrifice2_1.title: Ammataru
scene_ro3_sacrifice2_1.description: The white hornbeast's ear twitches, and the symbols on the wood carving dissolve into nothing. It accepts your offering, and now what you want is—

scene_ro3_sacrifice2_2.title: Ammataru
scene_ro3_sacrifice2_2.description: The white hornbeast's tail swings, and the symbols on the wood carving dissolve into nothing. It accepts your offering, and now what you want is—

scene_ro3_sacrifice2_3.title: Ammataru
scene_ro3_sacrifice2_3.description: The white hornbeast's eyes open. Its pupils are clear and pure, making you momentarily forget everything as you stand there staring blankly at Its. When you come to your senses, It has already closed Its eyes, and the symbols on the wood carving dissolve into nothing. It accepts your offering, and now what you want is—

scene_ro3_sacrifice2_4.title: Ammataru
scene_ro3_sacrifice2_4.description: You offer devotion, and receive favor. When you wake from your dream, the other research team members are busy with their own affairs, not disturbing your rest.

scene_ro3_sacrifice2_5.title: Ammataru
scene_ro3_sacrifice2_5.description: Not wanting to disturb the hornbeast's rest, you sample a taste of the springwater flowing by Its side. It is so sweet and fresh that the misery within you seems to abate a bit. Just as you are savoring the sweetness, you are shaken awake by a teammate next to you. It seems that everything that just happened was just a dream.

scene_ro3_sacrifice2_6.title: Ammataru
scene_ro3_sacrifice2_6.description: After you ask your question, the hornbeast's antlers, adorned with ice crystals, begin to shed, and the fragments fall to your feet. You are about to express your thanks, but you lift your head and realize that before you is an accompanying shaman, not a hornbeast. The revelations from your dream fall into your hands, becoming two ominous Foldartals.

scene_ro3_sacrifice2_7.title: Ammataru
scene_ro3_sacrifice2_7.description: There is a stifling aura at the edge of the woodland, and dark shadows slowly draw near. You step forward, ready to teach these uninvited guests a lesson, as if defending It is as important as defending yourself.

scene_ro3_sacrifice2_8.title: Ammataru
scene_ro3_sacrifice2_8.description: The edge of the woodland is dotted with flames, a sign of people preparing to hunt It down. You draw your weapon and walk towards these uninvited guests, not quite sure why you've stepped forward to defend a wild beast. Perhaps you subconsciously believe that protecting It is its own reward.

scene_ro3_ent1_enter.title: Northwizard Cup
scene_ro3_ent1_enter.description: Every clan is here! Even those who have stumbled in are welcome. After sharing a number of stories, jokes, and treesap juice, the Sami suddenly fall silent as a few men clearly dressed like snowpriests solemnly walk into the woods. The Sami host of this gathering approaches you and asks in a methodical tone if you would like to 'choose a fighter.' Behind him is a group of grotesque 'giants' being driven out of the woods by the snowpriests.

scene_ro3_ent1_1.title: Northwizard Cup
scene_ro3_ent1_1.description: 'Beastly Hornfels' wins the fight, sending 'Behemoss' flat on its back with a single punch, the moss from the latter's body scattering everywhere! The puppet you chose has won! The host laughs heartily as they give you your prize.

scene_ro3_ent1_2.title: Northwizard Cup
scene_ro3_ent1_2.description: 'Treebrows' swings its body, dodging a huge lump of snow thrown by 'Big Blizz' before jogging up close to its opponent and performing a nimble somersault, using the weight of its legs to knock the other puppet to the ground—you didn't see that one coming! The puppet you chose has won! The host laughs heartily as they give you your prize, this time with more edible agglomerates and gels.

scene_ro3_ent1_3.title: Northwizard Cup
scene_ro3_ent1_3.description: Foldartal sigils appear on the clay palms of 'Hothands Sidan'! They're clearly radiating heat! Its fiery fists slap the stuffing out of 'Othermetal Azag,' sending sparks everywhere! The puppet you chose has won! The host laughs heartily as they give you your prizes, and you're surprised to find a micro-operation platform among them.

scene_ro3_ent1_4.title: Northwizard Cup
scene_ro3_ent1_4.description: 'Old Björn' hobbles and totters, on the verge of collapse like a fowlbeast nest made of withered branches, but it suddenly unleashes its power, pushing down 'Walking Stonewall' and pummeling it furiously! The puppet you chose has won! Almost no one else here expected this result! The young girl controlling 'Old Björn' heaves a sigh of relief. 'She just took over the reins recently, but she's done such a great job!' The host shouts as they hand you the grand prize, their voice almost drowned out by the roar of the audience.

scene_ro3_ent1_5.title: Northwizard Cup
scene_ro3_ent1_5.description: For just a moment, you think your chosen battle puppet is going to win, but 'Gatekeeper Helma' uses its ability to lift the snow and dirt off the ground, and ultimately comes out on top. The host shrugs at you before approaching with a smile, waiting for you to speak.

scene_ro3_ent1_6.title: Northwizard Cup
scene_ro3_ent1_6.description: The gigantic battle puppet is wholly unexhausted, and the winning snowpriest controller brandishes their wooden staff proudly. 'Next! Let's have another bout!' You can't help but feel closer to these uncharacteristically yelling and whistling Sami. The host hands you the roster again while laughing—the entire gathering no longer holds any sense of solemnity.

scene_ro3_ent1_7.title: Northwizard Cup
scene_ro3_ent1_7.description: You leave the clan gathering grounds, and from your back come the sounds of tree trunks crashing into the soil and hearty laughter of the people.

scene_ro3_ent1_8.title: Northwizard Cup
scene_ro3_ent1_8.description: If you can't beat them, join them! This time you've chosen 'Gatekeeper Helma'! And you win! You viciously jab your fist skyward, as if unleashing everything towards it. The host taps your shoulder and smiles, saying the prizes are ready, but fun should be enjoyed in moderation, so maybe it's time you hit the road. You look at your prizes, and realize they are even more sumptuous than what was promised before.

scene_ro3_ent2_enter.title: Best Buddies
scene_ro3_ent2_enter.description: 'Listen to me, my dear friend...' Far away from a tribal bonfire gathering, you see a Sami man drinking alone with his arm around a tree. He sees you approaching, and asks the tree beside him with an evasive look in his eyes: 'Do you mind getting to know a stranger? No? Alright.'

scene_ro3_ent2_1.title: Best Buddies
scene_ro3_ent2_1.description: Well, maybe they really are a pair of good friends, or maybe this local just wants a silent and reliable target to vent his feelings on, but either way, this land has its own customs and you should proceed with caution.

scene_ro3_ent2_2.title: Best Buddies
scene_ro3_ent2_2.description: He tells the story of a warrior in his tribe who sacrificed himself, but halfway through you realize the man he mentions is actually 'alive' in the tribe. Whether it be from the alcohol or the story, you find yourself starting to sweat.

scene_ro3_ent2_3.title: Best Buddies
scene_ro3_ent2_3.description: As your tongue experiences a marvelous flavor, you slightly regret drinking the wine so quickly... You want to complain about how unpleasant it is to drink this type of wine, but your drinking partner doesn't even look up at your face, and only clumsily pours you another drink.

scene_ro3_ent2_4.title: Best Buddies
scene_ro3_ent2_4.description: He tells the story of a bedridden elder in the tribe who was picked up by a hornbeast and spent his last moments in the highest reaches of the forest. After he finishes his tale, he pats the tree beside him, and asks it to lift him up too before he dies, and take him someplace high to look at the sun.

scene_ro3_ent2_5.title: Best Buddies
scene_ro3_ent2_5.description: He tells the story of a Columbian trader passing by the tribe who had an unfortunate encounter with a tuskbeast. You follow the direction he mentions and find one of the trader's goods under the snow, but the obvious traces of Sami spells left nearby raise your suspicions.

scene_ro3_ent2_6.title: Best Buddies
scene_ro3_ent2_6.description: When you regain consciousness, you find yourself curled up in a ball on the ground, and the only thing you remember is that you seem to have drunk too much in one go. The Sami man throws a quick glance at you, tosses something over, and then turns back to continue his chat with the tree.

scene_ro3_ent2_8.title: Best Buddies
scene_ro3_ent2_8.description: You bid farewell to the Sami man, who never looked at you from start to finish, only spreading both hands out to the tree beside him and asking his tree friend to send him home. As soon as he finishes speaking, a branch clatters to the ground beside him.

scene_ro3_ent2_7.title: Best Buddies
scene_ro3_ent2_7.description: 'I can tell you another secret... it doesn't matter if someone else is listening in, that person isn't local, so they can't understand what I'm saying.' The Sami man takes another large swig of wine and continues rambling to the tree.

scene_ro3_ent3_enter.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_ent3_enter.description: The research team has found a large and deep cave. It looks like a regular cavern, and looking down you can see a variety of strange plants and symbols. The team members are extremely excited, and hope to get your permission to use the Survey Equipment to probe the cave's extremities.

scene_ro3_ent3_1.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_ent3_1.description: If the survey equipment is exhausted here, you soon won't even be able to find your way back, so you decisively reject the team's request.

scene_ro3_ent3_2.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_ent3_2.description: You try it out on a spot at the edge of the cave, and accidentally discover a box of precious metals! Now this is true value, much more tangible than some vague exploration of the unknown.

scene_ro3_ent3_3.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_ent3_3.description: Nothing much appears on the display other than a flat and smooth wall. The team members are clueless as to why.

scene_ro3_ent3_4.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_ent3_4.description: Some plants you've never seen before appear on the display. They are clinging to the rock walls, entangled each other in a mesh-like formation, and seem to be patching up the hole. Some of the team members are already thinking of the economic value they could generate.

scene_ro3_ent3_5.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_ent3_5.description: Some irregular bumps on the rocky surface appear on the display. Mucus-like secretions are gushing out of these bumps, flowing down the rock wall. Some of the team members record the relative position of the survey equipment and take some samples of the secretions.

scene_ro3_ent3_6.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_ent3_6.description: A bunch of symbols in an unfamiliar style appear on the display. These symbols flicker on and off, maintaining a steady rhythm like breathing. Some of the team members take out their notebooks and begin to ponder the symbols' meaning.

scene_ro3_ent3_7.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_ent3_7.description: The survey effort pauses temporarily as the research team members start comparing and studying the freshly obtained data, speculating on how this huge cave formed.

scene_ro3_ent3_8.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_ent3_8.description: Piecing together the clues eventually has the team digging up an artifact at the cave's edge. The container storing the object is made of an organic polymer biomaterial. There is no civilization on Terra capable of making such a material, so could this... possibly be a prehistoric remnant?

scene_ro3_ent3_9.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_ent3_9.description: After the equipment cools down, the research team jumps back into action, eager to request permission to use the device again.

scene_ro3_ent3_10.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_ent3_10.description: The equipment is still working, and the research team members stare nervously at the screen.

scene_ro3_res1_enter.title: Auspicious Sign
scene_ro3_res1_enter.description: You discover a colony of musbeasts in a clearing. The little white creatures are bunched up together like a woolen quilt. Your presence has not scared them away, and on the contrary, you have a vague sense that they're actually inviting you.

scene_ro3_res1_1.title: Auspicious Sign
scene_ro3_res1_1.description: You have a great time holding many tiny paws with fur stuck down your neck. After a while, the musbeasts disperse, leaving behind something shiny where the 'woolen quilt' used to be.

scene_ro3_res1_2.title: Auspicious Sign
scene_ro3_res1_2.description: Even through your coldproof gear, you can fully feel the softness and warmth. You spend the afternoon lying down on the ground, thinking about the sky, the forest, the snowy mountains, the land, and do nothing else.

scene_ro3_res2_enter.title: Rain!
scene_ro3_res2_enter.description:
'It's black rain...
'We just finished harvesting a few samples,' the man says in a numb voice, 'but now both my samples and equipment are destroyed, and my people have run away... What do I do about the money I owe the company?'

scene_ro3_res2_1.title: Rain!
scene_ro3_res2_1.description: The equipment is intact, untouched by the rain. But the man seems to be seeing a different scene, and he pushes you away, asking you to take whatever you want and leave quickly. You try persuading him a few more times, but he ignores you completely.

scene_ro3_res2_2.title: Rain!
scene_ro3_res2_2.description: There is not even a single drop of water on his equipment, and it works perfectly. But the man seems to be seeing a different scene, and he pushes you away, asking you to take whatever you want and leave quickly. You try persuading him a few more times, but he ignores you completely.

scene_ro3_res3_enter.title: Grab and Go
scene_ro3_res3_enter.description: To your knowledge, the hunters and scouts from the local tribes often travel through the forests and snowfields in groups, working for weeks out in the countryside. They dig burrows in the ground and hollow out tree trunks to store emergency supplies in. According to their customs, these supplies can be accessed as needed—the forest itself will whisper the locations of these stashes to Sami hunters. But you are different, you don't need to hear the trees' voices, for you have equipment and instruments.

scene_ro3_res3_1.title: Grab and Go
scene_ro3_res3_1.description: The probe finds a cavity, and the 'geometry' on the device's display is clearly the boxes stacked in front of you: some wooden, some weaved, and some plastic. You and your companions are not in any dire need for supplies, but the locals' cold soup is so delicious that—as someone who has been living off of soup gels and fat cubes on your journey—you have to try it.

scene_ro3_res3_2.title: Grab and Go
scene_ro3_res3_2.description: You feel around the tree trunk and soon press on a loose piece of bark. Stacks of Foldartals are hidden in its hollow. According to your guide, they are 'all of the same type, and grow hot just by rubbing them with your hands.' Each of you takes one, and many still remain.

scene_ro3_res4_enter.title: Regular Maintenance
scene_ro3_res4_enter.description: Contrary to what southerners may imagine, there aren't actually many sunny days on the snowy plains—and this is one of those days. You and your companions seize the opportunity to conduct an inspection, setting up various instruments and equipment with everyone helping out. On a distant snowfield are mangler cubs frolicking with their prey, and a herd of hornbeasts on a migration.

scene_ro3_res4_1.title: Regular Maintenance
scene_ro3_res4_1.description: The locator shows that you're heading in the right direction, but the communicator is unresponsive, indicating that you've left the coverage range of the few base stations in Sami. All in all, no bad news.

scene_ro3_res4_2.title: Regular Maintenance
scene_ro3_res4_2.description: Everything seems fine—and then you remember this telescope is not for 'viewing' and take out your binoculars. You see the herd heading your way; they're looking for moss, and the place you're going doesn't have any, so this means you're both heading in the right directions.

scene_ro3_res4_3.title: Regular Maintenance
scene_ro3_res4_3.description: The equipment inspection and heading verification go without a hitch, and even the canned soup is letting off steam when you open it. You and your companions feel today has been a really lucky day. It would be great if tomorrow could be just like it—you're willing to pay any price for that. Silver snowflakes drift by, and it suddenly occurs to you that you may have already paid your price for today.

scene_ro3_res5_enter.title: A Dark Room
scene_ro3_res5_enter.description:
Following the directions left by a snowpriest on their deathbed, you find a hut lodged in the wind and snow. Your companions switch on their searchlights, but the darkness is barely dispelled. You notice traces of a snowpriest spell lingering on the light's edge. Just what did they fight here? 
The doors suddenly slam shut.

scene_ro3_res5_1.title: A Dark Room
scene_ro3_res5_1.description: Ever since you came to Sami, you've learned to trust your intuition, and especially your bad hunches.

scene_ro3_res5_2.title: A Dark Room
scene_ro3_res5_2.description:
It is quiet all around you with no movement, and you bend down to pick up a few coins lying at your feet. Then, you find it increasingly difficult to breathe, and realize you might have misunderstood what the snowpriest meant by pointing in this direction. You shut the door out of an irrational fear of suffocating. 
A gust of wind blows into the hut, but for a long time you hear only silence.

scene_ro3_res5_3.title: A Dark Room
scene_ro3_res5_3.description: An inexplicable panic grips the room, but you and your companions keep silent. You realize that some supplies have been left here, and perhaps you can find something useful for the research team.

scene_ro3_res5_4.title: A Dark Room
scene_ro3_res5_4.description:
You push open a door to find a safe room, the objects within seemingly well preserved. 
——This is how you explain where the object in your hand came from, but your companions all look at you with strange expressions. 
'There was no room or door there.'

scene_ro3_res5_5.title: A Dark Room
scene_ro3_res5_5.description: As you hold your device up to the wall, you confirm some kind of energy signal is getting picked up, stable and continuous. You and your companions then examine the entire room, but remain confused by the signals randomly distributed around the room. Eventually you choose to avoid spots with stronger signals and take some safer-looking objects with you to continue your journey.

scene_ro3_res2a_enter.title: Ceremony of Healing
scene_ro3_res2a_enter.description: This funerary fleet is performing some sort of rite. Drums beat to a rhythm as people bend down to kiss the water, whispering prayers for the spirits and the sun's rays. The host invites you to do as the locals do.

scene_ro3_res2a_1.title: Ceremony of Healing
scene_ro3_res2a_1.description: After the ceremony concludes, you learn that in recent years the locals have been disturbed by huge shadows in their dreams. Can a rite like this really improve their situation? Before you can voice your doubts, you feel dizzy from the water you drank. The locals burst into laughter, and give you an item as compensation.

scene_ro3_res2a_2.title: Ceremony of Healing
scene_ro3_res2a_2.description: After the ceremony concludes, you learn that in recent years the locals have been disturbed by huge shadows in their dreams. Can a rite like this really improve their situation? As soon as you make your question, you feel dizzy from the water you drank. The locals are quite critical of your attitude, but give you an item as a token of their care.

scene_ro3_res2a_3.title: Ceremony of Healing
scene_ro3_res2a_3.description: The ice-cold water wets your lips and you suddenly feel relaxed, as though you've never experienced such a peaceful moment ever since you set foot on Sami soil. You want to understand the science of the ritual by analyzing the water's properties, but the equipment falls into the water as you quietly try to take a sample. All the locals look up at you, and you know that you should leave at once.

scene_ro3_res2a_4.title: Ceremony of Healing
scene_ro3_res2a_4.description: You have heard of this rite that calms the mind and grants courage against evil spirits, but you still don't know what exactly these evil spirits the Sami see really are. Confident in the research team's equipment and supplies, you decline their invitation.

scene_ro3_res3a_enter.title: Black Footprints
scene_ro3_res3a_enter.description: Your teeth are chattering. Dead beasts, countless dead beasts, dirty snow covering their bodies. Intuition tells you not to go any further in this direction, but you are unable to free your legs from the quagmire of fear. You don't know how long you spend standing there until the burly local warriors have you surrounded.

scene_ro3_res3a_1.title: Black Footprints
scene_ro3_res3a_1.description: You share with these warriors all you know about this threat, the menace that has already roamed for hundred of miles—and perhaps beyond—blackening the snowfields as it goes. From their pensive expressions, these Sami seem to know what it is, but determinedly refuse to divulge even a word to you. They give you some supplies in return.

scene_ro3_res3a_2.title: Black Footprints
scene_ro3_res3a_2.description: Your equipment has been damaged, and you're unable to fight off even a single hornbeast on your own. The Sami warriors take a good look at you, and without a word bring you back to their tribe. After ingesting several herbs provided by the locals, you slowly regain your composure.

scene_ro3_res3a_3.title: Black Footprints
scene_ro3_res3a_3.description: Run, run, run. The Sami's arrows graze you, and all you can think of is getting away from that snow, fleeing in the opposite direction of those traces of filth.

scene_ro3_res3a_4.title: Black Footprints
scene_ro3_res3a_4.description: They see you as a poacher, as the equipment and instruments on you are beyond suspicious in their eyes. Just what have they gone through to treat all outsiders with such violence? But now, you have no time to think about it.

scene_ro3_res5a_enter.title: Unfreezing River
scene_ro3_res5a_enter.description: You unconsciously take a step back when you see the river. It seems to have appeared out of nowhere, blocking you as it surges down a mountain stream. You and your companions make use of the various instruments you carry, but collect no abnormal data, and have no way to explain the uneasy anxiety inside you all.

scene_ro3_res5a_1.title: Unfreezing River
scene_ro3_res5a_1.description: You temporarily change the expedition's travel route for safety reasons. Your hands finally stop trembling as you step into the warm sunshine, but everyone remains silent and frustrated—they all know that the river is flowing in the direction of a nearby Sami settlement.

scene_ro3_res5a_2.title: Unfreezing River
scene_ro3_res5a_2.description: Luck is on your side today. You find a stable enough boat upstream, and it even holds a small amount of supplies. However, as you boat across the river, a melting ice crystal that falls on the back of your hand seems to call your attention, and you suddenly lower your head to see... the starry sky?

scene_ro3_res5a_3.title: Unfreezing River
scene_ro3_res5a_3.description: The corroded earth, the vanished beasts, your own body growing inward... A myriad of chaotic premonitions flash through your head as your companions pull you ashore. You can no longer recall if you had first jumped into the river out of fear, or if you were already in the river choking from fear.

scene_ro3_rec1_enter.title: Wilderness Survival Expert
scene_ro3_rec1_enter.description: A lone explorer covered in dirt and grime asks you for today's date, and you hear him count the years in a whisper before he violently slaps himself in the face. 'Whatever, I made it back alive.' He mumbles a few Columbian expletives. 'And who tricked you into coming here? Want me to pass on a message?'

scene_ro3_rec1_1.title: Wilderness Survival Expert
scene_ro3_rec1_1.description:
'Shiny new coins! Much newer than my gear at the very least! Nothing compared to my paycheck, but I bet those people think I've gone missing anyway!' 
He then assures you that these few coins are enough to keep him alive for his bike trip back to his warm apartment, and he'll help you make a few phone calls too.

scene_ro3_rec1_2.title: Wilderness Survival Expert
scene_ro3_rec1_2.description:
He suddenly looks solemn and shares the results of his extensive expedition with you. 
'Technically, these are confidential Rhine Lab secrets, but you're a nice person, so I hope you can get home alive too.' After repeatedly urging you to be careful on your journey, he assures you that the funds you gave him are enough for him to safely reach his expedition base in the south.

scene_ro3_rec1_3.title: Wilderness Survival Expert
scene_ro3_rec1_3.description:
'You're right, luck does prove very useful in Sami.' 
He jots down your message on a piece of scrap paper, stuffs it into his backpack, and lets out a few more expletives as he leaves. You remember the name he's been cursing, and it seems to be... the Director of Rhine Lab's Scientific Investigation Section?

scene_ro3_rec2_enter.title: On-site at Public Signal Amplification Station 756
scene_ro3_rec2_enter.description: You find a patch of what the tribespeople call a 'glade which glows when you step on it' that seems to be an important landmark in this area. You walk to the center of the clearing, and notice that part of the surrounding snow begins to disappear into thin air, revealing streaks of spectacular light in the ground. Then, your communicator receives a signal, the first in a long time, and the voices of your other companions left behind the camp far to the south erupt from it, and it sounds like they're in complete disbelief.

scene_ro3_rec2_1.title: On-site at Public Signal Amplification Station 756
scene_ro3_rec2_1.description: You wanted to get everyone in the team to talk to those back at camp, but then the glowing streaks in the ground quickly dim before your communications disconnect. You and your companions momentarily rest on the spot before moving on.

scene_ro3_rec2_2.title: On-site at Public Signal Amplification Station 756
scene_ro3_rec2_2.description: You try to pass on your needs, relative positions, and heading in the most succinct way you can, and the glowing streaks in the ground quickly dim before your communications disconnect. Later on, backup manages to catch up with your group with the help of this very landmark.

scene_ro3_rec2_3.title: On-site at Public Signal Amplification Station 756
scene_ro3_rec2_3.description: You try to pass on your needs in the most succinct way you can, your relative position with the help of your equipment, and even have time for a little long-distance chat. The streaks in the ground dim as you hang up your communications, and later on, backup quickly catches up with your group with your precise directions.

scene_ro3_relic1_enter.title: Trimounts Travel Agency Dispatch
scene_ro3_relic1_enter.description: A micro-operation platform stops in front of you. Several large low-temperature storage boxes commonly used for scientific research are bound to the chassis with ropes, with a small lidded iron basket welded to a huge cryoshield. Inside are tourism flyers covered in scenic photographs of Trimounts, Bunkerhill City, and Max D.C., along with some embarrassing copywriting, claiming that their travel agency 'now has Sami-speaking tour guides!'

scene_ro3_relic1_1.title: Trimounts Travel Agency Dispatch
scene_ro3_relic1_1.description: Most of the box's contents are of little use, but there seems to be a few items of great value buried underneath. However, they're such a pain to retrieve that you can't help but feel like making a complaint to whoever stowed them away.

scene_ro3_relic1_2.title: Trimounts Travel Agency Dispatch
scene_ro3_relic1_2.description: Your equipment beeps; it has found something for you. The operation platform rocks back and forth as if wanting to say something, but it emits a flash of dazzling light and disappears before you can even react. You and your companions look at each other in dismay, and your instruments did not record any valuable information either.

scene_ro3_relic1_3.title: Trimounts Travel Agency Dispatch
scene_ro3_relic1_3.description: You pull open a hidden compartment, and many items lie within it. The operation platform begins buzzing, approaching you as if wanting to say something, but it emits a flash of dazzling light and disappears before you can even react. You and your companions look at each other in dismay, and your instruments did not record any valuable information either.

scene_ro3_relic1_4.title: Trimounts Travel Agency Dispatch
scene_ro3_relic1_4.description: You triumphantly take out what you wanted and sit on the floor panting, intending to rest for a bit while your companions handle the other remaining boxes, but the operation platform emits a flash of dazzling light and disappears before you can even open your mouth to say anything. You and your companions look at each other in dismay, and your instruments did not record any valuable information either.

scene_ro3_relic1_5.title: Trimounts Travel Agency Dispatch
scene_ro3_relic1_5.description: The operation platform spins around and makes a rhythmic ticking sound, as if telling you something, but before you can even consider anything, it emits a flash of dazzling light and disappears. You and your companions look at each other in dismay, but come to a realization and you turn over the flyers in your hands—amazingly, they all have the same set of coordinates and password printed on the back.

scene_ro3_relic2_enter.title: On-site at Public Nomadic Station N6
scene_ro3_relic2_enter.description: A snowdrift taller than a person appears right in front of you, and under your instruments' prompting, you and your companions unearth the corner of a half-buried building with two large doors. The lights on the doors are still lit, one green and one red, emitting a faint glow.

scene_ro3_relic2_1.title: On-site at Public Nomadic Station N6
scene_ro3_relic2_1.description: You spend a good deal of time investigating the building. You don't manage to get in or find any clues about its purpose, but find a few items that you're not sure why were here. Perhaps this is a secret Columbian or Ursus facility, and it's better not to delve too deep into it.

scene_ro3_relic2_2.title: On-site at Public Nomadic Station N6
scene_ro3_relic2_2.description: It's the exact coordinates from the tourism flyers! The door with the green light opens when you say the password! But a female voice seems to play from somewhere, and mentions 'forbidden,' 'bringing pets,' 'will return to the parking lot,' and other things in a strange accent. A light flashes, and all of you appear in a snowfield with items scattered around your group. You can still see the building in the distance, but it seems to have been re-buried in snow.

scene_ro3_relic2_3.title: On-site at Public Nomadic Station N6
scene_ro3_relic2_3.description: A few silvery snowflakes float by and you feel lucky, kicking the door with the red light. It falls straight backwards! But a female voice seems to play from somewhere, and mentions 'damage,' 'traffic safety,' 'will return to the parking lot,' and other things in a strange accent. A light flashes, and all of you appear in a snowfield with items scattered around your group. You can still see the building in the distance, but it seems to have been re-buried in snow.

scene_ro3_spring_enter.title: Vacation Spot
scene_ro3_spring_enter.description: There is still no precise answer as to why someone would invest in a resort in such a harsh and cold place like Sami. But in fact, business is booming here, and the owner is making a fortune. Additionally, as one of the research team's sponsors, he is happy to let your tired team members rest here free of charge for a night and indulge in the pleasures of Sami.

scene_ro3_spring_1.title: Vacation Spot
scene_ro3_spring_1.description: Ice lake Fincatching, bonfire parties, and cabin saunas, especially cabin saunas! Your people at last understand why this place is so popular. On the next day, as the team prepares to leave, everyone agrees to return here after the trip and live it up.

scene_ro3_height_enter.title: Wounded Prime Tree
scene_ro3_height_enter.description: Holding a clan migration is uncommon to the Sami, but by no means unheard of. You are now in the midst of a migrating Sami tribe, their clan tree making long and huge strides, starting and stopping as it unceasingly waits for its clansmen and their livestock to come along. These tribespeople look exhausted but still greet you politely. Their snowpriest has already agreed to tell you about their experience so far.

scene_ro3_height_1.title: Wounded Prime Tree
scene_ro3_height_1.description: The snowpriest is open with you, and tells you everything she knows. When the conversation ends, she wishes you good luck and says that she believes that all of you will 'make the prophecy come true.'

scene_ro3_height_2.title: Wounded Prime Tree
scene_ro3_height_2.description: Suddenly, you feel dizzy and your vision seems to be clouded by a layer of shimmering stars. Your energy is also rapidly draining. The snowpriest clutches your shoulders with both hands, and you come back to your senses. She solemnly urges you to 'look steadily forward' on the journey, and tells you a ton of useful information about the area ahead. In subsequent conversations, you wisely avoid bringing up the clan tree as a topic.

scene_ro3_pick1_enter.title: Missing Mountains
scene_ro3_pick1_enter.description:
Just as you are about to make a misstep, someone pulls you backward. The mountains' shadows overlap, and a distorted darkness creeps across your eyes. In the face of your trepidation, the fortuneteller-looking woman asks you to draw a card. 
—How strange. As far as you know, neither the Sami or the Cyclopes Sarkaz use divination as a way to tell the future.

scene_ro3_pick1_1.title: Missing Mountains
scene_ro3_pick1_1.description:
'Don't be afraid of your own fate... and don't fear turning away from it either. 
'A prophecy, hmm? You'll see the light when you reunite with it, and understand that it has, all along, been waiting for you in the future.' 
You look at the crystal ball she gave you. However, inside lies only a black mountain range, clearly solidifying, as if... it's not related to your fate.

scene_ro3_pick1_2.title: Missing Mountains
scene_ro3_pick1_2.description:
'Be at ease, the object he left behind is untainted. 
'He was a shaman who led many through life and death, until he himself also 'rose from the dead'... now that is a truly frightening memory. 
'I've been wandering between the mountains ever since, in order to bring him back from the gigantic shadow.'

scene_ro3_pick1_3.title: Missing Mountains
scene_ro3_pick1_3.description:
You can't clearly see her expression. Is it regret... or relief? She removes the purse on her, claiming that it is 'something useless I've lost to you.' 
As you take the purse, you notice a large number of Originium crystals on her body.

scene_ro3_pick1_4.title: Missing Mountains
scene_ro3_pick1_4.description:
'May our fates cross again once more...' 
She bids you farewell, walking off into the wind and snow.

scene_ro3_pick2_enter.title: Clairvoyance's Direction
scene_ro3_pick2_enter.description:
The blizzard on the uninhabited icefield makes it impossible to see anything, and you and your research team companions fight the extreme cold as you try your best to keep up with the mysterious procession in black. Where are these Cyclopes headed to? 
They reply: 'The next millennium.'

scene_ro3_pick2_1.title: Clairvoyance's Direction
scene_ro3_pick2_1.description: They sigh and march northward, none of them answering your question save for one who hands you something as he passes by. You realize that it is a whetstone, a possible catalyst for Sami Arts. 'The only tool is an indestructible self.'

scene_ro3_pick2_2.title: Clairvoyance's Direction
scene_ro3_pick2_2.description: They sigh and march northward, none of them answering your question save for one who hands you something as he passes by. You realize that it is a compass containing the Cyclopes' Originium Arts. 'Now that you have started, do not ever stop.'

scene_ro3_pick2_3.title: Clairvoyance's Direction
scene_ro3_pick2_3.description: The towering Cyclopes gradually walk further and further away. It seems none of them believe that you can be of any help to them. You never manage to catch up with them, but you find something by the bonfire embers they left behind during their momentary stop to rest.

scene_ro3_pick2_4.title: Clairvoyance's Direction
scene_ro3_pick2_4.description: You have heard many a legend about this band of Sarkaz, but you had never believed that they existed in the northern reaches of Sami until you saw them with your own eyes. You're worried that the rumors of them bringing bad luck are true, so you silently watch them walk away.

scene_ro3_normal1_enter.title: Sami's Language
scene_ro3_normal1_enter.description:
'From a linguistic perspective, deciphering the Foldartals in the hands of the locals is no puzzle to crack. The truly difficult question is where they come from, and if they were carved by man... wait, what's that sound?' 
The professionals in the research team are proposing that you set up cameras to monitor the local shamans' movements, so all of you witness this moment together: the wood's surface cracks and peels with a loud noise, and a intricate pattern forms on the tree.

scene_ro3_normal1_1.title: Sami's Language
scene_ro3_normal1_1.description:
The tribe's shaman deciphers the Nature Foldartal for you, and you learn some of their legends: 'The divine spirits hide in all things, the first of Foldartals a cry across the mounts'; 'Sami once foretold itself, revealing a mountain range and icefield firemelt. Their wars fought long before all awoke, and this shall recur.' 
You are very happy, for this is information you could never get purely from deciphering the language or symbols.

scene_ro3_normal2_enter.title: Ursus
scene_ro3_normal2_enter.description: What presumably was the lair of a mangler now echoes laughter, shouting, and Ursine expletives, as some of what seem to be its new inhabitants are clearly enjoying themselves. In the corner you can see the cave's original owner, heaving its last breaths after getting punched and kicked.

scene_ro3_normal2_1.title: Ursus
scene_ro3_normal2_1.description: A drunk responds to you: 'Anywhere full of Ursus people, is naturally already Ursus itself!' They seem to be planning to transform the cave into some sort of territorial governance bureau. These people then slip you a bunch of vodka bottle labels, saying that with these 'official colonization permits,' you will be able to get all the aid you need from the state.

scene_ro3_normal2_2.title: Ursus
scene_ro3_normal2_2.description: A new challenger—it's you! After a fierce fight (mostly amongst themselves), the Ursus people are quite impressed with your fighting skills. They pile a whole bunch of 'gifts' on you, and then fall asleep on the ground snoring in disarray. The most pitiable thing in the whole affair is probably the mangler that got punched many more times.

scene_ro3_normal2_3.title: Ursus
scene_ro3_normal2_3.description: You and your companions leave the cave behind. You are quite sure that the local Sami tribe will not ignore this matter.

scene_ro3_normal3_enter.title: Useless Item
scene_ro3_normal3_enter.description: You are lost, and rescued by a local shaman who seems to be used to this. She enthusiastically offers you some help, saying that she's carrying more than she needs. However, as you talk to her, your gaze cannot help but drift to the path she came from, as well as the withered vegetation on it.

scene_ro3_normal3_1.title: Useless Item
scene_ro3_normal3_1.description:
A few coins emitting an ominous aura fall into your hands, and you can't stop yourself from asking if she has any relation to the evil spirits of the north mentioned in Sami legend. She tells you those coins were left behind by companions who were sacrificed. 
'Nature is power, and since we draw power from it, we will of course fight off the threat.'

scene_ro3_normal3_2.title: Useless Item
scene_ro3_normal3_2.description:
A Foldartal falls into your hands, surprising you: is this one of the 'surplus items' she mentioned? 
'We do not recognize it as Sami. It has borrowed Sami.' After saying that, she deciphers the omens on the Foldartal for you. You get a feeling her narration style is quite strange, perhaps too blunt, so much so that... you feel scared for no apparent reason.

scene_ro3_normal3_3.title: Useless Item
scene_ro3_normal3_3.description: She grips your hand and whispers a prayer. You fear that your life will dry up like the trees in the wilderness, but as you listen to her voice, you actually feel increasingly calm, and relax. Just what exactly did she pray to? She smiles when faced with the question, and does not answer.

scene_ro3_chest_enter.title: Bob's Emporium
scene_ro3_chest_enter.description: Canned vegetables, beer, spices. These products are evidently popular in this area, and you wait half a day for a chance to talk to the owner of this little store alone. You only get two words out before the other party excitedly dives into the shelves, trying to find something from the slow-moving and overstocked goods to hand you as a gift.

scene_ro3_chest_1.title: Bob's Emporium
scene_ro3_chest_1.description: He tells you of his boss using 'certain methods' to get out of jail early—all thanks to everyone who was willing to buy his beer back then—and was able to jump on the upsurge of Columbian pioneers heading northward, even managing to expand his business. 'We really shouldn't be selling these modern tech gadgets to the Sami though.' He taps on your gift, clearly not caring about the lost profits.

scene_ro3_rest1_enter.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest1_enter.description: You and your team members find an unmanned research outpost. Magallan skillfully opens the combination lock at the entrance and welcomes everyone inside. For now, the cold winds of Sami are far away, and you can take a breather to calm down and organize your thoughts.

scene_ro3_rest1_1.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest1_1.description: Enjoying the conveniences and safety of civilization is a luxury out in the wilderness. Close your eyes and get some rest while it's still warm.

scene_ro3_rest1_2.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest1_2.description: Treading the snowfields requires experience more than equipment.

scene_ro3_rest1_3.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest1_3.description: When talk of strange tales, rituals, and nature fills the room, people become more eager to explore the uncharted territory that lies ahead.

scene_ro3_rest1_4.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest1_4.description: The outpost's survey equipment is still working, so it's time to contact the backup crew to join the squad.

scene_ro3_rest1_5.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest1_5.description: The survey equipment is the most important part of the snowfield expedition, and regular maintenance is essential to keeping it working.

scene_ro3_rest1_6.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest1_6.description: The Sami shamans seek revelation with the trees outside the building, then share Sami's decree with everyone.

scene_ro3_rest2_enter.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest2_enter.description: You and your team members find an unmanned research outpost. Magallan skillfully opens the combination lock at the entrance and welcomes everyone inside. For now, the cold winds of Sami are far away, and you can take a breather to calm down and organize your thoughts.

scene_ro3_rest2_1.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest2_1.description: Enjoying the conveniences and safety of civilization is a luxury out in the wilderness. Close your eyes and get some rest while it's still warm.

scene_ro3_rest2_2.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest2_2.description: Treading the snowfields requires experience more than equipment.

scene_ro3_rest2_3.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest2_3.description: When talk of strange tales, rituals, and nature fills the room, people become more eager to explore the uncharted territory that lies ahead.

scene_ro3_rest2_4.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest2_4.description: The outpost's survey equipment is still working, so it's time to contact the backup crew to join the squad.

scene_ro3_rest2_5.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest2_5.description: The survey equipment is the most important part of the snowfield expedition, and regular maintenance is essential to keeping it working.

scene_ro3_rest2_6.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest2_6.description: The Sami shamans seek revelation with the trees outside the building, then share Sami's decree with everyone.

scene_ro3_rest3_enter.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest3_enter.description: You and your team members find an unmanned research outpost. Magallan skillfully opens the combination lock at the entrance and welcomes everyone inside. For now, the cold winds of Sami are far away, and you can take a breather to calm down and organize your thoughts.

scene_ro3_rest3_1.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest3_1.description: Enjoying the conveniences and safety of civilization is a luxury out in the wilderness. Close your eyes and get some rest while it's still warm.

scene_ro3_rest3_2.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest3_2.description: Treading the snowfields requires experience more than equipment.

scene_ro3_rest3_3.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest3_3.description: When talk of strange tales, rituals, and nature fills the room, people become more eager to explore the uncharted territory that lies ahead.

scene_ro3_rest3_4.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest3_4.description: The outpost's survey equipment is still working, so it's time to contact the backup crew to join the squad.

scene_ro3_rest3_5.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest3_5.description: The survey equipment is the most important part of the snowfield expedition, and regular maintenance is essential to keeping it working.

scene_ro3_rest3_6.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_rest3_6.description: The Sami shamans seek revelation with the trees outside the building, then share Sami's decree with everyone.

scene_ro3_scout_enter.title: Searching For A Path Forward
scene_ro3_scout_enter.description: An unexplored area lies before you, so you stop and prepare to select someone to scout the way ahead.

scene_ro3_scout_1.title: Searching For A Path Forward
scene_ro3_scout_1.description: Valarqvin relays to you something she 'saw'—a light curtain of mist, a painful pipedream, formless needles, and a black key. You have no idea what she's talking about, so you ask her to show you a path. This time, she doesn't speak in riddles and draws a clearly visible route on your map.

scene_ro3_scout_2.title: Searching For A Path Forward
scene_ro3_scout_2.description: After a few exchanges, you learn some things about what lies ahead from the Sami locals.

scene_ro3_scout_3.title: Searching For A Path Forward
scene_ro3_scout_3.description: Your chosen research team members soon finish packing and set off with their equipment.

scene_ro3_story1_enter.title: Crossing Sami's Arm
scene_ro3_story1_enter.description:
The research team walks up the mountain ridge, the land behind gradually fading away. The distant scenery is shrouded with wind and snow, and the only thing nearby is a single path with no end in sight. You and your teammates are walking in between, not knowing where you have come from or where you are going, merely repeating the advancement of this journey. The mountain gale roars, the falling snow rumbles, and nature questions the group—
'Do you still wish to proceed?'

scene_ro3_story1_1.title: Crossing Sami's Arm
scene_ro3_story1_1.description: It is obvious that the environment can no longer stop mankind's footsteps, and so the mountain range raises a peak in front of everyone. Sami wishes to understand your determination.

scene_ro3_story1_2.title: Crossing Sami's Arm
scene_ro3_story1_2.description: A warrior's determination is unquestionable, and Sami knows this. And so the wind and snow slowly disperse. In the distance, as far as the eye can see, the darkness becomes increasingly distinct.

scene_ro3_story2_enter.title: Shattered Omen
scene_ro3_story2_enter.description: The Foldartal leads you to the location of the Treescar. His clan looks to have just gone through a terrible battle, and everyone seems to have some sort of injury. But there is no one groaning or cursing. They are like the forest itself: silent, and yet powerful. You wish to go up and talk to him, and hand him the Foldartal. But after he sees the woodcut in your hands from afar, he orders the warriors to rise and continue marching across the snowfield. All that is left for you is a messy camp.

scene_ro3_story2_1.title: Shattered Omen
scene_ro3_story2_1.description: They take most of their supplies as they leave, but you find the Treescar's helmet in his tent. A Sami warrior leaving their helmet behind as they go off to fight means that they are determined to die in battle. You think over the Foldartal's contents, and hurriedly lead your team to catch up with Treescar.

scene_ro3_story2_2.title: Shattered Omen
scene_ro3_story2_2.description: You scavenge whatever remains of the camp and leave with your teammates. You are concerned with the life or death of this one Sami, but the Foldartal already states his fate clearly. You don't wish to put your own life at risk.

scene_ro3_story3_enter.title: Pessimist's Cage
scene_ro3_story3_enter.description: The route Valarqvin drew for you leads you to a huge cave. There are no light sources at all, and Valarqvin stops you from any attempt to light a lamp or turn on a flashlight. All you can do is hold her hand and move forward step by step. When you finally see light again, you spot an altar with a flower atop: rootless, blooming, and incomparably sharp. Many Cyclopes are sitting around the altar, and they are silent as they 'stare' at the flower in front of them. 'Your path will be darker than the one you have just traveled,' Valarqvin says to herself. 'If you can still walk, then pick up the flower.' As she utters the very last word, all the Cyclopes look towards you.

scene_ro3_story3_1.title: Pessimist's Cage
scene_ro3_story3_1.description: You reach out to hold it. But you don't even manage to touch it. You try to focus your mind on the flower, but soon feel your head spinning... You try many methods to move the flower even a bit, but it is all in vain—and just as your head is in chaos, its roots take hold in your mind. 'Virtual earth, a rootless flower, the key to the other side,' Valarqvin mumbles to herself. You still don't manage to touch the flower, but its position relative to you is fixed. You can 'take' it 'away.' The Cyclopes raise their heads and whisper as they watch you and Valarqvin leave.

scene_ro3_story3_2.title: Pessimist's Cage
scene_ro3_story3_2.description: 'Then let us return, this path is not an easy one to walk.' Valarqvin brings you back to the team, and it feels like none of this happened at all. The Cyclopes remain silent the whole time, and for some reason you feel a lot lighter inside.

scene_ro3_startbuff_enter.title: Operation Rewards
scene_ro3_startbuff_enter.description: Your overcame at least two floors in your last exploration. You'll be able to receive more assistance this time

scene_ro3_bat1_enter.title: Sobbing in the Swamp
scene_ro3_bat1_enter.description: You lead your team forward with caution, afraid of running into some strange Sami entity. But before long you hear something sobbing by your ears. You quickly alert your team members to prepare for battle, but a long period of time passes with no terrifying enemies showing up. You finally muster the courage to head towards the source of the sound, and realize that it is a Perro sobbing nonstop.

scene_ro3_bat1_1.title: Sobbing in the Swamp
scene_ro3_bat1_1.description: You tell him to hurry up and leave, but he just stays there squirming back and forth the place as he sobs. This annoys you to the point where you finally prepare to forcefully kick him out.

scene_ro3_bat1_2.title: Sobbing in the Swamp
scene_ro3_bat1_2.description: You can tell he's not exactly a master rhetorician, so you hand him a piece of gummy as a gesture of friendliness. He sniffs it, takes it from you, and eats it, then takes out an unopened pack of serviettes to present to you as a gift. Thank goodness, you're still able to come across regular people in Sami—even though he hasn't said a word the whole time and hasn't stopped crying either.

scene_ro3_bat1_3.title: Sobbing in the Swamp
scene_ro3_bat1_3.description: You're angry over the fact that he spent half a day hiding behind a tree without saying a word to you, but at the very least he's just a person and not some frightening Sami monster. You let your team members rest there for a while before continuing onward.

scene_ro3_bat2_enter.title: A Profitable Plan
scene_ro3_bat2_enter.description: You've never doubted the Duck Lord's ability to cause trouble, but still you feel a chill creeping up your spine at the sight of him gathering a bunch of tainted Sami people who are conducting a rite. Even though he tells you that these things are just tools for creating wealth, and they haven't attacked you of their own volition, this event itself is just too bizarre!

scene_ro3_bat2_1.title: A Profitable Plan
scene_ro3_bat2_1.description: You don't have a clue what this rite is about, but one thing is clear: you can't let these tainted Sami people continue to exist on Sami land. On top of that, you also have to teach this maverick duck a lesson.

scene_ro3_bat2_2.title: A Profitable Plan
scene_ro3_bat2_2.description: The Duck Lord is stingy, but he doesn't seem to reject the idea of spending money to avoid peril. You happily leave the area after receiving a bunch of Originium.

scene_ro3_bat2_3.title: A Profitable Plan
scene_ro3_bat2_3.description: There are so many strange things in Sami, so you can turn a blind eye to the ones that aren't actually a threat.

scene_ro3_bat3_enter.title: Entourage
scene_ro3_bat3_enter.description: You see a luxurious motorcade parked in Sami. The people in the cars seem rich and powerful, but there don't seem to be any bodyguards or mercenaries around. You inadvertently catch a glimpse of the Duck Lord chatting in one of these cars, and when you scan the area again, you spot Gopnik leaning against a tree.

scene_ro3_bat3_1.title: Entourage
scene_ro3_bat3_1.description: Clearly it was the Duck Lord who duped all these people and brought them to this dangerous place. You'll use your fists to drive them back to Columbia. Oh, Gopnik's spotted you.

scene_ro3_bat3_2.title: Entourage
scene_ro3_bat3_2.description: Gopnik glances at you, and sees that you have no intention of approaching any further. So you spend an important part of your life listening to these people boast endlessly for a full twenty-four hours. You sort out the information you obtained, and there are a few that could make you a ton of money.

scene_ro3_bat3_3.title: Entourage
scene_ro3_bat3_3.description: Even if they were to reveal some Terra-shattering news, you have no way to cash in on that right now, so let's just forget about it.

scene_ro3_bat4_enter.title: Duck Lord's Sinister Plot
scene_ro3_bat4_enter.description: Just like in those Columbian comics, in the remote uninhabited wilderness sits a villain's fortress. He and his minion lurk within, secretly hatching a plan to develop terrifying weapons that will threaten the entire land... Oh, this villain... is a duck?

scene_ro3_bat4_1.title: Duck Lord's Sinister Plot
scene_ro3_bat4_1.description: You know something is up when you see the Duck Lord show his face, and you prepare to strike before they can even react.

scene_ro3_bat4_2.title: Duck Lord's Sinister Plot
scene_ro3_bat4_2.description: When the Duck Lord spots you, he invites you in to take a look. Actually, this is no 'fortress of evil,' but a research outpost rented by a Wrankwood production crew for a film shoot. You shake hands with the director and actors, and also receive a small gift from the crew.

scene_ro3_bat4_3.title: Duck Lord's Sinister Plot
scene_ro3_bat4_3.description: Your mission to explore is a serious one, and you're not about to waste any more time here getting involved in the Duck Lord's nefarious plans. After all, should anything happen, surely the Columbian government would sort it out, right?

scene_ro3_bat5_enter.title: Chain of Camps
scene_ro3_bat5_enter.description: There seems to be a sizeable army stationed on the icefield, camps stretched out as far as the eye can see. Is it Ursus? Higashi? Or even Yan? The style of the barracks doesn't match any of them, so it might be none of those nations. Perhaps you should take a closer look.

scene_ro3_bat5_1.title: Chain of Camps
scene_ro3_bat5_1.description: Arrows shot from the camp deals some damage to your party, but when you walk into the camp you find nothing inside. Just like a phantom, a scam. As you prepare to leave, a loud horn sounds out from thin air, and Kuranta emerge from the empty phantom tent in single file, dressed in unusual clothing. They quickly line up in formation, encircling a general in the center. He points his weapon at you.

scene_ro3_bat5_2.title: Chain of Camps
scene_ro3_bat5_2.description: The camp is so huge it takes you a long time simpler to reach its perimeter. However, you're surprised to find several other camps of similar size connected end to end, just like a lone knight leaving his footprints on the earth.

scene_ro3_bat6_enter.title: On-stage Invitation
scene_ro3_bat6_enter.description: Scarlet tents are pitched on the silverwhite icefield, and those unaware of the inside story lift the curtains to find a play about to begin.

scene_ro3_bat6_1.title: On-stage Invitation
scene_ro3_bat6_1.description: The play staged here is titled 'Frost Buck and Snow Doe,' the tale of a snowpriest's pair of twin guards, and the duo's tragic deaths. How distasteful... wait, why are those actors pointing their weapons at the audience...? ...Why are the backup dancers jumping off the stage? ...What are you people doing?

scene_ro3_bat6_2.title: On-stage Invitation
scene_ro3_bat6_2.description: Just as you were about to go in and watch the play, you suddenly realize your wallet is missing and search outside the tent for a long time, but all you find is a strange woodcut. When you turn around, the not-so-distant camp has burned down, with no survivors.

scene_ro3_bat6_3.title: On-stage Invitation
scene_ro3_bat6_3.description: What kind of theater troupe would come to sparsely populated Sami to perform a play? It's probably better we stay away.

scene_ro3_bat7_enter.title: Northwind Witch
scene_ro3_bat7_enter.description: You didn't expect to find a little cabin out in the desolate icefield, owned by a polite and proper multilingual Sarkaz lady. She invites you in for a rest and even prepares tea and desserts for you. Afterwards, she picks up her basket and heads out into the snow to pick plants. As she leaves, she instructs you to rest in the house and not to wander around. Or you may leave when you're done resting. In short, it seems she doesn't want you poking around the house looking for the secrets she has hidden within.

scene_ro3_bat7_1.title: Northwind Witch
scene_ro3_bat7_1.description: The house seems to be infuriated by your rudeness. It splits apart into four nachzehrer branches, and the ones resting by the fireplace... oh no, are those rotchasers?! Could this scary lady possibly be someone important in the Nachzehrer Royal Court?! No one else in their right mind would build a house with these things!

scene_ro3_bat7_2.title: Northwind Witch
scene_ro3_bat7_2.description: It doesn't take long for the witch to return, and she prepares a sumptuous feast for you along with some rations. You wonder why she's been so hospitable, and she dismisses you with a vague 'you have an important mission' excuse. Since nothing bad has happened so far, you just roll with it. As for her original intention? Who knows, it certainly wasn't love at first sight, anyway.

scene_ro3_bat7_3.title: Northwind Witch
scene_ro3_bat7_3.description: You've heard many strange tales related to Sami, and some of scary shamans who would trick people into a house, only to have the actually living house eat them up. The more you think about it, the more frightened you become, so it's better that you get out before it's too late, before the witch does something to you.

scene_ro3_bat8_enter.title: Always on Alert
scene_ro3_bat8_enter.description: You meet six wandering souls on the icefield, undoubtedly tainted. From their appearance, they look like regular victims of no fame. Perhaps you'll want to show mercy and set them free here.

scene_ro3_bat8_1.title: Always on Alert
scene_ro3_bat8_1.description: You ready up your team, and a Sniper Operator takes the lead in your attack. However, the bolts they fire are casually caught by the enemy and melted in mid-air with Arts. You immediately realize these guys are not to be trifled with, but there is no turning back now.

scene_ro3_bat8_2.title: Always on Alert
scene_ro3_bat8_2.description: Your intuition tells you that these guys are not easy to deal with, so you lead your team around them.

scene_ro3_bat9_enter.title: Chain of Suspicion
scene_ro3_bat9_enter.description: A Sami tribe has taken in a large number of outsiders. However, the differences in race and nationality make them suspicious of each other, and whispered complaints form an undercurrent running through the tribe. There are no Collapsals here, but eventually the shadow of a lie shatters the people's sanity, leaving the whole tribe in disarray.

scene_ro3_bat9_1.title: Chain of Suspicion
scene_ro3_bat9_1.description: Together with the tribe's shaman, you create a sanctuary for those who are still sane, and then set out to deal with the violent mob.

scene_ro3_bat9_2.title: Chain of Suspicion
scene_ro3_bat9_2.description: You feel a completely inexplicable urge for cathartic violence rising inside you, so you quickly leave with your team members.

scene_ro3_bat9_3.title: Chain of Suspicion
scene_ro3_bat9_3.description: Together with the tribe's shaman, you create a sanctuary in an easily defensible location to keep those who are still sane safe, and give it your all to keep the violent mob out.

scene_ro3_portalsample_enter.title: Forward Forest
scene_ro3_portalsample_enter.description: Gnarled trees and vines completely block your path, and the fates of innumerable Sami beings extend along the branches and leaves, crisscrossing and connecting before your eyes. You check over and over that the map provided by the locals truly points in this direction.

scene_ro3_portalsample_1.title: Forward Forest
scene_ro3_portalsample_1.description: You finally cut through the overgrowth of trees and vines, and something falls to the ground as the sun shines into the forest. You feel a strange premonition—you might just have damaged an exquisite artifact. But the damage done is irreversible, and you can do nothing but to pick up the fallen object and leave.

scene_ro3_portal0201a_enter.description: Gnarled trees and vines completely block your path, and the fates of innumerable Sami beings extend along the branches and leaves, crisscrossing and connecting before your eyes.
