scene_ro3_portal0603c_enter.description: Gnarled trees and vines completely block your path, and the fates of innumerable Sami beings extend along the branches and leaves, crisscrossing and connecting before your eyes. You check over and over that the map provided by the locals truly points in this direction.

scene_ro3_portal0603c_1.title: Forward Forest
scene_ro3_portal0603c_1.description: You finally cut through the overgrowth of trees and vines, and something falls to the ground as the sun shines into the forest. You feel a strange premonition—you might just have damaged an exquisite artifact. But the damage done is irreversible, and you can do nothing but to pick up the fallen object and leave.

scene_ro3_month1_enter.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_month1_enter.description: You and your team members find an unmanned research outpost. Magallan skillfully opens the combination lock at the entrance and welcomes everyone inside. For now, the cold winds of Sami are far away, and you can take a breather to calm down and organize your thoughts.

scene_ro3_month1_1.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_month1_1.description: There are many choices to make on an expedition, and sometimes you follow experience while other times you let fate decide. Following Magallan's drone, you find some old supplies in a corner of the room. A large amount of richly flavored Columbian nutritional snacks are stored in a well-packaged metal box. Who is the selfish researcher that stashed all this here?

scene_ro3_month1_2.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_month1_2.description: Enjoying the conveniences and safety of civilization is a luxury out in the wilderness. Close your eyes and get some rest while it's still warm.

scene_ro3_month1_3.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_month1_3.description: When talk of strange tales, rituals, and nature fills the room, people become more eager to explore the uncharted territory that lies ahead.

scene_ro3_month1_4.title: Research Outpost
scene_ro3_month1_4.description: The outpost's survey equipment is still working, so it's time to contact the backup crew to join the squad.

scene_ro3_month2_enter.title: A Dark Room
scene_ro3_month2_enter.description:
Following the directions left by a snowpriest on their deathbed, you find a hut lodged in the wind and snow. Your companions switch on their searchlights, but the darkness is barely dispelled. You notice traces of a snowpriest spell lingering on the light's edge. Just what did they fight here? 
The doors suddenly slam shut.

scene_ro3_month2_1.title: A Dark Room
scene_ro3_month2_1.description: Ever since you came to Sami, you've learned to trust your intuition, and especially your bad hunches.

scene_ro3_month2_2.title: A Dark Room
scene_ro3_month2_2.description:
Your group dares not take a step as you watch the Sarkaz girl pull out an arrow to draw a slash across the wall. Perhaps it is her Arts at work, as the wallborne moss curls up as if burning, falling off in large chunks. 
The room brightens up. You and your companions gratefully sit down to rest, and decide to believe that Typhon is always right.

scene_ro3_month2_3.title: A Dark Room
scene_ro3_month2_3.description: An inexplicable panic grips the room, but you and your companions keep silent. You realize that some supplies have been left here, and perhaps you can find something useful for the research team.

scene_ro3_month2_4.title: A Dark Room
scene_ro3_month2_4.description:
You push open a door to find a safe room, the objects within seemingly well preserved. 
——This is how you explain where the object in your hand came from, but your companions all look at you with strange expressions. 
'There was no room or door there.'

scene_ro3_month2_5.title: A Dark Room
scene_ro3_month2_5.description: As you hold your device up to the wall, you confirm some kind of energy signal is getting picked up, stable and continuous. You and your companions then examine the entire room, but remain confused by the signals randomly distributed around the room. Eventually you choose to avoid spots with stronger signals and take some safer-looking objects with you to continue your journey.

scene_ro3_month3_enter.title: Black Footprints
scene_ro3_month3_enter.description: Your teeth are chattering. Dead beasts, countless dead beasts, dirty snow covering their bodies. Intuition tells you not to go any further in this direction, but you are unable to free your legs from the quagmire of fear. You don't know how long you spend standing there until the burly local warriors have you surrounded.

scene_ro3_month3_1.title: Black Footprints
scene_ro3_month3_1.description: The old tree's attendant helps you to see the truth of this land devastated by disaster: fear will eventually come even if you do not move forward, the endpoint of escape is only nothingness, and you never had a choice in the first place. Fortunately your companions are by your side, and they are all willing to accompany you on this long road with a slim chance of success.

scene_ro3_month3_2.title: Black Footprints
scene_ro3_month3_2.description: Run, run, run. The Sami's arrows graze you, and all you can think of is getting away from that snow, fleeing in the opposite direction of those traces of filth.

scene_ro3_month3_3.title: Black Footprints
scene_ro3_month3_3.description: They see you as a poacher, as the equipment and instruments on you are beyond suspicious in their eyes. Just what have they gone through to treat all outsiders with such violence? But now, you have no time to think about it.

scene_ro3_month4_enter.title: Clairvoyance's Direction
scene_ro3_month4_enter.description:
The blizzard on the uninhabited icefield makes it impossible to see anything, and you and your research team companions fight the extreme cold as you try your best to keep up with the mysterious procession in black. Where are these Cyclopes headed to? 
They reply: 'The next millennium.'

scene_ro3_month4_1.title: Clairvoyance's Direction
scene_ro3_month4_1.description: They sigh and march northward, none of them answering your question save for one who hands you something as he passes by. You realize that it is a whetstone, a possible catalyst for Sami Arts. 'The only tool is an indestructible self.'

scene_ro3_month4_2.title: Clairvoyance's Direction
scene_ro3_month4_2.description: They sigh and march northward, none of them answering your question save for one who hands you something as he passes by. You realize that it is a compass containing the Cyclopes' Originium Arts. 'Now that you have started, do not ever stop.'

scene_ro3_month4_3.title: Clairvoyance's Direction
scene_ro3_month4_3.description:
The Cyclopes do not answer, but one whispers a warning as they pass: 'Your destiny is already unclear. Can you even remember where you're headed?'
You turn around, and at some point Valarqvin approaches you as she mumbles to herself: 'The ending is the purpose, and the purpose is the reason.'

scene_ro3_month4_4.title: Clairvoyance's Direction
scene_ro3_month4_4.description: You have heard many a legend about this band of Sarkaz, but you had never believed that they existed in the northern reaches of Sami until you saw them with your own eyes. You're worried that the rumors of them bringing bad luck are true, so you silently watch them walk away.

scene_ro3_month5_enter.title: Sami's Language
scene_ro3_month5_enter.description:
'From a linguistic perspective, deciphering the Foldartals in the hands of the locals is no puzzle to crack. The truly difficult question is where they come from, and if they were carved by man... wait, what's that sound?' 
The professionals in the research team are proposing that you set up cameras to monitor the local shamans' movements, so all of you witness this moment together: the wood's surface cracks and peels with a loud noise, and a intricate pattern forms on the tree.

scene_ro3_month5_1.title: Sami's Language
scene_ro3_month5_1.description:
The tribe's shaman deciphers the Nature Foldartal for you, and you learn some of their legends: 'The divine spirits hide in all things, the first of Foldartals a cry across the mounts'; 'Sami once foretold itself, revealing a mountain range and icefield firemelt. Their wars fought long before all awoke, and this shall recur.' 
You are very happy, for this is information you could never get purely from deciphering the language or symbols.

scene_ro3_month5_2.title: Sami's Language
scene_ro3_month5_2.description: Surtr approaches the ancient tree, an irresistible flame in hand. As the fire crackles, two Foldartals fall to the ground, scorched with burn marks. 'Flames, war, my memories...' She mumbles under her breath as she watches the flames on the tree extinguish in the wind and snow. Afterwards, she takes out her notebook to record something, and also crosses out a line.

scene_ro3_month6_enter.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_month6_enter.description: The research team has found a large and deep cave. It looks like a regular cavern, and looking down you can see a variety of strange plants and symbols. The team members are extremely excited, and hope to get your permission to use the Survey Equipment to probe the cave's extremities.

scene_ro3_month6_1.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_month6_1.description: If the survey equipment is exhausted here, you soon won't even be able to find your way back, so you decisively reject the team's request.

scene_ro3_month6_2.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_month6_2.description: You try it out on a spot at the edge of the cave, and accidentally discover a box of precious metals! Now this is true value, much more tangible than some vague exploration of the unknown.

scene_ro3_month6_3.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_month6_3.description: Nothing much appears on the display other than a flat and smooth wall. The team members are clueless as to why.

scene_ro3_month6_4.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_month6_4.description: Some plants you've never seen before appear on the display. They are clinging to the rock walls, entangled each other in a mesh-like formation, and seem to be patching up the hole. Some of the team members are already thinking of the economic value they could generate.

scene_ro3_month6_5.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_month6_5.description: Some irregular bumps on the rocky surface appear on the display. Mucus-like secretions are gushing out of these bumps, flowing down the rock wall. Some of the team members record the relative position of the survey equipment and take some samples of the secretions.

scene_ro3_month6_6.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_month6_6.description: A bunch of symbols in an unfamiliar style appear on the display. These symbols flicker on and off, maintaining a steady rhythm like breathing. Some of the team members take out their notebooks and begin to ponder the symbols' meaning.

scene_ro3_month6_7.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_month6_7.description: The survey effort pauses temporarily as the research team members start comparing and studying the freshly obtained data, speculating on how this huge cave formed.

scene_ro3_month6_8.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_month6_8.description: Piecing together the clues eventually has the team digging up an artifact at the cave's edge. The container storing the object is made of an organic polymer biomaterial. There is no civilization on Terra capable of making such a material, so could this... possibly be a prehistoric remnant?

scene_ro3_month6_9.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_month6_9.description: After the equipment cools down, the research team jumps back into action, eager to request permission to use the device again.

scene_ro3_month6_10.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_month6_10.description: The equipment is still working, and the research team members stare nervously at the screen.

scene_ro3_month6_11.title: Entrance to the Abyss
scene_ro3_month6_11.description: The special seeds sent by Rhine Lab are tossed into the chasm, and the team members eagerly wait for them to mark its depths. However, the seeds soon stop falling. One team member dons protective equipment and heads down to retrieve them. But when she returns, she's holding only one thing. By her account, as well as the photos she took, a unique ecosystem seems to have formed inside the chasm, and the seeds they threw had been eaten by a fowlbeast.

scene_ro3_ex1_enter.title: Change
scene_ro3_ex1_enter.description: Many years have passed since the giant facility at the end of the icefield was discovered, and many great things have happened since then: 'Terra Icefield Megastructure Research and Restoration Convention'—the birth of the Black Hole Protocol, the Feranmut Sami's departure, and a spike in technological advancements brought by Collapsal research. Every explorer undoubtedly dreams of traveling north to the place that changed everything, but... what exactly is the test mentioned in the invitation? That's when you notice an unfamiliar figure in camp that no one else seems to perceive.

scene_ro3_ex1_1.title: Change
scene_ro3_ex1_1.description: You subconsciously pull out the invitation and hand it over to him. He takes a look, nods, and turns around before vanishing before your eyes. You seem to catch a glimpse of the Rhodes Island logo and a bone pen as he disappears. However, the very next moment you find yourself in the sands of Sargon. Your team members are panicking at this sudden shift, but you are fully aware that this is a test for you to prove yourself.

scene_ro3_ex1_2.title: Change
scene_ro3_ex1_2.description: Just as you are about to attack him, he vanishes into the mist, and the other expeditioners look to you in surprise. Luckily, the farce passes quickly, and you resume your journey towards the icefield.

scene_ro3_ex2_enter.title: Reconstruction
scene_ro3_ex2_enter.description: By the time your squad arrives at the camp, everything else is already ready. You hand Kal'tsit the materials, and she separates them before distributing them to every department. As the instruments sound, the scientists take their positions, and the gigantic megastructure restoration project officially begins. In phase one, expeditioners have to clean up the Collapsals and eradicate their influence on the ring-shaped megastructure.

scene_ro3_ex2_1.title: Reconstruction
scene_ro3_ex2_1.description: After eradicating the Collapsal menace, we need to investigate the megastructure and attached buildings, simultaneously repairing any damage done with Terran materials and activating the dimensional stabilizers originally used to deal with Crazelyseon. With the Sami Snowpriests' assistance and the analysis and application of the Elves' prehistoric knowledge, we should be able to completely stabilize the disorderly dimensional currents and ensure our investigations and repairs will not be interrupted.

scene_ro3_ex2_2.title: Reconstruction
scene_ro3_ex2_2.description: Restoration and on-site cleanup is complete. Finally, we have to decipher the connection between the megastructure and the various operating devices in the surrounding buildings. Columbian researchers, Leithanian Casters, Sami Shamans, and a few squads of Sarkaz proficient in witchcraft work together to overcome this final problem. On the other hand, the engineers have to figure out how to power the enormous complex.

scene_ro3_ex2_3.title: Reconstruction
scene_ro3_ex2_3.description: The entire facility has been repaired, and the megastructure restarts. The rootless garden is flooded with starlight, and the ring now displays a serene cavity. The door is already open, quietly awaiting its visitors. The supplies, personnel, and contingency plans are all ready to go, and you will be the first to go through the gate.

scene_ro3_ex3_enter.title: One Small Step for Expeditioners
scene_ro3_ex3_enter.description: One moment you were deep in the icefield, and the next you find yourself in a scorching desert. Behind you are the ruins of a megastructure identical to the one on the icefield, except almost completely eroded by the wind and sand. You consider the harsh environment ahead, and immediately send a request for help to the other end of the gate.

scene_ro3_ex3_1.title: One Small Step for Expeditioners
scene_ro3_ex3_1.description: You wait for a while, and then a squad emerges from the gate with construction materials.

scene_ro3_ex3_2.title: One Small Step for Expeditioners
scene_ro3_ex3_2.description: You wait for a while, and then a transport team emerges from the gate with enough supplies for two Operators.

scene_ro3_ex3_3.title: One Small Step for Expeditioners
scene_ro3_ex3_3.description: You wait for a while, and then an Operator you urgently need emerges from the gate.

scene_ro3_ex3_4.title: One Small Step for Expeditioners
scene_ro3_ex3_4.description: You wait for a while, and then an item is delivered to you.

scene_ro3_ex3_5.title: One Small Step for Expeditioners
scene_ro3_ex3_5.description: You wait for a while, and then a party brimming with hostility emerges from the gate. Wait, they're not from the end of the icefield, so where did your message end up? Does the gate actually lead elsewhere as well?!

scene_ro3_ex3_6.title: One Small Step for Expeditioners
scene_ro3_ex3_6.description: The megastructure seems to stop working due to its dilapidated condition by the time support arrives. You and your team decide to explore the surrounding area first and return as soon as it restarts. Having just arrived from a polar region, the high temperature brings extreme discomfort, but the worst has yet to come. The sand before you glows golden, reflections off of metal shimmer unceasingly, there are faint sounds of horns coming from behind, and an intimidating wave of fear and surrender surges forth. It suddenly dawns on you that exploration is no longer a priority, but rather survival in a war you have no chance of winning.

scene_ro3_month7_enter.title: On-site at Public Signal Amplification Station 756
scene_ro3_month7_enter.description: You find a patch of what the tribespeople call a 'glade which glows when you step on it' that seems to be an important landmark in this area. You walk to the center of the clearing, and notice that part of the surrounding snow begins to disappear into thin air, revealing streaks of spectacular light in the ground. Then, your communicator receives a signal, the first in a long time, and the voices of your other companions left behind the camp far to the south erupt from it, and it sounds like they're in complete disbelief.

scene_ro3_month7_1.title: On-site at Public Signal Amplification Station 756
scene_ro3_month7_1.description: You wanted to get everyone in the team to talk to those back at camp, but then the glowing streaks in the ground quickly dim before your communications disconnect. You and your companions momentarily rest on the spot before moving on.

scene_ro3_month7_2.title: On-site at Public Signal Amplification Station 756
scene_ro3_month7_2.description: You try to pass on your needs, relative positions, and heading in the most succinct way you can, and the glowing streaks in the ground quickly dim before your communications disconnect. Later on, backup manages to catch up with your group with the help of this very landmark.

scene_ro3_month7_3.title: On-site at Public Signal Amplification Station 756
scene_ro3_month7_3.description: You try to pass on your needs in the most succinct way you can, your relative position with the help of your equipment, and even have time for a little long-distance chat. The streaks in the ground dim as you hang up your communications, and later on, backup quickly catches up with your group with your precise directions.

scene_ro3_month7_4.title: On-site at Public Signal Amplification Station 756
scene_ro3_month7_4.description: You try your best to concisely communicate your needs to the person in charge of Rhodes Island. The light on the ground quickly dims, and communication is cut. Later, you are pleasantly surprised when the support team catches up with you, for not only did Kal'tsit understand you fully, she also trained your reinforcements to be better partners in your expedition.

scene_ro3_month8_enter.title: On-site at Public Nomadic Station N6
scene_ro3_month8_enter.description: A snowdrift taller than a person appears right in front of you, and under your instruments' prompting, you and your companions unearth the corner of a half-buried building with two large doors. The lights on the doors are still lit, one green and one red, emitting a faint glow.

scene_ro3_month8_1.title: On-site at Public Nomadic Station N6
scene_ro3_month8_1.description: You spend a good deal of time investigating the building. You don't manage to get in or find any clues about its purpose, but find a few items that you're not sure why were here. Perhaps this is a secret Columbian or Ursus facility, and it's better not to delve too deep into it.

scene_ro3_month8_2.title: On-site at Public Nomadic Station N6
scene_ro3_month8_2.description: It's the exact coordinates from the tourism flyers! The door with the green light opens when you say the password! But a female voice seems to play from somewhere, and mentions 'forbidden,' 'bringing pets,' 'will return to the parking lot,' and other things in a strange accent. A light flashes, and all of you appear in a snowfield with items scattered around your group. You can still see the building in the distance, but it seems to have been re-buried in snow.

scene_ro3_month8_3.title: On-site at Public Nomadic Station N6
scene_ro3_month8_3.description: A few silvery snowflakes float by and you feel lucky, kicking the door with the red light. It falls straight backwards! But a female voice seems to play from somewhere, and mentions 'damage,' 'traffic safety,' 'will return to the parking lot,' and other things in a strange accent. A light flashes, and all of you appear in a snowfield with items scattered around your group. You can still see the building in the distance, but it seems to have been re-buried in snow.

scene_ro3_month8_4.title: On-site at Public Nomadic Station N6
scene_ro3_month8_4.description: The girl nods her head and raises her staff after hearing your words. With a flash of light, a bunch of things begin to appear out of thin air before loudly landing before you. A radio-like female voice sounds in a somewhat strange dialect, mentioning 'clearing the path,' 'gratitude' and so on. After another flash of light, you find yourselves in a snowy field, surrounded by the items from before. You can still see the building from a distance, but it appears to be once again buried in the snow.

BATTLE_NORMAL.name: Combat Ops
BATTLE_NORMAL.description: Everyone has their weapons drawn. They're definitely not here to negotiate.

BATTLE_ELITE.name: Emergency Ops
BATTLE_ELITE.description: Some violence may well exceed your expectations, a very common occurrence.

BATTLE_BOSS.name: Dreadful Foe
BATTLE_BOSS.description: Criminals, ruffians, and the damned… You're in trouble.

REST.name: Safe House
REST.description: Nobody will bother you here, and there's plenty of food and water. No need to be so tense all the time.

INCIDENT.name: Encounter
INCIDENT.description: New friends, old rivals… Strange encounters never age. Only scars stand the test of time.

ENTERTAINMENT.name: Downtime Recreation
ENTERTAINMENT.description: A little indulgence in life's simpler pleasures goes a long way in fighting the monotony and hardships on your long road ahead.

UNKNOWN.name: Dense Fog
UNKNOWN.description: There's something in the mist, but you cannot see anything...

WISH.name: Wish Fulfilled
WISH.description: There are many ways of making a wish, but the wish itself is almost always the same thing.

SACRIFICE.name: Lost and Found
SACRIFICE.description: The void of helplessness will be filled by the joy and satisfaction of gain.

EXPEDITION.name: Scout
EXPEDITION.description: Someone will always have to take the first step, to show the way for those who come after.

BATTLE_SHOP.name: Rogue Trader
BATTLE_SHOP.description: Neither an ally nor an enemy. Some people like to sit on the fence.

PORTAL.name: Bosky Passage
PORTAL.description: Branches on one side and leaves on the other, the unexplored land lies right next to you.

STORY.name: Prophecy
STORY.description:
Are your feet on the road, the mud, or in the snow?

STORY_HIDDEN.description:

content: Good morning, good afternoon, and good night.
You give me the Originium, and I give you the goods. Don't worry too much about the details.
We may be old friends, but business is business.
Why am I helping you? Think of it as an investment.
Rhodes Island is a business, and I am a businessman. See, we're peers.
I'm not picking up the scraps. I'm just taking the treasure nobody else wanted.
You want to hear a story? Of course, my friend, but good tales don't come cheap.
We meet again, friend. What are you buying this time?
Long time no see, old friend. Good to know you're still alive and kicking.
Rare opportunities must be seized, for not everywhere on the icefield is open for business.
What do you fancy? Supplies for survival, coldproof protective gear, or perhaps... some Sami secrets?
Rare opportunities must be seized, for not everywhere on the icefield is open for business.
What do you fancy? Supplies for survival, coldproof protective gear, or perhaps... some Sami secrets?
You need manpower? I got you. No need to hesitate.
I hope the metaphors brought by the ice and snow can provide you the help you need.
'Towards the depleted north, towards the silent icefield, towards the depressing reveal of the unknown.'
Be careful of any Columbian organizations with 'Maylander' in the name.
This is way cheaper than having you look everywhere for a Messenger.
You guys at Rhodes Island have all sorts of weirdos, huh...
I know, everyone has their own affairs to attend to.
You need help, but that help's not going to be free.
Mind if I have a look-see at Rhodes Island's aircraft? No? Too bad.
If you want a fighter, the Sarkaz and Blacksteel are good options.
Life in the barrens is full of pain. It's not easy to survive.
I hope the metaphors brought by the ice and snow can provide you the help you need.
'Towards the depleted north, towards the silent icefield, towards the depressing reveal of the unknown.'
Don't worry. Spending money can make the world turn 'round.
Don't be too high-maintenance; picking up all these scraps was hard work.
A fully armed society must surely be a civilized society.
What's this thing good for? Why, buy it and find out!
They say Laterano's a place without conflict or hatred. Do you buy that? I sure don't.
Gaul is long gone, but its remnants are still driving many to run the gauntlet.
I once bought a whole crate of Honey Biscuits, but this Perro girl made off with the lot of them.
You want to travel deep into the Sami tundra? Even the Empire of Ursus knows to stay far away from there.
For every ten Siracusans you bump into, about five are part of a 'Famiglia.' Watch yourself.
Have you experienced the gaze of nature on you?
Maybe this can help you withstand your ordeal of ice and snow.
Maybe this can help you withstand your ordeal of ice and snow.
Have you experienced the gaze of nature on you?
Be prepared for anything. Better safe than sorry, friend.
This little thing is equal parts worthless and terrifying...
What's this thing for? Good question, I don't know either.
It can help your machine 'see' more clearly, is that clear enough for you?
Feeling a little confused on where to head next? Try this out, and you'll be fine.
Now this will catch your eyes—oh, I'm referring to this little piece of metal.
Check out this new toy. The Prospective Investment System. Use your extra riches to pave the way for the future.
Always try take the long view. Money can buy infinite possibilities. That's a good thing, my friend.
This is the kind of stuff Columbian entrepreneurs love peddling! Capitalism, ho!
You're an optimistic one. Try your hand at investing in the future, and you won't regret it, friend.
Don't resist the urge to splurge. That's money's not doing anything for you in your wallet.
Now's the time to be thanking your past self for your foresight. Am I right, friend?
There's always a return on investment. Well, not really, but everyone likes to think so.
A little investment here and there'll eventually help you overcome anything. Can't hurt, anyway.
There's a withdrawal limit, but I'm willing to free up some space to bring you more practical goods. Thanks for always being so understanding, my friend.
Your investment reserves have gone up, friend. It's a good thing.
With your investment reserves, you can set out on your adventures with confidence.
Wonderful! Your next adventure will go much more smoothly. Probably.
Ah, I can see right away you're a cautious one. Maybe a little too cautious.
I only take a small commission for your investments in future adventures. It's a fair deal.
There's a saying in Yan: 'Plan ahead, or plan to fail.' The Yanese have a point.
I got myself some new trinkets. You'll love them.
You should invest in your upcoming adventures!
I do thank you for your support, friend. Let's keep working together.
The value of my wares will go down if you leave too many fingerprints on them, my friend.
Hand me the Ingots first, and you can touch that all you like.
Don't like my wares? Prices giving you second thoughts?
Oh, do be careful. You break it, you buy it.

ro3_ending_1.name: To Talk with the Mountains
ro3_ending_1.desc: The mountains have been crossed, and the expeditioners' tracks left all over the endless icefield. The split earth talks to you, questions you, promises you. The quest for knowledge has no end, and misfortune is only the beginning.

ro3_ending_2.name: Winterfall
ro3_ending_2.desc: Fate arrives at his end, lowering its curtain. The warrior's last drop of blood freezes to ice before it can be shed.
ro3_ending_2.changeEndingDesc: The fortress built in the north has granted you passage, and the warriors will scale the high walls and watch the borders of Sami day and night.

ro3_ending_3.name: Long into an Abyss
ro3_ending_3.desc: You have seen the impenetrable depths of darkness, and have felt a certain sheet of heavy snow fall onto your shoulders. Now there is only silence.
ro3_ending_3.changeEndingDesc: The vision of the Cyclops is now shared with you. Deep in the icefields, the full picture of the prophecy is yet to be revealed.

ro3_ending_c.name: The Fleetest of Light
ro3_ending_c.desc: An incorrect deduction, a mistaken responsibility, an unnecessary sacrifice. You have found a way here for those who come afterwards, a secret that fate shall keep.
ro3_ending_c.changeEndingDesc: Unrealized changes detailed in this ending

ro3_ending_4.name: From Start To End
ro3_ending_4.desc: You travel through an eternity of sand and war, and find yourself back at the base of the megastructure. This signifies the end of a long journey, but also the beginning of a new one. A group of expeditioners will follow in your footsteps, setting out to explore the land beyond the giant structure, and eventually discover the truth.
ro3_ending_4.changeEndingDesc: The circular gate lies within the cold winds, waiting to be opened once more.

battleLoadingTips.tip: Sami—Located at the north of Terra, a 'country' with a special system composed of many tribes, and a model of co-existence between man and nature that is one-of-a-kind on Terra.

Collapsals—Lifeforms observed on the endless icefield. Their appearance immediately interferes with the basic laws of reality and cognitive thinking. Huge bands of Sami warriors have been fighting against them for generations.
Cyclopes—Living in seclusion in the Fjal Vetrtonn, independent of the Royal Court. They have the ability to foresee the future, but it is said that all their visions only carry tragic endings.

The northwest border of Ursus—Formed after Ursus employed various means to force the Sami tribes on the border to migrate one by one. The Sami people view Ursus's influence as the individual tribe's concern, rather than a common threat to them all.

Train more Operators and explore the synergies between them to gain a greater advantage during combat

rogue_3_totem_R_L1.description: Realm-weight the guilt, ruined of pardon; never now to meet again.

rogue_3_totem_R_L2.name: Hunter
rogue_3_totem_R_L2.description: Bow traps shadow, shrieking in wind; knows the hunt no end.

rogue_3_totem_R_L3.name: Warrior
rogue_3_totem_R_L3.description: Firm beeth rock, rising in ranges; horned the helmet in hoar.

rogue_3_totem_R_L6.name: Hero

rogue_3_totem_R_L6.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader ['Demon's Blade'] 6 times

rogue_3_totem_R_E1.name: Sing

rogue_3_totem_R_E2.name: Silence
rogue_3_totem_R_E2.description: Heed the trees' way, hearken no answer; still are mountains stood.
rogue_3_totem_R_E2.usage: Allied units gain Max HP +50% in battle here

rogue_3_totem_R_E3.name: Recite

rogue_3_totem_R_E4.name: Debate
rogue_3_totem_R_E4.description: Cease does your singing, self do I show; thought meets truth intact.

rogue_3_totem_R_E5.name: Console

rogue_3_totem_R_E6.name: Confess

rogue_3_totem_G_L2.name: Water

rogue_3_totem_G_L3.name: Eye
rogue_3_totem_G_L3.description: Seen and known, sought and bid; there to gloaming gone.
rogue_3_totem_G_L3.usage: Select 1 adjacent node to the right

rogue_3_totem_G_L4.name: Arch
rogue_3_totem_G_L4.description: Hornbeast tracks, training of bells; vague 'til passing's place.
rogue_3_totem_G_L4.usage: Select 1 non-combat node + 2 more randomly selected non-combat nodes

rogue_3_totem_G_L5.name: Light
rogue_3_totem_G_L5.description: Stands the torch, certain as daylight; challenges chilblain eve.

rogue_3_totem_G_L6.name: Earth
rogue_3_totem_G_L6.description: Rise every being, return eft to roots; hewn is All from here.
rogue_3_totem_G_L6.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader [Weaving Vinecreeps] 6 times

rogue_3_totem_G_E1.name: Delight
rogue_3_totem_G_E1.description: Rainbow floats moonshade, rests in its jar; here now wish as you will.
rogue_3_totem_G_E1.usage: Gain 8 Originium Ingots after traversing node(s)

rogue_3_totem_G_E2.name: Surprise
rogue_3_totem_G_E2.description: Amid custom strange, bestowed is a gift; waver well then unite.

rogue_3_totem_G_E3.name: Rage
rogue_3_totem_G_E3.description: Ice and rock's havoc, hammer cast down; feather cannot dare crow.

rogue_3_relic_legacy_156.usage: Friendly Operators gradually gain ATK when not using a skill, up to a maximum of +60% after 60 seconds; bonus is reset when skill ends

rogue_3_relic_legacy_157.name: 'Sui's Wrath'
rogue_3_relic_legacy_157.description: The Feranmut lifts Its head, heaven and earth cower in fear.
rogue_3_relic_legacy_157.usage: Whenever you deploy a unit, deal 3000 Arts damage to a random enemy and the area around it
rogue_3_relic_legacy_157.unlockCondDesc: Win a battle while having at least 3 Specialist Operators

rogue_3_relic_legacy_158.name: Golden Chalice
rogue_3_relic_legacy_158.description: Saints, knights, and believers. All of them are madmen. Dear God, even the chalice itself is made of pure gold!
rogue_3_relic_legacy_158.usage: For each 5 Originium Ingots in possession, all friendly units have +7 ASPD

rogue_3_relic_legacy_159.name: Spinach Pack
rogue_3_relic_legacy_159.description: Many Cautus out there believe that popping the contents of this can into their mouths will grant them immense strength. The marketing's effectiveness is a classic success story in the industry.
rogue_3_relic_legacy_159.usage: All friendly units have +60% ATK for one second after their skill becomes active

rogue_3_relic_legacy_160.name: Wrath of Siracusans
rogue_3_relic_legacy_160.description: The signature pasta dish of an 'authentic Siracusan restaurant' that once operated in the capital of Gaul. The dish's unique taste, and particularly its sauce—a blend of thick chocolate sauce and Originium Slug liver—earned the praise of many Gaulish nobles. Supposedly, though, this dish nearly caused a diplomatic crisis between Siracusa and Gaul.
rogue_3_relic_legacy_160.usage: All friendly units have +100% ATK for one second after their skill becomes active
rogue_3_relic_legacy_160.unlockCondDesc: Clear [Rock and a Hard Place] without losing more than 3 Life Points

rogue_3_relic_legacy_162.name: 'End of Times'
rogue_3_relic_legacy_162.description: As long as a new cycle has not been reached, there is still time to fix your mistakes.
rogue_3_relic_legacy_162.usage: For one time only, if you would fail any battle other than the final battle of the area or a Leader battle, you instead gain +1 Life Point and advance to the next step instead of concluding the exploration
rogue_3_relic_legacy_162.unlockCondDesc: In a single battle, lose a total of 8 Life Points (including mission failures)

rogue_3_relic_legacy_163.name: 'King's Fellowship'
rogue_3_relic_legacy_163.description: The Cultists of the Deep did not achieve success overnight; they lingered at the junction between land and sea for ages, preparing for the calamity that would come to be known as the Profound Silence.
rogue_3_relic_legacy_163.usage: +2 Objective Shield, coverts all Life Points into an equivalent amount of Objective Shield (Cannot be reduced below 1 by this effect)
rogue_3_relic_legacy_163.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, obtain 20 victories with 1 Life Point remaining

rogue_3_relic_legacy_164.name: King's New Lance
rogue_3_relic_legacy_164.description: Beautiful wishes made in dire straits can bring hope, even if they are not necessarily the truth.
rogue_3_relic_legacy_164.usage: When Life Point is 1, all friendly units have +50 ASPD

rogue_3_relic_legacy_165.name: Castle's Offspring
rogue_3_relic_legacy_165.description: With enough time, this box will become a whole new stage.
rogue_3_relic_legacy_165.usage: All Operators gain +300 DEF and +30 RES after being deployed for 100 seconds
rogue_3_relic_legacy_165.unlockCondDesc: Complete an adventure with at least 80 Operators deployed in battle

rogue_3_relic_legacy_166.name: 'Little Gran Faro'
rogue_3_relic_legacy_166.description: The illumination device produced after reverse engineering the Eye of Iberia. It is powerful enough to penetrate layers of dark clouds, as well as temporarily repel powerful enemies.
rogue_3_relic_legacy_166.usage: Deals Stun to all enemy units for 5 seconds every time an enemy unit enters the Objective Point
rogue_3_relic_legacy_166.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, lose a total of 125 Life Points

rogue_3_relic_legacy_167.name: 'Memories of The Shard'
rogue_3_relic_legacy_167.description: 'It has pierced Victoria's heart, and is watching the empire bleed.'
rogue_3_relic_legacy_167.usage: Deals 3000 True damage to all enemy units every time an enemy unit enters the Objective Point

rogue_3_relic_legacy_168.name: King's Buckler
rogue_3_relic_legacy_168.description: Keep your eyes straight ahead, and let your stalwart heart resist all hardship.
rogue_3_relic_legacy_168.usage: When Life Point is at 1, all Operators have +2 Block

rogue_3_relic_legacy_169.name: King's Staff
rogue_3_relic_legacy_169.description: Let go of worthless pomp and treat others with kindness. They will no doubt return in kind.
rogue_3_relic_legacy_169.usage: When Life Point is at 1, all Operators recover an additional 1 SP every 2 seconds

rogue_3_relic_legacy_170.name: King's Crown
rogue_3_relic_legacy_170.description: O Nameless King, may you continue to bless Iberia, even should your kingdom fall to ruin.
rogue_3_relic_legacy_170.usage: When Life Point is at 1, all friendly units have +50% ATK, increased to +150% ATK if you have collected 3 or more King's Collectibles

rogue_3_relic_legacy_171.name: 'Glorious Kazimierz'
rogue_3_relic_legacy_171.description: A Kazimierzian best-seller that adapts the deeds of the arena's brightest-shining knights into a novel. Nearl, who was exiled but returned to reclaim her laurels, occupies a considerable portion of its pages.
rogue_3_relic_legacy_171.usage: Operators gain +70% ATK for 6 seconds after dodging

rogue_3_relic_legacy_172.name: 'The Return'
rogue_3_relic_legacy_172.description: This Kazimierzian best-seller is said to be a collective creation by fans. 'Nearl' has already become an amalgamation of many ideals and fantasies. 'For her, exile was not an escape. She came back, and stood alone against the era's torrents.'
rogue_3_relic_legacy_172.usage: Operators gain +130% ATK for 6 seconds after dodging
rogue_3_relic_legacy_172.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, clear a total of 40 battles

rogue_3_relic_book_1.name: Iron Guard - Consolidation
rogue_3_relic_book_1.description: No matter how hard fate hits you, just take it in.
rogue_3_relic_book_1.usage: Defender Operators gain HP +40%, DEF +40%, and RES +20
rogue_3_relic_book_1.unlockCondDesc: Across all adventures, enter the [Wilderness Survival Expert] event 4 times

rogue_3_relic_book_2.name: Rusted Blade - Spearhead Sharpening
rogue_3_relic_book_2.description: 'Try this new weapon out—or did you already try it out just now?
rogue_3_relic_book_2.usage: Specialist Operators have +40% ATK and +2 shift strength
rogue_3_relic_book_2.unlockCondDesc: Across all adventures, enter the [Lowland Market] event 6 times

rogue_3_relic_hand_1.name: Hand of Fisticuffs
rogue_3_relic_hand_1.description: What she means by standing over there, is that you cannot cross.
rogue_3_relic_hand_1.usage: Protector, Arts Protector, and Duelist Operators inflict Bind on all nearby enemies lasting 1 second every 2 seconds, and deal True damage equal to 100% of their ATK

rogue_3_relic_hand_2.name: Hand of Adaptability
rogue_3_relic_hand_2.description: What we lack now is not battlefield intelligence, but a captain who is able to finish reading said intelligence in time.
rogue_3_relic_hand_2.usage: Charger, Pioneer, and Tactician Operators have -10 DP Cost, and after defeating an enemy grant -1 DP Cost to all undeployed Operators on their next deployment

rogue_3_relic_hand_3.name: Hand of Outburst
rogue_3_relic_hand_3.description: Smash open every single crack, or perhaps make the very first.
rogue_3_relic_hand_3.usage: Heavyshooter, Deadeye, and Besieger Operators deal increasing damage to enemies as the target's HP decreases, up to a maximum of 50%, and instantly defeat enemies below 20% HP

rogue_3_relic_res_1.name: Knight Lance Pro
rogue_3_relic_res_1.description: Don't worry if your own strength isn't enough! Use these tiny levers to move more, and win more in every round! The grand prize is a holiday trip to Sami!
rogue_3_relic_res_1.usage: Treasure Chests on the battlefield will drop more Originium Ingots

rogue_3_relic_res_2.name: Spectrum Analyzer
rogue_3_relic_res_2.description: Please be careful regarding the abnormal phenomena in Sami. The results from measuring electromagnetic radiation and analyzing the specimen's micro-crystals are completely incompatible.

rogue_3_relic_res_3.name: Full-Auto Maintenance Station
rogue_3_relic_res_3.description: It's a little dirty, but can run on complete full-auto. And, for reasons no one knows, even runs from morning to night when no one's using it. Raythean Industries claims to have never designed such a product.
rogue_3_relic_res_3.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, enter a total of 40 non-combat nodes

rogue_3_relic_res_4.name: Leisure Time
rogue_3_relic_res_4.description: The children are experts at picking up all sorts of things to build their own play-kingdom. The wetland dwellers are accustomed to the outsiders always abruptly abandoning their vehicles halfway to their destination.

rogue_3_relic_res_5.name: Warning Fence
rogue_3_relic_res_5.description: The colorful decorations stand out in the snow, letting people imagine them clearly even in their dreams. The territory has no borders, but the roaming mind needs to know where fear is lurking.

rogue_3_relic_res_6.name: 'Heavy Music Anthology'
rogue_3_relic_res_6.description: Every winter, Columbian rescue crews stationed in southern Sami have several missions to rescue bands who get lost in the snowy woods while filming music videos.

rogue_3_relic_res_7.name: Wandering Caster's Nostalgia
rogue_3_relic_res_7.description: Someone has copied these notes down in a desperate attempt to remember them. The melody performed by the blade cutting through the air is strangely harmonious, but does not follow the equal temperament of music at all.
rogue_3_relic_res_7.usage: When entering Secluded Passage, -3 Collapse value

rogue_3_relic_res_8.name: Tranquil Spring Current
rogue_3_relic_res_8.description: After escaping a siege of wind and snow by following the sound of water drops, this specimen has become a protective charm for the research team.
rogue_3_relic_res_8.usage: Gain +2 Anti-Interference Index, +3 Max Life Points, and +3 Hope

rogue_3_relic_res_9.name: Ceremony Bell
rogue_3_relic_res_9.description: Close your eyes. Look inward for all that you crave.
rogue_3_relic_res_9.usage: Recover 1 Life Point whenever you lose Anti-Interference Index
rogue_3_relic_res_9.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader [Weaving Vinecreeps] 2 times

rogue_3_relic_res_10.name: 'Blindness'
rogue_3_relic_res_10.description: These days, there is no one capable of determining if they still retain the structure of a Sarkaz Royal Court, or if they still have a King within. The final memory that everyone can recall is the moment when a certain Cyclopes took off the black crown atop their head.
rogue_3_relic_res_10.usage: When Anti-Interference Index is at 0 to 1, moving horizontally or vertically will randomly grant you Objective Shield, Originium Ingot, Hope, Anti-Interference Index, or Foldartal
rogue_3_relic_res_10.unlockCondDesc: Complete an adventure with at least 30 Life Points lost

rogue_3_relic_res_11.name: Northern Pioneer's Crutch
rogue_3_relic_res_11.description: It can detect some types of hazards, but more importantly, it can detect coins. According to the terms of the contract, the company will only bear the costs of the Pioneers' medical insurance after a local medical institute adhering to Columbian standards has been established.
rogue_3_relic_res_11.usage: When Anti-Interference Index is no less than 4, gain +2 Originium Ingots whenever you enter a non-combat node

rogue_3_relic_res_12.name: Scarred Amber
rogue_3_relic_res_12.description: The elves have been left so alone on Terra that they embrace the dust with their backs to a foreign land.
rogue_3_relic_res_12.usage: Uncaps Anti-Interference Index Limit, and every surplus index point will grant all allied units HP +8% and ATK +8%
rogue_3_relic_res_12.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, obtain a total of 20 Anti-Interference Index

rogue_3_relic_fight_1.name: Hunters' Insight
rogue_3_relic_fight_1.description: Before her will is completely wrested away, the girl begs the rescuer approaching her: 'Let me draw the bowstring, let me defeat it, let me never fear.'
rogue_3_relic_fight_1.usage: All Operators ignore 50% DEF and RES when attacking [Collapsals], and Slow them for 0.5 sec
rogue_3_relic_fight_1.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, defeat a total of 200 'Tainted Carcass'

rogue_3_relic_fight_2.name: 'Devotion'
rogue_3_relic_fight_2.description: Since antiquity, this tribe has believed that they hold a truth about Sami: Everything originally had a voice, until 'It' spoke for all of them.
rogue_3_relic_fight_2.usage: Ranged Operators deal 150 Arts damage to a random enemy within attack range with every attack or heal

rogue_3_relic_fight_3.name: Celestial Dust
rogue_3_relic_fight_3.description: She gently blows away the countless records of sunrises, moonsets, and the changing of the stars. Her life is blown away that easily.
rogue_3_relic_fight_3.usage: Ranged Operators Levitate all enemies within attack range for 2 seconds when a skill is manually activated

rogue_3_relic_fight_4.name: Frozen Husk
rogue_3_relic_fight_4.description: The warriors of Sami stationed in the Fjal Vetrtonn are often inspired by an illusion: As their life flows toward the earth, their originally frozen bodies become lighter and lighter.
rogue_3_relic_fight_4.usage: Melee Operators gain ASPD +40 for 5 seconds after taking damage

rogue_3_relic_fight_5.name: Ring of Thorns
rogue_3_relic_fight_5.description: You were able to steady yourself while in a distorted fear. There is blood left on the thorns, and you don't know if it was you or the Snowpriest who was pricked by them. They will use whatever means they have, without batting an eye.
rogue_3_relic_fight_5.usage: When Melee Operators are healed, they and Operators in the adjacent 4 tiles will recover 1 SP

rogue_3_relic_fight_6.name: 'Peek into the Eternal Night'
rogue_3_relic_fight_6.description: The moment she turns around to head north, mountains in black lie before her eyes, just like the omen she saw many years ago.
rogue_3_relic_fight_6.usage: All Operators gain ATK +25% and ASPD +25, but lose 25 HP every second

rogue_3_relic_fight_7.name: 'Dead Tree's Echo'
rogue_3_relic_fight_7.description: Drum to call their ancestors' souls, drum to communicate with the vegetation, drum to exorcise evil spirits. Shaman after shaman have received this beastbone hammer, some leaving a longer echo than the others.
rogue_3_relic_fight_7.usage: All Operators recover 50 HP every second, but have Max HP -25%

rogue_3_relic_fight_8.name: Frozen Whetstone
rogue_3_relic_fight_8.description: The stone's surface is smooth as ice. The maker asked the mountain cliffs for permission to replicate their overpowering strength in their blade.
rogue_3_relic_fight_8.usage: When a battle begins, the Max HP, ATK, DEF, RES, Block Count, Starting SP, and DP Cost of a random Operator is doubled

rogue_3_relic_fight_9.name: Clairvoyant's Reveal
rogue_3_relic_fight_9.description: There is no direction you can head to avoid misfortune.
rogue_3_relic_fight_9.usage: The DP Cost and Redeployment Time of all Operators is randomly changed

rogue_3_relic_fight_10.name: Weave of Snow and Soil
rogue_3_relic_fight_10.description: Those within this ring receive the attention of the snow and earth.
rogue_3_relic_fight_10.usage: Designates one deployable tile at the beginning of battle; allied Operators deployed on that tile or its surrounding 8 tiles will grant 1 SP to another Operator within those tiles whenever they gain SP from Offensive or Defensive Recovery

rogue_3_relic_fight_11.name: Weave of Thorns and Leaves
rogue_3_relic_fight_11.description: Those within this ring receive the favor of the thorns and leaves.
rogue_3_relic_fight_11.usage: Designates one deployable tile at the beginning of battle; allied units deployed on that tile or its surrounding 8 tiles will gain Camouflage

rogue_3_relic_fight_12.name: Living Woodplate
rogue_3_relic_fight_12.description: The shamans know how trees will cling to survival, so they invite the trees to become armor for a warrior possessing a similar will.
rogue_3_relic_fight_12.usage: All allied melee units gain a Barrier equal to 50% of their Max HP on deployment

rogue_3_relic_fight_13.name: Finshell Shield
rogue_3_relic_fight_13.description: The stacks of distant trauma cannot surpass the layers of protection built by the body.
rogue_3_relic_fight_13.usage: All allied ranged units gain 3 layers of Shield on deployment

rogue_3_relic_fight_14.name: Ancient Tree Fruit
rogue_3_relic_fight_14.description: The children of Sami made their wishes into tree seeds, and buried them in the snow. When the tree bears fruit, the first four are taken, and the smallest is left for future generations to make their wishes. The remaining fruits are tributes to Sami, praying for answers.

rogue_3_relic_fight_15.name: Polar Retrofit Package
rogue_3_relic_fight_15.description: Proudly produced by the Volvort Kochinski Extreme Environment Equipment Testing Department. It can modify a variety of devices, adapting them for polar regions and increasing their effectiveness in cold environments.
rogue_3_relic_fight_15.usage: When used, Support items will also be used simultaneously on the adjacent 4 tiles
rogue_3_relic_fight_15.unlockCondDesc: Select 'Support Squad' and complete your adventure

rogue_3_relic_fight_16.name: Frost Buck's Pauldron
rogue_3_relic_fight_16.description: There are no signs of injuries on his body, only a pair of eyes drained of blood and tears.
rogue_3_relic_fight_16.usage: All allied units gain ATK +40% and DEF +40% for 30 seconds when blocking 2 or more enemies
rogue_3_relic_fight_16.unlockCondDesc: Win a battle while having at least 3 Defender Operators

rogue_3_relic_fight_17.name: Snow Doe's Glove
rogue_3_relic_fight_17.description: She shoots the last three arrows in her quiver at the Frozen Monstrosity, who used them to end her life.
rogue_3_relic_fight_17.usage: All allied units gain ASPD +80 and obtain 50% Physical and Arts Dodge for 30 seconds when blocking 3 or more enemies

rogue_3_relic_fight_18.name: Empty Fowlbeast
rogue_3_relic_fight_18.description: The body is long since gone, but the soul remains in the shell for eternity. The unmelting creatures in the branches and leaves carry icicles as they spread their wings in the forest.
rogue_3_relic_fight_18.usage: Summons gain Max HP +30%, ATK +30%, and grant ATK +60% to their summoner

rogue_3_relic_fight_19.name: Rock Horn
rogue_3_relic_fight_19.description: If you want to gather up manpower in Sami, blowing a trumpet is definitely the best way to do it.
rogue_3_relic_fight_19.usage: All Operators gain ATK +20% for every Operator in the adjacent 4 tiles

rogue_3_relic_fight_20.name: Inextinguishable Torch
rogue_3_relic_fight_20.description: Flames represent radiance and warmth. Gathering round a fire turns despair into hope.
rogue_3_relic_fight_20.usage: All Operators gain ASPD +30 for every Operator in the adjacent 4 tiles
rogue_3_relic_fight_20.unlockCondDesc: Complete an adventure with at least 200 Operator deployments in battle

rogue_3_relic_fight_21.name: Lakebed Aegis
rogue_3_relic_fight_21.description: Three decades ago, a child dropped his toy wooden shield into the lake. Three decades later, he bores through the frozen lake, retrieves his shield, and embarks on a hero's journey.
rogue_3_relic_fight_21.usage: Objective Shield +1; all allied units gain Max HP +60% if you have any Objective Shield at the beginning of a battle

rogue_3_relic_fight_22.name: Roundstone Altar
rogue_3_relic_fight_22.description: Offer a sacrifice, and receive a reward. It is so convenient that the people never think about what they are directing their sacrifices to.
rogue_3_relic_fight_22.usage: There is a chance after battle to permanently increase all allied units' ATK and DEF by 5% (Can stack up to 10 times)

rogue_3_relic_fight_23.name: Ancient Fresco
rogue_3_relic_fight_23.description: Walk out of the cave, and raise your head. This has never been right, even since antiquity.
rogue_3_relic_fight_23.usage: When an enemy enters or is freed from Levitation and/or Weightless, they take 1000 Arts damage and are Silenced for 10 seconds

rogue_3_relic_fight_24.name: Galleria Stellaria's Splendor
rogue_3_relic_fight_24.description: At that moment, the light of truth shone onto the earth.
rogue_3_relic_fight_24.usage: When an enemy enters or is freed from Levitation and/or Weightless, they take 2000 Arts damage and take 30% more damage for 10 seconds

rogue_3_relic_fight_25.name: Rainbow Jar
rogue_3_relic_fight_25.description: It is usually placed by the Sami people wherever the rainbow falls. They are meticulously maintained in order to withstand the untraceable catastrophes, both natural and man-made.
rogue_3_relic_fight_25.usage: Whenever an enemy enters the Objective Point, immediately selects a random Operator waiting to be re-deployable, and reduces their Redeployment Time by half

rogue_3_relic_fight_26.name: Cloud-Moving Totem
rogue_3_relic_fight_26.description: The Sami tribe that believes in the King of Fowlbeasts created this totem. It is said that a sincere call will stir its wings, raising a storm and making the earth tremble.
rogue_3_relic_fight_26.usage: All enemies have -15% Movement Speed, and the Weightless effect further drops their Weight Level by 2

rogue_3_relic_explore_1.name: Sprouted Stick
rogue_3_relic_explore_1.description: It accompanied a sturdy and swarthy Kuranta out of the country of sand, accompanied him, the Director of Rhine Lab's Scientific Investigation Section, into the silverwhite plains. Even though it was separated from its owner in an accident, it can still bring its wielder a revelation about survival.
rogue_3_relic_explore_1.usage: Gain +2 Objective Shield when entering Bosky Passage or Lost and Found nodes

rogue_3_relic_explore_2.name: Cannot's Mark
rogue_3_relic_explore_2.description: Some people are willing to do Cannot a favor, and some are worthy for Cannot to do a 'favor.'
rogue_3_relic_explore_2.usage: Gain 1 Hope whenever you buy an item at the Rogue Trader or make an exchange at Lost and Found
rogue_3_relic_explore_2.unlockCondDesc: In the 'Prospective Investment System,' reach an Investment Reserve Balance of 325

rogue_3_relic_explore_3.name: Guiding Vinedoll
rogue_3_relic_explore_3.description: The shamans often make these little puppets out of vines to navigate the forest. Even though they are not very accurate, striking true can conserve a lot of the survey equipment's energy.
rogue_3_relic_explore_3.usage: Anti-Interference Index has a chance to not decrease when traveling through a vertical path

rogue_3_relic_explore_4.name: Broken Ursus Blade
rogue_3_relic_explore_4.description: It was not for a lack of determination; his willpower is beyond question. It was only that, at that moment of self-determination, his body instinctively committed an irreversible mistake.
rogue_3_relic_explore_4.usage: Gain Command EXP +10% for each level of Collapsal Paradigm
rogue_3_relic_explore_4.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader ['Demon's Blade'] 2 times

rogue_3_relic_explore_5.name: Slytooth, Forest Destroyer
rogue_3_relic_explore_5.description: When it discovered that humans were willing to exchange tree fruits for wood chips, this musbeast began to unscrupulously devour the forest bark for more chips. It may not have expected that many of those chips would embody Sami's supreme will.
rogue_3_relic_explore_5.usage: Battles have a chance to drop an extra 1 Foldartal

rogue_3_relic_explore_6.name: Amma's Affection
rogue_3_relic_explore_6.description: It does love you, as is evident from the weight in your pocket, but Its love is fleeting and fickle, and you never know if what you retrieve from your pocket will be proof of Its protection or a handful of melted snow.
rogue_3_relic_explore_6.usage: All allied units gain +1% HP, ATK, and DEF; occasionally something wonderful will happen

rogue_3_relic_boss_1.name: Treescar Helm
rogue_3_relic_boss_1.description: It carries status and power, but to the warrior, it is only an artificial object for the weak to protect themselves. Some discard it to abandon their duty, some discard it only to strengthen their resolve to give up their lives.
rogue_3_relic_boss_1.usage: +3 Hope; leads expedition in a different direction

rogue_3_relic_boss_2.name: Boundless Gift
rogue_3_relic_boss_2.description: Takes root in regions unperceivable, absorbs nutrients in places unimaginable. The flowers bloom across the vastness, becoming the very first signal beacon outside the border.
rogue_3_relic_boss_2.usage: +3 Collapse value; leads expedition in a different direction

rogue_3_relic_boss_2b.name: Routeweave Net
rogue_3_relic_boss_2b.description: An intricate network is woven into a map that no one understands. It shows what seems to be a path that extends in all directions, but what it actually displays is only the result.
rogue_3_relic_boss_2b.usage: Additional enemies appear in battle; leads expedition in a different direction

rogue_3_explore_tool_1.name: Altar-type Radar
rogue_3_explore_tool_1.description: Wireless locating device that can be quickly deployed and withdrawn to avoid friendly casualties. After returning from Chernobog, engineers have worked to understand the principles behind the device, overcoming the harm they once caused.
rogue_3_explore_tool_1.usage: Bring 1 Altar-type Radar to each battle

rogue_3_explore_tool_2.name: R-45 Portable 'Gramophone'
rogue_3_explore_tool_2.description: Originium Arts conductor prototype, part of Engineering's attempt to create a transmission protocol that operators with lower Originium Arts Assimilation can use. Criticized by some Leithanians as lacking in elegance.
rogue_3_explore_tool_2.usage: Bring 1 R-45 Portable 'Gramophone' to each battle

rogue_3_explore_tool_3.name: Ornamental Giant Mushroom
rogue_3_explore_tool_3.description: Manmade shelter that provides cover from the weather. Blatantly artificial, it fails to blend into the environment even in the jungles of Sargon.
rogue_3_explore_tool_3.usage: Bring 2 Ornamental Giant Mushrooms to each battle

rogue_3_explore_tool_4.name: Field Device LUD-99X
rogue_3_explore_tool_4.description: Every operator seems to have a different idea about what this is. Some saw a stool, others a crowbar. Meanwhile, Closure and most engineering operators insist that its serial number is assigned to a conceptual model that has never been produced. Nor will it ever be.
rogue_3_explore_tool_4.usage: Field Device LUD-99X appears in all battles

rogue_3_explore_tool_5.name: Two-step Firecracker and Data-collector
rogue_3_explore_tool_5.description: One-time data collection device that emits a loud popping sound when activated. A Yanese operator has added the following note to the manual: 'It only pops once.'
rogue_3_explore_tool_5.usage: Bring 5 Two-step Firecracker and Data-collectors to each battle

rogue_3_explore_tool_6.name: Self-Driving Recon Cart
rogue_3_explore_tool_6.description: Autonomous device that can collect data and record video in areas too dangerous for operators to enter. Like most Durin designs, it spent a large portion of its development cycle as a toy for operators before field testing was conducted.
rogue_3_explore_tool_6.usage: Bring 1 Recon Self-Driver Launchpoint to each battle

rogue_3_relic_boss_4a.name: Horizon Invitation
rogue_3_relic_boss_4a.description: An invitation to the end of the icefield, distributed or sold through secret channels to those deserving. However, obtaining this invitation is merely the first step, and the test is yet to come—
rogue_3_relic_boss_4a.usage: Leads expedition in a different direction
rogue_3_relic_boss_4a.unlockCondDesc: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

rogue_3_relic_boss_4b.name: Dimensional Fluid
rogue_3_relic_boss_4b.description: A raw material developed by integrating technology from multiple nations and results from deep-dives into Collapsal research. After passing the test, the Rhodes Island operator officially hands it to you along with a message: 'Deliver it safely to the end of the icefield, where Kal'tsit waits for you.'
rogue_3_relic_boss_4b.usage: Leads expedition in a different direction
rogue_3_relic_boss_4b.unlockCondDesc: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

rogue_3_relic_curse_1.name: Collapsal Seed
rogue_3_relic_curse_1.description: Traces of Collapse remain here, refusing to be removed.
rogue_3_relic_curse_1.usage: All friendly units have -15% ATK and -15% HP
rogue_3_relic_curse_1.unlockCondDesc: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

rogue_3_relic_curse_2.name: Fragment of Space
rogue_3_relic_curse_2.description: The space here has been indiscriminately torn to shreds, leaving only a tiny piece.
rogue_3_relic_curse_2.unlockCondDesc: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

rogue_3_relic_curse_3.name: Profound Scorchmarks
rogue_3_relic_curse_3.description: The boundless energy burned away their body and soul, and they will never recover.
rogue_3_relic_curse_3.unlockCondDesc: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

rogue_3_relic_legacy_173.name: 'King's Crystal'
rogue_3_relic_legacy_173.description: The Iberians' contact with the Seaborn goes back further than they can imagine, but they did not know what the Seaborn were back then.
rogue_3_relic_legacy_173.usage: At the end of battle, -2 Life Points (will not go lower than 1), +1 Hope, +5 Originium Ingots

rogue_3_relic_legacy_174.name: 'Blossom'
rogue_3_relic_legacy_174.description: After several attempts by Touch, nature briefly opens up to you.
rogue_3_relic_legacy_174.usage: All Operators recover 1 SP every time they take damage or Elemental Injury
rogue_3_relic_legacy_174.unlockCondDesc: Win Emergency Ops [Harass With Strength] without losing any Life Point

rogue_3_relic_legacy_175.name: Timeworn Poetry Strips
rogue_3_relic_legacy_175.description: 'Drunk far beyond all mounts that list the realm, all beings take on souls as they demand.'
rogue_3_relic_legacy_175.usage: Summons will no longer use Deployment slots

rogue_3_relic_hand_4.name: Hand of Unyielding
rogue_3_relic_hand_4.description: Nice to have, even nicer when in danger.
rogue_3_relic_hand_4.usage: Artificers, Merchants, and Geeks will grant 3 temporary Life Points after being deployed on the field for 30 seconds (Each Operator can only trigger this once per battle)

rogue_3_relic_hand_5.name: Hand of Return
rogue_3_relic_hand_5.usage: Multi-target Medics, Chain Medics, and Wandering Medics will heal any Operator within their range to full HP when that Operator takes critical damage (Each Operator can only trigger this once per battle)

rogue_3_relic_book_3.name: Blunt Claws - Fuel
rogue_3_relic_book_3.description: The flames turn more intense with each additional firewood added to the pile.
rogue_3_relic_book_3.usage: For every Vanguard Operator on the field, gain 1 DP every 3 seconds (stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_3_relic_book_4.name: Bend Spears - Battlecry
rogue_3_relic_book_4.description: Combat is also a group activity. The more people there are, the more confident they get, and the more powerful they become with weapons in hand.
rogue_3_relic_book_4.usage: For every Guard Operator on the field, all allies gain ATK +8% (stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_3_relic_book_5.name: Iron Guard - Rampart
rogue_3_relic_book_5.description: Gather sand to form a tower, and gaze upon enemies from above.
rogue_3_relic_book_5.usage: For every Defender Operator on the field, all allies take 10% less physical damage (stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_3_relic_book_6.name: Fatal Bolts - Succession
rogue_3_relic_book_6.description: Hear the sound of the first arrow, as the last pierces the torso.
rogue_3_relic_book_6.usage: For every Sniper Operator on the field, all allies gain ASPD +12 (stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_3_relic_book_7.name: Broken Wand - Harmony
rogue_3_relic_book_7.description: The solos have their merits, but a chorus can destroy everything.
rogue_3_relic_book_7.usage: For every Caster Operator on the field, all allies deal +12% Arts damage (stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_3_relic_book_8.name: Stalwart Aid - Linkup
rogue_3_relic_book_8.description: Hand in hand, shoulder to shoulder, brace yourselves, and look straight ahead.
rogue_3_relic_book_8.usage: For every Supporter Operator on the field, increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.2/s (stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_3_relic_book_9.name: Healer's Path - Wellspring
rogue_3_relic_book_9.description: They are clear springs formed from flowing water, and they heal all that live.
rogue_3_relic_book_9.usage: For every Medic Operator on the field, all allies gain Redeployment Time -5% (stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_3_relic_book_10.name: Rusted Blade - Disturbance
rogue_3_relic_book_10.description: Delay the enemy bit by bit, just like slicing a sausage, and by the time they realize it there will be nothing they can do.
rogue_3_relic_book_10.usage: For every Specialist Operator on the field, all enemies have -5% Movement Speed (stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_3_relic_fight_27.name: Palmtop Pavilion
rogue_3_relic_fight_27.description: The Tumu Tianshi's masterpiece. Fits in one hand, but throw it to the ground and it turns into the ground floor of the Chamber of Heaven's Designs' outer pavilion. Once a secret of the Tianshi Bureaus, now mass-produced and widely used in garrisons and expeditions on the icefield.
rogue_3_relic_fight_27.usage: All Operators gain +1 Block, and an additional +1 Block after being deployed for more than 60 seconds
rogue_3_relic_fight_27.unlockCondDesc: Win Emergency Ops [No More Than Four] without losing any Life Point

rogue_3_relic_fight_28.name: Minoan Ode
rogue_3_relic_fight_28.description: 'Is there a feat more worthy of praise than an expedition into no man's land? Now, yes! Go forth into the north, and write the next chapter of your saga!'
rogue_3_relic_fight_28.usage: All Allies permanently gain HP +3% for every Emergency Ops cleared (stacks up to 15 times)

rogue_3_relic_fight_29.name: Friston.P
rogue_3_relic_fight_29.description: Friston would certainly not miss out on an opportunity to explore the secrets of another predecessor civilization. Oh, but Closure didn't even consider making backups, so DON'T tell her about this!
rogue_3_relic_fight_29.usage: All Allies permanently gain ASPD +5 for every Emergency Ops cleared (stacks up to 15 times)

rogue_3_relic_fight_30.name: Vinecreep Mortar Gunner
rogue_3_relic_fight_30.description: It's no surprise such a fantastical weapon would appear when people from different cultures let down their guard and communicate with sincerity.
rogue_3_relic_fight_30.usage: Enemies defeated while airborne will deal 3000 physical damage to surrounding enemies

rogue_3_relic_fight_31.name: Northwind Construct
rogue_3_relic_fight_31.description: Though she often fails, she is still committed to helping those who would challenge their tragic fates.
rogue_3_relic_fight_31.usage: [Machine] and [Arts Creations] enemies will be immediately Frozen with their first attack for 15 seconds
rogue_3_relic_fight_31.unlockCondDesc: Win Emergency Ops [Manmade Carnival] without losing any Life Point

rogue_3_relic_fight_32.name: Shattered Alliance Treaty
rogue_3_relic_fight_32.description: What are the Sarkaz in the eyes of others? Perhaps this object can explain everything.
rogue_3_relic_fight_32.usage: All Operators receive 50% less damage from Sarkaz and Possessed enemies

rogue_3_relic_fight_33.name: Paradigm Apparatus
rogue_3_relic_fight_33.description: Naturally, Ursus was unwilling to divulge their research into the Royal Guard to other countries. But ultimately, they caved to international pressure and shared some of their technology—after all, this was all to find the source of the demons.
rogue_3_relic_fight_33.usage: All enemies have ASPD -30 when on tiles affected by Dominion

rogue_3_relic_fight_34.name: Expeditioner's Field Pack
rogue_3_relic_fight_34.description: They always stuff their backpacks with survival supplies, then press forward with the determination and will to challenge the boundaries of the known.
rogue_3_relic_fight_34.usage: All Operators gain ATK +60% and Resist for 15 seconds after recovering from a negative status
rogue_3_relic_fight_34.unlockCondDesc: Win Emergency Ops [Where Ice Condenses] without losing any Life Point

rogue_3_relic_fight_35.name: Black Hole Protocol
rogue_3_relic_fight_35.description: This collaborative operation is unprecedented in the history books. The nations of Terra have invested a great deal of resources into the megastructure in the far north, and the NGO Rhodes Island has become the actual managing party in order to prevent the results from being concealed or tampered with.
rogue_3_relic_fight_35.usage: When DP is maxed out, all Operators gain Max HP +150%
rogue_3_relic_fight_35.unlockCondDesc: Win Emergency Ops [Payback] without losing any Life Point

rogue_3_explore_tool_3.trapDesc: Friendly units in the 4 adjacent tiles gain increased investigation abilities

grandPrizes.displayDiscription:
Back from a long vacation cut short.
He believes he has found the future for those ensnared by the past.

grandPrizes.acquireTitle: Top Operator Skill Training Pack Obtainable
grandPrizes.displayDiscription: Comprehensive record of expert techniques that allows Operators to quickly accumulate experience and become experts themselves.

grandPrizes.displayName: Memories of the Souls Furniture Pack I
grandPrizes.displayDiscription:
When the storytellers leave their stories,
the bizarre decorations dissipate like mist.
The countless Kazdels they visited diminish into hollow impressions,
'Melancholy Figments' and 'Unknown Omens' are all that remain.
The sacrifice created by thought must be offered by words.

The true essence of the soul,
transcends the confines of reason.
Heed your inner voice.
Declare your fashion statement through chaos.

grandPrizes.displayName: Memories of the Souls Furniture Pack II
grandPrizes.displayDiscription:
When the storytellers leave their stories,
the bizarre decorations dissipate like mist.
The countless Kazdels they visited diminish into hollow impressions,
'Dreamforged Rebirth' and 'Temporal Eddies' are all that remain.

The integration of data content is the essence of systems engineering.
It can improve the abilities of operators, or assist in adjusting their combat methods.
Are you already starting to think about how to put this to use?
Or will you keep it in your back pocket, saving it for a more suitable opportunity?

A creation marred by forbidden witchcraft.
A passage linking past to future.
A taboo arts that draws souls into stories.
A path to our consciousnesses.

Smash the obstructing shackles.
Move the piling barriers.
Even without her heavy amor,
No one can stop the Child of Soil and Stone.
An endless quest born of intuition, desire, instinct, and imagination.
An inerasable symbol from the Sarkaz's history.

chatItemList.chatDesc: Is it just a story, or the future?
'Project Cyclops'
Re-connection
'Has nobody thought of asking for a 'Gravity Defying Machine'? Seriously?'
'A fable would have vanished by now. Ha! So this shouldn't be a story.'
'Bet you haven't seen that before? That's the ice cream furnace of Kazdel, the city of candy. Just throw me in, and aim properly.'
Contact the liaison, submit the report, and stand by at the designated spot.
A meeting agenda should be determined by the democratic discussion of a committee, with the clerk independent of both the committee and the subject of discussion.
In truth, they knew way before Tin Man did, and this he knew as well.
Thoughts frantically rejoice for that faint echo.
She asked the Thought to sing the song that the lost land left behind.
She, too, should be selfish.
Why can I not see the bell tower?
How do I get in the bell tower?
I will not enter the bell tower.
A sigh blowing past the end
The resonance of an interwoven melody
The first roar of life
A starting point that requires imagination to reach
Fluctuating history
There is no end but the future
You are the source of suffering
Who're you?
We're not far from each other
