ro4_n_1_1.name: Bad Neighbors
ro4_n_1_1.description: A group of tramps and their pets have taken over this maintenance channel, modifying it without regard for others.

ro4_n_1_2.name: Vermin
ro4_n_1_2.description:
The furnace's heat attracts all kinds of critters from the wastes. They eagerly slip inside and gleefully wreak havoc.
<@rolv.rem><Waste Heat Vents> that deal Arts damage for brief periods when activated are present on the field</>

ro4_n_1_3.name: Safety Inspection
ro4_n_1_3.description:
The Liches have declared that maintenance workers must be examined and counted when they leave the furnace—not one less, and certainly not one more. This rule is not always enforced.
<@rolv.rem><Active Originium> that greatly increases the ATK and ASPD of units that pass over it, but continuously reduces their HP is present on the field</>
<@rolv.rem><Mobile Tactical Hangars> that deploy enemy mercenary drones are present on the field.</>

ro4_n_1_4.name: Hasty Escape
ro4_n_1_4.description: These embezzling Sarkaz sought to steal treasure from the furnace, but the 'treasure' discovered them first. In this chase, any road is a way out to survival.

ro4_n_1_5.name: Ice Age
ro4_n_1_5.description:
Making use of your environment is a fundamental survival skill, and the ice traps have already been set. The rest is up to you.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Ice Crystals> that continuously apply [Cold] are present on the field.</>

ro4_n_2_1.name: Dissuasion Seminar
ro4_n_2_1.description: Regularly hosted by the Temple of Knowledge, the Liches inside the furnace recount vivid horrors they've faced, urging others to leave. No one ever does.

ro4_n_2_2.name: Temporary Patchup
ro4_n_2_2.description:
Furnace maintenance tip #1: If something's busted, tear it down—if it needs repairing, someone will come and do it.
<@rolv.rem><Stun Generator> that can be activated with DP to stun surrounding enemies is present on the field.</>

ro4_n_2_3.name: Exhaust Vents
ro4_n_2_3.description:
Most Sarkaz youths have boasted of jumping off the platforms by the furnace exhaust vents and gliding down with the wind. In reality, those 'platforms' don't even have solid footing.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Jetstreams> that generate airflow currents are present on the field</>

ro4_n_2_4.name: Furnace Volunteers
ro4_n_2_4.description:
They were getting off work but were in such a hurry that they ended up in the wrong Kazdel.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Altars> that deal damage to both allies and enemies are present on the field</>

ro4_n_2_5.name: Clear the Crowd
ro4_n_2_5.description:
After figuring out what happened, these Sarkaz begin arguing over which Kazdel is better. They invite you to arbitrate the dispute, and won't leave until they're satisfied with the result.
<@rolv.rem><Exhaust Grilles> are present on the field; Operators deployed on this tile will not be targeted by enemy ranged attacks</>

ro4_n_2_6.name: Kaz Falls
ro4_n_2_6.description:
This place is famed for its unique living waterfall and bizarre life cycle. When enough slugkaz fall into the valley, they transform into machines, swim upstream, and revert to organic nourishment.
<@rolv.rem>Obtain extra Originium Ingots and Command EXP upon victory</>

ro4_n_2_7.name: Dense Jungle
ro4_n_2_7.description: Though they're called Slug Eaters, they'll devour anything that fits in their mouths.

ro4_n_3_1.name: Simulated Skirmish
ro4_n_3_1.description:
No one wants to play the role of 'foreign foe' in drills like this, so these mock skirmishes always turn into Sarkaz versus Sarkaz.
<@rolv.rem><Corrosive Ground> that halves the DEF of allied units deployed on it is present on the field</>

ro4_n_3_2.name: Bloodline Debates
ro4_n_3_2.description: A classic debate topic in the Temple of Knowledge: How exactly did the Teekaz split off, and when in history did it happen? Scholars endlessly speculate, with new theories 'invented' from time to time.

ro4_n_3_3.name: Blotted Sky
ro4_n_3_3.description: Kazdel's lifts always have long queues, with Nachzehrers handling uninvited guests trying to sneak into the city. Their summons also provide shade for everyone waiting.

ro4_n_3_4.name: Morning Labor
ro4_n_3_4.description:
In the city, crystal clusters grow nonstop, making morning harvesting a daily habit for the Sarkaz. Those who can afford breakfast harvest after eating; those who can't, go straight away.
<@rolv.rem><Rubble> that can change the enemy's route is present on the field</>

ro4_n_3_5.name: Careless Magic
ro4_n_3_5.description:
When cooking, accidents are prone to happen if the fire is neglected. The same is true when summoning servants with witchcraft. These two common sense rules are sometimes forgotten by the Sarkaz.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Altars> that deal damage to both allies and enemies are present on the field</>

ro4_n_3_6.name: Lottery Fight
ro4_n_3_6.description:
Invented by well-traveled Sarkaz for the thrill of it, the 'prizes' in this lottery step into the ring. It always ends in a chaotic group scrap, but at least everyone's having fun.
<@rolv.rem><Defensive Barricades> are present on the field that Block enemies</>
<@rolv.rem><Originium Ice Crystals> that continuously apply [Cold] are present on the field</>

ro4_n_3_7.name: Firepower Squad
ro4_n_3_7.description:
Scarmarket Nexus's firepower squads are armed with excessively many bomb drones and rocket launchers to carpet bomb enemies at first sight. This strategy reminds you of a certain other Sarkaz you know well.
<@rolv.rem>Obtain extra Originium Ingots and Command EXP upon victory</>

ro4_n_3_8.name: Motorized Squad
ro4_n_3_8.description: This Sarkaz squad is regularly deployed to the ground to collect enemy intelligence for the Sky City.

ro4_n_4_1.name: Epochal Gaps
ro4_n_4_1.description:
Time releases its grip, and the Sarkaz memories flicker through the intervals of existence.
<@rolv.rem><Roadside Emergency Reserves> that grant a certain amount of DP and Max DP when destroyed are present on the field</>

ro4_n_4_2.name: Sordid Surveillance
ro4_n_4_2.description: Illusions ebb and flow under witchcraft, with balance meticulously monitored across all epochs to ensure events unfold in their designated order.

ro4_n_4_3.name: Past The Aquapit
ro4_n_4_3.description:
A Durin from who-knows-where learned the skill of low-altitude flight from the Scrap Assemblers and now relishes in flight contests through the gaps between buildings in Kazdel. After all, the worst you'll get is a head full of bumps.
<@rolv.rem><Defensive Barricades> that block enemies are present on the field</>

ro4_n_4_4.name: Crimson Corridor
ro4_n_4_4.description:
This corridor will bring you to the Vampire's mausoleum, but it has yet to be stained with blood. This is precisely why Vampire heirs are scrambling to dye it in their shade right now.
<@rolv.rem><Heat Pump Passages> that periodically inflict damage to units standing on them are present on the field</>
<@rolv.rem><Defensive Barricades> that block enemies are present on the field</>

ro4_n_4_5.name: Rules of Modern Warfare
ro4_n_4_5.description:
Several months have passed since the Sarkaz Joint Agreement was enacted. All involved parties stand ready, as this new blood pact prepares to face its first trial in the flames of war.
<@rolv.rem><Power Armors> that activate by absorbing experimental products are present on the field</>
<@rolv.rem><Gramophones> that deal Arts damage to enemies and heal allies when captured are present on the field</>

ro4_n_4_6.name: Timeworn Tensions
ro4_n_4_6.description: Some ancient Sarkaz have been angered by these machines they've never seen before, but their outer shells seem to sport an engraved symbol of Kazdel.

ro4_n_4_7.name: Ghost City
ro4_n_4_7.description:
Legends say a revenant has possessed an ancient nomadic plate and wanders the land to this day. Could it be this very plate before you? What kind of people live on it?
<@rolv.rem><Twigs That Crave> that produce Rot Eaters are present on the field</>

ro4_n_4_8.name: Elusive Merc
ro4_n_4_8.description:
She has many names and many identities in different tales, but if you were to ask what she's like, the answer is always 'loves explosions'.
<@rolv.rem>Obtain extra Originium Ingots and Command EXP upon victory</>

ro4_n_4_9.name: Chaos
ro4_n_4_9.description:
The Sarkaz are pouring in. Did you figure out which tale this is? You didn't think about it? Th-Then what should we do?
<@rolv.rem>This map is filled with <Poison Haze> that causes allies to constantly lose HP</>
<@rolv.rem>Obtain extra Originium Ingots and Command EXP upon victory</>

ro4_n_4_10.name: Frequent Dispute
ro4_n_4_10.description:
The Tarans' arrival has only complicated the mine's ownership dispute. Ultimately, the solution is violence.
<@rolv.rem><Rubble> pieces that can block the enemy's route are present on the map.</>

ro4_n_5_1.name: Rogue Mercenary
ro4_n_5_1.description:
A mercenary went to Londinium to make ends meet, but you firmly believe she has nothing to do with the great blaze that destroyed the city.
<@rolv.rem><Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery> that deals True damage to the target area periodically is present on the field</>

ro4_n_5_2.name: Land Reclamation
ro4_n_5_2.description: The Sarkaz reclaim land with brutal efficiency: bombard the area until it's flat. With mouths to feed, careless interlopers won't deter their relentless plans.

ro4_n_5_3.name: Witch-Curse Alliance
ro4_n_5_3.description:
Led by the Emperor and nobles, the Leithanians gradually grew accustomed to life with the Sarkaz. Little do they know, this genuine friendship will soon bring shocking secrets.
<@rolv.rem><Tuning Nodes> that can be attacked to switch variations and buff allied units are present on the field</>

ro4_n_5_4.name: Passage Blockade
ro4_n_5_4.description: This channel must be sealed off, and any negligence eradicated within the furnace. Illusions hold truth and can shape reality, so act with extreme precaution.

ro4_n_5_5.name: Guiltless Paradise
ro4_n_5_5.description:
Chaos is order, creation is law.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Pollution> that continuously deals True damage to units and greatly reduces their SP recovery is present on the field</>

ro4_n_5_6.name: Aerial Assault
ro4_n_5_6.description: Kazdel's 'plate' sails through the skies, but regrettably, this does not mean it is impervious to assaults from hostile cities.

ro4_n_5_7.name: Wrecked Academy
ro4_n_5_7.description:
One night, parts of the academy tumbled into Kazdel's many cracks. The next day, unaffected scholars and professors were anguished, lamenting their missed opportunity.
<@rolv.rem><Exhaust Grilles> are present on the field; Operators deployed on this tile will not be targeted by enemy ranged attacks</>

ro4_n_5_8.name: Regular Army
ro4_n_5_8.description:
If the twin kings' federation were to have a standing army, they might look like this—
<@rolv.rem>This map has <Exhaust Grilles> which prevent allies from being targeted by enemy ranged attacks</>
<@rolv.rem>Obtain extra Originium Ingots and Command EXP upon victory</>

ro4_n_5_9.name: Rhine Guardians
ro4_n_5_9.description:
Anyone eyeing Nasti's technology must first get past Defense Section's security.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Jetstreams> that generate airflow currents are present on the field</>

ro4_n_6_1.name: Quest For Consensus
ro4_n_6_1.description: Most ancestors tend to discuss similar possibilities, while others vehemently express their objections. Within the illusion, figures representing the opposition begin rushing towards you.

ro4_n_6_2.name: Divine Desire
ro4_n_6_2.description:
The two greatest wishes of the Teekaz outside the Holy City are acceptance and entry. The Gelato Stops within the city will take care of the rest.
<@rolv.rem><'Gelato Stops'> are present on the field that restore allied SP when captured</>

ro4_n_7_1.name: Heavenly Paradise
ro4_n_7_1.description: 'They say paradise should be offered four treasures: a mirror with wings of copper, a wooden paperweight of gathered strength, a seal of passage engraved with an auspicious beast, and a flawless spearhead of iron.'

ro4_n_7_2.name: 'Heretics'
ro4_n_7_2.description: Perhaps labeling this rabble 'heretics' is too good for them. They're not even followers of another path. They simply want to tear down your flag for their own satisfaction.

ro4_b_1.name: River Watcher
ro4_b_1.description: As humidity rises, a gentle stream wraps around your feet—a greeting from the Convallis. Guided by ancestral tales, you cast your gaze two centuries back, and Laqeramaline smiles back at you.

ro4_b_1_b.name: Veil of Probability
ro4_b_1_b.description:
The enemy from two centuries ago did not appear as planned. Through her veil, you exchange a gaze with the Banshee from afar. You both find the city familiar and yet strange.
<@rolv.rem><Twigs That Crave> that produce Rot Eaters are present on the field</>

ro4_b_1_c.name: Courtyard of Farewells
ro4_b_1_c.description:
Perhaps she longs for another glimpse of the city. She will continue to sing tomorrow, the day after, and the days that follow. She will still sing.
<@rolv.rem><Twigs That Crave> that produce Rot Eaters are present on the field</>

ro4_b_2.name: Silent Guardian
ro4_b_2.description:
He barely speaks of his past, yet his passion is relentless, like the engine he maintains. Guided by ancestral tales, you cast your gaze two centuries back, but the warrior does not turn around.
<@rolv.rem><Command Terminals> that will deplete Life Points when destroyed are present on the field</>

ro4_b_2_b.name: Devoted Warrior
ro4_b_2_b.description:
The enemy from two centuries ago did not appear as planned. The warrior's sword bursts aflame. It burns for his friends, a fire that refuses to extinguish.
<@rolv.rem><Command Terminals> that will deplete Life Points when destroyed are present on the field</>

ro4_b_2_c.name: Brave Souls Marching
ro4_b_2_c.description:
A better life is for future generations; the Goliath secures the present. As enemies swarm and home teeters on collapse, the Goliath marches steadfastly forward.
<@rolv.rem><Rubble> that can change the enemy's route is present on the field</>
<@rolv.rem><Active Originium> that greatly increases the ATK and ASPD of units that pass over it, but continuously reduces their HP is present on the field</>

ro4_b_3.name: Battle of Survival
ro4_b_3.description:
Vassal, fool, friend, foe. The ancestors debate incessantly, while you cast your gaze two centuries back. This is a battle of life and death, and you see Kal'tsit with her comrades tearing through the front lines.
<@rolv.rem><Mobile Tactical Hangars> that deploy enemy mercenary drones are present on the field</>

ro4_b_3_b.name: Decapitation
ro4_b_3_b.description:
The hero from two centuries ago did not appear as planned. Spurred by the doom she foresees, the prophet and her companion go for their target without hesitation. You must confront them.
<@rolv.rem><Mobile Tactical Hangars> that deploy enemy mercenary drones are present on the field</>

ro4_b_3_c.name: Under The Crown
ro4_b_3_c.description: Guard Yliš's chariot and crown a little longer—this is more than just honor. Ensure this, and the future prophet and King of Sarkaz will not regret their missed encounter.

ro4_b_4.name: Emergency Lecture
ro4_b_4.description:
Everyone: stop at once, and put everything down. We will now begin an important course on ceremony operational safety, and attendance is mandatory.
<@rolv.rem>Allied units Redeployment Time reduced by 50%</>

ro4_b_4_b.name: Cognitive Correction
ro4_b_4_b.description:
The revenants have managed to enrage the Lich King, so the contents of this emergency lecture have changed.
<@rolv.rem>Allied units Redeployment Time reduced by 50%</>

ro4_b_4_c.name: Emergency Lecture
ro4_b_4_c.description:
Everyone: stop at once, and put everything down. We will now begin an important course on ceremony operational safety, and attendance is mandatory. 
<@rolv.rem>Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new enemies will appear</>

ro4_b_4_d.name: Cognitive Correction
ro4_b_4_d.description:
The revenants have managed to enrage the Lich King, so the contents of this emergency lecture have changed.
<@rolv.rem>Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new enemies will appear</>

ro4_b_5.name: Court Visit
ro4_b_5.description: A century or more ago, the Sarkaz rescued the Palace of Westhaleg along with other plates from a giant Catastrophe in Londinium and brought them to Kazdel. It was the beginning, and a symbol of reconciliation.

ro4_b_5_b.name: The Court of Souls
ro4_b_5_b.description: The revenants changed the tale again, so this time you'll be facing the twin kings and their royal guard... Wait, since when were the ancestors themselves the royal guard?!

ro4_b_5_c.name: Court Visit
ro4_b_5_c.description:
A century or more ago, the Sarkaz rescued the Palace of Westhaleg along with other plates from a giant Catastrophe in Londinium and brought it to Kazdel. It was the beginning, and a symbol of reconciliation.
<@rolv.rem>Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new enemies will appear</>

ro4_b_5_d.name: The Court of Souls
ro4_b_5_d.description:
The revenants changed the tale again, so this time you'll be facing the twin kings and their royal guard... Wait, since when were the ancestors themselves the royal guard?!
<@rolv.rem>Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new enemies will appear</>

ro4_b_6.name: Holy City
ro4_b_6.description:
The Holy City—magnificent, harmonious, generous, elegant. Its guardians equally and mercifully examine every individual entering the gates, accepting all who accept it.
<@rolv.rem>Holy Automatons gain greatly increased ATK</>

ro4_b_7.name: The Dharma Sermon
ro4_b_7.description:
Qui'lon has made his preparations for his debate with the Storytellers. No matter their numbers or questions, he shall be there to the very end.
<@rolv.rem>Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; Thunderburst will appear</>

ro4_b_8.name: Fate's Finale
ro4_b_8.description: The final page of every story.

ro4_t_1.name: Failed Dare
ro4_t_1.description:
He followed his boss to Kazdel and was egged on by friends to prove his bravery. No Sarkaz even noticed him, yet he had already reduced himself into a sobbing mess.
<@rolv.rem><Detector> that can disable the Invisibility of enemies when activated is present on the field</>

ro4_t_2.name: Signal Light
ro4_t_2.description:
Who knows what unhinged plans the Duck Lord had in mind when he arranged a vehicle to abduct civilians. Fortunately, you found out about it in advance, and the drivers don't know the route too well.
<@rolv.rem><Static Roadblocks> that can block the enemy's route and be attacked by allied units are present on the map</>

ro4_t_3.name: Illusory Heist
ro4_t_3.description: 'These are all illusions, you can't take them out of the furnace...' Recalling past encounters, you decide to approach them differently this time—by letting your weapon do the talking.

ro4_t_4.name: Duck-Speed Highway
ro4_t_4.description:
Duck Lord has built a transportation hub here! His friends are flooding in! He does not have Kazdel's municipal approval, nor an environmental impact assessment report! Illegal buildings must be torn down!
<@rolv.rem><Roadblock> that can block the enemy's route can be deployed</>

ro4_t_5.name: Beside The Battlefield
ro4_t_5.description: Not all conflicts end in violence. In those that don't, the two sides lay down not just their weapons, but their prejudices.

ro4_t_6.name: Legacy
ro4_t_6.description:
'It' considers itself a passage, and 'it' has come, following the successor's claim.
<@rolv.rem><Twigs That Crave> that produce Rot Eaters are present on the field</>

ro4_t_7.name: Victory Rewind
ro4_t_7.description:
Characters and events flash before your eyes as time rewinds. This backtrack is necessary and inevitable for another possible ending, but it shouldn't be this way. Nothing should be absolutely inevitable.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Ice Crystals> that continuously apply [Cold] are present on the field</>

ro4_t_8.name: Revenge of the Toys
ro4_t_8.description: The emergency alarm has been triggered. Abandoned dreams and hopes manipulate the similarly abandoned scrap heap, determined to protect those who deem them valuable.

ro4_ev_1.name: Property Dispute
ro4_ev_1.description:
Items created through imagination belong to their creator, not the finder. Mr. Goodenough is still making excuses—teach him how things work.
<@rolv.rem><Static Roadblocks> that can block the enemy's route and also be attacked by allied units are present on the map</>

ro4_ev_2.name: Narrative Offer
ro4_ev_2.description: You thought up this agreement, you imagined his signature, and they immediately became real within the furnace illusions. An agreement has been reached, and your requests to Mr. Goodenough are completely warranted.

ro4_duel_1.name: Eye For an Eye
ro4_duel_1.description:
The author of this story cares not where the blood flows, only that there be a bloodbath.
<@rolv.rem>Choose a foe and fight. Losing will not deduct Life Points. Defeating a tougher foe within the given time grants a better reward</>

ro4_duel_2.name: Narrow Path
ro4_duel_2.description:
The narrow path that good and evil share doesn't always mean rare cooperation. Sometimes, it's the narrow way out that they must both fight for equally.
<@rolv.rem>Choose a foe and fight. Losing will not deduct Life Points. Defeating a tougher foe within the given time grants better reward</>

ro4_duel_3.name: Twin Gargoyles
ro4_duel_3.description:
Give people a path, and they'll fight tooth and nail to follow it. Deny them one, and they'll carve a path themselves.
<@rolv.rem>Choose a foe and fight. Losing will not deduct Life Points. Defeating a tougher foe within the given time grants better reward</>

ro4_duel_b.name: The Boat Home
ro4_duel_b.description:
'One boat for the people, the other for the scriptures. The faithful cerulean lotuses will lead the mahasattva of the Anasa home.'
<@rolv.rem>Choose a foe and fight. Losing will not deduct Life Points. Defeating a tougher foe within the given time grants a better reward</>

ro4_e_1_1.name: Bad Neighbors
ro4_e_1_1.description: A group of tramps and their pets have taken over this maintenance channel, modifying it without regard for others.

ro4_e_1_4.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP; new enemies will appear

ro4_e_1_5.name: Ice Age
ro4_e_1_5.description:
Making use of your environment is a fundamental survival skill, and the ice traps have already been set. The rest is up to you.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Ice Crystals> that continuously apply [Cold] are present on the field.</>
ro4_e_1_5.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP; extra Originium Ice Crystals will appear

ro4_e_2_1.name: Dissuasion Seminar
ro4_e_2_1.description: Regularly hosted by the Temple of Knowledge, the Liches inside the furnace recount vivid horrors they've faced, urging others to leave. No one ever does.
ro4_e_2_1.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; Corruption damage is increased

ro4_e_2_2.name: Temporary Patchup
ro4_e_2_2.description:
Furnace maintenance tip #1: If something's busted, tear it down—if it needs repairing, someone will come and do it.
<@rolv.rem><Stun Generator> that can be activated with DP to stun surrounding enemies is present on the field.</>
ro4_e_2_2.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; an extra Spine of Epoch will appear

ro4_e_2_3.name: Exhaust Vents
ro4_e_2_3.description:
Most Sarkaz youths have boasted of jumping off the platforms by the furnace exhaust vents and gliding down with the wind. In reality, those 'platforms' don't even have solid footing.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Jetstreams> that generate airflow currents are present on the field</>
ro4_e_2_3.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; Breaker Leaders are also Invisible

ro4_e_2_4.name: Furnace Volunteers
ro4_e_2_4.description:
They were getting off work but were in such a hurry that they ended up in the wrong Kazdel.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Altars> that deal damage to both allies and enemies are present on the field</>
ro4_e_2_4.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased DEF and HP; new Elite enemies will appear

ro4_e_2_5.name: Clear the Crowd
ro4_e_2_5.description:
After figuring out what happened, these Sarkaz begin arguing over which Kazdel is better. They invite you to arbitrate the dispute, and won't leave until they're satisfied with the result.
<@rolv.rem><Exhaust Grilles> are present on the field; Operators deployed on this tile will not be targeted by enemy ranged attacks</>
ro4_e_2_5.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new enemies will appear

ro4_e_2_6.name: Kaz Falls
ro4_e_2_6.description:
This place is famed for its unique living waterfall and bizarre life cycle. When enough slugkaz fall into the valley, they transform into machines, swim upstream, and revert to organic nourishment.
<@rolv.rem>Obtain extra Originium Ingots and Command EXP upon victory</>
ro4_e_2_6.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and DEF; new enemies will appear

ro4_e_2_7.name: Dense Jungle
ro4_e_2_7.description: Though they're called Slug Eaters, they'll devour anything that fits in their mouths.
ro4_e_2_7.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP; different enemies will appear

ro4_e_3_1.name: Simulated Skirmish
ro4_e_3_1.description:
No one wants to play the role of 'foreign foe' in drills like this, so these mock skirmishes always turn into Sarkaz versus Sarkaz.
<@rolv.rem><Corrosive Ground> that halves the DEF of allied units deployed on it is present on the field</>
ro4_e_3_1.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and DEF; Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery will appear

ro4_e_3_2.name: Bloodline Debates
ro4_e_3_2.description: A classic debate topic in the Temple of Knowledge: How exactly did the Teekaz split off, and when in history did it happen? Scholars endlessly speculate, with new theories 'invented' from time to time.
ro4_e_3_2.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP; new enemies will appear; Spine of Epoch will spawn at a different location

ro4_e_3_3.name: Blotted Sky
ro4_e_3_3.description: Kazdel's lifts always have long queues, with Nachzehrers handling uninvited guests trying to sneak into the city. Their summons also provide shade for everyone waiting.
ro4_e_3_3.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; Seed of Withering gains additional ATK

ro4_e_3_4.name: Morning Labor
ro4_e_3_4.description:
In the city, crystal clusters grow nonstop, making morning harvesting a daily habit for the Sarkaz. Those who can afford breakfast harvest after eating; those who can't, go straight away.
<@rolv.rem><Rubble> that can change the enemy's route is present on the field</>
ro4_e_3_4.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, HP, and Movement Speed; Rubble has reduced Max HP

ro4_e_3_5.name: Careless Magic
ro4_e_3_5.description:
When cooking, accidents are prone to happen if the fire is neglected. The same is true when summoning servants with witchcraft. These two common sense rules are sometimes forgotten by the Sarkaz.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Altars> that deal damage to both allies and enemies are present on the field</>
ro4_e_3_5.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; extra Originium Altars will appear

ro4_e_3_6.name: Lottery Fight
ro4_e_3_6.description:
Invented by well-traveled Sarkaz for the thrill of it, the 'prizes' in this lottery step into the ring. It always ends in a chaotic group scrap, but at least everyone's having fun.
<@rolv.rem><Defensive Barricades> are present on the field that Block enemies</>
<@rolv.rem><Originium Ice Crystals> that continuously apply [Cold] are present on the field</>
ro4_e_3_6.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; Trilby Asher has greatly increased ASPD

ro4_e_3_7.name: Firepower Squad
ro4_e_3_7.description:
Scarmarket Nexus's firepower squads are armed with excessively many bomb drones and rocket launchers to carpet bomb enemies at first sight. This strategy reminds you of a certain other Sarkaz you know well.
<@rolv.rem>Obtain extra Originium Ingots and Command EXP upon victory</>
ro4_e_3_7.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, Max HP, and Movement Speed

ro4_e_3_8.name: Motorized Squad
ro4_e_3_8.description: This Sarkaz squad is regularly deployed to the ground to collect enemy intelligence for the Sky City.
ro4_e_3_8.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; additional enemies will appear

ro4_e_4_1.name: Epochal Gaps
ro4_e_4_1.description:
Time releases its grip, and the Sarkaz memories flicker through the intervals of existence.
<@rolv.rem><Roadside Emergency Reserves> that grant a certain amount of DP and Max DP when destroyed are present on the field</>
ro4_e_4_1.eliteDesc: Enemies gain greatly increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new Elite enemies will appear

ro4_e_4_2.name: Sordid Surveillance
ro4_e_4_2.description: Illusions ebb and flow under witchcraft, with balance meticulously monitored across all epochs to ensure events unfold in their designated order.
ro4_e_4_2.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP

ro4_e_4_3.name: Past The Aquapit
ro4_e_4_3.description:
A Durin from who-knows-where learned the skill of low-altitude flight from the Scrap Assemblers and now relishes in flight contests through the gaps between buildings in Kazdel. After all, the worst you'll get is a head full of bumps.
<@rolv.rem><Defensive Barricades> that block enemies are present on the field</>
ro4_e_4_3.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP; additional enemies will appear

ro4_e_4_4.name: Crimson Corridor
ro4_e_4_4.description:
This corridor will bring you to the Vampire's mausoleum, but it has yet to be stained with blood. This is precisely why Vampire heirs are scrambling to dye it in their shade right now.
<@rolv.rem><Heat Pump Passages> that periodically inflict damage to units standing on them are present on the field</>
<@rolv.rem><Defensive Barricades> that block enemies are present on the field</>
ro4_e_4_4.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP; additional enemies will appear

ro4_e_4_5.name: Rules of Modern Warfare
ro4_e_4_5.description:
Several months have passed since the Sarkaz Joint Agreement was enacted. All involved parties stand ready, as this new blood pact prepares to face its first trial in the flames of war.
<@rolv.rem><Power Armors> that activate by absorbing experimental products are present on the field</>
<@rolv.rem><Gramophones> that deal Arts damage to enemies and heal allies when captured are present on the field</>
ro4_e_4_5.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP; additional enemies will appear

ro4_e_4_6.name: Timeworn Tensions
ro4_e_4_6.description: Some ancient Sarkaz have been angered by these machines they've never seen before, but their outer shells seem to sport an engraved symbol of Kazdel.
ro4_e_4_6.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; additional enemies will appear

ro4_e_4_7.name: Ghost City
ro4_e_4_7.description:
Legends say a revenant has possessed an ancient nomadic plate and wanders the land to this day. Could it be this very plate before you? What kind of people live on it?
<@rolv.rem><Twigs That Crave> that produce Rot Eaters are present on the field</>
ro4_e_4_7.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP; 'Twigs That Crave' have greatly increased HP

ro4_e_4_8.name: Elusive Merc
ro4_e_4_8.description:
She has many names and many identities in different tales, but if you were to ask what she's like, the answer is always 'loves explosions'.
<@rolv.rem>Obtain extra Originium Ingots and Command EXP upon victory</>
ro4_e_4_8.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; W is Invisible

ro4_e_4_9.name: Chaos
ro4_e_4_9.description:
The Sarkaz are pouring in. Did you figure out which tale this is? You didn't think about it? Th-Then what should we do?
<@rolv.rem>This map is filled with <Poison Haze> that causes allies to constantly lose HP</>
<@rolv.rem>Obtain extra Originium Ingots and Command EXP upon victory</>
ro4_e_4_9.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; Sarkaz Crossbowmen are Invisible; Poison Haze deals more damage

ro4_e_4_10.name: Frequent Dispute
ro4_e_4_10.description:
The Tarans' arrival has only complicated the mine's ownership dispute. Ultimately, the solution is violence.
<@rolv.rem><Rubble> pieces that can block the enemy's route are present on the map.</>
ro4_e_4_10.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; Demolitionist Leaders gain increased ATK

ro4_e_5_1.name: Rogue Mercenary
ro4_e_5_1.description:
A mercenary went to Londinium to make ends meet, but you firmly believe she has nothing to do with the great blaze that destroyed the city.
<@rolv.rem><Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery> that deals True damage to the target area periodically is present on the field</>
ro4_e_5_1.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; different enemies will appear

ro4_e_5_2.name: Land Reclamation
ro4_e_5_2.description: The Sarkaz reclaim land with brutal efficiency: bombard the area until it's flat. With mouths to feed, careless interlopers won't deter their relentless plans.
ro4_e_5_2.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP, Londinium Mobile Defense Artillery fires more frequently

ro4_e_5_3.name: Witch-Curse Alliance
ro4_e_5_3.description:
Led by the Emperor and nobles, the Leithanians gradually grew accustomed to life with the Sarkaz. Little do they know, this genuine friendship will soon bring shocking secrets.
<@rolv.rem><Tuning Nodes> that can be attacked to switch variations and buff allied units are present on the field</>
ro4_e_5_3.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP, Tuning Nodes require more SP to activate

ro4_e_5_4.name: Passage Blockade
ro4_e_5_4.description: This channel must be sealed off, and any negligence eradicated within the furnace. Illusions hold truth and can shape reality, so act with extreme precaution.
ro4_e_5_4.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; when either Corrupted Knight or Withered Knight is defeated, the other gains extra ATK increase

ro4_e_5_5.name: Guiltless Paradise
ro4_e_5_5.description:
Chaos is order, creation is law.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Pollution> that continuously deals True damage to units and greatly reduces their SP recovery is present on the field</>
ro4_e_5_5.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new enemies will appear

ro4_e_5_6.name: Aerial Assault
ro4_e_5_6.description: Kazdel's 'plate' sails through the skies, but regrettably, this does not mean it is impervious to assaults from hostile cities.
ro4_e_5_6.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; additional enemies will appear

ro4_e_5_7.name: Wrecked Academy
ro4_e_5_7.description:
One night, parts of the academy tumbled into Kazdel's many cracks. The next day, unaffected scholars and professors were anguished, lamenting their missed opportunity.
<@rolv.rem><Exhaust Grilles> are present on the field; Operators deployed on this tile will not be targeted by enemy ranged attacks</>
ro4_e_5_7.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; Sarkaz Maze Spellweaver uses ability more frequently

ro4_e_5_8.name: Regular Army
ro4_e_5_8.description:
If the twin kings' federation were to have a standing army, they might look like this—
<@rolv.rem>This map has <Exhaust Grilles> which prevent allies from being targeted by enemy ranged attacks</>
<@rolv.rem>Obtain extra Originium Ingots and Command EXP upon victory</>
ro4_e_5_8.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; Marks of Epoch have increased range

ro4_e_5_9.name: Rhine Guardians
ro4_e_5_9.description:
Anyone eyeing Nasti's technology must first get past Defense Section's security.
<@rolv.rem><Originium Jetstreams> that generate airflow currents are present on the field</>
ro4_e_5_9.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; additional enemies will appear

ro4_e_6_1.name: Quest For Consensus
ro4_e_6_1.description: Most ancestors tend to discuss similar possibilities, while others vehemently express their objections. Within the illusion, figures representing the opposition begin rushing towards you.
ro4_e_6_1.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; Soul Maelstroms have greatly increased DEF

ro4_e_6_2.name: Divine Desire
ro4_e_6_2.description:
The two greatest wishes of the Teekaz outside the Holy City are acceptance and entry. The Gelato Stops within the city will take care of the rest.
<@rolv.rem><'Gelato Stops'> are present on the field that restore allied SP when captured</>
ro4_e_6_2.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; Pathfinder Ballistarius and Pathfinder Ballistarius Prefect deal increased damage to 'Gelato Stops'

ro4_e_7_1.name: Heavenly Paradise
ro4_e_7_1.description: 'They say paradise should be offered four treasures: a mirror with wings of copper, a wooden paperweight of gathered strength, a seal of passage engraved with an auspicious beast, and a flawless spearhead of iron.'
ro4_e_7_1.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and Max HP; Defeating Apparition enemies requires more hits. Additional enemies will appear

ro4_e_7_2.name: 'Heretics'
ro4_e_7_2.description: Perhaps labeling this rabble 'heretics' is too good for them. They're not even followers of another path. They simply want to tear down your flag for their own satisfaction.
ro4_e_7_2.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and DEF; Competitive-Grade Beach Buggies have greatly increased HP and DEF

ro4_e_t_2.name: Signal Light
ro4_e_t_2.description:
Who knows what unhinged plans the Duck Lord had in mind when he arranged a vehicle to abduct civilians. Fortunately, you found out about it in advance, and the drivers don't know the route too well.
<@rolv.rem><Static Roadblocks> that can block the enemy's route and be attacked by allied units are present on the map</>
ro4_e_t_2.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; additional enemies will appear; Static Roadblocks gain greatly increased HP

ro4_e_t_3.name: Illusory Heist
ro4_e_t_3.description: 'These are all illusions, you can't take them out of the furnace...' Recalling past encounters, you decide to approach them differently this time—by letting your weapon do the talking.
ro4_e_t_3.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; additional enemies will appear

ro4_e_t_4.name: Duck-Speed Highway
ro4_e_t_4.description:
Duck Lord has built a transportation hub here! His friends are flooding in! He does not have Kazdel's municipal approval, nor an environmental impact assessment report! Illegal buildings must be torn down!
<@rolv.rem><Roadblock> that can block the enemy's route can be deployed</>
ro4_e_t_4.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; additional enemies will appear

ro4_e_t_5.name: Beside The Battlefield
ro4_e_t_5.description: Not all conflicts end in violence. In those that don't, the two sides lay down not just their weapons, but their prejudices.
ro4_e_t_5.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; different enemies will appear

ro4_e_t_6.name: Legacy
ro4_e_t_6.description:
'It' considers itself a passage, and 'it' has come, following the successor's claim.
<@rolv.rem><Twigs That Crave> that produce Rot Eaters are present on the field</>
ro4_e_t_6.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; additional enemies will appear

ro4_e_t_8.name: Revenge of the Toys
ro4_e_t_8.description: The emergency alarm has been triggered. Abandoned dreams and hopes manipulate the similarly abandoned scrap heap, determined to protect those who deem them valuable.
ro4_e_t_8.eliteDesc: All enemies gain greatly increased HP

zone_1.name: Furnace Origin
zone_1.description: Verse one. Familiar warmth fades into the darkness as reality erodes at every turn.
zone_1.endingDescription: It seems that both you and your Sarkaz ancestors are too attached to the furnace's warmth, and entered the faraway land of dreams.

zone_2.name: Wrought Ironroots
zone_2.description: Line two. The winding past connects to an unprecedented future as the spores of imagination grow within every pipe.
zone_2.endingDescription: Every pipe seems to branch off into three, yet their ends are connected. No words seem to describe them.

zone_3.name: Ashforged Ruins
zone_3.description: Paragraph three. Do you recognize this city//wreck//palace//village?
zone_3.endingDescription: The city//wreck//palace//village has rejected you, and will no longer shift to your persuasions.

zone_4.name: Probable Divergence
zone_4.description: Section four. At imagination's peak, Kazdel is both bountiful and hollow. It craves, it hungers, always wanting more, oblivious to the encroaching boundaries.
zone_4.endingDescription: You crossed one boundary after another, chose one Kazdel after the other, and all of them accepted you

zone_5.name: Border of Truth
zone_5.description: Chapter five. The end, unity, and stability—all torn asunder. Subverting common sense is the only path to a new chapter.

zone_6.name: Radiant Zenith
zone_6.description: Article six. Rebirth ushers in an immeasurable imagination, both unexpected and reasonable. Accept the curse//blessing.
zone_6.endingDescription: You fall before the truth. Its might is so overwhelming that you can only run back to it.

zone_7.name: Temple of Shattered Shackles
zone_7.description: Article six. The Dharma has been transmitted, and to hold it is to reach ultimate freedom. But can thusness be followed, be sought? If only with great difficulty, can it be held on to?
zone_7.endingDescription: 'A lotus petal falling in the water harms not its root. Obsess not over it.'

zone_8.name: Endless Rest
zone_8.description: Coda. Every story stops here. The light gradually dims, and the furnace sounds cease.
zone_8.endingDescription: The furnace ceases, and the storyteller no longer speaks.

zone_portal_normal_1.name: Bizarre Fragment
zone_portal_normal_1.description: Recorded history always hopes to be enriched by stories, just as water longs to be filled with reflections.
zone_portal_normal_1.endingDescription: The water ripples with fusing thoughts, expanding the borders wide open once more.

recruit_group_random.desc: Three random Recruitment Vouchers with one 5-star Temporary Recruitment guaranteed

choice_ro4_res1_3.description: When possessing <@ro4.get>Doodle of Hope</>: gain <@ro4.get>4</> Originium Ingots and <@ro4.get>2</> Hope

choice_ro4_res2_2.title: Get help to carry them away
choice_ro4_res2_2.description: When possessing <@ro4.get>Doodle of Hope</>: gain <@ro4.get>3</> Hope

choice_ro4_res3_2.title: Please help me and my companions
choice_ro4_res3_2.description: When possessing <@ro4.get>Doodle of Hope</>: gain <@ro4.get>4</> Max Life Points

choice_ro4_res3_3.title: I don't need help
choice_ro4_res3_3.description: I'm good for now, maybe next time.

choice_ro4_res4_1.title: The warrior's body disintegrates into ash

choice_ro4_res4_2.title: The warrior's horns take root and grow

choice_ro4_res4_3.title: The epoch frozen for eternity
choice_ro4_res4_3.description: This is not where I want to go

choice_ro4_res5_2.title: We're here for the seminar
choice_ro4_res5_2.description: When possessing <@ro4.get>Doodle of Hope</>: gain <@ro4.get>5</> Plans

choice_ro4_fin1_1.title: The two of them crowning each other

choice_ro4_rec1_1.title: Recruit
choice_ro4_rec1_1.description: Lose <@ro4.lose>2</> Originium Ingots and recruit one Operator (from a selection of 2 random classes)

choice_ro4_rec1_2.title: Promise future compensation
