scene_ro4_res1_enter.title: Story's End
scene_ro4_res1_enter.description: A young Lich perks up when he hears you approaching. 'I finally found someone alive!' He eagerly asks you, 'Can you read? Please tell me how this story ends.' You flip to the last page: A Sarkaz hunter has finally caught up to his prey, a Sankta. This is how it ends—

scene_ro4_res1_1.title: Story's End
scene_ro4_res1_1.description: 'Reasonable...' You realize only now that the Lich's eyes are ashen-white. He awkwardly explains he has been hiding here researching to solve a problem given by his teacher. Now, he can finally go back.

scene_ro4_res1_2.title: Story's End
scene_ro4_res1_2.description: 'I see...' You realize only now the Lich's eyes are ashen-white. He awkwardly explains he has been hiding here researching to solve a problem given by his teacher. Now, he can finally go back.

scene_ro4_res1_3.title: Story's End
scene_ro4_res1_3.description: 'How can that be?' The Lich cries out in surprise, then falls silent, lost in thought. Could this be the answer his teacher wanted him to find? You notice the Lich's ashen-white eyes, and a mysterious glow faintly flickering behind his head. Has he taken the story seriously?

scene_ro4_res2_enter.title: Falling Objects
scene_ro4_res2_enter.description: 'Hey—!' Someone shouts from above, but looking up, all you see are heavy gray clouds. 'Unload more weight from Area C! Damn, are you trying to send Kazdel crashing into the ground?' Soon after, a torrent of miscellaneous objects pours down, followed by a slow rain of clothes and scrap paper. You wait until the downpour ceases before approaching for a closer look.

scene_ro4_res2_1.title: Falling Objects
scene_ro4_res2_1.description: The ground is peppered with holes both small and large, from suitcases and cabinets destroyed by their high-speed fall. Some sheets of paper covered with Sarkaz characters are perfectly intact, but the messy handwriting leaves them indecipherable. You can only barely discern a few words: 'Lift-off', 'Assembly', and 'Quota'.

scene_ro4_res2_2.title: Falling Objects
scene_ro4_res2_2.description: You find a Sarkaz herdsman who whistles toward the hills, and soon a few strong farmers show up. There are Felines and Perros among them, but everyone is fluent in Sarkaz. They happily transport everything back to their village. When you bring up the voice from the sky, they calmly mention it's a regular occurrence. You don't even have to be smart to get up there—just lucky.

scene_ro4_res3_enter.title: Kind Lady
scene_ro4_res3_enter.description: 'We meet again.' A young lady calls out to you. She looks familiar, but you cannot remember her name. 'Don't bother trying to recall. I'm not in your story, so you'll soon forget it even if you do.' She takes out a page, seemingly freshly torn from a book. 'So, will you need my help this time?'

scene_ro4_res3_1.title: Kind Lady
scene_ro4_res3_1.description: 'Alright, I guess I came for nothing again.' The young lady shrugs. 'I hope you can go further this time; everyone's waiting for the rest of the story.' She stamps her foot and vanishes. At that very moment, you seem to recall her name, but forget it right away.

scene_ro4_res3_2.title: Kind Lady
scene_ro4_res3_2.description: 'Oh?' The young lady seems slightly surprised. 'Pretty lucky this time, to find this drawing.' She thinks for a moment, and writes something on the paper with her finger. It burns away without flame, turning into spots of light that enter you and your companions. You clench your fists, feeling your body grow stronger. 'Till we meet again. Don't let us down, alright?' she says with a kind smile. With a snap of her fingers, she vanishes.

scene_ro4_res3_3.title: Kind Lady
scene_ro4_res3_3.description: 'No problem.' She shakes her hand just slightly, and the paper somehow burns with no flames. A warm current courses through your body, and all fatigue and pain vanish. But as the warmth quickly fades, the returning cold air nearly makes you choke. 'Good luck. Try to go further this time; everyone's waiting for the rest of the story.' she says with a kind smile. With a snap of her fingers, she vanishes.

scene_ro4_res4_enter.title: After the Story Ends
scene_ro4_res4_enter.description: The Wendigo warrior fought till his last breath, and died with his hopes and dreams. Only a husk remains, and his story has come to an end. But you get to witness what happens after the story ends. You see—

scene_ro4_res4_1.title: After the Story Ends
scene_ro4_res4_1.description: Most Sarkaz are infected, and everyone knows their ending. A cool breeze blows and takes the ash away into the wind. This is his final lingering wish—to go home.

scene_ro4_res4_2.title: After the Story Ends
scene_ro4_res4_2.description: His corpse seems to refuse his destined death. The Wendigo's horns soon take root in the soil and grow, a tender branch even wraps itself around your finger, conveying his final wish. His death nurtures a new story, with sincere hopes that new life can thrive.

scene_ro4_res4_3.title: After the Story Ends
scene_ro4_res4_3.description: No fowlbeast flies, and no wind stirs. You wait for a long time, but nothing changes. No changes will occur—not when you leave, not when the land crumbles, not even when the sun is no more.

scene_ro4_res5_enter.title: Inauguration Ceremony
scene_ro4_res5_enter.description: Night descends swiftly, and a hot wind stirs ashes and torn page fragments. Tonight marks the first night since Kazdel ascended into the sky. The bare soil bears no trace of the city, only hundreds of glowing iron barrels scattered across the landscape. You see Sarkaz engineers throwing stacks of blueprints into the flames. Some of the engineers cast wary glances behind you. Turning around, you face a group of ominous outlanders. An engineer on watch demands to know why you're here, and you respond—

scene_ro4_res5_1.title: Inauguration Ceremony
scene_ro4_res5_1.description: They sneer, and grab the blueprints on the ground, tossing them all into the flames before running into the night. You do not chase after them, instead salvaging a few pages yet to be taken by the flames. There is no resolving the conflict between the Sarkaz and the other races, which is why the former escaped into the skies.

scene_ro4_res5_2.title: Inauguration Ceremony
scene_ro4_res5_2.description: When the engineers hear you're here for the seminar, they relax and point you the way. 'We have friends of all races to thank for Kazdel's ascent. This design seminar is to share our experiences with everyone as a token of gratitude.' You follow the outlanders—who were actually lost—to the event venue and take many notes. This knowledge will certainly be useful in the future.

scene_ro4_fin1_enter.title: Coronation
scene_ro4_fin1_enter.description: 'The previous King of Sarkaz is no more, and the black crown floats between Theresa and Theresis. The power of Civilight Eterna awaits a wielder, the Sarkaz await their King, and Kazdel awaits its master. And so, we witness—'

scene_ro4_fin1_1.title: Coronation
scene_ro4_fin1_1.description: 'The Black Crown follows their hands and splits into two, hanging above both their heads. Henceforth, the Sarkaz usher in two Kings ruling together. Some cheer for the arrival of this new era; others fear this unprecedented anomaly. As for what happens next, we still do not know.'

scene_ro4_fin1_2.title: Coronation
scene_ro4_fin1_2.description: 'A new King of Sarkaz is born, and hope spreads across Kazdel. As for what happens next, I'm sure we all know.'

scene_ro4_fin2_enter.title: Courtyard of the Departed
scene_ro4_fin2_enter.description: War, disease, and accident have constantly wrested friends away from Theresis and Theresa. To commemorate the fallen, the two Kings have erected a memorial park in the center of Kazdel. Here, you see monuments dedicated to their close friends. You walk before one, and look carefully at the name of the departed—

scene_ro4_fin2_1.title: Courtyard of the Departed
scene_ro4_fin2_1.description: 'Here lies Ascalon, chief bodyguard of the King of Sarkaz. She protected the King from a hundred assassins and perished in the line of duty.' A bouquet of fresh flowers is laid before her monument.

scene_ro4_fin2_2.title: Courtyard of the Departed
scene_ro4_fin2_2.description: 'Here lies Touch, an expert outfield medic of Babel. She unfortunately succumbed to fatigue from excessive work.' Some medical equipment lies before her monument.

scene_ro4_fin2_3.title: Courtyard of the Departed
scene_ro4_fin2_3.description: 'Here lies Amiya, may she rest in peace.' Ten rings are carved on her monument. In an absent-minded daze, you see a vision of Theresa putting on Amiya's rings for her, and seeing her off. When you return to your senses, those same ten rings are already on your fingers. You don't know why, but you feel these rings don't belong to the Amiya before you, but to the King of Sarkaz, to Rhodes Island... They belong to the Cautus you know.

scene_ro4_fin2_4.title: Courtyard of the Departed
scene_ro4_fin2_4.description: 'Here lies Mr. Fitzroy, a merchant friend who shifted Columbia's attitude with commerce. He died from an incurable genetic condition, and as per his will, the Banshee Nasti has inherited his assets.' A few Originium Ingots are placed before his monument.

scene_ro4_fin2_5.title: Courtyard of the Departed
scene_ro4_fin2_5.description: 'Here lies Erikson, recorder of history. He died of old age with no regrets.' Several books are placed before his monument.

scene_ro4_rec1_enter.title: Dealings in Blood
scene_ro4_rec1_enter.description: This is the Scar Market, where the mercenaries operate. The cutthroats are at your disposal, as long as you can afford them.

scene_ro4_rec1_1.title: Dealings in Blood
scene_ro4_rec1_1.description: Any problem that can be solved with money is no problem at all. You soon find the mercenary you wanted.

scene_ro4_rec1_2.title: Dealings in Blood
scene_ro4_rec1_2.description: The promise of a better future can always attract someone willing to work without pay.

scene_ro4_rec1_3.title: Dealings in Blood
scene_ro4_rec1_3.description: Even today, bartering remains an ancient Sarkaz tradition. After handing over the burdenbeast and the loot it carries, the boss of the market lets you pick any mercenary you want, while they handle negotiation and payment.

scene_ro4_rec1_4.title: Dealings in Blood
scene_ro4_rec1_4.description: The Scar Market is built deep underground, with countless chains keeping it fixed above the lava. A rare and marvelous sight for your eyes: no matter where you go, the Scar Market seems as stable as an anchor... You leave once you satiate your curiosity.

scene_ro4_rec2_enter.title: Scarmarket Nexus
scene_ro4_rec2_enter.description: The ancient Sarkaz mercenary group has reformed themselves, now appearing on Terra as 'Scarmarket Nexus'. You've obtained their membership, so now you can do some hiring for free.

scene_ro4_rec2_1.title: Scarmarket Nexus
scene_ro4_rec2_1.description: Scarmarket Nexus has the best mercenaries Terra has to offer, and you soon find the one you want.

scene_ro4_rec2_2.title: Scarmarket Nexus
scene_ro4_rec2_2.description: You've only come to tour the place, so the receptionist arranges a guide for you. A mercenary named Franka takes you around the high-speed battleship they use as a base of operations.

scene_ro4_rec2_3.title: Scarmarket Nexus
scene_ro4_rec2_3.description: A Djall known as 'Clip' Cliff entertains you. This expert marksman bested all his rivals to become the market's boss and eventually reorganized the group into its current form. After a brief chat, he entrusts his assistant, Woodrow, to take you mercenary shopping.

scene_ro4_relic1_enter.title: Lost Treasure
scene_ro4_relic1_enter.description: In a crowded art salon, an artist introduces his oil paintings based on ancient legends to passing viewers. Which work would you like to hear about?

scene_ro4_relic1_1.title: Lost Treasure
scene_ro4_relic1_1.description: 'He was exiled by his own father, and grew up in the wastes. But he was destined to wear the crown, so many years later he returned when the local tribes had descended into turmoil, wet his blade with the blood of his kins, and seized the symbol of the chieftain.' As you listen to the vague description, the outline of an object slowly forms in your mind.

scene_ro4_relic1_2.title: Lost Treasure
scene_ro4_relic1_2.description: 'With ambition and force, he galloped across the plains, subjugating the Teekaz under his flag. The Teekaz built two artifacts for him, and whosoever possesses them shall be the king of all Teekaz.' As you listen to the vague description, you try your best to imagine what these objects would look like.

scene_ro4_relic1_3.title: Lost Treasure
scene_ro4_relic1_3.description: 'When there were no more races between the mountains and the sea left to conquer, the King of Teekaz became the undisputed ruler of Terra. He forged countless treasures to showcase his reign to his people.' You aren't very interested in the story, but try your best anyway to envision what the king might have been wearing.

scene_ro4_relic1_4.title: Lost Treasure
scene_ro4_relic1_4.description: You find these clichés boring, and leave after eating your fill.

scene_ro4_relic2_enter.title: Decision in Despair
scene_ro4_relic2_enter.description: A battered line of Sarkaz clad in black slowly inches forward. With most of their bloodlines lost, the Sarkaz struggle to find a way out. You seek guidance from the sages for a path to survival. The Banshee takes out a bone pen, the Lich gazes into the void, and the Cyclops opens his lone eye. After a moment of contemplation, you decide to—

scene_ro4_relic2_1.title: Decision in Despair
scene_ro4_relic2_1.description: Following the flute's melody, the procession continues its march, crossing a river valley, entering a cave, and heading deep underground. If the land under the sun will not allow the Sarkaz to grow, then let this domain of darkness become their home.

scene_ro4_relic2_2.title: Decision in Despair
scene_ro4_relic2_2.description: The Lich offers their Knot and it binds everyone. When a group becomes a single entity, it will be difficult for their enemies to kill them all. Before the individuals known as Sarkaz are completely wiped out, they encounter friends from the sea and ultimately become part of their big family.

scene_ro4_relic2_3.title: Decision in Despair
scene_ro4_relic2_3.description: The Sarkaz follow the Cyclops and settle in Sami, working with the locals to repel demons from the north. The eye of the Cyclops has witnessed countless futures and tragedies. To ensure the Sarkaz remain free from the demonic plague, the Cyclopes depart to face the demonic disaster alone. With eyes festering from demonic corruption, they foresee the demons' demise.

scene_ro4_relic2_4.title: Decision in Despair
scene_ro4_relic2_4.description: You fail to get an answer from the sages. Since no one can point to a certain future, the only thing left to do is keep moving on, for at least the path right ahead is still clear. And so the Sarkaz continue to roam the land, their dream of building Kazdel strong but distant.

scene_ro4_pick1_enter.title: Fated Encounter
scene_ro4_pick1_enter.description: The black beast clamps its jaws down on its prey's throat, until it stops struggling and goes limp. Suddenly, it sees a flash of gold, a creature it has never seen before on the wastes. Under the sun, the strange creature's mane shines, its fangs and claws powerful. Curious, the black beast puts down the prey, locks eyes with the creature, and...

scene_ro4_pick1_1.title: Fated Encounter
scene_ro4_pick1_1.description: Thousands of years later, the different races have become indistinguishable. Cooperation is how both sides can win—this is what everyone agrees on.

scene_ro4_pick1_2.title: Fated Encounter
scene_ro4_pick1_2.description: When Sarkaz kill their prey, their prey's descendants will kill the Sarkaz in return. Kill or be killed, a third option does not exist on Terra.

scene_ro4_pick1_3.title: Fated Encounter
scene_ro4_pick1_3.description: And so, it would be a few more days later before the fated encounter between the Teekaz and the Elders.

scene_ro4_pick1_4.title: Fated Encounter
scene_ro4_pick1_4.description: In that moment, the Teekaz hears an earnest wish: the creature before it desires to end its hunger. The Teekaz grants this wish, offering its prey to the beast, which then dies from overindulgence, becoming the Teekaz's meal. Sadly, those who followed only remembered the Teekaz granting wishes. They wished and wished, until both they and the Teekaz met their ruin.

scene_ro4_normal1_enter.title: Slugkaz!
scene_ro4_normal1_enter.description: 'They say that Originium has shaped the Teekaz over eons, making them what they are today. Unknown to many, Originium has bestowed upon the Teekaz more than one form. In the twisting pipes and obscure corners of the Soul Furnace, amidst piles of century-old Originium waste, dwells a distant cousin of the modern Sarkaz—the arachnid type'

scene_ro4_normal1_1.title: Slugkaz!
scene_ro4_normal1_1.description: 'Augh! That's a 'Slugkaz'! Don't move, or listen to its sweet whispers! Don't touch its strings! Hey, why aren't you listening to me?!'

scene_ro4_normal1_2.title: Slugkaz!
scene_ro4_normal1_2.description: 'Augh! That's a 'Slugkaz'! It covets your human form, and will cast a terrible curse on you! It's over for you! And me! Wait a minute, why did it just leave? Did it leave something on the ground?

scene_ro4_normal1_3.title: Slugkaz!
scene_ro4_normal1_3.description: Perhaps an 'Originium Slug epoch' may have existed, but we have long missed it.

scene_ro4_normal2_enter.title: Shortcut
scene_ro4_normal2_enter.description: 'The pipes of the Soul Furnace sprawl wide and are infested with all sorts of odd creatures. Perhaps a sentient pipe truly exists, promising travelers safety and comfort at its end. Yet, fate dictates that each step on that path only brings them closer to a gruesome end... What do you think?'

scene_ro4_normal2_1.title: Shortcut
scene_ro4_normal2_1.description: 'Oh, that's clever. If only I had a head as good as yours back then... Let's go, wake me up when we arrive. You better not bring me back to the Scar Market while I'm sleeping though.'

scene_ro4_normal2_2.title: Shortcut
scene_ro4_normal2_2.description: 'This is Kazdel, where all promises inevitably turn true—that's what they told me, anyway. Hmph, take a different path then. Like this one that leads to some ruins, or that one that's a dead end.'

scene_ro4_normal3_enter.title: Burdenbeast Traveler
scene_ro4_normal3_enter.description: A burdenbeast loaded with luggage stands atop the city ruins, calmly shaking the snow off its body. Where did it come from? How did it get up there? It obviously cannot talk, but it snorts and a notebook falls off its back. It says 'Hiking Across Terra! Next stop: Kazdel ruins! Looking for guides, compensation negotiable!' The inside pages are filled with stamps, the last one hailing from a certain Snowcap Post Office in Kjerag.

scene_ro4_normal3_1.title: Burdenbeast Traveler
scene_ro4_normal3_1.description: You make the effort to get the burdenbeast down from the ruins. It lowers its head to nuzzle your legs—it must be happy. You find a bell from its luggage with words engraved on it: 'All hail Carrot, the great burdenbeast adventurer.' You ring the bell as you go, and the burdenbeast Carrot obediently follows suit.

scene_ro4_normal3_2.title: Burdenbeast Traveler
scene_ro4_normal3_2.description: You make the effort to get the burdenbeast down from the ruins, and explain you require a down payment. The beast shakes its shoulder, and a few Originium Ingots drop to the ground along with a bell. When you bend down to grab the ingots, you notice a word engraved on the beast's goggles: 'Carrot.' This seems to be its name. You try calling it a few times to no avail, but when you ring the bell, it slowly catches up with you.

scene_ro4_normal3_3.title: Burdenbeast Traveler
scene_ro4_normal3_3.description: You turn to leave but can't resist a glance back: the burdenbeast remains atop the ruins, doing nothing. You're more convinced than ever that this is a scam—since Kazdel descended underground, swindlers have targeted foreign treasure hunters with all kinds of tricks. You just didn't expect them to use such a creative method.

scene_ro4_normal4_enter.title: Crater Treasure
scene_ro4_normal4_enter.description: A dirt-covered Sarkaz stops you and asks if you'd like to broaden your horizons. 'I dug up all these from the depths of Kazdel—actual artifacts from the Royal Courts.' He produces a glowing stone, proudly showing the Royal Court's imprint. Seeing your skeptical gaze, he grits his teeth and promises to throw in a ticket to the 'Lost Kazdel Museum.' 'It's a popular attraction, you know? You'll definitely get your money's worth!'

scene_ro4_normal4_1.title: Crater Treasure
scene_ro4_normal4_1.description: You hand over the ingots and buy the rock. It feels almost weightless in your hand, but staring at it somehow makes your eyes sore. You ask about the ticket he promised, and he smiles a crooked grin as he points to the rock in your hands, saying: 'You're looking at it.'

scene_ro4_normal4_2.title: Crater Treasure
scene_ro4_normal4_2.description: 'Carrot? The burdenbeast explorer?' His eyes widen. 'So you're treasure hunters? Why didn't you say so earlier!' You learn from him that an explorer's association has been established near the colossal Kazdel crater. The flocking explorers have boosted the local economy and created many jobs, such as crater guides. 'Here, on the house. Look for me if you want to go underground, I'll give you a discount.'

scene_ro4_normal4_3.title: Crater Treasure
scene_ro4_normal4_3.description: 'I would've let you go if you were an explorer, but now...' The dirt-covered Sarkaz waves his hand impatiently and a group of Sarkaz wielding hoes and sickles surrounds you. 'I'm sure they're loaded with ingots. Make sure you squeeze them dry!'

scene_ro4_normal4_4.title: Crater Treasure
scene_ro4_normal4_4.description: You insist on leaving and the Sarkaz does not stop you. As you pass him by, you notice there's no dirt under his nails despite his dirt-covered body. You realize something and quicken your pace.

scene_ro4_normal5_enter.title: Popular Attraction
scene_ro4_normal5_enter.description: You see a strangely shaped arch gate with the words 'Lost City Kazdel' welded onto its rusty frame. You find a shabby ticket booth with no line and a sleepy child inside. He shoots you a glance and says: 'Free King of Sarkaz souvenir with each ticket, only three 'clinkers'. No refunds.' You search your pockets, but find nothing you'd call a 'clinker'.

scene_ro4_normal5_1.title: Popular Attraction
scene_ro4_normal5_1.description: Past the arches, a winding staircase leads downward, flanked by slipshod murals telling the increasingly absurd story of Kazdel's crash. Deeper in, you find yourself on a viewing platform. By torchlight, you see a 'palace' made of leaves and straw atop a rocky outcrop, complete with a crooked sign proclaiming: 'Actual Site for the King of Sarkaz's Coronation. Crowns sold at the ticket booth.'

scene_ro4_normal5_2.title: Popular Attraction
scene_ro4_normal5_2.description: You walk away, increasingly puzzled: What exactly is a 'clinker'? Why is this the first time you've heard of it? Seeking answers, you return and ask the child, who bursts into laughter: 'Clinkers are clinkers! If you don't have one, what's that on your shoulders?' Your head suddenly feels dizzy, and your neck seems unbearably heavy. Too scared to ask further, you quickly leave.

scene_ro4_normal5_3.title: Popular Attraction
scene_ro4_normal5_3.description: You angrily return to the ticket booth, but now see a Sarkaz covered in dirt inside. He whistles a tune as he picks at his nails, paying your complaints no mind. When you ask for a refund, he suddenly takes out a knife and jabs it into the table: 'Having a laugh, are we? No refunds! Unless you let me gouge out your eyes and unsee my exhibit!'

scene_ro4_normal5_4.title: Popular Attraction
scene_ro4_normal5_4.description: As you pass by the ticket booth, you notice a dirt-covered Sarkaz inside instead of the child. He looks familiar, but you want nothing more to do with this place, so you pretend he doesn't exist and keep walking. When you're far enough away, you hear a muffled sound behind you. Turning back, you see the arch gate has vanished, leaving only a deep hole in the ground.

scene_ro4_normal6_enter.title: Epochal Revision
scene_ro4_normal6_enter.description: 'Look, this is one of the many tomes that the Sarkaz has written to hold their prophecies. Let's see, destroyed homeland, cruel enemies, the usual stuff... Wait, these are unlucky incidents... that all happened to me recently?! Could this book be foretelling my fate? I wonder if I can change my luck if I did some revisions...'

scene_ro4_normal6_1.title: Epochal Revision
scene_ro4_normal6_1.description: '...And we all lived great lives. The end!'

scene_ro4_normal6_2.title: Epochal Revision
scene_ro4_normal6_2.description: 'Best not add anything! What's so bad about a little misfortune?'

scene_ro4_normal7_enter.title: Eve of Defense
scene_ro4_normal7_enter.description: Kazdel's city walls are being reinforced to resist the coalition's invasion. Right after you put a roadblock into place, a Sarkaz comes by. 'Hey, friend. Wanna know about something that just happened in the city?'

scene_ro4_normal7_1.title: Eve of Defense
scene_ro4_normal7_1.description: 'I hear that dreadful Feline general has even brought Ursines to her side. We'll have to face a four-nation coalition... Hey, don't run away, let me finish. A brother of mine in the city says the two Kings have prepared the Sarkaz well. The Goliaths have donned new armor, and the songs of the Banshees are strong. I have faith in our victory.'

scene_ro4_normal7_2.title: Eve of Defense
scene_ro4_normal7_2.description: You carry a sandbag and walk away. You believe, along with the Sarkaz, that the city is well defended, and the invaders will definitely be repelled... You are familiar with what happens next. The old King of Sarkaz will fall, a new one will rise. The Six Heroes will fend off the three-nation coalition, and Theresis will kill the Feline General leading them. These scenes are already a natural part of your story.

scene_ro4_normal8_enter.title: Shifting City
scene_ro4_normal8_enter.description: Kazdel's city structure defies logic. Roads stretch based on intuition, and the scenery mirrors one's subconscious. Walking through it feels like reflecting on time and space. Consequently, many lose their way, while the city itself watches countless bewildered travelers with great interest.

scene_ro4_normal8_1.title: Shifting City
scene_ro4_normal8_1.description: You deconstruct the city's logic with your plans and uncover its principle: In this perceivable space, one's creativity condenses into tangible bricks that pave the city. These bricks change with each shift in thought, reshaping the city with every change. You apply this understanding to the road ahead, and Kazdel reveals a path to somewhere familiar—

scene_ro4_normal8_2.title: Shifting City
scene_ro4_normal8_2.description: You offer your plans to the city, and soon find some resources. Were these left behind by the explorers before you, or was it a 'reward'... from the city itself?

scene_ro4_normal8_3.title: Shifting City
scene_ro4_normal8_3.description: The Child of soil and stone built this city, so naturally she knows how exactly it works. You soon leave the place with her guidance.

scene_ro4_normal9_enter.title: Future Hunter
scene_ro4_normal9_enter.description: A Cyclops tears open a rift and appears before you. 'Greetings.' Her manner is polite, but her tone carries an edge. 'You have it, don't you? The key that can change the future.' Though she doesn't look directly at you, her gaze feels piercing. 'Please hand it over so I can alter the bleak future I foresee. Do not refuse me.'

scene_ro4_normal9_1.title: Future Hunter
scene_ro4_normal9_1.description: 'I'm sorry, but I must have it, even if I have to resort to violence.' The Cyclops waves her staff and vanishes into the fog. The mist dissipates, mapping out a conflict with you within.

scene_ro4_normal9_2.title: Future Hunter
scene_ro4_normal9_2.description: 'Peace and mutual aid, what wonderful illusions. The colors within suffice to overcome any darkness. With it, I can erase the dark future I have foreseen before it is too late. Thank you.' She leaves you a wonder of life, then disappears into the rift.

scene_ro4_normal9_3.title: Future Hunter
scene_ro4_normal9_3.description: 'Endless hatred, violence crystallized. I can use it to slaughter all the dark futures I have foreseen, and turn the sufferings the Cyclopes have foreseen into figments of imagination. Thank you.' She leaves you some fragments of past prophecies, then disappears into the rift.

scene_ro4_normal10_enter.title: Ominous Portal
scene_ro4_normal10_enter.description: The outline of a door materializes on the wall, with witchcraft energy seeping from its cracks. Is this a form of reconnaissance, an attempt to traverse through time and space, or the creation of a powerful entity? The important question isn't who they are, but how you will confront them.

scene_ro4_normal10_1.title: Ominous Portal
scene_ro4_normal10_1.description: This creation has restrictions set in place, so both wisdom and violence are required to open it.

scene_ro4_normal10_2.title: Ominous Portal
scene_ro4_normal10_2.description: This creation has restrictions set in place, so both wisdom and violence are required to open it.

scene_ro4_normal10_3.title: Ominous Portal
scene_ro4_normal10_3.description: Indulging your curiosity can be dangerous, even in your fabricated tale. You decide to avoid this strange phenomenon.

scene_ro4_normal10_4.title: Ominous Portal
scene_ro4_normal10_4.description: You transform your contemplations of the door into Inspirers for future use. Clearly, it is a creation of witchcraft that you can materialize in your story at any time. As for what will happen when you open it, you have no clue.

scene_ro4_ent1_enter.title: Deciphering Evolution
scene_ro4_ent1_enter.description: The Farchaser's Revelation forever altered the evolution of the Teekaz, but it took time for all of them to grow halos and wings. During this period, kin of both black and white left behind written records. You discover a library full of these files that could help with future explorations. You decide to interpret them with the following method.

scene_ro4_ent1_1.title: Deciphering Evolution
scene_ro4_ent1_1.description: According to the records, the Teekaz eventually resolved their internal conflicts with Empathy, and the document you're reading describes the experience in detail. You imagine with the help of text and simulated empathy how it would be like then, and the feeling leaves a deep impression on you.

scene_ro4_ent1_2.title: Deciphering Evolution
scene_ro4_ent1_2.description: Deciphered by witchcraft, the record shows you the widespread conflict of the period: not all Teekaz were willing to transform, and that resistance quickly escalated into violence. The countless ways they resisted remain fresh in your mind.

scene_ro4_ent1_3.title: Deciphering Evolution
scene_ro4_ent1_3.description: You analyze the wrong record in the wrong way, so of course the result is... nothing.

scene_ro4_ent1_4.title: Deciphering Evolution
scene_ro4_ent1_4.description: There are still many files, all mixed together waiting to be interpreted.

scene_ro4_ent1_5.title: Deciphering Evolution
scene_ro4_ent1_5.description: If the result has already been determined, why does the process even matter?

scene_ro4_ent2_enter.title: Tower of Thoughts
scene_ro4_ent2_enter.description: 'These are all ideas nobody wants. Pity they just end up in a pile here.' A Zalak stands atop the trash heap, checking a list off in his hands. 'The boss asked me to pack 'em up and take them away, so if you want something, you best be quick.'

scene_ro4_ent2_1.title: Tower of Thoughts
scene_ro4_ent2_1.description: You find something encased in a fossil. You peel away the fossil to reveal a high-grade artifact. Zalak glances at his list and checks a box.

scene_ro4_ent2_2.title: Tower of Thoughts
scene_ro4_ent2_2.description: You find a miniature statue of a golden Gargoyle that breaks in your hands, revealing hidden loot. Zalak's eyes light up at the sight of scattered Originium Ingots on the ground.

scene_ro4_ent2_3.title: Tower of Thoughts
scene_ro4_ent2_3.description: You find a forgotten philosophy and enrich your mind with some of its ideas. However, the Zalak simply glances at the idea in your hand and crosses out something on his list.

scene_ro4_ent2_4.title: Tower of Thoughts
scene_ro4_ent2_4.description: There might be something useful inside this pile of abandoned ideas. Do you want to keep looking?

scene_ro4_ent2_5.title: Tower of Thoughts
scene_ro4_ent2_5.description: Two useless stones smash together and shatter. Space distorts, and a box falls to the ground. The baffled Zalak notes something down on his list.

scene_ro4_ent2_6.title: Tower of Thoughts
scene_ro4_ent2_6.description: The Zalak observes your lack of mysterious finds and crosses something out on his list.

scene_ro4_ent2_7.title: Tower of Thoughts
scene_ro4_ent2_7.description: 'W-Wait, what'cha grabbing me for? H-hey! Wise up, or I'm not gonna go easy on ya!'

scene_ro4_ent2_8.title: Tower of Thoughts
scene_ro4_ent2_8.description: You put the Zalak down, and apologize to him. Soon after you leave, a large swarm of drones moves the trash someplace else.

scene_ro4_ent2_9.title: Tower of Thoughts
scene_ro4_ent2_9.description: You not only refuse to put him down, but even grab his cheeks to give it a good squeeze. Naturally, he gets angry and breaks free from your grasp. He hits a red button, dives into the trash, and vanishes without a trace.

scene_ro4_ent2_10.title: Tower of Thoughts
scene_ro4_ent2_10.description: You have no plans to waste your time on worthless trash, so you turn and leave.

scene_ro4_ent3_enter.title: Highest Bidder Wins
scene_ro4_ent3_enter.description: A crowd gathers outside a tent, their expressions mixed—some ecstatic, others crying in remorse. Curious about the commotion, you move closer, but Gopnik stops you. 'The Duck Lord is holding an auction,' he explains, 'and there's only one item left. You need to pay an entrance fee to start bidding.' He adds curtly, 'This event is reserved for the successful.'

scene_ro4_ent3_1.title: Highest Bidder Wins
scene_ro4_ent3_1.description: Gopnik leads you inside, hands you a bidding sign, and explains the rules: the starting bid for the mysterious last item is five ingots. Each bid must be at least five higher, and the highest bidder wins. You see Duck Lord seated among the crowd. Could he actually be both seller and buyer? You quickly ask Gopnik, but he only slams his gavel to begin the bid. The Duck Lord instantly raises his sign to raise the bid to ten ingots.

scene_ro4_ent3_2.title: Highest Bidder Wins
scene_ro4_ent3_2.description: You raise your sign, and a spotlight immediately shines on you. But before you have a chance to get used to its glare, the light quickly slips away, and you see Duck Lord has raised the bid to twenty! His expression is indifferent, as if this is nothing to him.

scene_ro4_ent3_3.title: Highest Bidder Wins
scene_ro4_ent3_3.description: You raise your sign, and a spotlight immediately shines on you. Duck Lord seems a little surprised by your bid. He casts a glance at you from afar, calls Gopnik over, and whispers something into his ear. He does not raise the bid and the countdown drops to zero. With the bang of the gavel, the treasure is yours!

scene_ro4_ent3_4.title: Highest Bidder Wins
scene_ro4_ent3_4.description: Gopnik doesn't seem to understand you, so you try again, hoping he doesn't get angry. But your explanation falls on deaf ears, and Duck Lord runs out from behind the curtains in a huff, snatching the sign from your hands. Gopnik puts down his gavel and begins cracking his knuckles.

scene_ro4_ent3_5.title: Highest Bidder Wins
scene_ro4_ent3_5.description: 'Just kidding, you say...?' Someone grabs you by the collar, and your feet leave the soft carpeted floor. 'Just kidding?' Duck Lord seats himself with an arm raised up high, and sentences you with a downward gesture. A gang of thugs armed with bats immediately surrounds you. The one with a bruised and bitter face seems to be the spotlight operator.

scene_ro4_ent3_6.title: Highest Bidder Wins
scene_ro4_ent3_6.description: You raise your sign and snatch the spotlight back! Duck Lord is once again slightly surprised by your new bid as he looks at you from afar. You notice his threatening gaze, but it does not extinguish the enjoyable warmth of the spotlight shining on you for the next ten seconds before he raises his sign again to increase his bid to thirty.

scene_ro4_ent3_7.title: Highest Bidder Wins
scene_ro4_ent3_7.description: Squeak—! Duck Lord jumps off his seat and stares at your face. He gestures with his hand, and screams sound from above before the spotlight refocuses on him. However, he does not name a new price, and throws the sign onto the ground before angrily stomping backstage. The gavel falls, and Gopnik walks into the lit circle to announce that you have won the final item behind the curtain for thirty-five ingots.

scene_ro4_ent3_8.title: Highest Bidder Wins
scene_ro4_ent3_8.description: You walk out of the tent with your expensive treasure, glancing at the same stock of expressions around the tent with a sense of newfound empathy. You lower your head to look at the item in your arms, not knowing whether to laugh or cry at your victory. As you consider, a newcomer pays the entrance fee and enters the tent with anticipation, and you swear you hear the Duck Lord laughing.

scene_ro4_ent3_9.title: Highest Bidder Wins
scene_ro4_ent3_9.description: You have a plan for each and every Ingot in your pocket—and they're definitely not going to be spent here.

scene_ro4_ent3_10.title: Highest Bidder Wins
scene_ro4_ent3_10.description: You raise your sign, and a spotlight immediately shines on you. Duck Lord seems a little surprised by your bid. He casts a glance at you from afar, calls Gopnik over, and whispers something into his ear. He does not raise the bid and the countdown drops to zero. With the bang of the gavel, the treasure is yours!

scene_ro4_bat1_enter.title: Haunting Cries
scene_ro4_bat1_enter.description: Your surroundings have changed many a time, but you always hear residents repeating the same rumor: a vengeful ghost that sobs as it haunts the streets of Kazdel... Eventually you decide you've heard enough, and go out to satisfy your curiosity. Whereupon you discover... it's just a lost Perro.

scene_ro4_bat1_1.title: Haunting Cries
scene_ro4_bat1_1.description: As you listen to his sobs, you suddenly realize something: You know this voice. This Perro seems to have been... following you the whole time?! You want to ask him why, but he keeps cringing away in silence, and it infuriates you.

scene_ro4_bat1_2.title: Haunting Cries
scene_ro4_bat1_2.description: His story is one of repeatedly trying to muster the courage to change, only to fall back to square one each time. Full of weepy lament and self-pity, it is hardly original. There's nothing you can do to help, so you console him briefly before leaving.

scene_ro4_bat2_enter.title: The Uninvited
scene_ro4_bat2_enter.description: This duck intrudes into your story out of nowhere, his quacks nerve-wracking and his webbed footprints ridiculous. How did he even appear, and what does he actually want?

scene_ro4_bat2_1.title: The Uninvited
scene_ro4_bat2_1.description: He seems to be very familiar with the city. Despite your efforts, you can't so much as pluck a feather off as he dodges all your blows, which infuriates you even more.

scene_ro4_bat2_2.title: The Uninvited
scene_ro4_bat2_2.description: You can't be bothered with this duck, and leave him be. Soon after, he waddles away and vanishes, leaving a tinkling noise that echoes throughout the city nonstop. Could he actually be part of the city? A duck of Kazdel?

scene_ro4_bat3_enter.title: The Silent Champ
scene_ro4_bat3_enter.description: This Ursine is only here in the story because of his noisy Duck boss. He rarely responds with words, because he can solve most issues with just his fists.

scene_ro4_bat3_1.title: The Silent Champ
scene_ro4_bat3_1.description: You decide to set things straight with the Ursine: This is Kazdel, your turf. When it comes to violence, you are the one to be reckoned with, not him.

scene_ro4_bat3_2.title: The Silent Champ
scene_ro4_bat3_2.description: The spiky spearhead attracts the Duck Lord's attention. He does not negotiate with you, and simply asks the Ursine to 'take it.'

scene_ro4_bat3_3.title: The Silent Champ
scene_ro4_bat3_3.description: He doesn't react as you leave, standing there with his arms crossed as usual. He watches his boss jump up and down, waiting for him to eventually leap onto his shoulders so they can vanish into the streets.

scene_ro4_bat4_enter.title: Quacking Mad
scene_ro4_bat4_enter.description: This time, both the duck and his accomplices are here. They're stepping on gold... stones... books..., no, why does it keep changing? What witchcraft is the duck employing? What does he want?

scene_ro4_bat4_1.title: Quacking Mad
scene_ro4_bat4_1.description: The duck's henchmen gather around as you approach them—wait, did someone escape already?

scene_ro4_bat4_2.title: Quacking Mad
scene_ro4_bat4_2.description: Duck Lord seems to fear the spearhead in your hand, and calls his men to be on guard, a rare sight. But it's too late—you decide to unleash all your resentment and wrath on him.

scene_ro4_bat4_3.title: Quacking Mad
scene_ro4_bat4_3.description: Other than being a tad annoying, he hasn't really gotten in your way, so why bother with him at all? He talks grandly about building Kazdel into a business empire while standing on a pile of shifting objects. You watch him for a moment, then smile and leave. What you fail to notice is that the surrounding decorations are changing too. Though their forms are not final, they are all shaping into the Duck Lord's head.

scene_ro4_bat5_enter.title: The Pious Worshiper
scene_ro4_bat5_enter.description: A pious Sankta nun kneels before a holy statue in soft prayer, completely unaware of your arrival.

scene_ro4_bat5_1.title: The Pious Worshiper
scene_ro4_bat5_1.description: You walk up behind her, still unsure of how to deal with this enemy, but a gunshot going off shatters your doubts. The nun dissipates before your eyes, and you find yourself surrounded by Sankta. Alright... so it was a trap.

scene_ro4_bat5_2.title: The Pious Worshiper
scene_ro4_bat5_2.description: Naturally, you have no mercy for your enemies. You throw your weapon, but it passes through her, smashing the statue. In an instant, Sankta emerge from the shadows, while she has already vanished into thin air.

scene_ro4_bat5_3.title: The Pious Worshiper
scene_ro4_bat5_3.description: A Sankta showing up in Kazdel with a horned holy statue—this strange sight compels you to act cautiously. The nun soon finishes praying and walks towards you. You can tell she is a pure Sankta, but what she places in your hands is a clay Sarkaz figurine. Was she praying for peace and reconciliation between the two races? Is that possible?

scene_ro4_scout_enter.title: Present and Future
scene_ro4_scout_enter.description: The story's content is ever-changing, its uncertainty is both a boon and a curse. As such, while we immerse ourselves in the present, someone has to go into the strange future and scout the way.

scene_ro4_scout_1.title: Present and Future
scene_ro4_scout_1.description: You believe you can obtain clues to the future from changes occurring here and now.

scene_ro4_scout_2.title: Present and Future
scene_ro4_scout_2.description: Your chosen member soon finishes packing and vanishes from view.

scene_ro4_sacrifice1_enter.title: The Origins
scene_ro4_sacrifice1_enter.description: The hunter is now the hunted. Shambling through the silver mounts, each step brings him closer to death. But amidst the relentless metallic onslaught, something seems destined to lead him out of this lethal peril, and that something is—

scene_ro4_sacrifice1_9.title: The Origins
scene_ro4_sacrifice1_9.description: Crimson patterns emerge on the black box while white light appears on his head and back. As the ebony hunter finds enlightenment, order is established, and a paradise begins to form. He takes the square box back to his tribe to enlighten his kin and share the glory with Empathy. In the end, the Holy City of Kazdel stands proud, with the hunter's sacred horn resting where he found enlightenment.

scene_ro4_sacrifice1_10.title: The Origins
scene_ro4_sacrifice1_10.description: It is merely a regular Sarkaz horn, but you know it does not belong to the Sarkaz. The scent of the nemesis is unmistakable; but how can a Sarkaz be a Sankta? You hold onto your doubts and keep the horn with you for now.

scene_ro4_sacrifice1_7.title: The Origins
scene_ro4_sacrifice1_7.description: The hunter does not hunt his kin, for it is beneath him. As the skeletons of his prey pile on, the Teekaz eagerly follow his actions. The most valuable battle spoils are left behind where the hunter pulls out the spearhead.

scene_ro4_sacrifice1_6.title: The Origins
scene_ro4_sacrifice1_6.description: The hunter takes the strange object and continues deeper into the mountain range...

scene_ro4_sacrifice1_1.title: The Origins
scene_ro4_sacrifice1_1.description: The hunter takes the strange object and continues deeper into the mountain range...

scene_ro4_sacrifice1_2.title: The Origins
scene_ro4_sacrifice1_2.description: The hunter takes the strange object and continues deeper into the mountain range...

scene_ro4_sacrifice1_3.title: The Origins
scene_ro4_sacrifice1_3.description: The hunter takes the strange object and continues deeper into the mountain range...

scene_ro4_sacrifice1_4.title: The Origins
scene_ro4_sacrifice1_4.description: —The artifact you place down instantly changes into another, and the story jumps forward thousands of years. The one that completed the exchange for you, the Sa... the Teekaz is none other than Farchaser, the first King of Sarkaz.

scene_ro4_sacrifice1_5.title: The Origins
scene_ro4_sacrifice1_5.description: The hunter takes the strange object and continues deeper into the mountain range...

scene_ro4_sacrifice1_8.title: The Origins
scene_ro4_sacrifice1_8.description: The peace and serenity that the drawing conveys leave a deep impression on the hunter. In the days to come, he will wear the crown and become the king of all life.

scene_ro4_sacrifice1_11.title: The Origins
scene_ro4_sacrifice1_11.description: The broken pieces of metal can no longer shoot deadly flames, allowing the hunter to venture deeper into the mountains unharmed. In the days to come, he will be crowned king.

scene_ro4_sacrifice1_12.title: The Origins
scene_ro4_sacrifice1_12.description: The hunter takes the strange object and continues deeper into the mountain range...

scene_ro4_sacrifice1_13.title: The Origins
scene_ro4_sacrifice1_13.description: The organism awakens and soon grows into a humanoid resembling the hunter. The two converse for days and nights before parting ways. Henceforth, all that lies above the ground belongs to the hunter, while all that lies beneath belongs to the other 'hunter'. The site of their encounter becomes a sacred altar connecting the two domains—a garrison for sacrifice and worship, where everything is done in pairs for eternity.

scene_ro4_sacrifice1_14.title: The Origins
scene_ro4_sacrifice1_14.description: The petal floating on the water points east, hinting at the solution to the Teekaz's troubles. Yet, the hunter sees only the water in the stone bowl. He drinks it all, then continues into the mountains... After the rain, the bowl refills, and the petal floats anew, awaiting the next traveler.

scene_ro4_sacrifice1_15.title: The Origins
scene_ro4_sacrifice1_15.description: You know almost nothing of the Sarkaz's eastern cousins. All you know is that Qui'lon, the Wrathful Cerulean Flame, met his end in distant lands after journeying eastward, where some Sarkaz chose to settle. To confirm this story, you pick up the bowl and head eastwards.

scene_ro4_sacrifice1_16.title: The Origins
scene_ro4_sacrifice1_16.description: The hunter takes the strange object and continues deeper into the mountain range...

scene_ro4_sacrifice1_17.title: The Origins
scene_ro4_sacrifice1_17.description: The hunter carries the baby and continues deeper into the mountain range...

scene_ro4_sacrifice1_18.title: The Origins
scene_ro4_sacrifice1_18.description: The hunter puts the baby on his back and sets off. No matter what he finds in the end, his kin will inherit his undertaking. This spiritual gift is how unfathomable relationships begin, and now more foreigners than Teekaz make the pilgrimage.

scene_ro4_chest_enter.title: Employee of Babel
scene_ro4_chest_enter.description: Together with his kin, a man named Big Bob has transformed this Babel outpost into a rest station for travelers. However, since they all wear identical gear, you're not sure which one is the real Big Bob. As you prepare to depart, a Babel employee brings you some supplies.

scene_ro4_chest_1.title: Employee of Babel
scene_ro4_chest_1.description: Some say Big Bob is a mercenary loyal to his men; others claim he was once a wealthy and straightforward businessman. There are even rumors of him having done time in a moldy jail. But to you, he's just a regular guy trying to get by and a good buddy to the Sarkaz.

scene_ro4_nportal1_enter.title: Story to be Told
scene_ro4_nportal1_enter.description: You notice a rift open up in a corner of Kazdel, an immature and incomplete concept brought to life. You watch the scene unfolding inside the gap and decide to—

scene_ro4_nportal1_1.title: Story to be Told
scene_ro4_nportal1_1.description: The gap expands until it replaces the original landscape. A new story begins.

scene_ro4_nportal1_2.title: Story to be Told
scene_ro4_nportal1_2.description: The gap soon disappears, and what remains in your mind are only fragments of its existence.

scene_ro4_nportal1_3.title: Story to be Told
scene_ro4_nportal1_3.description: In time, perhaps these ideas can prove to be useful.

scene_ro4_eportal1_1.title: Truth to be Told
scene_ro4_eportal1_1.description: The gap expands until it replaces the original landscape. Meanwhile, a vague sense of connection spreads in your mind... Whatever it is, a new story begins.

scene_ro4_sala1_enter.title: Soul Tales: Eye For an Eye
scene_ro4_sala1_enter.description: The Tin Man has gathered some scattered memories and reconstructed them into a story. Would you like to experience them?

scene_ro4_sala1_1.title: Soul Tales: Eye For an Eye
scene_ro4_sala1_1.description: A Vampire once imprisoned by the Crimson Troupe now plots her revenge. She will drench them in their own blood, an end befitting their name.

scene_ro4_sala1_2.title: Soul Tales: Eye For an Eye
scene_ro4_sala1_2.description: Kazdel's future is too enticing for you to be distracted by other tales just yet.

scene_ro4_sala1_3.title: Soul Tales: Eye For an Eye
scene_ro4_sala1_3.description: The lotus petal stirs ripples in the tale, dispersing the fog to reveal part of the story: The King of Sarkaz leads his people eastward. With each step, their suffering diminishes. When the lost King attains enlightenment, the Sarkaz becomes the Anasa. They vow to forever introspect and bring their revelations back west to save their kin. Their journey home begins with a small boat...

scene_ro4_sala2_enter.title: Soul Tales: Unity of Extremes
scene_ro4_sala2_enter.description: The Tin Man has gathered some scattered memories and reconstructed them into a story. Would you like to experience them?

scene_ro4_sala2_1.title: Soul Tales: Unity of Extremes
scene_ro4_sala2_1.description: Two Sarkaz from the east journey west in search of truth. One seeks enlightenment under a tree, while the other indulges in secular pleasures. Despite frequent clashes, they trust each other with full confidence to watch their backs in battle.

scene_ro4_sala2_2.title: Soul Tales: Unity of Extremes
scene_ro4_sala2_2.description: Kazdel's future is too enticing for you to be distracted by other tales just yet.

With each step, their suffering diminishes. When the lost King attains enlightenment, the Sarkaz becomes the Anasa. They vow to forever introspect and bring their revelations back west to save their kin. Their journey home begins with a small boat...

scene_ro4_sala3_enter.title: Soul Experiences: Twin Gargoyles
scene_ro4_sala3_enter.description: The Tin Man has gathered some scattered memories and reconstructed them into a story. Would you like to experience them?

scene_ro4_sala3_1.title: Soul Experiences: Twin Gargoyles
scene_ro4_sala3_1.description: This pair of Gargoyle cousins are renowned Catastrophe Messengers in Kazdel. Arturia excels in stone-shaping Arts, while Federico is known for his rock-solid perseverance. Their conflicting personalities often lead to arguments, but their disagreements are matched only by their unwavering solidarity against Catastrophes.

scene_ro4_sala3_2.title: Soul Experiences: Twin Gargoyles
scene_ro4_sala3_2.description: Kazdel's future is too enticing for you to be distracted by other tales just yet.

scene_ro4_sala3_3.title: Soul Experiences: Twin Gargoyles
scene_ro4_sala3_3.description: The lotus petal stirs ripples in the tale, dispersing the fog to reveal part of the story: The King of Sarkaz leads his people eastward. With each step, their suffering diminishes. When the lost King attains enlightenment, the Sarkaz becomes the Anasa. They vow to forever introspect and bring their revelations back west to save their kin. Their journey home begins with a small boat...

scene_ro4_end1_enter.title: Final Page
scene_ro4_end1_enter.description: In countless stories and reflections, Kazdel has transformed from an empty shell with just a furnace into a prosperous city. Details and histories that defy reality fill it up, nearly completing it. Now, the only thing it lacks—the piece it needs from you—is its ending. You take a deep breath and...

scene_ro4_end1_1.title: Final Page
scene_ro4_end1_1.description: You succeeded, the painful reality cast from your mind. Kazdel stretches out before you, attracting people of all races. An inclusive federation rises on Terra, with the Speaker and the General—no, Kings of Sarkaz—realizing their dream. Soon, they find your group. Classified as anomalies by Civilight Eterna, they are obligated to eliminate you from this land.

scene_ro4_end1_2.title: Final Page
scene_ro4_end1_2.description: You feel a slap on the back of your head and hear the Lord of the Liches' rebuke. As you see Ermengarde backing away, a sense of imminent dread fills you.

scene_ro4_end1_3.title: Final Page
scene_ro4_end1_3.description: The revenants cover your mouth and construct an ending for the tale of the twin kings with their own understandings and bodies. Just when you think you have broken free of their grasp, the kings find you. Somehow you know that the soldiers standing behind them are revenants.

scene_ro4_end1_4.title: Final Page
scene_ro4_end1_4.description: You thought you sealed away the ancestors, but they managed to escape through your story, stopping to taunt Fremont, who had just rushed over, before disappearing back into the tale. As you watch Ermengarde wipe the sweat off her brow and Fremont's face turn ashen, a sense of dread washes over you.

scene_ro4_end1_5.title: Final Page
scene_ro4_end1_5.description: You should have succeeded. Kazdel stretches out from your feet, and boats sail past from the edges of the city. The Kings of Sarkaz have finally realized their dream. Soon, they find your group, and since you do not exist in Civilight Eterna's records and are classified as an anomaly, they are obligated to eliminate you from this land.

scene_ro4_end1_6.title: Final Page
scene_ro4_end1_6.description: A thunderous tirade strikes you, leaving you bewildered. In your daze, you see several strange ships sail over from the side, and Ermengarde beating a hasty retreat. A sense of dread washes over you.

scene_ro4_end1_7.title: Final Page
scene_ro4_end1_7.description: The revenants cover your mouth and construct an ending for the tale of the twin kings with their own understandings and bodies. Just when you think you have broken free of their grasp, the kings arrive on boats. Somehow you know that the soldiers standing behind them are revenants.

scene_ro4_end1_8.title: Final Page
scene_ro4_end1_8.description: You thought you sealed away the ancestors, but they turned into lotus petals and drifted out through your story, stopping to taunt Fremont, who had just rushed over, before disappearing back into the tale, leaving behind only a few strange boats. As you watch Ermengarde wipe the sweat off her brow and Fremont's face turn ashen, a sense of dread washes over you.

scene_ro4_end2_enter.title: The Dissident's Sound
scene_ro4_end2_enter.description: An ancient Guardian Gun lies by the Kazdel Soul Furnace. You have a hunch that firing off the gun will bring about a groundbreaking change.

scene_ro4_end2_1.title: The Dissident's Sound
scene_ro4_end2_1.description: As the gun fires, that vague connection clarifies, revealing the Holy City of pure white before you. You reach for the Prophet Horn at your belt but feel the steel of another gun. Firing it returns everything to silence, though Empathy lingers in your mind.

scene_ro4_end2_2.title: The Dissident's Sound
scene_ro4_end2_2.description: You throw the Guardian Gun into the forge and watch the symbol of the Sankta disappear into the flames. Sarkaz stories should not be sullied by their enemies.

scene_ro4_startbuff_enter.title: Operation Rewards
scene_ro4_startbuff_enter.description: Your overcame at least two floors in your last exploration. You'll be able to receive more assistance this time

scene_ro4_spring_enter.title: Warm and Cozy
scene_ro4_spring_enter.description: One anecdote ends, and a new story has yet to begin. For now, what you see is just the warm flames of the furnace from your memories.

scene_ro4_spring_1.title: Warm and Cozy
scene_ro4_spring_1.description: While the warm flames provide comfort, you're more captivated by the future that awaits. Before the new story unfolds, you decide to eagerly prepare for its arrival.

scene_ro4_rest1_enter.title: Grace Before Fire
scene_ro4_rest1_enter.description: Whether around a campfire, a bright lamp, or an energy-transporting furnace node, the Sarkaz can always find a place to gather, talk, and trade, even in the gravest times. You and your group find an empty spot among the crowd and sit down, resting briefly and contemplating your next steps.

scene_ro4_rest1_1.title: Grace Before Fire
scene_ro4_rest1_1.description: The heat radiating from the furnace node repels the cold, allowing you to doze off in its warmth.

scene_ro4_rest1_2.title: Grace Before Fire
scene_ro4_rest1_2.description: A mercenary group just happens to be by the furnace, and you learn a lot from chatting and sparring with them.

scene_ro4_rest1_3.title: Grace Before Fire
scene_ro4_rest1_3.description: Life may be lackluster, but at least everyone still holds hopes for the future.

scene_ro4_rest1_4.title: Grace Before Fire
scene_ro4_rest1_4.description: While the stories vary, the solutions to their challenges remain constant. You take inventory of your resources, assess each member, and reorganize the team.

scene_ro4_rest1_8.title: Grace Before Fire
scene_ro4_rest1_8.description: The open-air theater is full of people, and you just can't wait to listen to the new Sarkaz epics.

scene_ro4_rest1_7.title: Grace Before Fire
scene_ro4_rest1_7.description: It's easy to lose oneself in the comfort of the furnace's light and fire, so you sit in an open space and listen to a Banshee sing a story you've never heard.

scene_ro4_rest1_5.title: Grace Before Fire
scene_ro4_rest1_5.description: A small inn by the furnace offers your group refuge and rest. You recuperate here until the curtains drop on the current epoch.

scene_ro4_rest1_6.title: Grace Before Fire
scene_ro4_rest1_6.description: The Military Commission stationed here has volunteered to train any passing mercenaries, and you decide to listen in on a class.

scene_ro4_rest1_9.title: Grace Before Fire
scene_ro4_rest1_9.description: You discuss some matters with your companions, and their opinions open up your mind.

scene_ro4_rest1_10.title: Grace Before Fire
scene_ro4_rest1_10.description: You spend considerable time debating with professors in the academy by the furnace, benefiting greatly from the clash of ideas.

scene_ro4_rec3_enter.title: A Small Skiff
scene_ro4_rec3_enter.description: You consider paying your respects at a nearby temple, but can't find the way there. As you wander back and forth, you stumble upon a small boat among the reeds. The Anasa ferrywoman is willing to take you to the temple for free, except there's only space for one more on her tiny boat.

scene_ro4_rec3_1.title: A Small Skiff
scene_ro4_rec3_1.description: Recognizing your group's desire to pay respects, she hands over her pole and points the way. The chosen two sail towards the temple while you stay to chat with her. She explains that this was once an unmarked grave for Oripathy sufferers cast into the wilds. The Anasa founded a temple here to offer treatment and ensure they died with dignity. Having received the temple's grace herself, she vowed to ferry any passing travelers.

scene_ro4_rec3_2.title: A Small Skiff
scene_ro4_rec3_2.description: She takes the fortunate soul aboard and fades into the reeds. You notice that while she is focused, her movements are somewhat clumsy, as though unfamiliar with the local waters. After a long while, the boat returns, and your squadmate cannot help but excitedly share all they saw. This is how you learn the temple is essentially a treatment center for the Infected... and a cemetery.

scene_ro4_normal11_enter.title: Good Fortune To You
scene_ro4_normal11_enter.description: The resplendent temple enshrines a statue of an Anasa forged from darksteel. According to some Ancients worshiping by the road, the Tripartite Darksteel Heavenly King presides over wealth and commerce. One need only speak a reverent prayer or rejoice in one's heart to receive his blessing, and good fortune shall come to you.

scene_ro4_normal11_1.title: Good Fortune To You
scene_ro4_normal11_1.description: You have no idea who this Anasa is, and you're uninterested in listening to the explanations of the two nearby priests with lazuli hair. After a quick stroll around the temple, you leave.

scene_ro4_normal11_2.title: Good Fortune To You
scene_ro4_normal11_2.description: Once you finish paying your respects, a white-haired Kuranta priestess gives you a box wrapped in yellow silk, a gift from the temple for your patronage. As she returns to the rear courtyard, you catch a glimpse of row upon neat rows of similar boxes wrapped in silk. It seems the true reason for this temple's popularity is its ability to trade faith for wealth.

scene_ro4_normal12_enter.title: Desire to Express
scene_ro4_normal12_enter.description: Revenants suddenly appear in your tale. They rampage through it, tearing out a chunk of the sky and throwing it onto the ground. In its place, they construct a giant 'Portal', and countless smaller 'Portals' pour out from it, swallowing up the living and spitting them out in other times. They'll drive you mad with their antics before they stop.

scene_ro4_normal12_1.title: Desire to Express
scene_ro4_normal12_1.description: After Tin Man talks things over with them, the revenants quickly leave.

scene_ro4_normal12_2.title: Desire to Express
scene_ro4_normal12_2.description: With the help of Tin Man, you use some Plans to turn the tale into a cage. The revenants finish their fun and prepare to leave, but find themselves trapped in an endless loop. You place the ball full of ancestors in your bag, believing you have stymied any future trouble they may cause. However, they continue rolling around inside, waiting for the next opportunity to 'express' themselves.

scene_ro4_normal12_3.title: Desire to Express
scene_ro4_normal12_3.description: After you concede, the tale is quickly torn apart into nothingness. With nothing left to destroy, the revenants fade away in satisfaction, leaving behind only a fragment of the tale for you. You breathe a sigh of relief, pick up the fragment, and begin imagining a new tale.

scene_ro4_chest2_enter.title: Employee of Babel
scene_ro4_chest2_enter.description: Together with his kin, a man named Big Bob has transformed this Babel outpost into a rest station for travelers. However, since they all wear identical gear, you're not sure which one is the real Big Bob. As you prepare to depart, a Babel employee brings you some supplies.

scene_ro4_chest2_1.title: Employee of Babel
scene_ro4_chest2_1.description: Some say Big Bob is a mercenary loyal to his men; others claim he was once a wealthy and straightforward businessman. There are even rumors of him having done time in a moldy jail. But to you, he's just a regular guy trying to get by and a good buddy to the Sarkaz.

scene_ro4_chest2_2.title: Employee of Babel
scene_ro4_chest2_2.description: All you have ever hoped for lies in the hands of that Babel employee. You remember only briefly expressing your desire, but never thought your dreams would turn into reality. Who's granting your wish, anyway?

scene_ro4_res6_enter.title: Turning Point
scene_ro4_res6_enter.description: Cowards inevitably perish in a hateful age. Blood kin slaughtered one after the other, along with anyone keeping their killers away. The enemy did not take his life, if only to derive joy from this twisted joke. All he can do is clutch a photo of his family tightly in his arms. Or is it?

scene_ro4_res6_1.title: Turning Point
scene_ro4_res6_1.description: He is but an ordinary man, bereft of the courage to resist the embodiments of violence. Not long after, he ushers in his own tragic end. But in an era where the culture is violence, none will mourn him.

scene_ro4_res6_2.title: Turning Point
scene_ro4_res6_2.description: He only wanted to see his family one last time, but spots something else within the frame: unobtainable hope and peace between the races. He also sees the enemy who killed his family within the photo, and comes to a realization: if violence is not done with hatred or abused, then perhaps fighting can help him realize the hope contained within the frame.

scene_ro4_res6_3.title: Turning Point
scene_ro4_res6_3.description: How many succumb to the era, and how many change because of it? He lacks only the determination, not the strength or the skills. He accepts the hatred within. If only through killing can he bring himself peace, then so be it.

scene_ro4_fin3_enter.title: Omen in the Void
scene_ro4_fin3_enter.description: Nymph strolls the boundary of imagination, hoping for a rare lightbulb moment. The storyteller shares many stories with the revenants, but when she has already narrated truth, adaptation, and imagination, what else is there? The revenants linger around her, constantly examining and modifying the ideas the storyteller is unwilling to bring to light. For example, a prophecy regarding the Sarkaz King...

scene_ro4_fin3_1.title: Omen in the Void
scene_ro4_fin3_1.description: It concerns the Sarkaz King, Amiya's story—one with an unfathomable ending. But, but, at the revenants' urging, Nymph relents. She persuades herself to try it, to tell a story that might 'satisfy' her ancestors. What she does not realize is that the moment she let others take over the tale, she lost control of everything that happens.

scene_ro4_fin3_2.title: Omen in the Void
scene_ro4_fin3_2.description: Nymph is unwilling to narrate this dark story of despair. She decides to give herself some time to think alone. Perhaps, a new story will take shape when she figures something out.

scene_ro4_fin4_enter.title: All or Nothing
scene_ro4_fin4_enter.description: Pulling the story's loose threads while blindly searching for the end—the end is but an incoherent contradiction. By the time Nymph realizes this, the ground beneath her has already turned to layers of chaos. The desire for an end awakens the ending. From within the void, it models on 'Amiya' as it traces the narrator's own end. To stop it, to seal it back within the void, Nymph needs to...

scene_ro4_fin4_1.title: All or Nothing
scene_ro4_fin4_1.description: Powerlessness and despair created 'Amiya's' beginning, so Nymph combines them with the Sarkaz King's power to forge a key. Plunge it into the chest of the end, reach out to 'Amiya', and perhaps this farce may yet reach a conclusion.

scene_ro4_fin4_2.title: All or Nothing
scene_ro4_fin4_2.description: As she stops the narration, Nymph is pulled back into reality for just a moment before immediately returning to this familiar scene, except the approaching end has already vanished into thin air. She changes her mind, and begins anew the story she wants to tell.

scene_ro4_fin5_1.description: Desire and power caused 'Amiya's' development, so Nymph combines them with the Sarkaz King's power to forge a key. Plunge it into the chest of the end, reach out to 'Amiya', and perhaps this farce may yet reach a conclusion.

scene_ro4_fin5_2.title: All or Nothing
scene_ro4_fin5_2.description: As she stops the narration, Nymph is pulled back into reality for just a moment before immediately returning to this familiar scene, except the approaching end has already vanished into thin air. She changes her mind, and begins anew the story she wants to tell.

From within the void, it models on 'Amiya' as it traces the narrator's own end. To stop it, to seal it back within the void, Nymph needs to...

scene_ro4_fin6_1.title: All or Nothing
scene_ro4_fin6_1.description: Fearlessness and solitude created 'Amiya's' ending, so Nymph combines them with the Sarkaz King's power to forge a key. Plunge it into the chest of the end, reach out to 'Amiya', and perhaps this farce may yet reach a conclusion. 'But... it seems like I'm missing something?' Nymph is a little worried. Perhaps this key will be unable to touch the ending, and she fears she understands 'Amiya' less than she thought.

scene_ro4_fin6_2.title: All or Nothing
scene_ro4_fin6_2.description: As she stops the narration, Nymph is pulled back into reality for just a moment before immediately returning to this familiar scene, except the approaching end has already vanished into thin air. She changes her mind, and begins anew the story she wants to tell.

scene_ro4_relic3_enter.title: Plausible But False
scene_ro4_relic3_enter.description: You go through a Door and land on a ship's deck. It seems to be Rhodes Island, but the Kazdelian furnace atop it makes you think it might be a Sarkaz migration ship. You then see a duo walking towards you; one being the Theresa you know so well, but the other is the Feline general who attacked Kazdel...? What's going on?

scene_ro4_relic3_1.title: Plausible But False
scene_ro4_relic3_1.description: They say little of the King of Sarkaz Theresis's death, or of Kal'tsit's conversation with the black crown, but mention how Rhozdel is a harbor for the Infected, and that it will become the frontline in the battle against Originium. A shared vision has united the two who should have been mortal enemies. After hearing about your journey, they help you find a Door and fix it in place, so both parties can help each other at any time.

scene_ro4_relic3_2.title: Plausible But False
scene_ro4_relic3_2.description: Inside the Door does not belong to the story you're telling, and with a glance at that Feline, you begin to worry if this is actually some kind of Sarkaz nomadic prison. Thus, you escape from the two as you search for an exit the Door left for you, finally returning to your story.

scene_ro4_relic3_3.title: Plausible But False
scene_ro4_relic3_3.description: After learning how you were brought here by the Door, Theresa and Kal'tsit dispatch an operator to accompany you, but also to explore your Land once you are home. 'Don't worry.' Kal'tsit says, 'The stories have closer connections than you imagine, so it's not too difficult to return here, if you wish to.'

BATTLE_NORMAL.name: Combat Ops
BATTLE_NORMAL.description: Everyone has their weapons drawn. They're definitely not here to negotiate.

BATTLE_ELITE.name: Emergency Ops
BATTLE_ELITE.description: Some violence may well exceed your expectations, a very common occurrence.

BATTLE_BOSS.name: Dreadful Foe
BATTLE_BOSS.description: Criminals, ruffians, and the damned… You're in trouble.

REST.name: Safe House
REST.description: Nobody will bother you here, and there's plenty of food and water. You can finally relax.

INCIDENT.name: Encounter
INCIDENT.description: New friends, old rivals… Strange encounters never age. Only scars stand the test of time.

ENTERTAINMENT.name: Downtime Recreation
ENTERTAINMENT.description: Indulging in life's simpler pleasures helps combat the monotony and hardships of your long journey ahead.

UNKNOWN.name: Dense Fog
UNKNOWN.description: There's something in the mist, but you cannot see anything...

WISH.name: Wish Fulfilled
WISH.description: There are many ways of making a wish, but the wish itself is almost always the same.

SACRIFICE.name: Lost and Found
SACRIFICE.description: The void of helplessness will be filled by the joy and satisfaction of gain.

EXPEDITION.name: Scout
EXPEDITION.description: Someone will always have to take the first step, to show the way for those who come after.

BATTLE_SHOP.name: Rogue Trader
BATTLE_SHOP.description: Neither an ally nor an enemy. Some people like to sit on the fence.

PORTAL.name: Possibility
PORTAL.description: Throw your dreams into the frame, and transform your fragmented ideas into brand new plans.

ALCHEMY.name: False to Truth
ALCHEMY.description: The changes are so remarkably real that you think you can tell true from false.

DUEL.name: Face-Off
DUEL.description: This has happened to the Sarkaz too many times to count.

STORY.name: Prophecy
STORY.description: The choice lies before us, the outcome already set.

STORY_HIDDEN.name: Prophecy
STORY_HIDDEN.description: The choice lies before us, the outcome already set.
