content: Good morning, good afternoon, and good night.
You give me the Originium, and I give you the goods. Don't worry too much about the details.
We may be old friends, but business is business.
Why am I helping you? Think of it as an investment.
Buy short, sell long. Getting more with less. We dabble in the same business, you and I.
I'm not picking up the scraps. I'm just taking the treasure nobody else wanted.
You want to hear a story? Of course, my friend, but good tales don't come cheap.
We meet again, friend. What are you buying this time?
Long time no see, old friend. Good to know you're still alive and kicking.
Don't be so surprised, friend. Every story needs a touch of truth, and I'm just part of that reality.
What do you fancy? Supplies for survival, supplies for a rite, or perhaps... some Kazdelian secrets?
You need manpower? I got you. No need to hesitate.
Be careful of Columbian organizations with 'Maylander' in their names.
This is way cheaper than looking everywhere for a Messenger.
You guys at Rhodes Island have all sorts of weirdos, huh...
I know, everyone has their own affairs to attend to.
You need help, but that help's not going to be free.
Mind if I have a look-see at Rhodes Island's aircraft? No? Too bad.
If you want to find a fighter, the Sarkaz and Blacksteel are good options.
Life in the barrens is full of pain. It's not easy to survive.
If you see someone you know but their face is all wrong, don't talk to them.
Time for some new blood, the more the merrier. Don't want our readers bored to death.
Don't worry. Spending money can make the world turn 'round.
Don't be too high-maintenance, picking up all these scraps was very hard work.
A fully armed society must surely be a civilized society.
What's this thing good for? Why, buy it and find out!
They say Laterano's a place without conflict or hatred. Do you buy that? I sure don't.
Gaul is long gone, but its remnants are still driving many to run the gauntlet.
I once bought a whole crate of Honey Biscuits, but this Perro girl made off with the lot of them.
Doing business in Kazdel really takes a lot of mental effort, because 'money' is the least valuable thing here.
For every ten Siracusans you bump into, about five are part of a 'Famiglia.' Watch yourself.
Can you feel it? What a wonderful epoch.
Against a door that can't open, some fumble for the key, while others go for a crowbar. Which one are you?
Be prepared for anything. Better safe than sorry, friend.
This little thing is equal parts worthless and terrifying...
What's this thing for? Good question, I don't know either.
Check out this new toy. The Prospective Investment System. Use your extra riches to pave the way for the future.
Always think long-term. With enough wealth, life's possibilities are endless. That's a good thing, my friend.
This is the kind of stuff Columbian entrepreneurs love peddling! I can hear those bills multiply!
You're an optimistic one. Try your hand at investing in the future, and you won't regret it, friend.
Don't let the spending get to you. You'll get it back in the future when you need it.
Now's the time to thank your past self for your foresight. Am I right, friend?
There's always a return on investment. Well, not really, but everyone likes to think so.
A little investment here and there'll eventually help you overcome anything. Can't hurt, anyway.
There's a withdrawal limit, but I'm willing to free up some space to bring you more practical goods. Thanks for always being so understanding, my friend.
Your investment reserves have gone up, friend. It's a good thing.
With your investment reserves, you can set out on your adventures with confidence.
Wonderful! Your next adventure will go much more smoothly. Probably.
Ah, I can see right away you're a cautious one. Maybe a little too cautious.
I only take a small commission for your investments in future adventures. It's a fair deal.
There's a saying in Yan: 'Plan ahead, or plan to fail.' The Yanese have a point.
I got myself some new trinkets. You'll love them.
You should invest in your upcoming adventures!
I do thank you for your support, friend. Let's keep working together.
The value of my wares will go down if you leave too many fingerprints on them, my friend.
Hand me the Ingots first, and you can touch that all you like.
Don't like my wares? Prices giving you second thoughts?
Oh, do be careful. You break it, you buy it.
There aren't many stories about the revenants, but I do know a few... That's as much as I can say.
You did wipe it clean first, right friend?
Ah, a fading remnant, a lingering extension, a bitter fruit... born from memories.
What was the phrase? That thing where you turn ideas into money? Oh, that's right, 'monetization'.
Feeling empty inside? Check your wallet, friend. The weight's just shifted.
Why do I need these? For reasons beyond your understanding. Now is not the time for questions.
Good choice.
A steal, isn't it?
Thank you for your patronage. Do have a look at the rest too.
As a friend, I'd be happy to offer help in other ways.
Why can't we just barter? Hah, following the established rules is also part of being civilized.
You have to earn to spend. Believe me, friend, you've definitely made a profit here.

ro4_ending_1.name: The End?
ro4_ending_1.desc: The unfinished tale is abruptly halted by the Lord of the Liches. He prefers your focus on building the present rather than appeasing departed souls.

ro4_ending_2.name: Twin Crowns
ro4_ending_2.desc: Your bold assumptions and imagination have brought this ending to life. Your soul quivers with excitement, your mind in a trance, leaving you in awe as you slowly comprehend what has transpired.
ro4_ending_2.changeEndingDesc: The twin kings bring reconciliation to the land, where all beings live and love in harmony. After two centuries of suffering, an epoch of humanity finally dawns, allowing healing to begin. This is the dream home the Sarkaz are proud to share.

ro4_ending_3.name: City of Angels
ro4_ending_3.desc: Sarkaz and Sankta are one. This strange tale fascinates you so much that even the revenants' wrath and the involvement of the Lord of the Liches can't pull you away...
ro4_ending_3.changeEndingDesc: A gun fires, and both the nouns 'Sankta' and 'Sarkaz' are lost, leaving only a radiant and divine word in their wake: Teekaz.

ro4_ending_4.name: Wisdom of Kaśjñāna
ro4_ending_4.desc: Qui'lon shares many tales and parables with you. Today, you enlighten one another. Tomorrow, you accompany him into the home of the Anasa, the land of the Dharma—Katsidiya.
ro4_ending_4.changeEndingDesc: Crystals may glimmer, and water may have no ripples. Dependent origination, the realization of the Dharma. Katsidiya's gates now swing wide.

ro4_ending_5.name: Impeccable Day
ro4_ending_5.desc: 'The Lord of Fiends destroyed all.'—This is what the revenants imagine. But with enough time, if Amiya can truly figure out how to save everything, all life trapped in stasis will be granted salvation.
ro4_ending_5.changeEndingDesc: Complete or incomplete, all suffering in all stories ends today.

battleLoadingTips.tip: Kazdel: Translates into 'home' or 'where home is' in Sarkazian. With its unique economy and socio-culture, it is the only nomadic city on Terra where the Sarkaz gather.
Soul Furnace: The energy source of the nomadic city Kazdel. Through pipes all across the city layers, it transports energy to various nodes within for residential use.

Furnace illusions: The Soul Furnace chamber burns the eternal life and Arts of many Sarkaz revenants, and the residue of Originium Arts usage from its long operation has resulted in strange effects within.

Epochs: The result of the furnace's illusions resonating with the storytellers' tales. The furnace revenants recreate their collective memories of past periods of suffering. These epochs can pose a threat to storytellers.
During your initial recruitment, you can recruit your friends' Operators via Support Recruitment
Operators recruited via 'Temporary Recruitment' will not consume Hope. Do not miss the opportunity
'Hope' can be used to recruit or promote Operators
Combining different collectibles can lead to amazing results
Train more Operators and explore the synergies between them to gain a greater advantage during combat
The abilities of the first Operators you recruit are capped at Elite 1
You can consume 'Stray Myths' to permanently gain bonuses in adventures
You can obtain Thoughts from battles and events, which can greatly impact your adventure
When your Mental Toil exceeds the limit, your mind becomes Fractured, causing burdens and negative effects
When your Mental Toil exceeds the chokepoint, your mind becomes Obstructed, preventing progress to further nodes
You will enter various epochs in your adventures, each with unique conditions. Be prudent and adaptive
Thoughts have two attributes: toil and rarity. Higher toil will result in more negative effects while rarity of thoughts will affect reward quality in False to Truth nodes

rogue_4_relic_legacy_18.description: In the declining coastal towns of Iberia, certain churches will provide alms in the form of meals, which their believers can redeem using vouchers. As for how these vouchers are distributed, that is a secret.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_18.usage: Deployment Limit +2, all allied units gain +6% HP

rogue_4_relic_legacy_19.name: Extra-Pungent Coffee Beans
rogue_4_relic_legacy_19.description: Coffee beans fed to a rare, peculiar-smelling fowlbeast and processed from its excrement. The unique aroma from gastric acid fermentation triples the beans' price.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_19.usage: Squad Size Limit +1, Deployment Limit +1, Shield +1

rogue_4_relic_legacy_20.name: Blue Silk Scarf
rogue_4_relic_legacy_20.description: A lady's elegant scarf. Her appearance is a sign that it is safe here.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_21.name: Red Bow Tie
rogue_4_relic_legacy_21.description: The first present Phantom gave Miss.Christine. She is really fond of it.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_22.name: Solo Music Box
rogue_4_relic_legacy_22.description: An old music box. The music does not play when the box is opened, nor does the figure inside show any signs it is about to move. There is not a peep, and no one is breaking out in dance. Before she begins her performances with Phantom, the lead actress stares blankly into the music box.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_23.name: Originium Iris
rogue_4_relic_legacy_23.description: A most extravagant bouquet of flowers. The troupe leader has handed flowers like these to the leads during countless curtain calls.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_23.unlockCondDesc: Complete an adventure with at least 60 Max Hope

rogue_4_relic_legacy_24.name: Weird Flute
rogue_4_relic_legacy_24.description: A weird-looking flute. Someone plays it day in and day out.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_25.name: Glass Bird
rogue_4_relic_legacy_25.description: 'In this paradise of mine, the bird will sing forever and ever.'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_25.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, earn a total of 50 Hope

rogue_4_relic_legacy_26.name: Pure Gold Expedition
rogue_4_relic_legacy_26.description: The regent departed from the wastelands, and markets rose from beneath her dress like sprouts budding in the spring. The road of prosperity connected high mountains and dense forests, following her until she disappeared beyond the cliffs overlooking the western waves. —Ancient Sargon Fairy Tale
rogue_4_relic_legacy_26.usage: Hope +4, Squad Size Limit +1, Deployment Limit +1
rogue_4_relic_legacy_26.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, earn a total of 150 Hope

rogue_4_relic_legacy_27.name: 'Durin Overground'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_27.description: In this expedition account, we get a glimpse of how those who live underground see those who live on the surface.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_27.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, lose a total of 50 Life Points

rogue_4_relic_legacy_28.name: 'Gaulish Toponym Origins'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_28.description: A book of historical place names that Mint dug out of the Doctor's office. Calais-blason is mentioned in the book.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_28.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, lose a total of 125 Objective Life Points

rogue_4_relic_legacy_29.name: Hot Water Kettle
rogue_4_relic_legacy_29.description: Some people regularly use the water boiler in the Rhodes Island office to cook instant noodles in the middle of the night. That's not a very healthy lifestyle...

rogue_4_relic_legacy_30.name: Special Suppressor
rogue_4_relic_legacy_30.description: An enhanced suppressor developed by Rhodes Island that can better keep the Infected from losing control of their Originium Arts.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_30.usage: Max Life Point +2, recover 2 Life Points

rogue_4_relic_legacy_31.name: Stone Gargoyle
rogue_4_relic_legacy_31.description: A palm-sized sculpture. Supposedly these are handmade gifts given out by the Gargoyles as a sign of friendship.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_32.name: Vampire's Bed
rogue_4_relic_legacy_32.description: A lavish-looking coffin that matches the castle's aesthetics well. However, Warfarin says this is merely a stereotype.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_33.name: Proof of Longevity
rogue_4_relic_legacy_33.description:
A tree branch that has withered and flourished.
When it is withered, it grows anew. When it is thriving in its fullest, it fades away yet again.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_34.name: Pried Open Toolbox
rogue_4_relic_legacy_34.description: The tool box of the troupe's prop master. From nails to dummy props, it has everything.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_34_a.name: Pried Open Toolbox - α
rogue_4_relic_legacy_34_a.description: The tool box of the troupe's prop master. From nails to dummy props, it has everything.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_35.name: Antiquated Sheet Music
rogue_4_relic_legacy_35.description: A tattered piece of sheet music. The notes can no longer be clearly read. No one knows for certain what story this piece was meant to tell.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_35_a.name: Antiquated Sheet Music - α
rogue_4_relic_legacy_35_a.description: A tattered piece of sheet music. The notes can no longer be clearly read. No one knows for certain what story this piece was meant to tell.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_36.description: You can break free from this troupe with just one signature.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_37.description: An old, silver key. It can open any door. As the keeper, the troupe's butler naturally needs a key that unlocks all the secrets here.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_38.description: Outbloods show exceptional courage when in possession of this trinket, but to Logos, a rare male Banshee, it's just a common object.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_39.description: An ancient, rusty coin, weathered to the point that one can no longer identify its age. Things like these are all too common throughout Terra's barrens.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_39_a.name: Antique Coins - α
rogue_4_relic_legacy_39_a.description: An ancient, rusty coin, weathered to the point that one can no longer identify its age. Things like these are all too common throughout Terra's barrens.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_39_a.usage: Immediately add +10 Originium Ingots and Hope +1

rogue_4_relic_legacy_40.description: A box containing all kinds of shattered jewelry. The young lead wore this jewelry and stepped onto the stage, in the end jumping from its highest point.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_41.description: Even though it thrice brought the city to ruins, it yet shines radiantly in its flawless form. Even today, the Sargonian emperor in possession of the gem has yet to find another piece of jewelry matching its brilliance, leaving it with naught but gunsmoke for a companion.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_42.name: Game Room Admin Access Card
rogue_4_relic_legacy_42.description: With this, you have become master over Rhodes Island's entertainment privileges. Please exercise caution when processing the various strange applications from the Operators... and remember to lock the door every day.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_42.usage: Immediately Promote an Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_4_relic_legacy_42_a.description: With this, you have become master over Rhodes Island's entertainment privileges. Please exercise caution when processing the various strange applications from the Operators... and remember to lock the door every day.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_42_a.usage: Immediately add 1 Originium Ingot, and Promote an Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_4_relic_legacy_42_c.usage: Immediately add 3 Originium Ingots, and Promote an Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_4_relic_legacy_43.name: Miss.Christine Petting Ticket
rogue_4_relic_legacy_43.usage: Immediately Promote 2 Operators (Does not require Hope)

rogue_4_relic_legacy_43_a.name: Miss.Christine Petting Ticket - α
rogue_4_relic_legacy_43_a.usage: Shield +1, and immediately Promote 2 Operators (Does not require Hope)

rogue_4_relic_legacy_43_b.name: Miss.Christine Petting Ticket - β
rogue_4_relic_legacy_43_b.usage: Shield +2, and immediately Promote 2 Operators (Does not require Hope)

rogue_4_relic_legacy_43_c.name: Miss.Christine Petting Ticket - γ
rogue_4_relic_legacy_43_c.usage: Shield +3, and immediately Promote 2 Operators (Does not require Hope)

rogue_4_relic_legacy_44.name: Antique Casting
rogue_4_relic_legacy_44.description: 'Harken, the forge of the sky, awaits five earthborn metals'... Even though it can be used for all kinds of work, nobody understands its exact mechanism.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_44.usage: Immediately Promote 3 Operators (Does not require Hope)
rogue_4_relic_legacy_44.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, promote a total of 35 Operators

rogue_4_relic_legacy_45.name: Blunt Claws - Training
rogue_4_relic_legacy_45.description: A formidable set of equipment to provide strength, an indomitable heart to press forward bravely.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_45.usage: Immediately Promote a Vanguard Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_4_relic_legacy_46.name: Bend Spears - Training
rogue_4_relic_legacy_46.description: Some people use swords because they don't know how to use crossbows or Arts. Others use swords because that's all they need.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_46.usage: Immediately Promote a Guard Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_4_relic_legacy_47.name: Iron Guard - Training
rogue_4_relic_legacy_47.description: Scars symbolize glory, but who will remember the soldiers who were cut a bit too deeply?
rogue_4_relic_legacy_47.usage: Immediately Promote a Defender Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_4_relic_legacy_48.name: Fatal Bolts - Training
rogue_4_relic_legacy_48.description: 'Either you learn to control your fire power, or you learn to discern your target. Got it?'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_48.usage: Immediately Promote a Sniper Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_4_relic_legacy_49.name: Broken Wand - Training
rogue_4_relic_legacy_49.description: 'After watching the 'performance' of certain casters, I decided to quietly put away the Leithanian textbook.'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_49.usage: Immediately Promote a Caster Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_4_relic_legacy_50.name: Stalwart Aid - Training
rogue_4_relic_legacy_50.description: Their tactics are always diverse and colorful.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_50.usage: Immediately Promote a Supporter Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_4_relic_legacy_51.name: Healer's Path - Training
rogue_4_relic_legacy_51.description: When the day comes when everyone is a doctor and can even cure the disease known as life, we will no longer need doctors.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_51.usage: Immediately Promote a Medic Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_4_relic_legacy_52.name: Rusted Blade - Training
rogue_4_relic_legacy_52.description: When conducting live combat drills with Specialist Operators, please be prepared to be 'beaten up thoroughly before you are prepared.'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_52.usage: Immediately Promote a Specialist Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_4_relic_legacy_53.name: Rusted Iron Hammer
rogue_4_relic_legacy_53.description: 'Change is necessary, and we must do all we can to hasten the oncoming storm.'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_53.usage: Shop vendors charge -50% Originium Ingots for their goods

rogue_4_relic_legacy_54.name: Rhodes Island Tactical Transceiver
rogue_4_relic_legacy_54.description: Hang in there, help's on the way.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_54.usage: Gain an additional choice when Recruitment Vouchers are dropped after battle

rogue_4_relic_legacy_55.name: Four-Leaf Clover Fossil
rogue_4_relic_legacy_55.description: A symbol of luck that Magallan found in a place all but devoid of life. The rock has no doubt experienced many violent changes of the lands, but it survived, giving those who come across it a small bit of lingering hope.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_55.usage: Gain an additional choice when loot drops from a Wish Fulfilled node or after battle

rogue_4_relic_legacy_56.name: Acahuallan Bowl
rogue_4_relic_legacy_56.description: Fruit is one of the locals' staples, often eaten fresh right off the tree.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_57.name: Three-Dimensional Art Display
rogue_4_relic_legacy_57.description: Rhine Lab is often like this artwork: mysterious, sophisticated, and inscrutable.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_57.usage: Recover 7 Life Points and recover an additional 1 Life Point after each battle

rogue_4_relic_legacy_58.name: Defender-2
rogue_4_relic_legacy_58.description: A mass-produced defensive drone, oddly effective only in the hands of the enemy.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_59.name: Fissured Restraints
rogue_4_relic_legacy_59.description: It seems this sturdy band was once used to restrain something terrifying... Help...

rogue_4_relic_legacy_60.name: Abyssal Wyrdmask
rogue_4_relic_legacy_60.description: An eldritch mask not belonging to any culture you're familiar with, capable of making people lose their will to fight... and unconsciously fall into a state of deep contemplation.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_61.name: Godmother's Token
rogue_4_relic_legacy_61.description: A laurel of bones, the token of Signora Sicilia. This symbol of order will smooth the turbulence of all desires, for conflict is not allowed. Genuine or counterfeit, it still demands you to kneel.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_62.name: Worn-out Group Photo
rogue_4_relic_legacy_62.description: Do you know someone in the photo?

rogue_4_relic_legacy_63.name: Sea Terror Jerky
rogue_4_relic_legacy_63.description: When the will to survive outweighs fear, famished Iberians will consume this 'food', only to turn into Sea Terror in one of the days that follow.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_63.unlockCondDesc: Select 'Gathering Squad' and complete your adventure

rogue_4_relic_legacy_65.name: Gold-Plated Die
rogue_4_relic_legacy_65.description: The gold-plated die has one side representing life. As for the other nineteen sides...

rogue_4_relic_legacy_66.name: 'The Whisperer in Darknight'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_66.description: A black vinyl. DO. NOT. TOUCH. IT.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_67.name: 'The Silence'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_67.description: A painting that depicts the greatest disaster in Iberian history. Its brushstrokes, colors, and images are all meaningless. 'The Ægir know. The Ægir know. The Ægir know.'

rogue_4_relic_legacy_68.name: Oriron Round Shield
rogue_4_relic_legacy_68.description: Before the use of Oriron became widespread in today's industrial sector, the material was frequently used to forge military weapons like this one.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_69.name: Military Mirror Armor
rogue_4_relic_legacy_69.description: This mirror armor used to be able to withstand most attacks to the chest, but with the fall of Gaul, such archaic forms of armor have become museum pieces.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_70.name: Old Steam Armor
rogue_4_relic_legacy_70.description: Even this old, outdated steam armor seems to carry with it the resplendence of when the Victorian monarchs cast their glory across half the world.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_71.name: Emperor's Favor
rogue_4_relic_legacy_71.description: A very sharp letter opener. It was one of the favorite possessions of the last Ursus emperor, and as such it was very rarely used to actually open letters.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_71.usage: All allied melee units have +15% ATK

rogue_4_relic_legacy_72.name: Royal Rapier
rogue_4_relic_legacy_72.description: A highly decorative rapier for nobles. Used by Gaulish nobles first and foremost, though perhaps a little fragile for a military weapon.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_72.usage: All allied melee units have +25% ATK
rogue_4_relic_legacy_72.unlockCondDesc: Select 'Tactical Assault Squad' and complete your adventure

rogue_4_relic_legacy_73.name: Vieux Vanguard's Blade
rogue_4_relic_legacy_73.description: Prior to its downfall, Gaul first witnessed the sacrifices of its Vieux Vanguards.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_73.usage: All allied melee units have +35% ATK

rogue_4_relic_legacy_74.name: Necklace of the Presence
rogue_4_relic_legacy_74.description: Faith hangs ten centimeters above your heart, spoken words flow into your blood, and bullets slide into your magazine.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_74.usage: All allied ranged units have +15% ATK

rogue_4_relic_legacy_75.name: Silver Forks
rogue_4_relic_legacy_75.description: One for dealing with actors who botch their performances, one for dealing with incompetent playwrights, and one for anyone who needs it. The Chief will not tolerate any mistakes on the table.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_75.usage: All allied ranged units have +25% ATK

rogue_4_relic_legacy_76.name: Damaged Revolver Cylinder
rogue_4_relic_legacy_76.description: She never capitulated, even after enduring countless trials and tribulations. Her muzzle belched tongues of flame that burned like an angry sun, and the glow above her head was brighter than the daylight itself. Buried here is Outcast, our friend.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_76.usage: All allied ranged units have +35% ATK

rogue_4_relic_legacy_77.name: Noxious Hemostatic Agent
rogue_4_relic_legacy_77.description: 'After fermentation, the body fluids of this Originium slug can be used to stop bleeding.' —'Rhodes Island Wilderness Survival Guide'

rogue_4_relic_legacy_78.name: First Aid Kit
rogue_4_relic_legacy_78.description: '...Please use antibiotics and ethanol additives under the supervision of professionals...' —Rim Billiton Production Safety Manual
rogue_4_relic_legacy_78.unlockCondDesc: Select 'Tactical Fortification Squad' and complete your adventure

rogue_4_relic_legacy_79.name: Unknown Instrument
rogue_4_relic_legacy_79.description: Don't ask. It's for your own good.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_80.name: Rusted Razor
rogue_4_relic_legacy_80.description: If you cut yourself with this, you know what will happen.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_81.name: Carriage Driver's Whip
rogue_4_relic_legacy_81.description: As the troupe's carriage driver, he has no name and no past. His life is meaningful only when he whips his burdenbeasts.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_81.unlockCondDesc: Select 'Tactical Ranged Squad' and complete your adventure

rogue_4_relic_legacy_82.name: 'Hateful Avenger'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_82.description: A gift from Theresis and set up by Theresa, this is the very first weapon that Ascalon received after her inaugural mission as part of the Military Council.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_83.name: Standard Anti-Riot Instrument
rogue_4_relic_legacy_83.description: Standard equipment of the Ursus Guard. Comes with an intermittent blinding Originium Arts effect. Unfortunately, not many Guards out there remember this when push comes to shove.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_84.name: Emperor's Collection
rogue_4_relic_legacy_84.description: The Sami revere their wild lands more than anything, and this fragment of the vast wilderness sleeps in the personal collection of the Emperor of Ursus.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_84.unlockCondDesc: Select 'Tactical Destruction Squad' and complete your adventure

rogue_4_relic_legacy_85.name: 'Brilliant Lament'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_85.description: His blood yet flows. He has never left this place.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_86.name: Live Rose
rogue_4_relic_legacy_86.description: Is it you who nourishes her, or is it her who protects you?
rogue_4_relic_legacy_86.usage: All allied units have +20% healing effectiveness

rogue_4_relic_legacy_87.name: White Flower Crown
rogue_4_relic_legacy_87.description: A floral veil used in Vampire rituals. Its once vibrant redness has been sucked empty, leaving only a pale white color.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_87.usage: All allied units have +30% healing effectiveness

rogue_4_relic_legacy_88.name: Actor's Perfume
rogue_4_relic_legacy_88.description: Troupe actors put this on before going onstage. Stable yet aromatic fragrances like this can help them ease pressure. That's how it seems on the surface, at least.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_88.usage: All allied units recover 1% of Max HP per second

rogue_4_relic_legacy_89.name: Designer's Ruler
rogue_4_relic_legacy_89.description: Carefully measured with data and experience, those who wear this armor are known to be several magnitudes luckier.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_89.usage: All allied units have +15% Physical Dodge

rogue_4_relic_legacy_90.name: 'Arts Killer'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_90.description: Considering how Originium Arts and music go hand in hand in Leithanien, it's quite amazing someone came up with the bright idea of combating Arts with noise like this.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_90.usage: All allied units have +15% Arts Dodge

rogue_4_relic_legacy_91.name: Dancer's Bracelets
rogue_4_relic_legacy_91.description: The audience breaks into applause as the well-trained dancers waltz around the traps on stage. None of them are aware of the brushes with death the performers have just been through.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_91.usage: All allied units have +10% Physical and Arts Dodge

rogue_4_relic_legacy_92.name: Doll House
rogue_4_relic_legacy_92.description: Every kid needs at least one set.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_93.name: Miniature Stage Model
rogue_4_relic_legacy_93.description: The red paint has not yet dried. Careful. Don't get that paint on your hand.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_94.name: Dreambind Castle Model
rogue_4_relic_legacy_94.description: You've seen this place, and you once wandered the castle, yet you now hold it in your hand. Is this real, or is it all a dream?

rogue_4_relic_legacy_95.name: Jet-Black Dance Shoes
rogue_4_relic_legacy_95.description: The Columbian dancer's steps are firm and strong, her taps reverberating loudly in the air as she strikes the ground.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_95.usage: Can deploy Melee Operators on High Ground tiles
rogue_4_relic_legacy_95.unlockCondDesc: Clear the 3rd Floor, 'Ashforged Ruins' a total of 3 times, with 6 or more Ranged or Melee Operators recruited

rogue_4_relic_legacy_96.name: Pure White Dance Shoes
rogue_4_relic_legacy_96.description: The Ursus dancer's steps are swift and elegant, her body moving as she wills.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_96.usage: Can deploy Ranged Operators on Low Ground tiles
rogue_4_relic_legacy_96.unlockCondDesc: Clear the 3rd Floor, 'Ashforged Ruins' a total of 3 times, with 6 or more Ranged or Melee Operators recruited

rogue_4_relic_legacy_97.name: Blunt Claws - Advancement
rogue_4_relic_legacy_97.description: Plant a great stone within the waters. Split the waves and part the fog.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_97.usage: Vanguard Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP

rogue_4_relic_legacy_98.name: Blunt Claws - Burst
rogue_4_relic_legacy_98.description: He's already done all the reserve squad's work for them. What else do you expect?

rogue_4_relic_legacy_99.name: Blunt Claws - Proficiency
rogue_4_relic_legacy_99.description: As operators who are often the first to head into battle, what they have been through is unfathomable.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_99.usage: The SP Cost of Vanguard Operators' skills is decreased by 35%

rogue_4_relic_legacy_100.name: Blunt Claws - Mastery
rogue_4_relic_legacy_100.description: 'When the darkly-clad enemies rushed towards me, there were only four words on my mind — they are done for.'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_100.usage: Vanguard Operators have +50% ATK and DEF

rogue_4_relic_legacy_101.name: Bend Spears - Advancement
rogue_4_relic_legacy_101.description: The soldiers stepped onto the battlefield, drew their blades, and met in battle.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_101.usage: Guard Operators have -3 DP Cost and +40% HP

rogue_4_relic_legacy_102.name: Bend Spears - Acuity
rogue_4_relic_legacy_102.description: 'This is the 7th blade you've broken this month.' 'But I cut down eight enemies this month.'

rogue_4_relic_legacy_103.name: Bend Spears - Bloodbath
rogue_4_relic_legacy_103.description: Soldiers who get bolder as time passes are rare. Most need some form of psychological counseling to alleviate the trauma of war.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_103.usage: Guard Operators restore 2 SP after each attack

rogue_4_relic_legacy_104.name: Bend Spears - Deathmatch
rogue_4_relic_legacy_104.description: I wouldn't really recommend learning those skills from Blaze.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_104.usage: Guard Operators have -40% DEF, but gain +40% ATK and +30 ASPD

rogue_4_relic_legacy_105.name: Iron Guard - Advancement
rogue_4_relic_legacy_105.description: The shieldbearers formed a mountain range and became the earth. What they fight against are not enemies of flesh and blood. They fight against fate and injustice.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_105.usage: Defender Operators have -3 DP Cost and +40% HP

rogue_4_relic_legacy_106.name: Iron Guard - Invasion
rogue_4_relic_legacy_106.description: Defensive actions for the sake of teammates or strategic purposes often make people forget about their original aggressiveness.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_107.name: Iron Guard - Consolidation
rogue_4_relic_legacy_107.description: No matter how heavy fate's blow is, take it.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_107.usage: Defender Operators gain HP +40%, DEF +40%, and RES +20

rogue_4_relic_legacy_108.name: Iron Guard - Impenetrable
rogue_4_relic_legacy_108.description: Every blow they endure will turn into anger and be returned severalfold.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_108.usage: Defender Operators restore 2 SP after being attacked

rogue_4_relic_legacy_109.name: Fatal Bolts - Advancement
rogue_4_relic_legacy_109.description: Load, aim, and fire. Destruction arrives as scheduled.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_109.usage: Sniper Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP

rogue_4_relic_legacy_110.name: Fatal Bolts - Precision
rogue_4_relic_legacy_110.description: In an era when Originium Arts were not as robust as they are now, Yan had a saying, 'a pierced willow leaf from a hundred paces,' to praise others for their mastery of archery.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_111.name: Fatal Bolts - Crossfire
rogue_4_relic_legacy_111.description: The dense crossfire also exposes snipers to great danger. The next battle boils down to a game of vision.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_111.usage: Sniper Operators have -40% HP, but gain +40% ATK

rogue_4_relic_legacy_112.name: Fatal Bolts - Divine Speed
rogue_4_relic_legacy_112.description: It is said that the legendary archers of ancient Victoria could almost shoot a continuous stream of arrows.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_113.name: Broken Wand - Advancement
rogue_4_relic_legacy_113.description: Let Arts dance around your fingertips. Call the wind and rain, unravel reality, and achieve your grand goals.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_113.usage: Caster Operators have -3 DP Cost and +60% HP

rogue_4_relic_legacy_114.name: Broken Wand - Arts Weaving
rogue_4_relic_legacy_114.description: Those who gaze up at the great spires of Leithanien often see strange or even celestial phenomena.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_114.usage: Caster Operators have +25% ATK and +25 ASPD

rogue_4_relic_legacy_115.name: Broken Wand - Concentration
rogue_4_relic_legacy_115.description: 'When a caster intends to go all out, they will display a completely different temperament — even if we're talking about something like Skyfire's grumpiness.'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_115.usage: Increases the SP regen rate of Caster Operators by +0.4/s

rogue_4_relic_legacy_116.name: Broken Wand - Malediction
rogue_4_relic_legacy_116.description: It is virtually impossible to identify when the Sarkaz first encountered Originium, and the origins of these ancient Arts have long been separated from actual reality and common sense.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_116.usage: Caster Operators have -40% HP, but deal +70% Arts damage

rogue_4_relic_legacy_117.name: Stalwart Aid - Advancement
rogue_4_relic_legacy_117.description: Whenever you're 'almost done' with a task, what you need at that moment is someone to help you with the 'almost' part.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_117.usage: Supporter Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP

rogue_4_relic_legacy_118.name: Stalwart Aid - Diligence
rogue_4_relic_legacy_118.description: Operators tend to give it their all, even to tasks that might seem trivial. The reality is, those tasks are not trivial at all.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_118.usage: The SP Cost of Supporter Operators' skills is decreased by 40%

rogue_4_relic_legacy_119.name: Stalwart Aid - Assistance
rogue_4_relic_legacy_119.description: Proper meals, correct paths, or simply having a heart-to-heart... Victory is won through these little things.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_119.usage: Allied units within the attack range of Supporter Operators gain +20% ATK

rogue_4_relic_legacy_120.name: Stalwart Aid - Counter-Arts
rogue_4_relic_legacy_120.description: There are many ways to weaken an enemy's defensive capabilities: positional devices, armor-stripping Arts, marking weak points, and... giving them a stomachache.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_120.usage: Enemies within the attack range of Supporter Operators have -20% DEF and -20% RES

rogue_4_relic_legacy_121.name: Healer's Path - Advancement
rogue_4_relic_legacy_121.description: The desire to save lives is a virtue that mankind must applaud, for that is the support that keeps us alive.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_121.usage: Medic Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP

rogue_4_relic_legacy_122.name: Healer's Path - Self-Treating
rogue_4_relic_legacy_122.description: Who says healers can't heal themselves? They simply pop some pills before continuing to help others.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_122.usage: Increases the SP regen rate of Medic Operators by +0.3/s

rogue_4_relic_legacy_123.name: Healer's Path - Keen Hands
rogue_4_relic_legacy_123.description: Compared to snatching a life from the grip of death, what's three days of coma afterward?

rogue_4_relic_legacy_124.name: Healer's Path - Restore Sanity
rogue_4_relic_legacy_124.description: Making one's body as solid as a nomadic city is a bit of a romanticized description, but our medics are ready to put that idea into practice.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_124.usage: Allied units within the attack range of Medic Operators gain Resistance

rogue_4_relic_legacy_125.name: Rusted Blade - Advancement
rogue_4_relic_legacy_125.description: There may be many means, but only one end.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_125.usage: Specialist Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP

rogue_4_relic_legacy_126.name: Rusted Blade - Execution
rogue_4_relic_legacy_126.description: Endless rust to scrape, and a bottomless list of tasks to complete.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_127.name: Rusted Blade - No Man's Land
rogue_4_relic_legacy_127.description: A shadow blinks, a faint sound stirs, and a life is taken. The audience is the next victim.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_127.usage: The Redeployment Time of Specialist Operators -35%

rogue_4_relic_legacy_128.name: Ancient Gaulish Silver Coin
rogue_4_relic_legacy_128.description: A coin once circulated in the now fallen nation of 'Gaul.' It is in very good shape, making it highly valuable as a collector's item.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_129.name: Bank of Gaul Check
rogue_4_relic_legacy_129.description: An extravagant checkbook plated in gold and silver. Can no longer be cashed.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_130.name: 'Second Economic Reform Act'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_130.description: With this bill as the starting point, Gaul formally began its path to become a hegemonic empire.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_131.name: Vanilla Soda
rogue_4_relic_legacy_131.description: Bolívar's cheap specialty drink dates back hundreds of years. It is mixed with a variety of spices, and is known for not being very good.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_131.usage: Increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.2/s

rogue_4_relic_legacy_132.name: Fowlbeast Liver Pate
rogue_4_relic_legacy_132.description: A small jar of fowlbeast liver pâté. Bright and vividly colorful, it is eaten only by nobles.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_132.usage: Increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.35/s

rogue_4_relic_legacy_133.name: Dreaming Essence
rogue_4_relic_legacy_133.description: Supposedly the Banshees make their aromatics only for their beloved. A single drop is enough to enchant just about anyone, bringing out any artist's inspiration and creativity.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_133.usage: Increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.5/s

rogue_4_relic_legacy_134.name: Captain Morgan's Wine
rogue_4_relic_legacy_134.description: A wine produced in the Iberian region. Despite having gained popularity in the heart of Victoria's bustling cities, it is now discontinued.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_134.usage: Increases the SP regen rate of Offensive and Defensive Recovery skills by 1 SP per 3s

rogue_4_relic_legacy_135.name: Water of Life
rogue_4_relic_legacy_135.description: The strongest Ursine liquors go straight to one's head, but it's said that the healthy Ursine adult can down several bottles.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_135.usage: Increases the SP regen rate of Offensive and Defensive Recovery skills by 1 SP per 2.5s
rogue_4_relic_legacy_135.unlockCondDesc: Select 'First-Class Squad' and complete your adventure

rogue_4_relic_legacy_136.name: Royal Liqueur
rogue_4_relic_legacy_136.description: The fine wines of the fallen nation of Gaul have now become prized treasures for collectors. The place of production has moved to Leithanien, but the technique has been lost.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_136.usage: Increases the SP regen rate of Offensive and Defensive Recovery skills by 1 SP per 1.5s

rogue_4_relic_legacy_137.name: String Puppet
rogue_4_relic_legacy_137.description: The more you struggle and try to break free, the tighter the strings get. Do you really think you are still thinking rationally?
rogue_4_relic_legacy_137.usage: Enemies receive 700 Arts damage per second when stunned, frozen, or bound

rogue_4_relic_legacy_138.name: 'Children's Puppet'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_138.description: A simple puppet made by Iberian children using trinkets found on the seacoast. Supposedly just holding it tight will give you much richer dreams.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_138.usage: Enemies receive 1000 Arts damage per second when stunned, frozen, or bound

rogue_4_relic_legacy_139.name: Victory Horn
rogue_4_relic_legacy_139.description: Blow the horn, cry out, and scatter our foes with its roar!
rogue_4_relic_legacy_139.usage: Increases the duration of single-instance status effects such as stun, cold, or freeze by 100%

rogue_4_relic_legacy_140.name: Flash Camera
rogue_4_relic_legacy_140.description: Every photo shot by this camera is washed out in white, with only the victim's twisted expression faintly visible.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_140.usage: Increases the duration of single-instance status effects such as stun, cold, or freeze by 110%
rogue_4_relic_legacy_140.unlockCondDesc: Complete an adventure while having at least 3 Supporter Operators

rogue_4_relic_legacy_141.name: Therapy Tape
rogue_4_relic_legacy_141.description: He tried to stop you from listening. He said it was dangerous. He said you should not stay. Do you understand now? You are listening to his song.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_141.usage: Increases the duration of single-instance status effects such as stun, cold, or freeze by 150%

rogue_4_relic_legacy_142.name: Old Fan
rogue_4_relic_legacy_142.description: When it rains for several days on end, the old Yanese Tianshi complains to his friends about the pain in his knees, before casually waving his fan and driving away the rainclouds. It is about time he taught this trick to his young apprentice, currently working at the Central Judicial Office.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_142.usage: All Operators gain +10% ATK for every different type of Operator class in the squad
rogue_4_relic_legacy_142.unlockCondDesc: Complete an adventure while having at least 20 Operators

rogue_4_relic_legacy_143.name: Victorian 'Scrap' Medal
rogue_4_relic_legacy_143.description: A knight's medal that Siege threw together and awarded to Dagda on the spot. The materials used are pitiful, but it holds a lot of meaning to Dagda.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_144.name: Scout's Scope
rogue_4_relic_legacy_144.description: Lock on, aim, fire, and destroy the enemy's will to resist, all in the name of a better future that Scout will never see. Maybe you can do it for him.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_144.usage: Enemies take increased damage from allied units as range increases (max 100%)
rogue_4_relic_legacy_144.unlockCondDesc: Complete an adventure while having at least 3 Sniper Operators

rogue_4_relic_legacy_145.name: Black Tulip
rogue_4_relic_legacy_145.description: Silence crushed the Iberians, so she knows she must speak up. If her words aren't sharp enough, her sword will speak for her.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_145.usage: Allied Operators gradually gain ATK when not using a skill, up to a maximum of +60% after 60 seconds; bonus is reset when skill ends

rogue_4_relic_legacy_146.name: Golden Chalice
rogue_4_relic_legacy_146.description: Saints, knights, and believers. All of them are madmen. Dear God, even the chalice itself is made of pure gold!
rogue_4_relic_legacy_146.usage: For each 5 Originium Ingots in possession, all allied units have +7 ASPD

rogue_4_relic_legacy_147.name: Spinach Pack
rogue_4_relic_legacy_147.description: Many Cautus out there believe that popping the contents of this can into their mouths will grant them immense strength. The marketing's effectiveness is a classic success story in the industry.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_147.usage: Operators have +60% ATK for one second after their skill becomes active

rogue_4_relic_legacy_148.name: Wrath of Siracusans
rogue_4_relic_legacy_148.description: The signature pasta dish of an 'authentic Siracusan restaurant' that once operated in the capital of Gaul. The dish's unique taste, and particularly its sauce—a blend of thick chocolate sauce and Originium Slug liver—earned the praise of many Gaulish nobles. Supposedly, though, this dish nearly caused a diplomatic crisis between Siracusa and Gaul.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_148.usage: Operators have +100% ATK for one second after their skill becomes active
rogue_4_relic_legacy_148.unlockCondDesc: Clear [Failed Dare] without losing more than 3 Life Points

rogue_4_relic_legacy_150.name: King's New Lance
rogue_4_relic_legacy_150.description: Beautiful wishes made in dire straits can bring hope, even if they are not necessarily the truth.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_150.usage: When Life Point is 1, all allied units have +50 ASPD

rogue_4_relic_legacy_151.name: Castle's Offspring
rogue_4_relic_legacy_151.description: With enough time, this box will become a whole new stage.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_151.usage: All Operators gain +300 DEF and +30 RES after being deployed for 100 seconds
rogue_4_relic_legacy_151.unlockCondDesc: Complete an adventure with at least 80 Operators deployed in battle

rogue_4_relic_legacy_152.name: 'Little Gran Faro'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_152.description: An illumination device reverse-engineered from the Eye of Iberia. It can penetrate thick, dark clouds and temporarily repel powerful enemies.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_152.usage: Stuns all enemy units for 5 seconds every time an enemy unit enters the Objective Point
rogue_4_relic_legacy_152.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, lose a total of 125 Objective Life Points

rogue_4_relic_legacy_153.name: 'Memories of The Shard'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_153.description: 'Still impaled on Victoria's heart, it watches as the empire bleeds.'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_153.usage: Deals 5000 True damage to all enemy units every time an enemy unit enters the Objective Point

rogue_4_relic_legacy_154.name: King's Crown
rogue_4_relic_legacy_154.description: O Nameless Kings, may you continue to bless Iberia, even though your kingdoms are no more.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_154.usage: When Life Point is at 1, all allied units have +50% ATK, increased to +150% ATK if you have collected 3 or more King's Collectibles

rogue_4_relic_legacy_155.name: 'Glorious Kazimierz'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_155.description: A Kazimierzian best-seller that adapts the deeds of the arena's brightest-shining knights into a novel. Nearl, who was exiled but returned to reclaim her laurels, occupies a considerable portion of its pages.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_155.usage: Operators have +70% ATK for 6 seconds after dodging

rogue_4_relic_legacy_156.name: 'The Return'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_156.description: This Kazimierzian best-seller is said to be a collective creation by fans. 'Nearl' has already become an amalgamation of many ideals and fantasies. 'For her, exile was not an escape. She came back, and stood alone against the era's torrents.'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_156.usage: Operators have +130% ATK for 6 seconds after dodging
rogue_4_relic_legacy_156.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, clear a total of 40 battles

rogue_4_relic_legacy_157.name: Cannot's Mark
rogue_4_relic_legacy_157.description: Some are willing to do favors for Cannot to maintain good terms, while others deserve the same treatment from Cannot.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_157.usage: Gain 1 Hope whenever you buy an item at the Rogue Trader or make an exchange at Lost and Found
rogue_4_relic_legacy_157.unlockCondDesc: In the 'Prospective Investment System,' reach an Investment Reserve Balance of 325

rogue_4_relic_legacy_158.name: Lakebed Aegis
rogue_4_relic_legacy_158.description: Three decades ago, a child dropped his toy wooden shield into the lake. Three decades later, he bores through the frozen lake, retrieves his shield, and embarks on a hero's journey.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_158.usage: Shield +1; all allied units gain Max HP +60% if you have any Shield at the start of a battle
rogue_4_relic_legacy_158.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, enter a total of 40 non-combat nodes

rogue_4_relic_legacy_159.name: Roundstone Altar
rogue_4_relic_legacy_159.description: An offering made is returned with a reward. So simple it was, that people never questioned what they were sacrificing to.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_159.usage: Chance to permanently increase all allied units' ATK and DEF by 5% after a battle (Stacks up to 10 times)

rogue_4_relic_legacy_160.name: Empty Fowlbeast
rogue_4_relic_legacy_160.description: The body is long since gone, but the soul remains in the shell for eternity. The unmelting creatures in the branches and leaves carry icicles as they spread their wings in the forest.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_160.usage: Summons have +30% HP, +30% ATK, and when on the field, grant +60% ATK to their summoners

rogue_4_relic_legacy_161.name: Ancient Tree Fruit
rogue_4_relic_legacy_161.description: The children of Sami make their wishes into tree seeds and bury them in the snow. When the tree bears fruit, the first four are taken, and the smallest is left to the next generation for wish making. The rest are tributes to Sami for hearing their questions.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_162.name: Friston.P
rogue_4_relic_legacy_162.description: Friston would certainly not miss out on an opportunity to explore the secrets of another predecessor civilization. Oh, but Closure didn't even consider making backups, so DON'T tell her about this!
rogue_4_relic_legacy_162.usage: Allied units permanently gain ASPD +5 for every Emergency Ops cleared (Stacks up to 15 times)

rogue_4_relic_legacy_163.name: Expeditioner's Field Pack
rogue_4_relic_legacy_163.description: They always stuff their backpacks with survival supplies, then press forward with the determination and will to challenge the boundaries of the known.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_163.usage: Operators gain ATK +60% and Resistance for 15 seconds after recovering from a negative status

rogue_4_relic_legacy_164.name: Minoan Ode
rogue_4_relic_legacy_164.description: 'Is there a feat more worthy of praise than an expedition into no man's land? Now, yes! Go forth into the north, and write the next chapter of your saga!'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_164.usage: Allied units permanently gain HP +5% for every Emergency Ops cleared (Stacks up to 15 times)

rogue_4_relic_legacy_165.name: Hand of Buckler
rogue_4_relic_legacy_165.description: Drop by drop, bit by bit. It is unstoppable.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_165.usage: Decel Binder, Hexer, and Abjurer Operators' attacks deal extra Arts damage equal to 3% of the target's current HP

rogue_4_relic_legacy_166.name: Knight Lance Pro
rogue_4_relic_legacy_166.description: Kazimierz Major lottery tickets with hard-to-get adverts for weapons printed on them.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_166.usage: Treasure Chests on the battlefield will drop more Originium Ingots

rogue_4_relic_legacy_167.name: Living Woodplate
rogue_4_relic_legacy_167.description: Shamans know the formidable will to survive that trees possess, so when a warrior has a similar will, they invite the trees to be their armor.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_167.usage: All allied melee units gain a Barrier equal to 50% of their Max HP on deployment
rogue_4_relic_legacy_167.unlockCondDesc: Win a battle while having at least 3 Defender Operators

rogue_4_relic_legacy_168.name: Rock Horn
rogue_4_relic_legacy_168.description: If you want to gather up manpower in Sami, blowing a trumpet is definitely the best way to do it.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_168.usage: An Operator gains ATK +20% for every Operator in the adjacent 4 tiles

rogue_4_relic_legacy_169.name: 'Glory Pack'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_169.description: A special betting method set up by the organizers for the knight competition season. Diversify your bets with various plans to minimize losses on any match.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_169.usage: When an allied unit is defeated, all enemies in the four adjacent tiles are stunned for 6 seconds

rogue_4_relic_legacy_170.name: Ribbon of Honor
rogue_4_relic_legacy_170.description: Numerous actors have played this character, yet none of them were able to save the character's dearest friend.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_170.usage: All allied units have +100% ATK when blocking only one enemy

rogue_4_relic_legacy_171.name: Chitinous Ripper
rogue_4_relic_legacy_171.description: A more efficient way of growing an exoskeleton. It can tear prey apart, resist impact, and also be turned into a delicacy for its kin.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_171.usage: When a battle begins, a random Operator will have +100% ATK and +100% HP for that battle

rogue_4_relic_legacy_172.name: Medicine Sticks
rogue_4_relic_legacy_172.description: Inspired by ancient Yanese soldiers who marched with something in their mouths to maintain silence, Mulberry created this edible hard plaster. Excellent for prolonged chewing and spirit lifting.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_172.usage: All allied units gain 2 layers of Shield when deployed

rogue_4_relic_legacy_173.name: Supreme Ring
rogue_4_relic_legacy_173.description: In Leithanian mythology, he who holds the ring enjoys the vast riches of the entire world, but greed will also be his undoing.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_173.unlockCondDesc: Complete an adventure with at least 20 Originium Ingots remaining

rogue_4_relic_legacy_174.name: Coin-Operated Toy
rogue_4_relic_legacy_174.description: No idea why anyone would like a design like this, but its overall concept is indeed praiseworthy—Just insert a coin, and even a statue will start moving. There is nothing truer in this world.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_174.usage: For each 5 Originium Ingots in possession, all allied units have +3 ASPD

rogue_4_relic_legacy_175.name: Chivalric Commandments - New Edition
rogue_4_relic_legacy_175.description: Taking solemn vows is a thing of the past. The spirit of modern knighthood requires more flexible displays. Go ahead and input your number in the communications device, and you too will be an honorary knight.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_175.usage: For each 5 Originium Ingots in possession, all allied units have +5 ASPD

rogue_4_relic_legacy_176.name: Lucky Coin
rogue_4_relic_legacy_176.description: A coin picked up at Rhodes Island. If you find one, you're sure to be able to find many more.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_176.usage: Gain +2 Originium Ingots upon entering a non-combat node.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_177.name: Familiar Sculpture
rogue_4_relic_legacy_177.description: A familiar face but a different vibe. Perhaps you have met this person?

rogue_4_relic_legacy_178.name: 'Painful Happiness'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_178.description: Oripathy is spreading among the troupe members. Some collapsed, some broke out crying, some were overjoyed, and some turned their attention to writing. It was at such a time that the young man received his coming-of-age present. He will sing his very last song as an actor.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_178.usage: All enemy units have -15% HP and Movement Speed

rogue_4_relic_legacy_179.name: Convalescence Access Card
rogue_4_relic_legacy_179.description: A special service from the Convalescent Garden! Each Operator is entitled to one physiotherapy session from the Convalescent Garden before each of their field operations. Non-transferrable.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_179.usage: Operators gain +40 ASPD for 10 seconds after deployment

rogue_4_relic_legacy_180.name: Convalescence Premium Card
rogue_4_relic_legacy_180.description: A special collaboration between Convalescent Garden and the Medical Department! Each Operator receives a comprehensive physical and psychological assessment, plus a physiotherapy session. Afterwards, they can enjoy Podenco's homemade flower cakes.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_180.usage: Operators gain +70 ASPD for 10 seconds after deployment

rogue_4_relic_legacy_181.name: Old George's Nutri-Paste
rogue_4_relic_legacy_181.description: This poor-tasting fortified nutritional supplement was originally a 'dietary supplement' periodically provided to Columbian Pioneers, but after extensive marketing, it suddenly became a 'beauty product' beloved by nobles.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_181.usage: Operators gain ATK as their HP increases, up to +30% ATK at 100% HP
rogue_4_relic_legacy_181.unlockCondDesc: Select 'Improvisation Squad' and complete your adventure

rogue_4_relic_legacy_182.name: Emergency Stimulant
rogue_4_relic_legacy_182.description: An injection commonly used in Rim Billiton's local mines. Its strong active ingredient can stimulate the workers' senses and ensure their work efficiency in extreme environments. When life and their project both present their deadlines, sometimes the choice is simpler than one might think.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_182.usage: Operators gain ASPD as their HP decreases, up to +60 ASPD at 30% HP

rogue_4_relic_legacy_183.name: Leithanian Medal of Honor
rogue_4_relic_legacy_183.description: The twin empresses rarely do anything together, but conferring awards on those who create art is one such thing.

rogue_4_relic_legacy_184.name: HR Bronze Seal
rogue_4_relic_legacy_184.description: Emblem assigned to specific Operators when ■■■ receives an emergency deployment command. Your receipt of it signifies that ■■■ has completed the assignment.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_184.usage: Recruit a random 5-star Operator that is automatically Promoted

rogue_4_relic_legacy_185.name: Doctor Silver Seal
rogue_4_relic_legacy_185.description: Emblem that you instructed to be sent out at the right time before you left. Your selected Operator has joined the field mission at the camp, while handing it back to you the way you left it.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_185.usage: Recruit a random 6-star Operator that is automatically Promoted
rogue_4_relic_legacy_185.unlockCondDesc: Reach a Squad Size Limit of 13 at any point

rogue_4_relic_legacy_186.name: Timeworn Poetry Strips
rogue_4_relic_legacy_186.description: 'Drunk far beyond all mounts that list the realm, all beings take on souls as they demand.'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_186.usage: Summons have +30% HP, +30% ATK, and will no longer use Deployment slots

rogue_4_relic_legacy_187.name: Secret HR Letter
rogue_4_relic_legacy_187.description: '■■■ gave this to you? Guess there's no problem then.'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_187.usage: 6-star Operators cost -2 Hope to recruit, and every recruitment has a chance for all 6-star Operators to appear with a random promotion

rogue_4_relic_legacy_188.name: Rainbow Jar
rogue_4_relic_legacy_188.description: Usually placed by the Sami people where rainbows fall then carefully preserved, it is used to ward off unpredictable catastrophes, both natural and man-made.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_188.usage: Whenever an enemy enters the Objective Point, the Redeployment Time of a random Operator waiting to be re-deployed is reduced to 0

rogue_4_relic_legacy_189.name: 'Blossom'
rogue_4_relic_legacy_189.description: After several attempts by Touch, nature briefly opens up to you.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_189.usage: All Operators recover 1 SP every time they take damage or Elemental Injury
rogue_4_relic_legacy_189.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, obtain a total of 75 Collectibles after [Expansion II]

rogue_4_relic_legacy_190.name: Surging Feast
rogue_4_relic_legacy_190.description: We've known how to indulge since birth. Do not resist your desires. Submit to them instead.
rogue_4_relic_legacy_190.usage: All allied units receive +30% healing effectiveness and take -30% Elemental Injury

rogue_4_relic_fight_1.name: 'Bridge of Knowledge'
rogue_4_relic_fight_1.description: It is said you need only hold it, and its vibrations will lead you to the Liches' Temple of Knowledge. Is that really true? It stays silent. Those who fail to question it will indeed never reach those doors.
rogue_4_relic_fight_1.usage: Every Inspirer used grants all allied units +5% HP (Stacks up to 10 times)

rogue_4_relic_fight_2.name: 'Devilbane Banner'
rogue_4_relic_fight_2.description: Made by Sarkaz mercenaries loyal to Iberia, and used to kill Sarkaz mercenaries loyal to Leithanien. Many years later, Sarkaz mercenaries loyal to Victoria picked it up and gave it its name.
rogue_4_relic_fight_2.usage: Operators recover 2 SP when dealing damage to [Sarkaz] enemies
rogue_4_relic_fight_2.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader 'Kal'tsit' 2 times

rogue_4_relic_fight_3.name: Dawn of Literature
rogue_4_relic_fight_3.description: 'Aqqam Naqqun Sarqqam. That is 'Amnannam', the one and only curse, the uttering that kills even those who have yet to hear it. Now weep!'
rogue_4_relic_fight_3.usage: Deals 50% more physical and Arts damage to [Sarkaz] enemies

rogue_4_relic_fight_4.name: Mercenary's Accessory
rogue_4_relic_fight_4.description: A small price to pay for pursuing perfection. Small because it hasn't really affected his reading and writing.
rogue_4_relic_fight_4.usage: Grants a random Operator +5% ATK, DEF, and Max HP, plus an additional +5% after each perfectly cleared battle (Stacks up to 10 times)

rogue_4_relic_fight_5.name: Holy City's Embrace
rogue_4_relic_fight_5.description: 'O holy Kazdel! May you bless my bullets as you have blessed our eternal covenant; may you bridge my gun to my target just as you have bridged the Sankta and the Sarkaz!'

rogue_4_relic_fight_6.name: Children of the Walls
rogue_4_relic_fight_6.description: The Children of Soil and Stone carefully taught the ancient city of Kazdel how to toughen itself and protect its people behind its walls. With the advent of a protracted peace, it was broken into many little pieces and turned into amulets for adventurers heading into unexplored lands.
rogue_4_relic_fight_6.usage: Operators deployed on the 8 tiles surrounding the Objective Point gain +2 Block and +50% Max HP

rogue_4_relic_fight_7.name: King's Armor
rogue_4_relic_fight_7.description: There used to be many golden display cases placed before the palace gates and in the square, displaying all sorts of treasures to admire. But now, it hurts just to think about such sights.
rogue_4_relic_fight_7.usage: Shield +3; converts all Life Points into Shield; Life Point -1 and Shield +1 after each battle

rogue_4_relic_fight_8.name: King's Legacy
rogue_4_relic_fight_8.description: Grow up and face reality. Arm yourself with tenacity and confidence, while showing your friends tolerance and grace.
rogue_4_relic_fight_8.usage: When Life Point is at 1, all Operators recover an additional 1 SP and 3% of Max HP every 2 seconds

rogue_4_relic_fight_9.name: Personal Witchcraft Terminal
rogue_4_relic_fight_9.description: 'We use the name 'Teekaz witchcraft' to honor what our ancestors discovered during the uncivilized parts of our history. But today it has become a discipline permeating all of Terra, and our explorations and developments in this field are far from over.'
rogue_4_relic_fight_9.usage: All Operators have +35 ASPD if you used an Inspirer as the battle started

rogue_4_relic_fight_10.name: Primordial Vestige
rogue_4_relic_fight_10.description: The most significant change in these animals is the mutation they undergo after contracting Oripathy. Otherwise, their records have remained unchanged for countless years.
rogue_4_relic_fight_10.usage: All Operators DP Cost -6 if you did not use an Inspirer as the battle started

rogue_4_relic_fight_11.name: Disaster's Origin
rogue_4_relic_fight_11.description: The Sarkaz dug through the Targangils Prime Vein and Originium crystals spurted forth from Kazdel. Their fall was inevitable, so they wanted everything on this great land to be buried together with them.
rogue_4_relic_fight_11.usage: All enemies take +20% Arts damage and +100% Elemental Injury

rogue_4_relic_fight_12.name: Slave Hunter
rogue_4_relic_fight_12.description: After obtaining Nasti's designs, the Sarkaz put them to use in war right away. They flew into the sky, dominating the Ancients with waves of wrath, and the never-ending war entered a new stage.
rogue_4_relic_fight_12.usage: Units that become Levitated, Weightless, or are shifted will take 50% more damage for 10 seconds

rogue_4_relic_fight_13.name: Gravity Defying Machine
rogue_4_relic_fight_13.description: Nasti Lunorey's magnum opus lifted the Sarkaz from the land that had tormented them for thousands of years. Now, though they float in ethereal clouds, they remain firmly rooted in the sky.

rogue_4_relic_fight_14.name: Sarkaz King's Regal Rest
rogue_4_relic_fight_14.description: For those in this position, a peaceful sleep becomes eternal
rogue_4_relic_fight_14.usage: All Operators gain +20% DEF and +10 RES at full Life Points

rogue_4_relic_fight_15.name: Sarkaz King's Torn Banner
rogue_4_relic_fight_15.description: For those in this position, to struggle is to inevitably fall.
rogue_4_relic_fight_15.usage: All Operators gain +30 ASPD at full Life Points

rogue_4_relic_fight_16.name: 'Little Cube'
rogue_4_relic_fight_16.description: The Liches' vessel, capable of transcending time and space, proves even more durable in fantasies. Ermengarde spent a lot of time fixing it up.
rogue_4_relic_fight_16.usage: All Allied units gain +10% Max HP, and an additional +80% in Face-Off nodes

rogue_4_relic_fight_17.name: Halo
rogue_4_relic_fight_17.description: 'When I entered that door, my elder brother had already sprouted a halo and wings of light. As he turned around and greeted me, his words were like a key, freeing me from the suffering in my heart. And then, I responded aloud, the halo completely connected, and I received my revelation.'

rogue_4_relic_fight_18.name: Commander's Portrait
rogue_4_relic_fight_18.description: The portrait depicts a remarkable individual who made distrustful kings shake hands and soldiers who could not understand each other stand shoulder to shoulder. If she were alive today, Terra's unification might seem surprisingly plausible.
rogue_4_relic_fight_18.usage: All allied units gain +10% ATK and Max HP, and an additional +20% in Dreadful Foe nodes

rogue_4_relic_fight_19.name: Great Banshee's Veil
rogue_4_relic_fight_19.description: The former Lord of the Banshees always seemed amicable, as if that were her only side... until she pulled out her bone pen, sang softly, and impaled agonizing wails into the minds of every intruder.
rogue_4_relic_fight_19.usage: All enemies take +10% Arts damage and +50% Elemental Injury
rogue_4_relic_fight_19.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader 'Laqeramaline' 2 times

rogue_4_relic_fight_20.name: Fearless Blade
rogue_4_relic_fight_20.description: Before Kazdel's gates he stood, an impregnable bulwark. Gaulish artilleries, Leithanian casters, and Victorian Knights all took their shots at him. Yet, even when the gates fell and the coalition retreated, the Goliath did not yield an inch.
rogue_4_relic_fight_20.usage: When the battle begins, the Operator with the highest DP Cost gains +50% ATK and DEF
rogue_4_relic_fight_20.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader 'Goliath' 2 times

rogue_4_relic_fight_21.name: Soul Binding Bone
rogue_4_relic_fight_21.description: The elder revenant made a cage with his own bones to seal his kin within, and then tracked down his revenant kin scattered across the land in this tattered husk.
rogue_4_relic_fight_21.usage: For every Thought you have, all Operators gain +3% ATK

rogue_4_relic_fight_22.name: Soul Furnace's Fuel
rogue_4_relic_fight_22.description: The bones were thrown into the furnace, sending flames bursting forth. The revenants entangle into each other, transforming all their lament, fury, serenity, and shame into the energy that keeps Kazdel moving.
rogue_4_relic_fight_22.usage: For every Thought you have, all Operators gain +5% ATK

rogue_4_relic_fight_24.name: Clotheskaz
rogue_4_relic_fight_24.description: The Clotheskaz community thrives on the fierce competition among the creatures that wear them.
rogue_4_relic_fight_24.usage: Operators immediately obtain 30 SP after their skill ends for the first time

rogue_4_relic_fight_25.name: Unripe Yearning
rogue_4_relic_fight_25.description: These incomplete thoughts cling to their creators, zealously guarding them until they obtain their forms through a sudden revelation and embark on a long journey.
rogue_4_relic_fight_25.usage: For every Thought you have, all Operators gain +3% Max HP and DEF

rogue_4_relic_fight_26.name: Cursed Counterbeast
rogue_4_relic_fight_26.description: These bizarre beasts, born of falsehood, are drawn to fleeting flashes of odd thoughts. They devour wantonly, and when time shatters and paradoxes surge, they give birth to new cubs.
rogue_4_relic_fight_26.usage: All Operators gain +5 ASPD; consumes 1 Inspirer after each battle to grant an additional 5 ASPD (stacks up to 10 times)
rogue_4_relic_fight_26.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, clear a total of 30 battles after [Expansion II]

rogue_4_relic_fight_27.name: Visage of Crowned Fates
rogue_4_relic_fight_27.description: Each King bears a unique fate and form.
rogue_4_relic_fight_27.usage: Shield +3; converts all remaining max Life Points into an equivalent amount of Shield before reducing max Life Points to 1

rogue_4_relic_fight_28.name: King of Sarkaz's Vessel
rogue_4_relic_fight_28.description: For those in this position, prosperity is but an illusion.
rogue_4_relic_fight_28.usage: All Operators gain +80% Max HP when Life Points are full, increased to 200% if you have collected 3 or more King of Sarkaz's Collectibles

rogue_4_relic_fight_29.name: Expunger of Hatred
rogue_4_relic_fight_29.description: This weapon was forged by those unwilling to be blinded by hatred. It reveals a path: When the fear born of violence overpowers all hatred, then maybe, there exists a glimpse of the first light of peace.
rogue_4_relic_fight_29.usage: +5 Mental Toil; if Deathmatch is used in a perfect clear, obtain a Deathmatch after the battle

rogue_4_relic_fight_30.name: Wondrous Graffiti
rogue_4_relic_fight_30.description: The Liches often add a few more strokes to these pieces of 'street art'. According to them, it is mostly an economical way to bolster the city streets' defenses.
rogue_4_relic_fight_30.usage: Whenever an enemy enters the Objective Point, all Operators on field gain 20 SP
rogue_4_relic_fight_30.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, lose a total of 25 Life Points after [Expansion II]

rogue_4_relic_hand_1.name: Hand of Predation
rogue_4_relic_hand_1.usage: Pioneer, Charger, and Tactician Operators gain +10% ATK and DEF on every skill activation (Stacks up to 10 times); If you have Blunt Claws - Predation, also increases their SP regen rate by +0.5/s

rogue_4_relic_book_1.name: Blunt Claws - Predation
rogue_4_relic_book_1.description: The pack rumbles with hunger, waiting for a feast.
rogue_4_relic_book_1.usage: For every Vanguard Operator on the field, gain 1 DP every 3 seconds (Stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_4_relic_hand_2.name: Hand of Rending
rogue_4_relic_hand_2.usage: Reaper, Soloblade, and Fighter Operators ignore 70% of the target's DEF; If you have Bend Spears - Rending, they also recover 2.5% of Max HP per second

rogue_4_relic_book_2.name: Bend Spears - Rending
rogue_4_relic_book_2.description: Those with power can always help each other to success.
rogue_4_relic_book_2.usage: For every Guard Operator on the field, all allied units gain ATK +8% (Stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_4_relic_hand_3.name: Hand of Undulation
rogue_4_relic_hand_3.usage: Splash Caster, Chain Caster, and Mech-accord Caster Operators recover 2 SP each time they deal damage to an enemy unit; If you have Broken Wand - Undulation, they also gain +20 ASPD

rogue_4_relic_book_3.name: Broken Wand - Undulation
rogue_4_relic_book_3.description: Tuned to the same frequency; together we'll play the melody.
rogue_4_relic_book_3.usage: For every Caster Operator on the field, all allied units deal +12% Arts damage (Stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_4_relic_hand_4.name: Hand of Protraction
rogue_4_relic_hand_4.description: Protracted battles, a home of carnage.
rogue_4_relic_hand_4.usage: Ambusher, Merchant, and Geek Operators gain +25% ATK for every 30 seconds they remain on the battlefield (Stacks up to 5 times); If you have Rusted Blade - Protraction, maximum stack increases to 8

rogue_4_relic_book_4.name: Rusted Blade - Protraction
rogue_4_relic_book_4.description: If the host does not want guests, they'll never reach the door.
rogue_4_relic_book_4.usage: For every Specialist Operator on the field, all enemies have -5% Movement Speed (Stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_4_relic_hand_5.name: Hand of Mystery
rogue_4_relic_hand_5.usage: Core Caster, Primal Caster, and Ritualist Operators gain +0.5/s SP recovery rate whenever they use a skill (Stacks up to 4 times)

rogue_4_relic_book_5.name: Rusted Blade - Lone Force
rogue_4_relic_book_5.usage: When there are no allies in the surrounding 4 tiles of a Specialist operator, they gain +70% ATK

rogue_4_relic_hand_6.name: Hand of Rumble
rogue_4_relic_hand_6.description: Strikes land true, the earth trembles.
rogue_4_relic_hand_6.usage: Artilleryman, Phalanx Caster, and Flinger Operators gain +15% ATK for every time they deal damage to the same unit, up to 150%; this bonus will reset if no damage is dealt for 5 seconds

rogue_4_relic_book_6.name: Judgement: Guard
rogue_4_relic_book_6.description: Faced with the revenants' myriad mysteries, the Guards brandish their weapons and cut a path.
rogue_4_relic_book_6.usage: For every Bizarre Fragment Collectible owned, Guard Operators gain +20% ATK and +20 ASPD

rogue_4_relic_book_7.name: Judgement: Vanguard
rogue_4_relic_book_7.description: Faced with the revenants' myriad mysteries, the Vanguards take the lead and charge in.
rogue_4_relic_book_7.usage: For every Bizarre Fragment Collectible owned, Vanguard Operators gain +20% ATK and +30% Max HP

rogue_4_relic_book_8.name: Judgement: Defender
rogue_4_relic_book_8.description: Faced with the revenants' myriad mysteries, the Defenders prepare their defenses and steadily advance.
rogue_4_relic_book_8.usage: For every Bizarre Fragment Collectible owned, Defender Operators gain +20% DEF and +30% Max HP

rogue_4_relic_book_9.name: Judgement: Sniper
rogue_4_relic_book_9.description: Faced with the revenants' myriad mysteries, the Snipers adjust positions and unleash their firepower.
rogue_4_relic_book_9.usage: For every Bizarre Fragment Collectible owned, Sniper Operators gain +20% ATK and +20 ASPD

rogue_4_relic_book_10.name: Judgement: Specialist
rogue_4_relic_book_10.description: Faced with the revenants' myriad mysteries, the Specialists swiftly drop in on key targets.
rogue_4_relic_book_10.usage: For every Bizarre Fragment Collectible owned, Specialist Operators gain +20% ATK and +30% Max HP

rogue_4_relic_book_11.name: Judgement: Medic
rogue_4_relic_book_11.description: Faced with the revenants' myriad mysteries, the Medics treat the wounded and wait for the tides to shift.
rogue_4_relic_book_11.usage: For every Bizarre Fragment Collectible owned, Medic Operators gain +50% ATK

rogue_4_relic_book_12.name: Judgement: Caster
rogue_4_relic_book_12.description: Faced with the revenants' myriad mysteries, the Casters release their Arts to deconstruct them.
rogue_4_relic_book_12.usage: For every Bizarre Fragment Collectible owned, Caster Operators gain +20% ATK and +20 ASPD

rogue_4_relic_book_13.name: Judgement: Supporter
rogue_4_relic_book_13.description: Faced with the revenants' myriad mysteries, the Supporters break the mold and offer their unique ingenuity.
rogue_4_relic_book_13.usage: For every Bizarre Fragment Collectible owned, Supporter Operators gain +50% ATK

rogue_4_relic_hand_7.name: Hand of Fireworks
rogue_4_relic_hand_7.usage: Marksman, Loopshooter, and Sentry Protector Operators have a 25% chance on each attack to shoot an extra projectile, dealing 200% ATK as AoE Physical Damage

rogue_4_relic_res_1.name: Bag of Plans
rogue_4_relic_res_1.description: Ideas like 'build a bridge here', 'grow flowers there', or 'blow this wall open' are perfect for sitting inside bags so they can be easily retrieved when needed.

rogue_4_relic_res_2.name: Masterless Memories
rogue_4_relic_res_2.description: As the elder tossed them into the furnace, some revenants finally remembered where they came from and their duties, and remade their oaths to their faith. Others unleashed a sudden slew of curses, magnifying the echoes of flames reverberating on the furnace walls.
rogue_4_relic_res_2.usage: Immediately obtain 5 Thoughts at most left behind from your last adventure

rogue_4_relic_res_3.name: Herr Hraaselsuher
rogue_4_relic_res_3.description: Albrecht Von Musbeast, Graf of the Spire of Rosen und Horns, is at your service, pledging to bring you lost treasures and hidden wisdom! He asks only for an occasional share of the haul, saying they're for his wife and daughter.
rogue_4_relic_res_3.usage: Toil Limit +2 and chance to gain 1 Plan after combat

rogue_4_relic_res_4.name: Gift of Remembrance
rogue_4_relic_res_4.description: Water from the Convallis that never loses its shimmer, personally bottled by Laqeramaline Duqa Convalliss days after the miracle. The 'tear-weaving Convallis Hostess' happily gifted these vials to her dear ones.

rogue_4_relic_res_5.name: Cursed War Chronicles
rogue_4_relic_res_5.description: Hidden in the deepest corner of the library, this war chronicle ensnares hapless readers with its countless battles and campaigns, unraveling their minds as they resist. Eventually, the elder revenant tore out the rogue revenant in the book and sealed it in his bones.
rogue_4_relic_res_5.usage: Toil Limit +2; Toil Limit +1 after each perfectly cleared battle

rogue_4_relic_res_6.name: 'Song to Make A Tenacious Mind'
