rogue_4_relic_res_6.description: The song tells of a Djall born with the ability to sense fear. She was candid with what she sensed, but everyone was still wary. She later honed her skills to defeat foes without this power, yet remained known as the 'Arch-liar'.

rogue_4_relic_res_7.name: Anchor For Five Seconds Ago
rogue_4_relic_res_7.description: A young Lich was fretting over occasionally forgetting an idea he thought of five seconds ago, so he created this anchor to set those fleeting inspirations in place. Afterwards, he seemed to have forgotten to use it.
rogue_4_relic_res_7.usage: Gain 1 extra Inspirer after the battle if you used an Inspirer as the battle started

rogue_4_relic_res_8.name: Lost Key
rogue_4_relic_res_8.description: 'Fellas, this key can open the treasure trove lost within the royal city of Kazdel. Hey, green-haired Feline! Watch that hooded slave of yours and keep those hands away from my map!'
rogue_4_relic_res_8.usage: Gain +20% Command EXP from battles; obtain 50 Originium Ingots upon reaching Command Level 10
rogue_4_relic_res_8.unlockCondDesc: Consolidate 'Rogue Trader' nodes 4 times in Impression Restoration

rogue_4_relic_res_9.name: Nameless Totem
rogue_4_relic_res_9.description: This totem once stood at a crossroads, where those who approached would trample the vague outline of a revenant until their feet bled and they died from exhaustion. Eventually, the elder revenant shattered the token with a stomp and sealed the rogue revenant in his bones.
rogue_4_relic_res_9.unlockCondDesc: Consolidate 'False to Truth' nodes 2 times in Impression Restoration

rogue_4_relic_res_10.name: Revenant Remnant
rogue_4_relic_res_10.description: To be a wandering ghost without a body. This is the price some Sarkaz willingly paid to ensure the future of their race.
rogue_4_relic_res_10.usage: Hope +2, refresh count at each Node +1

rogue_4_relic_res_11.name: Magic Box
rogue_4_relic_res_11.description: This ordinary looking box devours souls, compelling those who see it to kill its owner and claim it. When all the humans had killed each other, animals became the new victims. Eventually, the elder revenant retrieved the box from a giant rockhorn's stomach and sealed the rogue revenant in his bones.

rogue_4_relic_res_12.name: Personal Paintbrush
rogue_4_relic_res_12.description: A haunted brush that compels its owners to paint with their own blood. The masterpiece mesmerizes beholders into adding another stroke the same way. Eventually, the elder revenant found the brush, along with many paintings, and sealed the rogue revenant in his bones.

rogue_4_relic_res_13.name: Half-Eaten Candy
rogue_4_relic_res_13.description: 'With every piece of candy I eat, I feel like I'm losing a part of my body. But I still want to eat more, and more... until that black shadow showed up and ripped away the monster inside me. But that hollow in my mind will never be filled.'

rogue_4_relic_res_14.name: Scales of Avarice
rogue_4_relic_res_14.description: Merchants offered money, treasure, and even their lives and souls, but couldn't balance the scales to obtain the feather-light glow. The elder revenant crushed the scales with his soul and sealed the rogue revenant in his bones.
rogue_4_relic_res_14.usage: Gain +3 Originium Ingots for each non-combat node entered when Total Mental Toil exceeds 20

rogue_4_relic_res_15.name: Word-Carving Knife
rogue_4_relic_res_15.description: Once the standard tool of Sarkaz stonemasons. It is said carving prayers on weeping spikes can calm the revenants' resentment. The knife is still sharp, but no one remembers the prayers.
rogue_4_relic_res_15.usage: <Spines of Epoch> and <Spikes of Weeping> have -50% DEF

rogue_4_relic_res_16.name: Thoughts Catcher
rogue_4_relic_res_16.description: Sorting truth from falsehood takes time, and some ideas will invariably scatter. In such moments, professionally trained retainers will snatch those ideas up and turn them into true wealth.
rogue_4_relic_res_16.unlockCondDesc: Consolidate 'False to Truth' nodes 4 times in Impression Restoration

rogue_4_relic_final_1.name: Pledge of Babel
rogue_4_relic_final_1.description: 'Babel' is directly led by two Kings of Sarkaz who have contributed greatly to the advancement of the military, technology, and medicine. Its initial, and also ultimate, goal is to eliminate war itself by any means necessary.
rogue_4_relic_final_1.usage: All Operators +3 DP Cost; leads expedition in a different direction

rogue_4_relic_final_2.name: Prophet Horn
rogue_4_relic_final_2.description: It was neither guns nor blades that conquered the Elders and Ancients, but the Law. Soon, the significance of the word 'teekaz' transcended race, and Kazdel became home to all life.
rogue_4_relic_final_2.usage: Nodes will turn into Prophecy when refreshed; not active in Bizarre Fragments

rogue_4_relic_final_3.name: Ten Rings
rogue_4_relic_final_3.description: Amiya hoped to change the land with her own power rather than relying on the King of Sarkaz. She refused their kindness and journeyed through Terra's nations with unmatched resilience and resolution, saving lives and calling for peace until Oripathy claimed her life.
rogue_4_relic_final_3.usage: Shadows of the Lord -50% Max HP

rogue_4_relic_final_4.name: Time and Light
rogue_4_relic_final_4.description: The first mad howl that awakened the Law.
rogue_4_relic_final_4.usage: Epochs will occur more often, and Thoughts have +1 Toil; leads expedition in a different direction

rogue_4_relic_final_5.name: Petal
rogue_4_relic_final_5.usage: -50% Command EXP and Originium Ingots from battles; triggers wondrous effects in Face-Off

rogue_4_relic_final_6.name: Anasa's Karma
rogue_4_relic_final_6.description: His nature has changed and his sword lies shattered, yet the crystals on his body are an eternal reminder that his spirit still needs honing.
rogue_4_relic_final_6.usage: Leader and Elite enemies have +50% max HP; Dreadful Foes in Border of Truth will be more difficult; leads expedition in a different direction

rogue_4_relic_final_7.name: Prophetic Image
rogue_4_relic_final_7.description: You must have heard this before: 'I see you, black crown on your head, melting millions of lives, into nothing but memories.'
rogue_4_relic_final_7.usage: Finale Cadence will appear in battles
rogue_4_relic_final_7.unlockCondDesc: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

rogue_4_relic_final_8.name: Framework of The End
rogue_4_relic_final_8.description: Catastrophes and war, as far as the eye can see. When help cannot stop death, when medical treatment becomes only an accomplice to hatred, Amiya carries on with the only option left: the futile, mechanical act of 'saving lives'.
rogue_4_relic_final_8.usage: All Operators have +2 DP Cost; all enemies take 20% less Physical and Arts damage
rogue_4_relic_final_8.unlockCondDesc: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

rogue_4_relic_final_9.name: Body of The End
rogue_4_relic_final_9.description: Amiya looks sadly at the person before her, sealed within the 'cocoon'. Frozen in place, they will no longer feel pain, nor will Originium cut their life short. She was unwilling to recklessly use her newly awakened powers, but now... there is no other choice.
rogue_4_relic_final_9.usage: All Operators have +2 DP Cost; all enemies take 20% less Physical and Arts damage and gain 20% ATK
rogue_4_relic_final_9.unlockCondDesc: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

rogue_4_relic_final_10.name: Reality of The End
rogue_4_relic_final_10.description: Everything has been sealed into the 'cocoon', and now time flows only for Amiya. She will seek a panacea for all afflictions—physical or mental, she wants to cure them all. An absolutely lonely and endlessly long journey stands before her. She has already set off.
rogue_4_relic_final_10.usage: All Operators have +2 DP Cost; all enemies take 20% less Physical and Arts damage and gain 20% ATK; extra enemies will appear in the last battle
rogue_4_relic_final_10.unlockCondDesc: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

rogue_4_relic_final_11.name: Endless Key
rogue_4_relic_final_11.description: Through your torrent of inspirations, a story takes shape from nothingness. Through your exhausted imagination, Amiya will put an end to everything. Can your thoughts become a weapon to resist her?
rogue_4_relic_final_11.usage: Leads expedition in a different direction
rogue_4_relic_final_11.unlockCondDesc: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

rogue_4_relic_encounter_1.name: Blood Tax Mystery
rogue_4_relic_encounter_1.description: 'Duq'arael ultimately failed. He stepped forward bravely, but did not manage to stop his brother Danso. The deep red chains then tethered all life on this land, so we now leave a trail of blood with every step we take. This blood tax is to repay the baseless debt we owe.'
rogue_4_relic_encounter_1.usage: All allied and enemy units have -35% Max HP; only active in Bizarre Fragments

rogue_4_relic_encounter_2.name: Crystal Mystery
rogue_4_relic_encounter_2.description: 'The Rotproofers' descendants, called 'Ice Gargoyles,' complemented the Diαblos with their icy powers and cool heads, skillfully covering each other's flaws. But they were deceived by Kalnawdika and never resurfaced after going underground to stop the Black Flow.'
rogue_4_relic_encounter_2.usage: All low ground Operators have +600 DEF but are Frozen for 15 seconds after deployment; only active in Bizarre Fragments

rogue_4_relic_encounter_3.name: Suspicion Mystery
rogue_4_relic_encounter_3.description: 'Duq'hraqaam openly questioned the Farchaser's caution towards the ruins and led his descendants underground. Prophecy foretold his demise by an 'ancient wound that refuses to heal' and that his descendants would call themselves 'Durin.' Their test tunnels would reach deep into the land's core, but no living soul would ever see them again.'
rogue_4_relic_encounter_3.usage: Earn double the Originium Ingots post battle, but also lose double the Life Points; only active in Bizarre Fragments

rogue_4_relic_encounter_4.name: Fabrication Mystery
rogue_4_relic_encounter_4.description: The 'Great Deceiver' once visited this Place of Possibility. She enriched the scenery with vivid tales, invited Sarkaz to hear ancient stories, and left puzzles revealing historical insights if solved. Yet, people insisted the Djall Arch-liar spoke only lies, leaving the Sarkaz convinced that what they heard was mere fabrications.
rogue_4_relic_encounter_4.usage: Starting DP +50, but natural DP regeneration rate is reduced by 50%; only active in Bizarre Fragments

rogue_4_relic_encounter_5.name: Foresight Mystery
rogue_4_relic_encounter_5.description: 'Lone eye, self-gouged; exile, a favor from the Liches. Mur'rannag endured this to prevent a future seen in visions. Since then, newborn Cyclopes started having two eyes like regular Sarkaz, but the prophecy was documented and would still come true.'
rogue_4_relic_encounter_5.usage: Gain +20% Command EXP from battles, extra enemies will appear in battle; only active in Bizarre Fragments

rogue_4_relic_encounter_6.name: Sigil Mystery
rogue_4_relic_encounter_6.description: 'With the sovereign's approval, the Northwind Witch Qalaiša taught the Nachzehrers how to draw energy from the Eternal Hunt's rigid laws. To Nezzsalem, that was the start of his subjects surpassing nature with reason. His decision exceeded everyone's expectations, and the Nachzehrers continue to revere him as their liege after becoming Nachzehrer Beschützers.'
rogue_4_relic_encounter_6.usage: All Operators gain +30 Starting SP, but natural SP recovery rate is reduced by 50%; only active in Bizarre Fragments

rogue_4_relic_encounter_7.name: Tranquil Mystery
rogue_4_relic_encounter_7.description: 'From the peak of Mount Anius to the heart of Lake Hyperion sit numerous monasteries of 'those without roots'. They work when their bells ring and rest otherwise. These bells seem to originate from the source of all things, and their rings resonate through eternity, beckoning all those seeking westward to turn back and ordering those sweeping eastward to lay down their arms. And thus, the nations of Victoria and Kazdel have enjoyed peace that lasts to this day.'
rogue_4_relic_encounter_7.usage: All allied and enemy units have -25% ATK, only effective in Bizarre Fragments

rogue_4_relic_encounter_8.name: Silk Bond Mystery
rogue_4_relic_encounter_8.description: 'Lich Bertha was obsessed with other kinds of Sarkaz since childhood. On the very next day that she became a 'First Scribe', she forced a witchcraft contract with a test subject animal to unlock its intelligence, creating the 'Slugkaz'. Her silk threads remain hidden, afraid to face the other Liches.'
rogue_4_relic_encounter_8.usage: Operators take continuous damage if other Operators are within the 8 surrounding tiles; otherwise, gain +50 ASPD; only active in Bizarre Fragments

rogue_4_relic_curse_1.name: Gul'dul's Silence
rogue_4_relic_curse_1.description: He stood at Kazdel's highest point and turned to stone. The Elder Hegemons retreated upon witnessing his black crown, while the Sarkaz rejoiced. This spectacle they named 'King of Sarkaz' endured for a long time—until the day the Sarkaz forgot their King, and pushed the statue down with their own hands.
rogue_4_relic_curse_1.usage: All enemies gain +3000 DEF, but lose 100 DEF upon taking damage (Stacks up to 30 times)

rogue_4_relic_curse_2.name: Qui'sartuštaj's Promise
rogue_4_relic_curse_2.description: With every changing generation, he promised his people and his carriers he would change the status quo for the Sarkaz. Within the layers of amassed hope and trust, he placed the crown on the ring-shaped structure, and knocked on the gates to the starry sky.
rogue_4_relic_curse_2.usage: All 5-star and above Operators cost +1 Hope to recruit and promote

rogue_4_relic_curse_3.name: Balor'sača's Arrogance
rogue_4_relic_curse_3.description: Lava obediently followed Balor'sača's army and spread across the land. They cared not for the Elder Hegemons, nor for their fellow Sarkaz. This land belongs to the Diαblo, and there is no need for others. As their King, Balor'sača absolutely cannot allow the crown to fall on the head of another.
rogue_4_relic_curse_3.usage: Elite and Leader enemies gain +20% HP, DEF, and ATK

rogue_4_relic_curse_4.name: Yliš's Ravings
rogue_4_relic_curse_4.description: Alas, the poor man. He could not comprehend the crown's power, and became a puppet. He was no longer his humble self, and lost the will to speak his own words. He became the first sacrifice to the crown's awakening.

rogue_4_relic_curse_5.name: Shard of the Untold Kings
rogue_4_relic_curse_5.description: A guardian of the Temple of Knowledge uses their Knot to unveil the mysteries of life, a crazy Sarkaz mercenary saddles a revenant to sow chaos, a vexing Beast Aristocrat establishes a commercial empire with the furnace, an ancient Feline wears the crown and subdues her own creator... Many stories remain folded within thoughts, waiting to be told.

rogue_4_relic_explore_1.name: Arch Glyph
rogue_4_relic_explore_1.description: Since antiquity, Kazdel has been concealed within the northern wind and snow. Led by the Cyclopes, the Sarkaz jointly created this Foldartal seal with their psychic powers. In a pinch, place it on ice and snow to hide within the Feranmut beneath your feet, evading the 'enemy'.
rogue_4_relic_explore_1.usage: For one time only, if you would fail any battle other than the final battle of the area or a Leader battle and are currently not in a Bizarre Fragment, you will enter a special Bizarre Fragment

rogue_4_relic_explore_2.name: Doodle of Hope
rogue_4_relic_explore_2.description: 'I'm a Teekaz orphan. My parents died in a Catastrophe, and it was my Feline neighbor who raised me and treated me as one of his own. I can say with a clear conscience that I am a descendant of the Ancients.'
rogue_4_relic_explore_2.usage: Hope +3; Emergency Ops will no longer appear when refreshing nodes; triggers wondrous effects in Encounter nodes

rogue_4_relic_explore_3.name: Talons of Hatred
rogue_4_relic_explore_3.description: 'A vampire killed my sister, a Nachzehrer took my papa, and mama escaped with me. I'll never compromise with the Sarkaz. They can repent when they're all gone.'
rogue_4_relic_explore_3.usage: All allied units and enemies have +20% ATK; Emergency Ops will appear more often when refreshing nodes; triggers wondrous effects in Encounter nodes

rogue_4_relic_explore_4.name: Hibernating Kin
rogue_4_relic_explore_4.description: Lost in the silver mountain range, the Sarkaz hibernated for self-preservation. It slept so long it nearly lost itself, until its fated kin awoke it. Now, it will follow his path.
rogue_4_relic_explore_4.usage: Hope +5, obtain an extra Collectible when this Collectible is exchanged in Lost and Found

rogue_4_relic_explore_5.name: Burdenherd Bell
rogue_4_relic_explore_5.description: Whip it, and it will flee in terror; Pull on the reins, and it will resist. Ring the bell, hum a tune, and it will follow you to the ends of the land.
rogue_4_relic_explore_5.usage: Burdenbeast Traveler joins your squad; gains an additional choice when loot drops from a Wish Fulfilled node

rogue_4_relic_explore_6.name: Lamp of Wishes
rogue_4_relic_explore_6.description: 'I heard the Sarkaz can grant any wish, so I dug deep to find their secrets. It seems this was the start of their suffering.'
rogue_4_relic_explore_6.usage: Originium Ingots +10, Wish Fulfilled will appear more often when refreshing nodes; triggers wondrous effects in Wish Fulfilled

rogue_4_relic_explore_7.name: Rolling Ancestors
rogue_4_relic_explore_7.description: Oh great, the ancestors are here, and they want something more exciting...
rogue_4_relic_explore_7.usage: All enemy units have ASPD +30, Movement Speed +30%, and Max HP +30%; can encounter a different Dreadful Foe in Border of Truth

rogue_4_relic_explore_8.name: Rhoder's Gate
rogue_4_relic_explore_8.description: This remodeled Portal binds two stories together, with the other end being Rhozdel—a safe haven for both Sarkaz and Infected.
rogue_4_relic_explore_8.usage: Immediately recruit multiple Reserve Operators; at the end of each combat, the last deployed Operator will be sent to a Scout node

rogue_4_relic_explore_9.name: Baby Djall
rogue_4_relic_explore_9.description: 'Oh, my little cutie-pie! Enough tickling my head, alright?'
rogue_4_relic_explore_9.usage: +3 Hope, obtain an extra +8 Hope when this Collectible is exchanged in Lost and Found
rogue_4_relic_explore_9.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, earn a total of 50 Hope after [Expansion II]

rogue_4_relic_explore_10.name: Eye of Fortune
rogue_4_relic_explore_10.description: A millennium after the Sarkaz vanished, the saying 'the eye of a Cyclops opens for wealth' became folklore. People began worshipping discs with a single embedded eye, seeking wealth and happiness.
rogue_4_relic_explore_10.usage: Originium Ingots +5, Operators dispatched in Scout nodes will return with 5 extra Ingots
rogue_4_relic_explore_10.unlockCondDesc: Across all adventures, earn a total of 150 Originium Ingots after [Expansion II]

rogue_4_fragment_D_01.name: Pure-White Petals
rogue_4_fragment_D_01.usage: Interpret together with Wordless Deed to obtain Pledge of Babel

rogue_4_fragment_D_02.name: Wordless Deed
rogue_4_fragment_D_02.usage: Interpret together with Pure-White Petals to obtain Pledge of Babel

rogue_4_fragment_D_03.name: Daybreak Sun
rogue_4_fragment_D_03.description: 'If you always leave early and return late, you'll never have time to enjoy the sun.'
rogue_4_fragment_D_03.usage: Rarity +1 when you carry this Lingerer onto a new floor. More likely to obtain a Collectible when interpreted

rogue_4_fragment_D_04.name: Wild Grass by the Door
rogue_4_fragment_D_04.description: 'They say I'm like grass. I want to see what grass looks like.'
rogue_4_fragment_D_04.usage: Rarity randomly shuffles when you carry this Lingerer onto a new floor. More likely to obtain a Collectible when interpreted

rogue_4_fragment_D_05.name: Memorial Stones
rogue_4_fragment_D_05.description: 'I should have gone up that tower, but I fell before its feet.'
rogue_4_fragment_D_05.usage: Rarity +2 when you carry this Lingerer onto a new floor. More likely to obtain a Collectible when interpreted

rogue_4_fragment_D_06.name: Nemesis Blood
rogue_4_fragment_D_06.description: 'It's not because I hate him, but because he ought to die.'
rogue_4_fragment_D_06.usage: Toil -1 when you carry this Lingerer onto a new floor. More likely to obtain a Collectible when interpreted

rogue_4_fragment_D_07.name: Home's Dust
rogue_4_fragment_D_07.description: 'What did these two words originally mean? Which one of them means 'home'?'
rogue_4_fragment_D_07.usage: Returns to you on the next floor if lost. More likely to obtain a Collectible when interpreted

rogue_4_fragment_D_08.name: Shrivel and Sprout
rogue_4_fragment_D_08.description: 'You're telling me only now that I have a child?'
rogue_4_fragment_D_08.usage: Obtains an additional copy of this Lingerer when brought to a new floor. More likely to obtain a Collectible when interpreted

rogue_4_fragment_D_09.name: Lead Tag
rogue_4_fragment_D_09.description: 'Knock on the door for me. If someone's willing to open, tell them I'm gone.'
rogue_4_fragment_D_09.usage: Originium Ingots +3 upon losing this Lingerer. Triggers a special effect in Safe House. More likely to obtain a Collectible when interpreted

rogue_4_fragment_D_10.name: Cheerful Banter
rogue_4_fragment_D_10.description: 'Cheer up, I'm about to write off the sum you owe me.'
rogue_4_fragment_D_10.usage: A simple wish. More likely to obtain a Collectible when interpreted

rogue_4_fragment_D_11.name: Pots In The Ground
rogue_4_fragment_D_11.description: 'How will they eat now that I'm like this... sigh.'
rogue_4_fragment_D_11.usage: A simple wish. More likely to obtain a Collectible when interpreted

rogue_4_fragment_D_12.name: Walled Gold
rogue_4_fragment_D_12.description: 'I just hope they're smart enough to not exchange my gold for those paper scraps.'
rogue_4_fragment_D_12.usage: A simple wish. More likely to obtain a Collectible when interpreted

rogue_4_fragment_D_13.name: Stored Instruments
rogue_4_fragment_D_13.description: 'Forget it, I'm sure they won't mess up with our ancestors watching over us.'
rogue_4_fragment_D_13.usage: A simple wish. More likely to obtain a Collectible when interpreted

rogue_4_fragment_D_14.name: Empty Thoughts
rogue_4_fragment_D_14.usage: A simple wish. More likely to obtain a Collectible when interpreted

rogue_4_fragment_D_15.name: Nonsensical Ravings
rogue_4_fragment_D_15.usage: A simple wish. More likely to obtain a Collectible when interpreted

rogue_4_fragment_D_16.name: Speechless
rogue_4_fragment_D_16.usage: A simple wish. More likely to obtain a Collectible when interpreted

rogue_4_fragment_D_17.name: Sprouting Stem
rogue_4_fragment_D_17.description: 'Spear's heavy, can't lift it. Take it away already, but don't forget to take off the tip.'
rogue_4_fragment_D_17.usage: A simple wish. More likely to obtain a Collectible when interpreted

rogue_4_fragment_D_18.name: Knotted Rope
rogue_4_fragment_D_18.description: 'When I pull the knot, a year will have passed. Shame I won't be there to see it.'
rogue_4_fragment_D_18.usage: When you carry this Lingerer, Epochs will occur more often

rogue_4_fragment_D_19.name: Elder's Crown
rogue_4_fragment_D_19.description: 'I was there your grandfather's whole life, and now it's your turn. Look after your people.'
rogue_4_fragment_D_19.usage: Can be interpreted with Inspirers to become an Inspirer of higher rarity

rogue_4_fragment_D_20.name: Despair
rogue_4_fragment_D_20.description: 'You'll definitely live, p-please believe in this... sob...'
rogue_4_fragment_D_20.usage:
Interpret with a Plan to obtain Salvation
Can be used in Encounter: All or Nothing
rogue_4_fragment_D_20.unlockCondDesc: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

rogue_4_fragment_D_21.name: Salvation
rogue_4_fragment_D_21.description: 'Sleep here for a bit. When we find a cure for Oripathy, you'll be able to wake up healthy.'
rogue_4_fragment_D_21.usage:
Interpret with a Plan to obtain Stasis
Can be used in Encounter: All or Nothing
rogue_4_fragment_D_21.unlockCondDesc: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

rogue_4_fragment_D_22.name: Stasis
rogue_4_fragment_D_22.description: 'When all of you wake up, there will be no more suffering. Until that day arrives, I will bear the pain alone.'
rogue_4_fragment_D_22.usage: Can be used in Encounter: All or Nothing
rogue_4_fragment_D_22.unlockCondDesc: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

rogue_4_fragment_F_01.name: Wall
rogue_4_fragment_F_01.description: 'Remember how to stack these rocks. When they're busy tearing them down, you can run for it.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_01.usage: When used: In the next battle, all allied units gain 1 Shield when deployed

rogue_4_fragment_F_02.name: Flames
rogue_4_fragment_F_02.description: 'Ha, that won't happen. We have nothing to start a fire with.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_02.usage: When used: In the next battle, all allied units have +35 ASPD

rogue_4_fragment_F_03.name: Relocation
rogue_4_fragment_F_03.description: 'Once the Royal Courts finish casting their Arts, just run the same old way. Outsiders won't be able to find us.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_03.usage: When used: In the next battle, ranged Operators gain Camouflage

rogue_4_fragment_F_04.name: Oathbreak
rogue_4_fragment_F_04.description: 'I already told them that I'd open the gates. Come in, and kill us all.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_04.usage: When used: In the next battle, melee Operators gain ASPD +50 for 5 seconds after taking damage

rogue_4_fragment_F_05.name: March
rogue_4_fragment_F_05.description: 'Come on, walk faster. It's a long journey, and death is waiting.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_05.usage: When used: In the next battle, all allied units have +2 push/pull strength

rogue_4_fragment_F_06.name: Lost
rogue_4_fragment_F_06.description: 'If the old won't go, the new won't come! We've been wanting to build a new one anyway.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_06.usage: When used: After the next battle, gain 1 additional Inspirer

rogue_4_fragment_F_07.name: Excavate
rogue_4_fragment_F_07.description: 'Everyone's gone. Quick, come with me and see if there's anything useful left behind.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_07.usage: When used: In the next battle, all allied units have +1 push/pull strength

rogue_4_fragment_F_08.name: Witchcraft
rogue_4_fragment_F_08.description: 'Then, the ancestors entered that silver door, and it's got everything you want.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_08.usage: When used: In the next battle, summon a 'Portal'

rogue_4_fragment_F_09.name: Initiate
rogue_4_fragment_F_09.description: 'I was a student in Kazdel then, studying comparative literature.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_09.usage: When used: In the next battle, Deployment Limit +1

rogue_4_fragment_F_10.name: Consume
rogue_4_fragment_F_10.description: 'We started out farming, and lived on the support layers while the sun was reserved for crops.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_10.usage: When used: In the next battle, all allied units have +15% Max HP

rogue_4_fragment_F_11.name: Reclaim
rogue_4_fragment_F_11.description: 'Later, Her Highness fixed up hydroponic equipment, and then we competed with crops for land.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_11.usage: When used: In the next battle, all allied units have +30% Max HP

rogue_4_fragment_F_12.name: Pillage
rogue_4_fragment_F_12.description: 'What else can we do? Rob them. The Feline, the Caprinae. They rob us back too.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_12.usage: When used: In the next battle, all allied units have +10% ATK

rogue_4_fragment_F_13.name: Invasion
rogue_4_fragment_F_13.description: 'The Sarkaz will 'conquer'. What's that? Go to their land, take their things, and stay.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_13.usage: When used: In the next battle, all allied units have +20% ATK

rogue_4_fragment_F_14.name: Rise and Fall
rogue_4_fragment_F_14.description: 'I'm planning to leave the city to make a living.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_14.usage: When used: In the next battle, all allied units gain +30% ATK and +50% Max HP

rogue_4_fragment_F_15.name: Words
rogue_4_fragment_F_15.description: 'Register here. Where are you from? Can you speak Sarkaz? Can you write?'
rogue_4_fragment_F_15.usage: When used: In the next battle, gain +25% Command EXP

rogue_4_fragment_F_16.name: Assembly
rogue_4_fragment_F_16.description: 'We won't be making deliveries to the frontline? Then... will you still look after us?'
rogue_4_fragment_F_16.usage: When used: In the next battle, gain +50% Command EXP

rogue_4_fragment_F_17.name: Catastrophe
rogue_4_fragment_F_17.description: 'What will come is inevitable. The higher ups think it's pointless to drive the city away.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_17.usage: When used: In the next battle, gain +50% Originium Ingot drops

rogue_4_fragment_F_18.name: Furnace
rogue_4_fragment_F_18.description: 'Basically, the best part of staying in the city is that you won't get cold.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_18.usage: When used: In the next battle, gain +100% Originium Ingot drops

rogue_4_fragment_F_19.name: Outblood
rogue_4_fragment_F_19.description: 'You don't have to remember who has what ears, they'll always recognize you as a Sarkaz.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_19.usage: When used: In the next battle, all allied units have +15 ASPD

rogue_4_fragment_F_20.name: City Driving
rogue_4_fragment_F_20.description: 'Remember: never go faster than 5 klicks per hour, or it'll take another decade to fix.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_20.usage: When used: In the next battle, all allied units have Redeployment Time -20%

rogue_4_fragment_F_21.name: Mercenary
rogue_4_fragment_F_21.description: 'Some fight to feed themselves, and some fight to feed their families.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_21.usage: When used: In the next battle, all allied units have -2 DP Cost

rogue_4_fragment_F_22.name: Civil War
rogue_4_fragment_F_22.description: 'Some say it's finally over, but others say it will never end.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_22.usage: When used: In the next battle, all allied units have -3 DP Cost

rogue_4_fragment_F_23.name: Respite
rogue_4_fragment_F_23.description: 'Take a break while you can. When the cannons start firing, you won't have time for one.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_23.usage: When used: In the next battle, all allied units recover 2% of their Max HP every second after deployment for 20s

rogue_4_fragment_F_24.name: Slumber
rogue_4_fragment_F_24.description: 'I've been worked to the bone my whole life, but now I can finally get a good night's sleep. You guys go ahead and chat; it won't wake me up.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_24.usage: When used: In the next battle, all allied units recover 5% of their Max HP every second after deployment for 20s

rogue_4_fragment_F_25.name: Demolition
rogue_4_fragment_F_25.description: 'If it's too big to carry, blow it up. The bits will still fetch a decent price.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_25.usage: When used: In the next battle, <Spines of Epoch> have 50% less Max HP

rogue_4_fragment_F_26.name: Deathmatch
rogue_4_fragment_F_26.description: 'Kill you, and I get to live another day. What's so hard to understand?'
rogue_4_fragment_F_26.usage: When used: In the next battle, 3 random Operators gain ASPD +100, DEF +50%, RES +25

rogue_4_fragment_F_27.name: Machine
rogue_4_fragment_F_27.description: 'Press the button, cobble together whatever garbage shoots out, and there you go, you're an inventor.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_27.usage: When used: In the next battle, summon 1 Lost Hovercraft

rogue_4_fragment_F_28.name: Industry
rogue_4_fragment_F_28.description: 'These smuggled machines can make kitchenware, musical instruments... With a bit of tinkering, they can all be used in battle.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_28.usage: When used: In the next battle, summon 3 Lost Hovercrafts

rogue_4_fragment_F_29.name: Grand Wish
rogue_4_fragment_F_29.description: 'The ancestors walk into the portal and stand before the window. The land outside is blank, waiting to be filled by their imaginations.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_29.usage: When used: In the next battle, summon a 'Window'

rogue_4_fragment_F_30.name: Envenom
rogue_4_fragment_F_30.description: 'Remember what you laced your weapons with—don't want to screw yourself over later.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_30.usage: When used: In the next battle, all allied Operators deal an additional 5% of damage dealt as Necrosis

rogue_4_fragment_F_31.name: Torment
rogue_4_fragment_F_31.description: 'That's how those overseers are. The more you yell, the harder they work you.'
rogue_4_fragment_F_31.usage: When used: In the next battle, enemies under the effects of Stun, Frozen, Frighten, or Fear take 200 Necrosis every second

rogue_4_fragment_I_1.name: Plans
rogue_4_fragment_I_1.description: 'Remember it well. You'll have to use it one day.'
rogue_4_fragment_I_1.usage: Can be used in Impression Restoration to alter a node or carve a new path

rogue_4_relic_fight_23.name: Survivor Contract
rogue_4_relic_fight_23.description: A very long contract, in which every term and condition is the result of experience, leaving no room for chance or sentiment. Satisfy them all to be the final survivor.
rogue_4_relic_fight_23.usage: At the start of battle, a random Operator gains +20% ATK and DEF, plus an additional +20% at the end of each battle

constData.seedModeIntro:
Seeds are parameters used to generate random content in Integrated Strategies, affecting things such as the map and collectibles. Using the same seed allows you to generate expeditions with consistent content.
Using a seed will disable the unlocking of higher difficulties, medals, and ending badges.
constData.seedModeConfirmReplacement: There is an active seed in use. Are you sure you want to replace it?
constData.officialUseSucceededTextHint: Successfully set seed. You can now begin exploring.
constData.seedModeLockedTextHint: Complete a [Regular Operation] expedition to unlock seeds

grandPrizes.displayDiscription:
Supporter Operator Raidian, the hub of information, the most precise equipment, the most attentive care.
She senses the path that belongs to her, in a future of electrical signals.

grandPrizes.acquireTitle: Top Operator Skill Training Pack Obtainable
grandPrizes.displayDiscription: Comprehensive record of expert techniques that allows Operators to quickly accumulate experience and become experts themselves.

grandPrizes.displayName: Fantasies of the Garden Furniture Pack I
grandPrizes.displayDiscription:
Everything in the Garden of Grotesqueries is a view, from the sights to the people.
The eye takes in the view, but it is the heart that creates it.
Every sight is a fragment of memory, an echo of the past.
'Climb the tower and feel the breeze. Lean against the railing and see the fowlbeasts off.'
When there is a wisp of sunset in the heart, all heaven and earth shall burn red.

Lava gave the tailor a reference image of a Yanese wandering warrior and said nothing more, as if communicating her stance was all that mattered.
She demands of herself the essence of wuxia, in thought and in action.

grandPrizes.displayName: Fantasies of the Garden Furniture Pack II
grandPrizes.displayDiscription:
Everything in the Garden of Grotesqueries is a view, from the sights to the people.
The eye takes in the view, but it is the heart that creates it.
Every sight is a fragment of memory, an echo of the past.
'Go into the pavilion and welcome the rising sun. Leave the balcony and pick warm scents.'

The integration of data content is the essence of systems engineering.
It can improve the abilities of operators, or assist in adjusting their combat methods.
Are you already starting to think about how to put this to use?
Or will you keep it in your back pocket, saving it for a more suitable opportunity?
A jade table, a stone screen, and a few accessories form this Sui Proxy gift.

The emotions of humans are passed on to their objects.
Gaze upon an object, and you catch a glimpse of its owner.
Meetings and partings, all are the tidings of fate.
Objects choose their own master too.
The one who etched the words is nowhere to be seen by the pond and trees. Parting is dearly felt only when the dew falls from the leaves.
No one knows when meetings and partings might occur, but the flowers bloom and wilt to their appointed time. The candleholders asks the flowers why, and they reply: 'We don't know either!'

chatItemList.chatDesc: The 'mountain' conquered with blood.
He can only hope there will be less sacrifices needed.
The tribulation of yesterday is the answer of today.
Sometimes, it is not a matter of principle as to whether to seek help from others or from oneself.
Just an intense game that went until late at night, nothing worth the attention of others.
Whose head is the ascended immortal touching?
Now it falls upon the page.
The you in the painting is the me.
Her fancy is spent.
From sweetness and sorrow is wine brewed, for joy and anger man already knows.
Men only speak of the new waves of later generations surging forward, far and wide, but they do not see the earlier waves of generations past, refusing to stop dreaming of the sea.
Raise your cup to the heavens, for a century of drunkenness.
In the desert, new buds bloom.
Cracks in the walls, yet they hold strong.
'Experience' is not only found on the battlefield.
Plant her into the soil.
How could life's growth stop at its fading?
The snow has melted, and its waters nourish the soil.
Fame
Profit
Truth
Lock of Lungmen
Unending Sea
The Heart Wills, The Sword Acts

detailConst.copySeedModeInfo: {0}#Copy and paste this string to the Sui's Garden of Grotesqueries seed to start a preset run

ro5_n_1_1.name: Whack-A-Mus
ro5_n_1_1.description: Legend says the musbeasts of the Garden of Grotesqueries love to nibble on ancient tomes of poetry. Visitors who recite sordid poems or vulgar words will hear jeering chitters from the shadows, and chase after them to hidden burrows, ultimately provoking furious battles.

ro5_n_1_2.name: To Market
ro5_n_1_2.description: Occasionally, a group of people will line up in squares in an empty space. When asked, they say: 'We're going to market.' With the strike of a gong, they head off on a tottering march, destroying all that blocks the way. A startling sight for onlookers.

ro5_n_1_3.name: Serious Business
ro5_n_1_3.description:
You can't defend a business with only your mouth. But it does seem like Big Bob has misunderstood why you've come to his shop.
<@rolv.rem><Defensive Barricades> are present on the field that Block enemies</>

ro5_n_1_4.name: Veteran Actor
ro5_n_1_4.description: You are cordially invited to watch the play, but the theater is deserted. There is a sudden burst of song from the shoddy stage as if urging you to stay, making the scene stranger than it already is.

ro5_n_1_5.name: Pest Control
ro5_n_1_5.description: In the Garden of Grotesqueries, pest control is generally done by the crops themselves. In their minds, if you are not a farmer, then you are a pest.

ro5_n_1_6.name: Ticket Please
ro5_n_1_6.description: It seems that the hubbub when the Garden opens has made its mark on the entrance, to the point that when it closes, naive geists are all too eager to imitate the tourists crowding into the gate to get their tickets inspected.

ro5_n_2_1.name: Learning for All
ro5_n_2_1.description: At the renovation site, the workers are eagerly listening to a lesson taught by a 'Tianshi'. 'Uneducated men are no different from geists!' As you pass by, you are pulled into the 'classroom' by the strict 'Tianshi'.

ro5_n_2_2.name: Look Out Above
ro5_n_2_2.description:
Flying Oxmanes and fleeing Hornbeasts are causing a ruckus in the Garden. Where did the throwing device that started it all come from? A geist tinkerer pats the sawdust off his body in a corner of the garden, leaving in satisfaction.
<@lv.item><Saltheap Cannon></> Periodically fires a shell forward, dealing Physical splash damage; can launch a nearby ground enemy of 3 Weight or less to the center of the explosion

ro5_n_2_3.name: Guardian of Justice
ro5_n_2_3.description:
The wandering warrior has been awaiting this match for over a decade, until a young child comes over: 'You can stop waiting now, that guy died ten years ago. Look, I've been looking for you so long, I'm big now.' Once done speaking, the child disappears, leaving behind only a saber on the ground.
<@rolv.rem><Gramophones> that deal Arts damage to enemies and heal allies when captured are present on the field</>

ro5_n_2_4.name: Daylight Robbery
ro5_n_2_4.description: 'Jianghu rules: if you beat the two of us, you'll keep all the belongings.' The twin bandits are beacons of righteousness, trying to cover for their comrades as they sneak away.

ro5_n_2_5.name: Rescue Mission
ro5_n_2_5.description:
There will always be some tourists who decide they don't want to leave yet when the Garden closes. Not only do you have to see them out, you also need to resolve whatever chaos they caused.
<@lv.item><Static Roadblock></> Blocks the movement of Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter; Can be destroyed by allied units.
<@lv.item><Ursus Civilian></> Depletes a Life Point when killed by an enemy.

ro5_n_2_6.name: Toy Soldiers
ro5_n_2_6.description: Once, a foreign guest left behind a set of action figures in the Garden. Now, they have made a place for themselves here.

ro5_n_3_1.name: Hook, Line, and Sinker
ro5_n_3_1.description: Only in the Garden of Grotesqueries can you see these extinct Pseudomuts. Enticed into the Garden by their rapacious appetite, they have not had to worry about food or drink for many years since. Both Yi and the Pseudomuts believe they have the favorable side of the arrangement.

ro5_n_3_2.name: Stopping the Advance
ro5_n_3_2.description: There's barely any space here to turn your head, let alone your body. Beasts intent on chasing their tails have no choice but to keep running forward, smashing everything in their path. The Statuegeists watching from the sidelines chortle as they pass.

ro5_n_3_3.name: Feng Shui
ro5_n_3_3.description:
The geists are alarmed, and they scatter all over the place. Have a closer look. I'll get straight to the point, the road's so curved, not even Originium slugs can stand it! Do some rearranging to get the feng shui right for them.
<@rolv.rem><Roadblocks> that can block the enemy's route can be deployed</>

ro5_n_3_4.name: Away, Hui!
ro5_n_3_4.description:
Garden rules state that at the start of every month, fire will be used to 'drive away the darkness of Hui'. As for what is being burned as fuel, best not ask.
<@rolv.rem>This stage has <Rubble> that can block the enemy's path</>.

ro5_n_3_5.name: Return to Your Roots
ro5_n_3_5.description:
Time flows, the land changes, and cities of steel rise. Their hometowns are long gone, but they are always looking out for a way back home.
<@lv.item><Shield and Wall></> Blocks the vision of your units

ro5_n_3_6.name: Repel the Outsiders
ro5_n_3_6.description: Many people will spend their entire lives never having left their homeland, but they will, and they will put their all into doing so.

ro5_n_4_1.name: Shanhaizhong Scramble
ro5_n_4_1.description:
'Of the eight 'Do Nots', the Shanhaizhong intruding in the Garden have violated four of them, so the roads they walk and the searches they perform are all fruitless as the geists 'teach them the rules'. Give them a hand before you hand them over to the Sui Regulator.
<@rolv.rem><Defensive Barricades> are present on the field that Block enemies</>

ro5_n_4_2.name: Sugared Bait
ro5_n_4_2.description: After trying to feed the fins in the pond, some tourists were knocked eight zhang away! In order to satisfy those fins, they learned from their mistakes and reflected on the past... deciding to do all they can to develop bigger, sweeter bait. <@rolv.rem><'Gelato Stops'> are present on the field that restore allied SP when captured <@rolv.rem> are present on the field that Block enemies

ro5_n_4_3.name: Cultured
ro5_n_4_3.description: You see that the Seaborn here are daubing paint, letting you breathe a sigh of relief. Then you see, painted on the wall, a 'sea with plenty of'—scrawled, teeming, and diverse 'fins'.

ro5_n_4_4.name: Take the Stage
ro5_n_4_4.description: Even though this is no longer an age when many watch plays, they still stubbornly cling to the idea that they have parts to play upon the stage. Some geists are trapped in the past, much like humanity.

ro5_n_4_5.name: Exemplary Service
ro5_n_4_5.description:
An armor-clad eccentric sleeps atop the mount, unmoving for over a decade. As you pass them, you suddenly sense yellow sands fill the air, and when you open your eyes, you find yourself before a city gate of steel. Soldiers line the walls while battle drums shake the heavens. Glory days of past service can be both a dream, and a cage.
<@rolv.rem><Defensive Barricades> are present on the field that Block enemies</>

ro5_n_4_6.name: Beware the Shadows
ro5_n_4_6.description: Two roads, one on either side, both with 'safety instructions'. The obvious dangers mentioned seem easy to guard against, but one line is worrying: Beware the ■■■■ in the shadows. The text is smudged, and hard to read.

ro5_n_4_7.name: Let It All Out
ro5_n_4_7.description: Yi has some regrets about letting the geists read the Higashinese novels in his collection. The geists playing ninja had only just scratched the surface of the culture before going on a rampage, causing much more of an uproar than those noisy musicians.

ro5_n_5_1.name: Green Hills Speak Not
ro5_n_5_1.description: 'You're sitting on me.' There don't seem to be any of Yi's relics here, but there are plenty of rocks. It is a good time to rest. 'I said, you're sitting on me!' The voice rings out again. You look all around you to find it, until the boulder under you rises into your field of view.

ro5_n_5_2.name: Departing Inspection
ro5_n_5_2.description: The Sui Regulator performs additional inspections on visitors leaving forbidden areas, to ensure you are still you, and all that leaves is you.

ro5_n_5_3.name: A Humble Gift
ro5_n_5_3.description: A younger brother receiving goods from his older brother is naturally not an issue. However, since one is named Yi and the other Ji, the Candleholders never lack reasons to inspect things being sent up the mountain.

ro5_n_5_4.name: Muted Past
ro5_n_5_4.description: Yi was given a worn-out guitar that couldn't produce a single note, but in his hands, it was able to play the most basic of tunes. The Sarkaz, wanting to snatch back this melody, chased him all the way back to the Garden from the west.

ro5_n_5_5.name: Mangshan Town Records
ro5_n_5_5.description: 'A horde of wares... awakened... attacked us in the streets... disaster... destruction...' The rest is hidden below an old, dark-red stain, unable to be read clearly.

ro5_n_5_6.name: Unlit Sparks
ro5_n_5_6.description:
Here lie abominations born of the food and drink people discard. Yi did not gather them for his collection. If Vapidities can become Sapidities, then there is the possibility they can yet bloom with flavor.
<@lv.item><Stove></> Summons 'Sapid Auspice' to deal True damage to all enemies in its path.
<@lv.item><Derelict Stove></> Summons 'Vapid Blight' to deal True damage to all allied units in its path.

ro5_n_5_7.name: Honed Edge
ro5_n_5_7.description: Through conservation treatments, items in the collection show their true worth. These particular pieces require a honing of their bravery and valor in endless battle to stay their best.

ro5_n_6_1.name: Inferno
ro5_n_6_1.description:
One burning vein of ore stretches on, hiding in Catastrophe. The other awakens evil beasts under the earth from their shallow sleep. Battle Heaven for time, battle the earth for life.
<@lv.item><Stove></> Summons 'Sapid Auspice' to deal True damage to all enemies in its path.
<@lv.item><Derelict Stove></> Summons 'Vapid Blight' to deal True damage to all allied units in its path.

ro5_n_6_2.name: Garrison
ro5_n_6_2.description:
'Atop the Tomb of Sui, a town was founded to receive guests. Suppressed by the geomantic fortunes of the eight directions, only a single gate was left open for the rite that saps Its strength.'
<@lv.item><Combat Special Barricade></> Blocks the enemy's line of sight, preventing direct shots.

ro5_n_7_1.name: Beyond Mount and Sea
ro5_n_7_1.description: History has been enticed by the present, revealing a past formed from both old and new.

ro5_n_7_2.name: Force Redirection
ro5_n_7_2.description:
Use the ways of beasts to reign over beasts. This was Great Yan's most important discovery when fighting against the gods.
<@lv.item><Stove></> Summons 'Sapid Auspice' to deal True damage to all enemies in its path.
<@lv.item><Derelict Stove></> Summons 'Vapid Blight' to deal True damage to all allied units in its path.

ro5_b_1.name: Cold Moonlight
ro5_b_1.description:
Anyone who searches for that long won't have a much better temper. The chill, colder than ice, is a reflection of her determination—even though this is only a statue of her.
<@lv.item><Originium Ice Crystal></> Periodically releases a frigid wave that will inflict Cold on your units

ro5_b_1_b.name: Memories of Dusk Beauty
ro5_b_1_b.description: People only ever speak of her searching the twin moons for her husband, but they never understand why she does so. Winter's grip may loosen, bitter frost may thaw, time may pass, but these memories shall never be erased.

ro5_b_2.name: Sword, Glaive, Spear
ro5_b_2.description:
They died before their lofty ambitions could be realized. The three heroes' weapons have faced the arms and armor of the Hundred Clans. If they saw Yan as it is today, would they know contentment?
<@lv.item><Active Originium></> Operators deployed on it and enemies who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and ASPD will be increased significantly.

ro5_b_2_b.name: Compassion, Justice, Valor
ro5_b_2_b.description: The virtuous begin with compassion. From compassion stems justice. Only in the end do they call for valor. And so, despite failing to quell the unrest under heaven, they shall be remembered with kind words for generations to come.

ro5_b_3.name: Enlightenment
ro5_b_3.description: Here, where the clouds lie deep, your footsteps alarm the pondfins. Before you lies a thousand years of Yan. Under your feet rests ten thousand years of the land. The elderly man sits upright as he places his finning rod down, waiting for the opportune one to step forward and talk.

ro5_b_3_b.name: Seeking the Way
ro5_b_3_b.description: After experiencing a lifetime of strife, he retreated beyond the land, free, unfettered. The one who has come to talk has witnessed breeze and drizzle, but naturally must also witness gale and storm.

ro5_b_4.name: The Suppression of Sui
ro5_b_4.description:
All things may act as the Garden of Grotesqueries' beams and columns, but there is only one who can bear the weight of it, only one who can bestow order upon it. It is not ye, but Yi. Sway his heart, and Yan shall breathe easy.
<@lv.item><Mark of Hui and Ming></> Operators deployed on it will earn a Hui-Ming Attribute.

ro5_b_4_b.name: A Change of Fate
ro5_b_4_b.description:
Yi is more than happy to allow you in, but ere you take another step, you must complete your duty.
<@lv.item><Mark of Hui and Ming></> Operators deployed on it gain a Hui-Ming Attribute.

ro5_b_5.name: Words Past Like Smoke
ro5_b_5.description: What caused the bestial Sui to reawaken, then leave no trace upon the mortal realm after Its destruction?

ro5_b_5_b.name: Near-Forgotten
ro5_b_5_b.description: When an uninkable scroll meets an unwritable past.

ro5_b_6.name: The Sui Strategist
ro5_b_6.description: Rather than fooling around with ceremonies year after year, it would be better to just pound the body of Sui into the dust to create a lasting peace. There is a 'man' who planned to do as such, and he approves of your gumption, but he cannot forgive you disturbing his kin's eternal rest.

ro5_b_7.name: The Last Hunt
ro5_b_7.description: The clearest recollection of the war in Sui's memories. It will know victory, and It will know defeat.

ro5_b_8.name: Recorded Memory
ro5_b_8.description: The memories of the Sui proxy induce signs of geistification in the ink-turned-icon, but the finishing touch still requires a human hand.

ro5_b_9_a.name: Stasis
ro5_b_9_a.description:
Let unending evolution end here.
<@rolv.rem>'Body' reflects a portion of damage received; 'Restrained Pride' and 'Fume of Anger' have increased Max HP</>

ro5_b_9_b.description:

ro5_b_9_e.description:
Let unending evolution end here.
<@rolv.rem>'Body' reflects a portion of damage received; all enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP, while 'Restrained Pride' and 'Fume of Anger' have further increased Max HP; 'Vessel of Shuo' and 'Arrogance Embodied' use their skills more often</>

ro5_b_10.name: Defining the World
ro5_b_10.description: The limit of what humanity can see, match, or define.

ro5_b_10_b.name: Defining the World
ro5_b_10_b.description:
The limit of what humanity can see, match, or define.
<@rolv.rem>'Body' reflects a portion of damage received; all enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP, while 'Restrained Pride' and 'Fume of Anger' have further increased Max HP; 'Vessel of Shuo' and 'Arrogance Embodied' use their skills more often</>

ro5_t_1.name: Steady Stream
ro5_t_1.description:
The food that Bear Lord's throwing away is attracting Originium slugs! Quick, send someone to tell him: NO LITTERING IN THE GARDEN OF GROTESQUERIES!
<@rolv.rem>This stage has <Rubble> that can block the enemy's path</>
<@rolv.rem><Gramophones> that deal Arts damage to enemies and heal allies when captured are present on the field</>

ro5_t_2.name: Sparkling Shine
ro5_t_2.description: Don't think you can hide behind those slugs to escape! Get that dog!

ro5_t_3.name: Reeducation
ro5_t_3.description: Trading without a license is strictly prohibited in the Garden of Grotesqueries. Get that rat to make an example out of him.

ro5_t_4.name: Duck and Yi
ro5_t_4.description: This duck stocking the shelves definitely made some kind of shady deal with Yi! Get him to 'fess up!

ro5_t_5.name: Calamitous Punishment
ro5_t_5.description:
You have disturbed the Bodhisattva's contemplation, thus you shall be punished. No doubt by experiencing this torment, you shall know the consequences of itchy hands and restless feet.
<@lv.item><Stove></> Summons 'Sapid Auspice' to deal True damage to all enemies in its path.
<@lv.item><Derelict Stove></> Summons 'Vapid Blight' to deal True damage to all allied units in its path.

ro5_t_6.name: Of Hundred Forms
ro5_t_6.description: When among civilization, Cannot shall treat you in a civilized manner. But if you insist on seeing another side of him, he shall grant your request. Reluctantly.

ro5_t_7.name: Feast of Fruit
ro5_t_7.description:
Fruit born from the soul of the land is stored here, guarded by rows of man-eating plants. They do not await a farmer to tend them, but rather, you.
<@lv.item><Thicket></> Cannot be attacked, and blocks the vision of your units

ro5_t_8.name: Biding Time
ro5_t_8.description: When on reconnaissance missions, Raidian will deploy 'lookouts' to establish contact with the main force. There is no information that can escape her net.

ro5_t_9_a.name: Joy From Burdenbeast
ro5_t_9_a.description: A game about growth. The 'strategist' says growth is like a burdenbeast's plodding steps, gentle and enduring.

ro5_t_9_b.name: Silicon Geist's Banquet
ro5_t_9_b.description: A game about propagation. The 'strategist' says propagation is like man-made objects becoming geists. You can try as hard as you like, but the results are hard to predict.

ro5_t_9_c.name: Totally Out of Control
ro5_t_9_c.description: A game about continuation. The 'strategist' says continuation is like the paradox of the Infected. To live, one cannot avoid self-sacrifice.

ro5_t_10.name: Cliff of Geists
ro5_t_10.description: Those passing through this natural redoubt always fly into a raging fury, refusing to fall back. Little do they know of the geists who lost their footing and slipped off the precipices on either side. This unnatural anger is their masterpiece.

ro5_ev_1.name: Astral Projection
ro5_ev_1.description: Why is this good merchant in your dream? Is he here to give you a treasure or two? Why isn't he happy to accept these presents you offer him?

ro5_ev_2.name: Sit Back and Watch
ro5_ev_2.description: He's thought of a lot of ways to handle your unruliness. His latest idea is what he calls 'fighting fire with fire'. Besides, the goods are lost either way, so why not sit back and enjoy a cup of tea while watching you tear at each other's throats?

ro5_duel_1.name: Bout by the Dusk River
ro5_duel_1.description:
Since needless arguing will lead to a flurry of blows, why not just get straight to the punching and kicking?
<@rolv.rem>Use Ranged Operators to fight the foe you picked; Losing will not deduct Life Points. Defeating a tougher foe within the given time grants a better reward</>

ro5_duel_1_b.name: Bout by the Dusk River
ro5_duel_1_b.description:
Since needless arguing will lead to a flurry of blows, why not just get straight to the punching and kicking?
<@rolv.rem>Use Melee Operators to fight the foe you picked; Losing will not deduct Life Points. Defeating a tougher foe within the given time grants a better reward</>

ro5_duel_2.name: Heroes of Nanwu
ro5_duel_2.description:
Taking first place is only the prelude to this gathering of the jianghu. Why do you think the Nanwu styles boast so many martial schools and escort agencies?
<@rolv.rem>Use Ranged Operators to fight the foe you picked; Losing will not deduct Life Points. Defeating a tougher foe within the given time grants a better reward</>

ro5_duel_2_b.name: Heroes of Nanwu
ro5_duel_2_b.description:
Taking first place is only the prelude to this gathering of the jianghu. Why do you think the Nanwu styles boast so many martial schools and escort agencies?
<@rolv.rem>Use Ranged and Melee Operators to fight the foe you picked; Losing will not deduct Life Points. Defeating a tougher foe within the given time grants a better reward</>

ro5_duel_2_c.name: Heroes of Nanwu
ro5_duel_2_c.description:
Taking first place is only the prelude to this gathering of the jianghu. Why do you think the Nanwu styles boast so many martial schools and escort agencies?
<@rolv.rem>Use Melee Operators to fight the foe you picked; Losing will not deduct Life Points. Defeating a tougher foe within the given time grants a better reward</>

ro5_duel_3.name: Dusk River Sayings
ro5_duel_3.description:
Having come to this, life and death are decided.
<@rolv.rem>Fight the foe you picked; Losing will not deduct Life Points. Defeating a tougher foe within the given time grants a better reward</>

ro5_duel_4.name: Nanwu Vows
ro5_duel_4.description:
Vows have been sworn. All that is left is to triumph.
<@rolv.rem>Fight the foe you picked; Losing will not deduct Life Points. Defeating a tougher foe within the given time grants a better reward</>

ro5_fs_1.name: Slandering Heaven
ro5_fs_1.description:
If Heaven does not stand with you, snatch it yourself.
<@rolv.rem>Candle Stand: Slandering Heaven: the Operators on this stand and the four adjacent tiles take progressively higher amounts of Arts damage at regular intervals. If the battle ends without that Operator retreating, they become a Candleguest.</>

ro5_fs_1_b.name: Slandering Heaven
ro5_fs_1_b.description:
If Heaven does not stand with you, snatch it yourself.
<@rolv.rem>Candle Stand: Slandering Heaven: the Operators on this stand and the four adjacent tiles take progressively higher amounts of Arts damage at regular intervals. If the battle ends without that Operator retreating, they become a Candleguest.</>

ro5_fs_2.name: Amidst Thunder
ro5_fs_2.description:
If storm clouds gather, take it yourself.
<@rolv.rem>Candle Stand: Amidst Thunder: the Operator on this stand takes a proportion of their Max HP as True damage at regular intervals. If the battle ends without that Operator retreating, they become a Candleguest.</>

ro5_fs_2_b.name: Amidst Thunder
ro5_fs_2_b.description:
If storm clouds gather, take it yourself.
<@rolv.rem>Candle Stand: Amidst Thunder: the Operator on this stand takes a proportion of their Max HP as True damage at regular intervals. If the battle ends without that Operator retreating, they become a Candleguest.</>

ro5_fs_3.name: Defying Quakes
ro5_fs_3.description:
If the earth spawns disaster, remove it yourself.

ro5_dv_5.name: Clarity
ro5_dv_5.description: Someone has placed a board here where black and white intersect, so that you will not be confused when you sit down for an actual game.

ro5_sv_11.name: Difficult Beginnings
ro5_sv_11.description: Thunder claps, and the maelstrom stops.

ro5_sv_13.name: Sealed Time
ro5_sv_13.description: Time has frozen this herd in a moment of confusion, but all seals must one day break. Best get out of here quick.

ro5_sv_14.name: Omnipresent Gospel
ro5_sv_14.description: No matter who collected them or where they are placed, the pervasive radiance of the holy statues of Laterano cannot be concealed.

ro5_sv_15.name: Conformity
ro5_sv_15.description: On the left walk men, on the right, geists. From afar, they fire. When near, they strike. In the end, they come together as one.
