ro5_e_1_1.name: Whack-A-Mus
ro5_e_1_1.description: Legend says the musbeasts of the Garden of Grotesqueries love to nibble on ancient tomes of poetry. Visitors who recite sordid poems or vulgar words will hear jeering chitters from the shadows, and chase after them to hidden burrows, ultimately provoking furious battles.
ro5_e_1_1.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP; additional enemies will appear

ro5_e_1_2.name: To Market
ro5_e_1_2.description: Occasionally, a group of people will line up in squares in an empty space. When asked, they say: 'We're going to market.' With the strike of a gong, they head off on a tottering march, destroying all that blocks the way. A startling sight for onlookers.
ro5_e_1_2.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; different enemies will appear

ro5_e_1_3.name: Serious Business
ro5_e_1_3.description:
You can't defend a business with only your mouth. But it does seem like Big Bob has misunderstood why you've come to his shop.
<@rolv.rem><Defensive Barricades> are present on the field that Block enemies</>
ro5_e_1_3.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP; Big Bob's HP is further increased

ro5_e_1_4.name: Veteran Actor
ro5_e_1_4.description: You are cordially invited to watch the play, but the theater is deserted. There is a sudden burst of song from the shoddy stage as if urging you to stay, making the scene stranger than it already is.
ro5_e_1_4.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP; different enemies will appear; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_1_5.name: Pest Control
ro5_e_1_5.description: In the Garden of Grotesqueries, pest control is generally done by the crops themselves. In their minds, if you are not a farmer, then you are a pest.
ro5_e_1_5.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP; additional enemies will appear; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_1_6.name: Ticket Please
ro5_e_1_6.description: It seems that the hubbub when the Garden opens has made its mark on the entrance, to the point that when it closes, naive geists are all too eager to imitate the tourists crowding into the gate to get their tickets inspected.
ro5_e_1_6.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP; Bloodboil Knightclub Elite's ATK is further increased

ro5_e_2_1.name: Learning for All
ro5_e_2_1.description: At the renovation site, the workers are eagerly listening to a lesson taught by a 'Tianshi'. 'Uneducated men are no different from geists!' As you pass by, you are pulled into the 'classroom' by the strict 'Tianshi'.
ro5_e_2_1.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and DEF and greatly increased HP; additional enemies will appear; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_2_2.name: Look Out Above
ro5_e_2_2.description:
Flying Oxmanes and fleeing Hornbeasts are causing a ruckus in the Garden. Where did the throwing device that started it all come from? A geist tinkerer pats the sawdust off his body in a corner of the garden, leaving in satisfaction.
<@lv.item><Saltheap Cannon></> Periodically fires a shell forward, dealing Physical splash damage; can launch a nearby ground enemy of 3 Weight or less to the center of the explosion
ro5_e_2_2.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_2_3.name: Guardian of Justice
ro5_e_2_3.description:
The wandering warrior has been awaiting this match for over a decade, until a young child comes over: 'You can stop waiting now, that guy died ten years ago. Look, I've been looking for you so long, I'm big now.' Once done speaking, the child disappears, leaving behind only a saber on the ground.
<@rolv.rem><Gramophones> that deal Arts damage to enemies and heal allies when captured are present on the field</>
ro5_e_2_3.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP; additional enemies will appear

ro5_e_2_4.name: Daylight Robbery
ro5_e_2_4.description: 'Jianghu rules: if you beat the two of us, you'll keep all the belongings.' The twin bandits are beacons of righteousness, trying to cover for their comrades as they sneak away.
ro5_e_2_4.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; some enemies will follow different routes; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_2_5.name: Rescue Mission
ro5_e_2_5.description:
There will always be some tourists who decide they don't want to leave yet when the Garden closes. Not only do you have to see them out, you also need to resolve whatever chaos they caused.
<@lv.item><Static Roadblock></> Blocks the movement of Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter; Can be destroyed by allied units.
<@lv.item><Ursus Civilian></> Depletes a Life Point when killed by an enemy.
ro5_e_2_5.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and DEF, and greatly increased HP; additional Static Roadblocks will appear; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_2_6.name: Toy Soldiers
ro5_e_2_6.description: Once, a foreign guest left behind a set of action figures in the Garden. Now, they have made a place for themselves here.
ro5_e_2_6.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP; different enemies will appear

ro5_e_3_1.name: Hook, Line, and Sinker
ro5_e_3_1.description: Only in the Garden of Grotesqueries can you see these extinct Pseudomuts. Enticed into the Garden by their rapacious appetite, they have not had to worry about food or drink for many years since. Both Yi and the Pseudomuts believe they have the favorable side of the arrangement.
ro5_e_3_1.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, HP and greatly increased Movement Speed; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_3_2.name: Stopping the Advance
ro5_e_3_2.description: There's barely any space here to turn your head, let alone your body. Beasts intent on chasing their tails have no choice but to keep running forward, smashing everything in their path. The Statuegeists watching from the sidelines chortle as they pass.
ro5_e_3_2.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP; different enemies will appear

ro5_e_3_3.name: Feng Shui
ro5_e_3_3.description:
The geists are alarmed, and they scatter all over the place. Have a closer look. I'll get straight to the point, the road's so curved, not even Originium slugs can stand it! Do some rearranging to get the feng shui right for them.
<@rolv.rem><Roadblocks> that can block the enemy's route can be deployed</>
ro5_e_3_3.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and DEF and greatly increased Max HP; additional enemies will appear; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_3_4.name: Away, Hui!
ro5_e_3_4.description:
Garden rules state that at the start of every month, fire will be used to 'drive away the darkness of Hui'. As for what is being burned as fuel, best not ask.
<@rolv.rem>This stage has <Rubble> that can block the enemy's path</>.
ro5_e_3_4.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased DEF and greatly increased ATK and HP; Purifying Flames have further increased ATK; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_3_5.name: Return to Your Roots
ro5_e_3_5.description:
Time flows, the land changes, and cities of steel rise. Their hometowns are long gone, but they are always looking out for a way back home.
<@lv.item><Shield and Wall></> Blocks the vision of your units
ro5_e_3_5.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; additional <Shield and Walls> will appear; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_3_6.name: Repel the Outsiders
ro5_e_3_6.description: Many people will spend their entire lives never having left their homeland, but they will, and they will put their all into doing so.
ro5_e_3_6.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_4_1.name: Shanhaizhong Scramble
ro5_e_4_1.description:
'Of the eight 'Do Nots', the Shanhaizhong intruding in the Garden have violated four of them, so the roads they walk and the searches they perform are all fruitless as the geists 'teach them the rules'. Give them a hand before you hand them over to the Sui Regulator.
<@rolv.rem><Defensive Barricades> are present on the field that Block enemies</>
ro5_e_4_1.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; certain enemies have greatly increased ATK; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_4_2.name: Sugared Bait
ro5_e_4_2.description: After trying to feed the fins in the pond, some tourists were knocked eight zhang away! In order to satisfy those fins, they learned from their mistakes and reflected on the past... deciding to do all they can to develop bigger, sweeter bait. <@rolv.rem><'Gelato Stops'> are present on the field that restore allied SP when captured <@rolv.rem> are present on the field that Block enemies
ro5_e_4_2.eliteDesc: Enemies gain greatly increased ATK, DEF, and HP; certain enemies have further increased ATK and HP; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_4_3.name: Cultured
ro5_e_4_3.description: You see that the Seaborn here are daubing paint, letting you breathe a sigh of relief. Then you see, painted on the wall, a 'sea with plenty of'—scrawled, teeming, and diverse 'fins'.
ro5_e_4_3.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; certain enemies have further increased HP; additional enemies will appear

ro5_e_4_4.name: Take the Stage
ro5_e_4_4.description: Even though this is no longer an age when many watch plays, they still stubbornly cling to the idea that they have parts to play upon the stage. Some geists are trapped in the past, much like humanity.
ro5_e_4_4.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; additional enemies will appear; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_4_5.name: Exemplary Service
ro5_e_4_5.description:
An armor-clad eccentric sleeps atop the mount, unmoving for over a decade. As you pass them, you suddenly sense yellow sands fill the air, and when you open your eyes, you find yourself before a city gate of steel. Soldiers line the walls while battle drums shake the heavens. Glory days of past service can be both a dream, and a cage.
<@rolv.rem><Defensive Barricades> are present on the field that Block enemies</>
ro5_e_4_5.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; certain enemies have further increased HP; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_4_6.name: Beware the Shadows
ro5_e_4_6.description: Two roads, one on either side, both with 'safety instructions'. The obvious dangers mentioned seem easy to guard against, but one line is worrying: Beware the ■■■■ in the shadows. The text is smudged, and hard to read.
ro5_e_4_6.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, HP, and Movement Speed; additional enemies will appear; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_4_7.name: Let It All Out
ro5_e_4_7.description: Yi has some regrets about letting the geists read the Higashinese novels in his collection. The geists playing ninja had only just scratched the surface of the culture before going on a rampage, causing much more of an uproar than those noisy musicians.
ro5_e_4_7.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; Suiton Masters gain Invisibility

ro5_e_5_1.name: Green Hills Speak Not
ro5_e_5_1.description: 'You're sitting on me.' There don't seem to be any of Yi's relics here, but there are plenty of rocks. It is a good time to rest. 'I said, you're sitting on me!' The voice rings out again. You look all around you to find it, until the boulder under you rises into your field of view.
ro5_e_5_1.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased DEF and greatly increased ATK and HP; certain enemies have further increased HP; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_5_2.name: Departing Inspection
ro5_e_5_2.description: The Sui Regulator performs additional inspections on visitors leaving forbidden areas, to ensure you are still you, and all that leaves is you.
ro5_e_5_2.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; additional enemies will appear; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_5_3.name: A Humble Gift
ro5_e_5_3.description: A younger brother receiving goods from his older brother is naturally not an issue. However, since one is named Yi and the other Ji, the Candleholders never lack reasons to inspect things being sent up the mountain.
ro5_e_5_3.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; additional enemies will appear

ro5_e_5_4.name: Muted Past
ro5_e_5_4.description: Yi was given a worn-out guitar that couldn't produce a single note, but in his hands, it was able to play the most basic of tunes. The Sarkaz, wanting to snatch back this melody, chased him all the way back to the Garden from the west.
ro5_e_5_4.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and Weight and greatly increased HP; additional enemies will appear; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_5_5.name: Mangshan Town Records
ro5_e_5_5.description: 'A horde of wares... awakened... attacked us in the streets... disaster... destruction...' The rest is hidden below an old, dark-red stain, unable to be read clearly.
ro5_e_5_5.eliteDesc: Enemies gain greatly increased ATK and HP; Statuegeists have further increased HP; additional enemies will appear

ro5_e_5_6.name: Unlit Sparks
ro5_e_5_6.description:
Here lie abominations born of the food and drink people discard. Yi did not gather them for his collection. If Vapidities can become Sapidities, then there is the possibility they can yet bloom with flavor.
<@lv.item><Stove></> Summons 'Sapid Auspice' to deal True damage to all enemies in its path.
<@lv.item><Derelict Stove></> Summons 'Vapid Blight' to deal True damage to all allied units in its path.
ro5_e_5_6.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; additional enemies and Statuegeists will appear; 'Fasting' is Invisible

ro5_e_5_7.name: Honed Edge
ro5_e_5_7.description: Through conservation treatments, items in the collection show their true worth. These particular pieces require a honing of their bravery and valor in endless battle to stay their best.
ro5_e_5_7.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; Rampaging Abnormal Manglerbeast has further increased DEF and HP, and follows a different route

ro5_e_6_1.name: Inferno
ro5_e_6_1.description:
One burning vein of ore stretches on, hiding in Catastrophe. The other awakens evil beasts under the earth from their shallow sleep. Battle Heaven for time, battle the earth for life.
<@lv.item><Stove></> Summons 'Sapid Auspice' to deal True damage to all enemies in its path.
<@lv.item><Derelict Stove></> Summons 'Vapid Blight' to deal True damage to all allied units in its path.
ro5_e_6_1.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; certain enemies have further increased HP; additional enemies will appear; additional Statuegeists will appear

ro5_e_6_2.name: Garrison
ro5_e_6_2.description:
'Atop the Tomb of Sui, a town was founded to receive guests. Suppressed by the geomantic fortunes of the eight directions, only a single gate was left open for the rite that saps Its strength.'
<@lv.item><Combat Special Barricade></> Blocks the enemy's line of sight, preventing direct shots.
ro5_e_6_2.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; additional enemies will appear; some enemies have been changed

ro5_e_7_1.name: Beyond Mount and Sea
ro5_e_7_1.description: History has been enticed by the present, revealing a past formed from both old and new.
ro5_e_7_1.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; some enemies have been changed; Statuegeists have reduced HP

ro5_e_7_2.name: Force Redirection
ro5_e_7_2.description:
Use the ways of beasts to reign over beasts. This was Great Yan's most important discovery when fighting against the gods.
<@lv.item><Stove></> Summons 'Sapid Auspice' to deal True damage to all enemies in its path.
<@lv.item><Derelict Stove></> Summons 'Vapid Blight' to deal True damage to all allied units in its path.
ro5_e_7_2.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; additional enemies will appear

ro5_e_t_1.name: Steady Stream
ro5_e_t_1.description:
The food that Bear Lord's throwing away is attracting Originium slugs! Quick, send someone to tell him: NO LITTERING IN THE GARDEN OF GROTESQUERIES!
<@rolv.rem>This stage has <Rubble> that can block the enemy's path</>
<@rolv.rem><Gramophones> that deal Arts damage to enemies and heal allies when captured are present on the field</>
ro5_e_t_1.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP; certain enemies have further increased ATK and HP; 'Gramophone' SP requirement increased

ro5_e_t_2.name: Sparkling Shine
ro5_e_t_2.description: Don't think you can hide behind those slugs to escape! Get that dog!
ro5_e_t_2.eliteDesc: Crying Thief gains greatly increased HP; his attacks will Stun allied units for longer

ro5_e_t_3.name: Reeducation
ro5_e_t_3.description: Trading without a license is strictly prohibited in the Garden of Grotesqueries. Get that rat to make an example out of him.
ro5_e_t_3.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and greatly increased HP; additional enemies will appear

ro5_e_t_4.name: Duck and Yi
ro5_e_t_4.description: This duck stocking the shelves definitely made some kind of shady deal with Yi! Get him to 'fess up!
ro5_e_t_4.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP; allied units have increased Redeployment Time; different enemies will appear

ro5_e_t_5.name: Calamitous Punishment
ro5_e_t_5.description:
You have disturbed the Bodhisattva's contemplation, thus you shall be punished. No doubt by experiencing this torment, you shall know the consequences of itchy hands and restless feet.
<@lv.item><Stove></> Summons 'Sapid Auspice' to deal True damage to all enemies in its path.
<@lv.item><Derelict Stove></> Summons 'Vapid Blight' to deal True damage to all allied units in its path.
ro5_e_t_5.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and greatly increased HP; enemies will follow different routes

ro5_e_t_6.name: Of Hundred Forms
ro5_e_t_6.description: When among civilization, Cannot shall treat you in a civilized manner. But if you insist on seeing another side of him, he shall grant your request. Reluctantly.

ro5_e_t_7.name: Feast of Fruit
ro5_e_t_7.description:
Fruit born from the soul of the land is stored here, guarded by rows of man-eating plants. They do not await a farmer to tend them, but rather, you.
<@lv.item><Thicket></> Cannot be attacked, and blocks the vision of your units
ro5_e_t_7.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and DEF and greatly increased Max HP; additional enemies will appear

ro5_e_t_8.name: Biding Time
ro5_e_t_8.description: When on reconnaissance missions, Raidian will deploy 'lookouts' to establish contact with the main force. There is no information that can escape her net.
ro5_e_t_8.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP

ro5_e_t_9_a.name: Joy From Burdenbeast
ro5_e_t_9_a.description: A game about growth. The 'strategist' says growth is like a burdenbeast's plodding steps, gentle and enduring.

ro5_e_t_9_b.name: Silicon Geist's Banquet
ro5_e_t_9_b.description: A game about propagation. The 'strategist' says propagation is like man-made objects becoming geists. You can try as hard as you like, but the results are hard to predict.
ro5_e_t_9_b.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have increased ATK and HP, and greatly increased DEF and RES

ro5_e_t_9_c.name: Totally Out of Control
ro5_e_t_9_c.description: A game about continuation. The 'strategist' says continuation is like the paradox of the Infected. To live, one cannot avoid self-sacrifice.
ro5_e_t_9_c.eliteDesc: Condition: Enemies have significantly increased ATK, DEF, HP, ASPD, and Movement Speed

ro5_e_t_10.name: Cliff of Geists
ro5_e_t_10.description: Those passing through this natural redoubt always fly into a raging fury, refusing to fall back. Little do they know of the geists who lost their footing and slipped off the precipices on either side. This unnatural anger is their masterpiece.
ro5_e_t_10.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK and HP

zone_1.name: Honglu Tower
zone_1.description: All visitors here to view the Garden are as one family.

zone_2.name: Shanshui Pavilion
zone_2.description: Picturesque sights are for the spirits too. Beware the soil, trees, grass, and stones.

zone_3.name: Yunwa Gazebo
zone_3.description: Look up to see the clouds, look down to see the roofs. The road ahead has many hindrances, its crags hard to traverse.
zone_3.endingDescription: Nature is lined with hidden danger and bleached bones. It has always been as such.

zone_4.name: Ruwu Gate
zone_4.description: Heaven and earth are vast, mount and river are fierce, but none as great as thou, none as great as I.
zone_4.endingDescription: 'Tis a mighty shame, thou art not as great as I.

zone_5.name: Jianzi Shrine
zone_5.description: Though named Jianzi Shrine, you see not a single character on its plaques. For all that transpires before and within the shrine cannot be recorded.
zone_5.endingDescription: The climb is easy, the descent is hard.

zone_6.name: Shimo Tomb
zone_6.description: From this comes life. Do not believe it is the end.
zone_6.endingDescription: The bestial Sui rests here, and thou shalt rest with it.

zone_7.name: Mingmie Peak
zone_7.description: The scroll appears, and the path ahead opens. Here, beginnings and endings, births and deaths, truths and lies converge.
zone_7.endingDescription: A past bereft of hope, a future bereft of sight.

zone_8.name: Laiqu Point
zone_8.description: Seek both past and present. Within the ever-changing ending, seek your destiny.
zone_8.endingDescription: It has the power to define change, whereas you are surrounded by change's flow.

zone_sky_1.name: Shifei Border
zone_sky_1.description: Vast and boundless, unchanging throughout the ages. Its form majestic and grand, Its name that of Sui.
zone_sky_1.endingDescription: An inferior soul shall be torn asunder. This too is common sense.

zone_sky_2.name: Jinxi Border
zone_sky_2.description: Yan's flame rages, Sui's body paces. Bestial shadows gather afar. The great wild hunt draws near.
zone_sky_2.endingDescription: Soldiers undisciplined, burdenbeasts unfed. With no preparations made, the tide resists turning.

zone_sky_3.name: Shifei Border
zone_sky_3.description: Vast and boundless, unchanging throughout the ages. Its form majestic and grand, Its name that of Sui.
zone_sky_3.endingDescription: An inferior soul shall be torn asunder. This too is common sense.

scene_ro5_double2_enter.title: Communication
scene_ro5_double2_enter.description: No matter the era, sound will always be the most direct method of communication. While the new recruits fumble for the transceivers hanging at their waists, the experienced old master has already finished transmitting the information using a long, wavering whistle. When you hear it winding its way down the mountaintop, you know the mission is a success. Not long after, some equipment is sent over by burdenbeast for your use.

scene_ro5_double2_1.title: Communication
scene_ro5_double2_1.description: They may seem simple, but the sets of crafted armor the stalls offer in bulk have passed through strict consecration ceremonies and are able to ward off evil and disaster.

scene_ro5_double2_2.title: Communication
scene_ro5_double2_2.description: This signal flag allows Candleholders to quickly call for backup in a timely fashion even while in the Garden of Grotesqueries.

scene_ro5_double2_3.title: Communication
scene_ro5_double2_3.description: As you depart, the old master notices you are heading further into the Garden of Grotesqueries, and grabs your hand to ask you to pass a message to the Tianshi Bureau successors he is in contact with inside. Though you are unsure if they are human or geist, you still agree to do it.

scene_ro5_camp1_enter.title: Hall of Candles
scene_ro5_camp1_enter.description: This building near the entrance of the Garden is a place where Yanese tourists pay their respects and pray for good luck. They light joss sticks and candles to pray, leaving rising spirals of smoke when they leave. But when the Garden closes, this becomes the headquarters of the Sui Regulator's Garden Management. Under candles from all across Yan, Candleholders light their own candles to reaffirm their commitment to their duty and rekindle their spirits.

scene_ro5_camp1_1.title: Hall of Candles
scene_ro5_camp1_1.description: After gazing at the candlelight for a long while, you leave.

scene_ro5_camp1_2.title: Hall of Candles
scene_ro5_camp1_2.description: The bestial Sui will awaken. Crystalized rage drips from the spike, idling by emotion's side, waiting for the moment to crush your heart.

scene_ro5_camp1_3.title: Hall of Candles
scene_ro5_camp1_3.description: So long as you pay attention to the shifts in mood, you are confident that with this monster they call 'ceaseless', you will be able to perceive the principles behind Sui's ability to transcend causality.

scene_ro5_normal1_enter.title: Fork in the Road
scene_ro5_normal1_enter.description: This road up the mountain leads straight to a tourist spot, one fenced off to prevent tourists from going any further. But you see several paths heading beyond the fence. One is a bare and level dirt path, as if flattened by countless steps; one is a faint beast trail, covered by vegetation; one seems to have been marked by crushing wheels, the ruts still clear in the ground.

scene_ro5_normal1_1.title: Fork in the Road
scene_ro5_normal1_1.description: The trail is difficult to follow, and you stumble upon a bundle left by your predecessors. Atop it is written... your name? Shuddering in fear, you cautiously follow a chunk of the trail before discovering you have returned to the mountain road. Looking behind you, you notice several paths reconverging where you stand... How many yous have chosen a path that ultimately ended up here, before continuing to walk onwards?

scene_ro5_normal1_2.title: Fork in the Road
scene_ro5_normal1_2.description: After following the road for a while, you look behind you to see several paths reconverging where you stand... You once heard of a crafter who could see through the paths of life and death and pave them into roads. This road may have a myriad forks, but there is only one start, and one end. Traversing a single path is as traversing ten thousand of them.

scene_ro5_scout_enter.title: Lamp-Holders and Candle-Wielders
scene_ro5_scout_enter.description: All human employees of the Garden are also part of the Sui Regulator, which is no secret within the Regulator itself. When the Garden is open, they act as tour guides, gardeners, and security. When it closes, they supervise spirits, record changes, and exorcise geists as lamp-holders and candle-wielders. During the Placation, they make for excellent guides and sentinels, and every Candleholder has benefited from their aid.

scene_ro5_scout_1.title: Lamp-Holders and Candle-Wielders
scene_ro5_scout_1.description: They give you a run-down of the general circumstances and important points of every part of the Garden. You learn a lot from them.

scene_ro5_scout_2.title: Lamp-Holders and Candle-Wielders
scene_ro5_scout_2.description: The masters regarded as lamp-holders regularly patrol every corner of the Garden. When you apply for their help, they will lead one of your retainers up ahead, traveling to parts of the Garden you have not yet explored.

scene_ro5_scout_3.title: Lamp-Holders and Candle-Wielders
scene_ro5_scout_3.description: The masters regarded as candle-wielders were once Candleholders who participated in past Placations. For whatever reason, they have declined better positions to stay employed here. When you apply for their help, these old Candleholders will lead one of your retainers deeper into the Garden while teaching them how to ascend and resist the oppressive consciousness of Sui. But everyone knows the price for these secrets is time...

scene_ro5_scout_4.title: Lamp-Holders and Candle-Wielders
scene_ro5_scout_4.description: The wooden case brought back from Sui's remnant consciousness to the human realm is held firm by one of your retainers, as everyone from the Sui Regulator and Tianshi Bureaus surrounds it. Several elderly Candleholders and Tianshis step forward and press their hands against its lid. Through their memories and experiences of humanity and Yan, this object that was born of Sui yet is not of Sui shall lead Yan to another possibility in managing the beast.

scene_ro5_scout_5.title: Lamp-Holders and Candle-Wielders
scene_ro5_scout_5.description: The case opens, and the scroll inside shoots out in all directions like a mass of writhing tentacles. The retainer holding the case is enwrapped before disappearing, drawn into the deepest depths of the Tomb of Sui. This scroll is a bridge, gestated in the past of Sui and humanity, born in the present of Sui proxies and humanity, and it is here that it shall begin seeking the future of Sui and humanity. The case and scroll have affixed themselves here, and from now on, you can send retainers into the place the scroll is searching for whenever you wish.

scene_ro5_scout_6.title: Lamp-Holders and Candle-Wielders
scene_ro5_scout_6.description: The scroll gently envelops the retainer who touches it, sending them to the place it seeks.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_enter.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_enter.description: He is a Sui proxy, the master builder Yi, but he is also the 'Mr. Yi' who has zero resistance to the allure of fine wares. You need only offer him something he fancies, and he shall be generous in return.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_3.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_3.description: Rarities always engender a certain tenderness in people. Yi wraps it well in a flannel cloth, then in a layer of bubble-wrap, before placing it in a locked wooden chest. Once done packing it up, he presents a rarity of his own to you.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_1.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_1.description: You adore the treasure you received.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_2.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_2.description: Ordinary wares have stories of their own. Yi carefully wipes it clean before placing it in a wooden case. Once done, he presents a mundane treasure of his own to you.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_4.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_4.description: Treasures have a natural irresistibility to them. Yi turns it in his hands many times before fetching a jewel-encrusted chest, and tenderly placing it on a lining of silk. He turns his head and pulls out a treasure of his own, deferentially presenting it to you.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_5.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_5.description: Rather than getting caught up in the friendly trading atmosphere, you care more about his identity. After careful consideration, you turn him down tactfully.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_6.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_6.description: He is surprised but still takes out a long case. Inside, eleven porcelain cups adorned with different flower motifs are kept in an orderly manner. As chance would have it, what you have offered him is the missing twelfth cup of the set. As thanks, he offers you a pair of treasures in return.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_7.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_7.description: As it is one of his own skillful creations, he has no desire to collect it. However, with the passage of time, he has a new understanding of this relic. After a little remodeling, he hands it back to you.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_8.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_8.description: What you gave away has far greater value in its rightful collector's hands. You pack your new treasure well before departing.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_9.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_9.description: Yi has left many more of his thoughts upon this work of his. You may need to fiddle with it more to discover the marvels within.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_10.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_10.description: Yi weighs the blessed luck in his hand, believing you to surely have many more treasures worth trading for in your pocket. From a cloud at the edge of the sky, he plucks a treasure room, so that the two of you may make a few more transactions.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_11.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_11.description: Ordinary wares have stories of their own. Yi carefully wipes it clean before placing it in a wooden case. Once done, he presents a mundane treasure of his own to you.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_12.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_12.description: Your luck yet lives. Yi believes he can still offer you suitable deals for the items you own. He awaits your reply.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_13.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_13.description: Rarities always engender a certain tenderness in people. Yi wraps it well in a flannel cloth, then in a layer of bubble-wrap, before placing it in a locked wooden chest. Once done packing it up, he presents a rarity of his own to you.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_14.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_14.description: You and Yi both pack away your new treasures, fully satisfied. Perhaps the joy of a good bartering session is one of those treasures.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_15.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_15.description: He is surprised but still takes out a long case. Inside, eleven porcelain cups adorned with different flower motifs are kept in an orderly manner. scene_ro5_sacrifice1_26.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_26.description: You and Yi both pack away your new treasures, fully satisfied. Perhaps the joy of a good bartering session lies in the trade itself.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_27.description: Rarities always engender a certain tenderness in people. Yi wraps it well in a flannel cloth, then in a layer of bubble-wrap, before placing it in a locked wooden chest. Once done packing it up, he presents a rarity of his own to you.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_28.description: Treasures have a natural irresistibility to them. He turns his head and pulls out a treasure of his own, deferentially presenting it to you.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_29.description: He is surprised but still takes out a long case. Inside, eleven porcelain cups adorned with different flower motifs are kept in an orderly manner. As chance would have it, what you have offered him is the missing twelfth cup of the set. As thanks, he offers you a pair of treasures in return.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_30.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_30.description: As it is one of his own skillful creations, he has no desire to collect it. However, with the passage of time, he has a new understanding of this relic. After a little remodeling, he hands it back to you.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_31.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_31.description: Yi weighs the tenacious luck in his hand, believing that rather than acting restrained, he would much rather put it all on the line like you have.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_32.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_32.description: To carry such tenacious luck, you must have both the courage to accept it and the ability to control it. You cannot tell if Yi is happy or sad, but when you look at the treasures you now own, you have your own opinion on the results of your grand gamble.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_33.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_33.description: Yi weighs the ordinary luck in his hand. For this, he is willing to give you a fair price.

scene_ro5_sacrifice1_34.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_sacrifice1_34.description: Although you were unable to exchange it for a treasure, this luck still brought you a windfall. A good enough reason to be happy.

scene_ro5_chest_enter.title: A Meeting
scene_ro5_chest_enter.description: A line bisects the newlyweds' room. The left half has been scrubbed clean, and the furniture freshly painted. A recently tossed coin still spins on the table. The right half is covered in cobwebs and dust, and the furniture is rotten and brittle, as if long abandoned. Atop the bed, what seem to be lovers' tokens are arranged neatly, but their owners are nowhere to be seen.

scene_ro5_chest_1.title: A Meeting
scene_ro5_chest_1.description: Just as you pick it up, the entire room shifts as half of it flips over, revealing a person. They do not thank you, instead incessantly digging at the ground, wishing to return.

scene_ro5_chest_2.title: A Meeting
scene_ro5_chest_2.description: The two tokens seem to have some sort of strange relationship, as if they were fastened together tightly. If one is removed, the other will be destroyed. You are vaguely aware of some connection between the tokens and the room, and after checking both inside and outside, you decide to—

scene_ro5_chest_3.title: A Meeting
scene_ro5_chest_3.description: The two tokens seem to have some sort of strange relationship, as if they were fastened together tightly. If one is removed, the other will be destroyed. You are vaguely aware of some connection between the tokens and the room, but you feel like all you need to do is use more strength. If you do, surely you can take everything offered.

scene_ro5_chest_4.title: A Meeting
scene_ro5_chest_4.description: When you solve the riddle and take the tokens, the entire room suddenly turns and ejects you. Once you crawl to your feet, you see it is still the same room, with the same division, but you also see an old couple leave it, giving you the deepest of kowtows.

scene_ro5_chest_5.title: A Meeting
scene_ro5_chest_5.description: Your brute-force approach destroys the two tokens, accompanied by the sound of something shattering. It seems like some barrier has disappeared forever. You flip the bed and ransack the cupboards before finally finding your spoils. As for the mystery of the room, you don't care one bit.

scene_ro5_chest_6.title: A Meeting
scene_ro5_chest_6.description: Nothing about the room changes. The tokens do not move an inch. There is nothing you can do except sigh at the unsolved mystery.

scene_ro5_chest_7.title: A Meeting
scene_ro5_chest_7.description: After you leave, the room rotates. One half is brand-new, the other ancient and dilapidated. As for the secrets and lives buried within, none pay them any mind.

scene_ro5_chest_8.title: A Meeting
scene_ro5_chest_8.description: Two families, and two star-crossed lovers. The girl visited her love one night to elope, but the guards locked the two in a side room. The unfortunate souls laid down their tokens, intending to die in each other's arms, when suddenly the room warped, separating them in a realm that knew not night or day. Though they were in the same room, each only saw the four walls, and were only allowed to meet but one night a decade. By the time you broke their curse, it had been eighty years. They have no desire but to stay together forever.

scene_ro5_chest_9.title: A Meeting
scene_ro5_chest_9.description: After you leave, the entire room sinks into complete silence. Many years later, the once-pristine half is also covered in dust. Perhaps someone will turn this room into a tomb, and give that forgotten couple a proper burial.

scene_ro5_chest_10.title: A Meeting
scene_ro5_chest_10.description: Just as you pick it up, the entire room shifts as half of it flips over, revealing a person. They do not thank you, instead incessantly digging at the ground, wishing to return.

scene_ro5_sala1_enter.title: Bout by the Dusk River
scene_ro5_sala1_enter.description: This arena comes from the ancient sparring grounds at the river island in the middle of Dusk City. The river split the residents into north and south, and they were always ready with a snide comment for the people of the other side. And so, the annual 'Dusk River Bout' single-elimination tournament became the best way to resolve their disputes. The island is long gone from the whims of geology, but the tradition lives on to this day.

scene_ro5_sala1_1.title: Bout by the Dusk River
scene_ro5_sala1_1.description: You are of the north side, while I am of the south. Step into the arena, bow, and begin the fight. Only then shall we talk.

scene_ro5_sala1_2.title: Bout by the Dusk River
scene_ro5_sala1_2.description: You have important matters to attend to, and it'd be better not to get mixed up with this rowdy crowd.

scene_ro5_sala1_3.title: Bout by the Dusk River
scene_ro5_sala1_3.description: Most bouts end with first blood, but if the candles are lit, it means grudges run deep, and the fight will continue until one party lies dead.

scene_ro5_double1_enter.title: Mount of Stone
scene_ro5_double1_enter.description: The land of Kou-wu is abundant with odd stones, formed by the erosion of wind and wave. They pile on one another to form mountain ranges, often used to decorate gardens and palaces; they may be craggy and steep, but they have their charms. The people of Kou-wu always say to 'ask the stones the way': they burn incense at the mountain's foot, then toss money at it. Hearing the tongbao clink within the rising mists brightens everyone's day. Kou-wu Hill in the Garden is no different, and is offered piles of tongbao and riches every holiday, an endless headache for the staff.

scene_ro5_double1_1.title: Mount of Stone
scene_ro5_double1_1.description: Most tongbao fall through gaps between the rocks to the foot of the mountain, which means very few actually stay within it. Perhaps they got wedged in a crack, or fell into a cavern. Seeing that the ones left here are the fortunate few, the luck they can impart must surely be extraordinary too.

scene_ro5_double1_2.title: Mount of Stone
scene_ro5_double1_2.description: The foot of the mountain is festooned with tongbao, along with some made of paper. There's even a... marble? You take a coin from the pile, and examine it carefully.

scene_ro5_double1_3.title: Mount of Stone
scene_ro5_double1_3.description: The mount of stone boasts an entire vault's worth of coins. What's one more or one less to it? It stands there, entertaining guests in silence.

scene_ro5_spring_enter.title: A Chance to Live
scene_ro5_spring_enter.description: A fire burns in an empty clearing, an unquenchable, unending source of light and heat. You approach it, even touch it, but you are not burned. It may not be part of you, but its energies feel very familiar.

scene_ro5_spring_1.title: A Chance to Live
scene_ro5_spring_1.description: The fire lifts your spirits, and gives you the strength to carry on. After you leave, the fire carries on burning. And it will burn until heaven and earth die in darkness, until thousands of eons pass, until you next return, until...

scene_ro5_spring_2.title: A Chance to Live
scene_ro5_spring_2.description: It's just a fire. Not worth sticking around for.

scene_ro5_portal1_enter.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portal1_enter.description: One can see wooden pillars shaped like nails or rules all across the Garden, drained of all color. Their influence can be seen in their monochrome surroundings. One need only stand within this zone to lose your grip on your senses, and for your consciousness to transcend your body. If you take it one step further—

scene_ro5_portal1_1.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portal1_1.description: You sense your consciousness expand... ascend... break through the clouds... gaze down at the earth... like the Feranmut of eld.

scene_ro5_portal1_2.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portal1_2.description: You should not enter strange places when not adequately prepared.

scene_ro5_portal1_3.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portal1_3.description: Through the combined power of the Sui proxies, you see the imagined awakening of a god within the ever-spinning instrument.

scene_ro5_end1_enter.title: Memorial Hall Entrance
scene_ro5_end1_enter.description: Jianzi Shrine stands at the peak of one of the Garden's bounding mountains, an exceedingly normal building unlike its grotesque fellows. The origins of its name have been passed down orally from generation to generation of Candleholders. The pronunciation and meaning can be conveyed without error, but were you to try to write it down, you would end up with paper as blank as hall's plaques. This is where your duty ends, and where the master of the Garden awaits you.

scene_ro5_end1_1.title: Memorial Hall Entrance
scene_ro5_end1_1.description: Yi sees the inkstick in your hands, then opens the doors to Jianzi Shrine. 'This is the first time I've seen the Sui Regulator able to carve a geist to such a degree. Please, enter. I shall grind the ink. Everything else will proceed as planned.' Liang keeps rubbing the back of his head, as if dejectedly wondering how he will cover up for the cacophony later.

scene_ro5_end1_2.title: Memorial Hall Entrance
scene_ro5_end1_2.description: Just as manglerbeasts cannot hunt fowlbeasts soaring through the sky, how can you harm the master of the Garden within its bounds? But this is what the ceremony means. Enter the Garden, take up the name of Sui, and do battle with the Sui proxy using both awe-inspiring might and knowing hand. Take the authority of mankind and plunge it into the Garden—straight into the bones of Sui.

scene_ro5_rest1_enter.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest1_enter.description: Traversing the Garden to see its sights inevitably leads to tired legs. This pavilion has been set up for tourists to rest and recuperate. With the breeze flitting past your face and majestic sights ahead, no matter how rugged the road ahead may be, at least you will be able to catch your breath here without worry.

scene_ro5_rest1_1.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest1_1.description: With the pavilion as your pillow, the land as your couch, and a pleasant dream, all your doubts fade away.

scene_ro5_rest1_2.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest1_2.description: A few pre-prepared meals are spread out on a stone table. Everyone gets a bowl of rice and their choice of several dishes, perfectly paired with soup and cakes. Not the most sumptuous of meals, but it's filling, enough to give you strength for the road ahead.

scene_ro5_rest1_3.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest1_3.description: You reassign duties amongst your team. This way, you can command them even more effectively.

scene_ro5_rest1_4.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest1_4.description: While you may not have much, you have all the essentials. The ceremony may be crude, but you need only to follow the steps properly and with sincerity to light a candle in your heart.

scene_ro5_rest1_5.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest1_5.description: You sit in a circle, sharing tales of your hometowns.

scene_ro5_rest1_6.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest1_6.description: By waving this flag, the Sui Regulator will promptly send backup to the designated meeting point.

scene_ro5_rest1_7.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest1_7.description: The pavilion provides emergency first aid kits for tourists to use, able to quickly handle any injury.

scene_ro5_rest1_8.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest1_8.description: The Tianshi Bureaus have developed a unique formation for Tianshis entering the Garden of Grotesqueries, allowing them to step into Sui's consciousness from several safe areas in the Garden. This is one of those areas.

scene_ro5_rest1_9.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest1_9.description: You sense your consciousness expand... ascend... break through the clouds... gaze down at the earth... like the Feranmut of eld.

scene_ro5_rest1_10.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest1_10.description: After readjusting your command style, you can easily command an even larger party.

scene_ro5_double2b_enter.title: Communication
scene_ro5_double2b_enter.description: You lift your head to see rooftop figures decorating multiple eaves of the buildings around you. These ornaments form a complex and comprehensive signaling network. When they hear specific tones, they coordinate with their companions on other eaves to transmit them to a specific place. In theory, you need only learn this 'rooftop figure code' to be able to send information all across the Garden.

scene_ro5_double2b_1.title: Communication
scene_ro5_double2b_1.description: The roars of beasts mean casualties. Beast control drones immediately start driving away the wild animals, offering their own armor plates to the victims as protection.

scene_ro5_double2b_2.title: Communication
scene_ro5_double2b_2.description: The song calls over a flock of fowlbeasts that take your Originium ingots, then return with a signal flag. Alas, it seems this love still has its price.

scene_ro5_double2b_3.title: Communication
scene_ro5_double2b_3.description: As you depart, a singing voice comes to you from afar, prompting the rooftop figures to respond with their own song. It seems these proud figures atop the eaves are the 'Tianshi Bureau successors' the old master was concerned about.

scene_ro5_double2b_4.title: Communication
scene_ro5_double2b_4.description: Upon hearing the cry of fowl, fowl-feeding machines will activate. If they happen upon someone imitating fowlcry, they will serve them a fine meal, of course.

scene_ro5_swpp_enter.title: Circled Square
scene_ro5_swpp_enter.description: Traces of humanity left over the eons are scattered across the land like tongbao. Sometimes they thrive, sometimes they decline. You look at the coins in your pouch. If you just happened to toss them, how would time change them?

scene_ro5_swpp_1.description: When you pick up the coin once more, time has imbued it with a whole new meaning. You place it in your pouch and weigh it. You're not sure why, but it seems heavier than before.

scene_ro5_swpp_5.title: Circled Square
scene_ro5_swpp_5.description: The eras of humanity flowing by have been hidden in these many tongbao. They fall into the mortal realm, jingling and jangling, and when the dust settles, they all sport a trace of divinity. You see them clearly, but you do not know what this scene looks like in the eyes of Sui.

scene_ro5_ent1_enter.title: One Player Short
scene_ro5_ent1_enter.description: A red-horned white-bodied Feranmut spurts jets of flame out of boredom. Before her is a massive table, a set of her favorite mahjong tiles set up neatly. Upon noticing your arrival, two copper giants instantly take a seat at either side of the table. She straightens excitedly, inviting you to join. 'We just need one more player, c'mon! But first things first, we each gotta add a few coins to the pot to make things interesting. Hey, what're you scared of? Think I won't pay up if you win?'

scene_ro5_ent1_1.title: One Player Short
scene_ro5_ent1_1.description: You win, and the Feranmut concedes defeat, digging around in her belly before throwing you a few crystals.

scene_ro5_ent1_2.title: One Player Short
scene_ro5_ent1_2.description: You win, and the Feranmut accepts her loss. She waves her claw about before throwing you a few strange stones.

scene_ro5_ent1_3.title: One Player Short
scene_ro5_ent1_3.description: You win, and the Feranmut honors her promise. She raises her head, and smiths you some armor with her fiery breath.

scene_ro5_ent1_4.title: One Player Short
scene_ro5_ent1_4.description: 'Another round?' The Feranmut looks at you with eager eyes.

scene_ro5_ent1_5.title: One Player Short
scene_ro5_ent1_5.description: You win, and the Feranmut scratches her head. Grabbing some soil, she forges you a treasure right then and there.

scene_ro5_ent1_6.title: One Player Short
scene_ro5_ent1_6.description: You lose, and the Feranmut smiles as she looks at you, thinking about what reward to demand from you.

scene_ro5_ent1_7.title: One Player Short
scene_ro5_ent1_7.description: You'd rather not kill time with Nian here. Upon seeing you scurry away, she falls back into despair, flicking her tail in utter boredom as she waits for another player.

scene_ro5_ent1_8.title: One Player Short
scene_ro5_ent1_8.description: 'That's it, I'm done! Screw you!' Nian sweeps the table clear with a swipe of her tail, then flies up into the sky. Her two copper companions stick their tongues out at you before falling to pieces.

scene_ro5_ent1_9.title: One Player Short
scene_ro5_ent1_9.description: After seeing your tiles, the Feranmut clearly hesitates for a moment. She turns her head, spitting out flame after flame until the area behind her is seared red-hot. Soon after, she turns back, giving you a big pile of treasure with extreme reluctance.

scene_ro5_ent1_10.title: One Player Short
scene_ro5_ent1_10.description: You win, and the Feranmut hadn't thought of what she'd give you if you did, so she lets you decide.

scene_ro5_ent1_20.title: One Player Short
scene_ro5_ent1_20.description: You win, and the Feranmut hadn't thought of what she'd give you if you did, so she lets you decide.

scene_ro5_ent1_21.title: One Player Short
scene_ro5_ent1_21.description: You win, and the Feranmut concedes defeat, digging around in her belly before throwing you a few crystals.

scene_ro5_ent1_22.title: One Player Short
scene_ro5_ent1_22.description: 'Another round?' The Feranmut looks at you with eager eyes.

scene_ro5_ent1_23.title: One Player Short
scene_ro5_ent1_23.description: 'Another round?' The Feranmut looks at you with eager eyes.

scene_ro5_ent1_24.title: One Player Short
scene_ro5_ent1_24.description: You win, and the Feranmut accepts her loss. She waves her claw about before throwing you a few strange stones.

scene_ro5_ent1_25.title: One Player Short
scene_ro5_ent1_25.description: You win, and the Feranmut honors her promise. She raises her head, and smiths you some armor with her fiery breath.

scene_ro5_ent1_26.title: One Player Short
scene_ro5_ent1_26.description: You win, and the Feranmut scratches her head. Grabbing some soil, she forges you a treasure right then and there.

scene_ro5_market_enter.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_enter.description: The brush and paper are ready. Dark ink marks the inkstone. You may be able to redefine reality a little with these.

scene_ro5_market_1.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_1.description: If there's anyone who knows what Sui ate, Yu would. You pay a small fortune to have him make you a meal, and you savor the flavor that fills your mouth.

scene_ro5_market_2.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_2.description: Whether or not further drawing makes the resemblance better or worse is not set in stone. So long as you are satisfied, then perhaps anything will do.

scene_ro5_market_3.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_3.description: After helping Ling pay her tab, she takes you out on a traipse through time. Free of fetters, you feel like you understand Sui's divine will a little better.

scene_ro5_market_4.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_4.description: Dusk takes her reward, then lifts her brush to draw a few strokes on your body. Presumably, she helped you have a physique a bit more like Sui's.

scene_ro5_market_5.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_5.description: Although mere mortals cannot hope to learn to transcend cause and effect, with Shu's guidance and several rounds of sowing and reaping, you do feel like you have a clearer understanding of Sui's essence and its immunity to entropy.

scene_ro5_market_6.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_6.description: Under Chongyue's supervision, you have this growing feeling that you are now as imposing as Sui Itself.

scene_ro5_market_7.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_7.description: Nian exhales flame as she hammers away at your body. Though you are in incredible pain, these shining scales are extremely hard... and extremely valuable.

scene_ro5_market_8.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_8.description: If there's anyone who knows what Sui ate, Yu would. You pay a small fortune to have him make you a meal, and you savor the flavor that fills your mouth.

scene_ro5_market_13.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_13.description: Nian exhales flame as she hammers away at your body. Though you are in incredible pain, these shining scales are extremely hard... and extremely valuable.

scene_ro5_market_14.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_14.description: Since you have expended your time, the taciturn lawmaker begins to speak, clarifying definitions for you. You suddenly notice a mass of floating objects by your side. These priceless objects are very likely to be the precursors to all sorts of modern geists.

scene_ro5_market_15.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_15.description: Since you have expended your time, the wandering young doctor heals your wounds. With the boundless energy coursing through your body, you perceive the life force of the Feranmut with newfound clarity.

scene_ro5_market_16.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_16.description: Since you have expended your time, the master of the Garden steadies your form. You had wanted to ask Yi if you really are impervious to harm now, but when you consider the fate of Sui, the answer is obvious.

scene_ro5_market_17.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_17.description: Since you have expended your time, the merchant in the remnant consciousness braids mane for you. After pacing about a few rounds, you really do feel what can only be described as a Feranmut's arrogance welling up in you.

scene_ro5_market_18.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_18.description: Since you have expended your time... Suddenly, a shower of weiqi stones falls from the sky, striking at your thoughts. You do not see any sight of that Sui proxy, but the fallen stones merge together, becoming a rare treasure. You may never know what gambits Wang has hidden on the board, just as how humanity could never guess at what Sui was thinking.

scene_ro5_market_19.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_19.description: Yi fetches the long, inked scroll. Each of your trips through the Garden has left behind precious marks, and the assembly of such remnants means that the Garden, even the Tomb, holds no more secrets for you, and also... that you can rouse the incomplete instrument. But whether or not you wish to take on this burden for the Sui proxies and use humanity's determination to complete the device—

scene_ro5_market_20.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_20.description: Your marks are left in the ink. Your experiences become gears, the past assembling into a structure, powering an endless search... The moment Yi hands it over to you, you seem to see countless figures. They all share a name, and by Their side, the light of flames no longer dances.

scene_ro5_market_21.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_21.description: Liu'er stands by your side, her new invention at the ready to take care of any hindrances the Hour of Sui throws your way. However... Yes, as always, you must give her something first...

scene_ro5_market_22.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_22.description: You seal the deal as you awaken the Hour. So long as you can fulfill her demands, you can rest assured as you use her new invention... probably...

scene_ro5_market_23.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_23.description: With Little Moji's help, you peel back the surface of Sui to reveal the spikes of rancor hiding beneath Its skin. They pace about by you, ready to tear apart your flesh at any moment.

scene_ro5_market_24.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_24.description: So long as you pay attention to the changes in matter, you are confident that with this monster they call 'Merciless', you will be able to perceive the influence Sui has on reality.

scene_ro5_market_25.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_25.description: Liu'er stands by your side, her new invention at the ready to take care of any hindrances the Hour of Sui throws your way. However... Yes, as always, you must give her something first...

scene_ro5_market_26.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_market_26.description: You copy Its form, you copy Its spirit, but to the Sui proxies, it is as if you tried to draw a Feline and ended up with a Perro. It's completely wrong. Maybe you can ask them to help you make some improvements.

scene_ro5_startbuff_enter.title: Operation Rewards
scene_ro5_startbuff_enter.description: Your overcame at least two floors in your last exploration. You'll be able to receive more assistance this time

scene_ro5_double1b_enter.title: Mount of Stone
scene_ro5_double1b_enter.description: This Kou-wu Hill in the Garden is also know as 'Grandfather Stone' or 'the Stone God of Riches'. A pagoda at its head, wealth laden at its middle, while its foot has deep roots within fortune itself. It sits here, never angering even if struck. Some take money from it after paying their respects, and it does not retort, even blessing them with financial fortune. Truly the temperament of a 'grandfather'. Passing Candleholders usually take a coin as well, all for good fortune.

scene_ro5_double1b_1.title: Mount of Stone
scene_ro5_double1b_1.description: Coins from Grandfather Stone's peak are called emperor coins. Utterly unique and exceptionally rare, each one is a treasure. Only when adorned with these emperor coins can it look down upon the realm.

scene_ro5_double1b_2.title: Mount of Stone
scene_ro5_double1b_2.description: Coins from Grandfather Stone's middle are called mandarin coins. Both luck and ability are required for your coin rest here. Only when surrounded by these mandarin coins can it wear its belt of jewels.

scene_ro5_double1b_3.title: Mount of Stone
scene_ro5_double1b_3.description: You're just here to see Grandfather Stone, but it's happy either way. Sunlight shines through the gaps between its stones, lighting up its eyes before falling on your body. This warm, lingering gaze always makes people want to stay a little bit longer.

scene_ro5_double1b_4.title: Mount of Stone
scene_ro5_double1b_4.description: Coins from Grandfather Stone's foot are called commoner coins. There are a great many of them, a teeming sea of money. Only with the aid of these commoner coins can Grandfather Stone lie down with stability.

scene_ro5_double3_enter.title: Stamp Collection
scene_ro5_double3_enter.description: Everywhere across the Garden are seals tourists can use to add to their stamp collections, but this one is very unique. Every time you enter the Garden, it seems to change. There was once a slacker who went in and out to get stamps, who ended up discovering only nine combinations of three primary components and three secondary. Some Candleholders are specialized seal crafters. With their help, you can decide the contents and style of the seal. First, choose the primary pattern, shaped like characters—

scene_ro5_double3_1.title: Stamp Collection
scene_ro5_double3_1.description: Next, choose the secondary pattern, also shaped like characters—

scene_ro5_double3_2.title: Stamp Collection
scene_ro5_double3_2.description: Next, choose the secondary pattern, also shaped like characters—

scene_ro5_double3_4.title: Stamp Collection
scene_ro5_double3_4.description: Once the adjustments are complete, stamp the table then turn it around. The seal will begin to shine, in accordance to the characters you chose.

scene_ro5_double3_3.title: Stamp Collection
scene_ro5_double3_3.description: Next, choose the secondary pattern, also shaped like characters—

scene_ro5_double3_5.title: Stamp Collection
scene_ro5_double3_5.description: After some tinkering, you leave the seal here, despite restoring it to its rightful state.

scene_ro5_double3_6.title: Stamp Collection
scene_ro5_double3_6.description: You examine it for a long time, but are unable to discern what is written. All you can sense is that it influences the space near you. It is a reasonable assumption that this seal stamps out a word. But these characters... Have they never been assigned meaning, or has that meaning been forgotten?

scene_ro5_double3_8.title: Stamp Collection
scene_ro5_double3_8.description: Once the adjustments are complete, stamp the table then turn it around. The seal will begin to shine, in accordance to the characters you chose.

scene_ro5_double3_7.description: Once the adjustments are complete, stamp the table then turn it around. The seal will begin to shine, in accordance to the characters you chose.

scene_ro5_double3_10.title: Stamp Collection
scene_ro5_double3_10.description: You examine it for a long time, but are unable to discern what is written. All you can sense is that it influences space far from you. It is a reasonable assumption that this seal stamps out a word. But these characters... Have they never been assigned meaning, or has that meaning been forgotten?

scene_ro5_double3_11.title: Stamp Collection
scene_ro5_double3_11.description: Once the adjustments are complete, stamp the table then turn it around. The seal will begin to shine, in accordance to the characters you chose.

scene_ro5_double3_14.description: You examine it for a long time, but are unable to discern what is written. All you can sense is that its influence can be felt everywhere. It is a reasonable assumption that this seal stamps out a word. But these characters... Have they never been assigned meaning, or has that meaning been forgotten?

scene_ro5_double3_15.title: Stamp Collection
