scene_ro5_double4_enter.title: A Bevy of Fireworks
scene_ro5_double4_enter.description: The New Year has passed, but according to custom, the Candleholders of the Garden always treat it as just around the corner, setting off fireworks in open spaces around the Garden. These fireworks fill the sky, declaring Yan's might for all to see. The sound lets evil and calamity know its time is nigh. Apparently, if someone were to empty their pockets to fund one of these shows, they would receive an imperial tongbao in return.

scene_ro5_double4_1.title: A Bevy of Fireworks
scene_ro5_double4_1.description: Everyone is grateful for your subsidy, and the Sui Regulator official delivering supplies happily slips you a coin with the True Lung's silhouette etched on it. Under a sky full of fireworks, you appreciate the coin aesthetically, and can't help but imagine how this custom has been passed down from the time of the great hunt.

scene_ro5_double4_2.title: A Bevy of Fireworks
scene_ro5_double4_2.description: Everyone pools their money and sets off some fireworks. The sky is filled with light while your ears are filled with the sounds of explosions. You cannot stop your mind from wandering. These flames, these cannon blasts... are all tightly interlinked with war.

scene_ro5_double4b_enter.title: A Bevy of Fireworks
scene_ro5_double4b_enter.description: Every New Year, the skies above Yan will be filled with the lights and sounds of fireworks... The day this custom was born was very much the same. The battlefield awash with god-hunters, throwing fire and Arts at the bestial Sui. When one warrior fell, another stepped forward to take their place, a tide unending. The True Lung decreed: 'All who gift their riches to resisting the Sui, and all who join the front lines against the Sui, shall be exempt from taxation and granted a tongbao from the True Lung himself.'

scene_ro5_double4b_1.title: A Bevy of Fireworks
scene_ro5_double4b_1.description: At the time, many families donated half, or even all, of their family fortunes to the court, and the reward they received after the hunt was far more than a simple imperial tongbao. Whether they asked for fame or wealth, Yan honored its promises. To this day, Yanese mandarins still symbolically offer these tongbao, imbued with special meaning, to organizations and individuals who offer large subsidies for these annual firework shows.

scene_ro5_double4b_2.title: A Bevy of Fireworks
scene_ro5_double4b_2.description: A hollow victory is the source of today's custom. From mourning to memorial, then to celebration. The custom may not have changed, but the meaning has shifted over time.

scene_ro5_double4b_3.title: A Bevy of Fireworks
scene_ro5_double4b_3.description: At the time, many families took to the field at once. Fathers stood shoulder-to-shoulder with sons, mothers stood in formation with daughters. With their feeble bodies, they attempted to leave a mark on their former gods.

scene_ro5_double4b_4.title: A Bevy of Fireworks
scene_ro5_double4b_4.description: Many families were wiped out and unable to receive this honor. The tongbao meant for them were melted down together and cast into Baizao's Monument of Martyrs. As for the survivors, the favor they received from Yan allowed them to pass the experience and skills they learned resisting the Feranmuts on to the next generation. Thus was the Sui Regulator founded.

scene_ro5_double4b_5.title: A Bevy of Fireworks
scene_ro5_double4b_5.description: The pain from that war has long since faded, but its effects are still benefiting Yan. Who knows if, millennia into the future, the people of Yan will still remember the blood shed by martyrs to pay for their prosperity, as they light fireworks and gaze at the sky.

scene_ro5_double4b_6.title: A Bevy of Fireworks
scene_ro5_double4b_6.description: Today, the field is littered with fragments of spent fireworks, just as the battlefield of eld was littered with corpses.

scene_ro5_double5_enter.title: Concentricity
scene_ro5_double5_enter.description: A set of concentric jade spheres, made with the finest craftsmanship, lies before you, each layer as thin as a cicada's wing. It seems there is something at the center of these multitudinous layers.

scene_ro5_double5_1.title: Concentricity
scene_ro5_double5_1.description: The horizon sphere slowly begins to rotate. You pick up a shattered piece of tile off the ground as a memento before jumping out. You examine it carefully afterward, learning that it was ground out using a crystal. Maybe you can ward something off with it by your side.

scene_ro5_double5_2.title: Concentricity
scene_ro5_double5_2.description: With a jade hairpin, you tinker with the spheres for an exceedingly long time before you espy the wonder within: at its very heart lies a bead of crystal, wholly transparent. Within is carved an entire village. You observe each and every minute detail, but once you lift your head, you realize you are now within it.

scene_ro5_double5_3.title: Concentricity
scene_ro5_double5_3.description: With Raidian taking the lead, you cautiously explore the village. After learning of the villagers' aggression, she tries to find a way to leave without causing conflict. However, while you are exploring, you are noticed by them.

scene_ro5_double5_4.title: Concentricity
scene_ro5_double5_4.description: You walk forward a few steps before running into some villagers, but the moment they see you, it's like they have encountered their nemesis. Their leader whistles, and soon, every living thing in the village is running your way.

scene_ro5_double5_5.title: Concentricity
scene_ro5_double5_5.description: Raidian soon returns bearing gifts. With her negotiating, the villagers saw you differently and offered to help you out. Speaking to them reveals a tale that they repeat over and over: this land is a utopia that once occupied their every waking thought. Aside from the god that sent them here, only 'intruders' would come in from outside. Eventually, you escape from the concentric spheres, but the reason behind all this the villagers spoke of leaves you puzzled for a very long time.

scene_ro5_double5_6.title: Concentricity
scene_ro5_double5_6.description: The horizon sphere slowly begins to rotate. If you jump out right away, you won't come to any harm aside from a slight stumble outside... After a few more minutes of rotating, the crystal bead is enveloped under a multitude of layers once more, its secrets forever hidden from your prying eyes.

scene_ro5_double5b_enter.title: Concentricity
scene_ro5_double5b_enter.description: A set of concentric jade spheres, made with the finest craftsmanship, lies before you, each layer as thin as a cicada's wing. It seems there is something alive at the center of these multitudinous layers. This is Yi's creation, so you decide to examine it carefully.

scene_ro5_double5b_1.title: Concentricity
scene_ro5_double5b_1.description: The villagers are astonished when they see your figure and smell your scent, prostrating themselves on the greenstone road one after the other as they offer you their local produce. When you advise them to leave, they all adamantly refuse. They recognize that they have found a utopia where they are eternally hidden from the fires of war, and are especially grateful for the benevolence of their 'god'. They kindly decline your offer, and request you do not speak of this place to anyone. 'This is our shared dream,' says the head elder.

scene_ro5_double5b_2.title: Concentricity
scene_ro5_double5b_2.description: After some rotation, you see a village within the crystal bead. The four seasons turn, alongside day and night. The people living within are content, without a hint of doubt or worry. For a moment, you are unsure if this is blessing or punishment.

scene_ro5_double5b_3.title: Concentricity
scene_ro5_double5b_3.description: Raidian steps into the town without hesitation, acting according to your instructions.

scene_ro5_double5b_4.title: Concentricity
scene_ro5_double5b_4.description: After you decide to stop interfering, the concentric spheres slowly rotate, enveloping the village and its people once more. After much pondering, you finally understand that what sustains the bead is the villager's collective consciousness. That is to say, if they do not wish to leave, the spheres will 'protect' them for all eternity.

scene_ro5_double5b_5.title: Concentricity
scene_ro5_double5b_5.description: Raidian returns with a box of supplies, and tells you the truth behind the village: several families founded it in a remote location to escape the fires of war. Although outsiders rarely came by, the fear they inspired in the villagers was inescapable. They wanted to live somewhere peaceful where they would never be disturbed, and a treasure-hunting 'god' answered their prayers. They offered him their ancient houseware, and in return, he granted them this exquisite apparatus to live in for generations to come.

scene_ro5_bat1_enter.title: Duck Guardian
scene_ro5_bat1_enter.description: This Ursus only ever says he's here on his boss's business, and refuses to answer any other questions. Doesn't matter who his boss is, or if he even has one, he shouldn't be loitering in the Garden.

scene_ro5_bat1_1.title: Duck Guardian
scene_ro5_bat1_1.description: You give him a big hint, but he doesn't move. You start moving his legs for him, and he raises a fist.

scene_ro5_bat1_2.title: Duck Guardian
scene_ro5_bat1_2.description: You start with the pushing right away, so he raises his fist right away.

scene_ro5_bat1_3.title: Duck Guardian
scene_ro5_bat1_3.description: Being able to stay in the Garden at a time like this probably means he has some obscure connection to the imperial court or Yi himself. Since he refuses to leave no matter what, then if he's attacked by geists, it's not your problem.

scene_ro5_bat2_enter.title: Nimble Perro Thief
scene_ro5_bat2_enter.description: This Perro keeps trying to cry his eyes out on the down-low, but that doesn't stop his hands and feet from being mighty nimble. Something's off, real off!

scene_ro5_bat2_1.title: Nimble Perro Thief
scene_ro5_bat2_1.description: He runs as soon as you look at him. He must've stolen something from the Garden!

scene_ro5_bat2_2.title: Nimble Perro Thief
scene_ro5_bat2_2.description: You patiently try to calm him, but didn't expect him to keep whimpering as he sticks to you like glue. His sobbing startles the geists in the area as it gets louder, and they surround you. It seems this time, you have gone from being the hunter to being the hunted...

scene_ro5_bat2_3.title: Nimble Perro Thief
scene_ro5_bat2_3.description: Everything has its reason, but some reasons... aren't worth knowing. Curiosity killed the Feline and all, y'know.

scene_ro5_bat3_enter.title: Rotund God of Wealth
scene_ro5_bat3_enter.description: Why is someone trying to get people to sign up for his investment scheme in the Garden of Grotesqueries... and why's he trying to get the geists in on it?! What the hell does this Zalak think he's doing?!

scene_ro5_bat3_1.title: Rotund God of Wealth
scene_ro5_bat3_1.description: The Zalak seems to know what he's up to isn't in line with the Laws of Yan, so he calls for his bodyguards.

scene_ro5_bat3_2.title: Rotund God of Wealth
scene_ro5_bat3_2.description: There's definitely a big crime syndicate behind him, so you give him a down payment, preparing to pull them out by the roots. Shame that when he brought you to an Ursus guy, your scheme was exposed.

scene_ro5_bat3_3.title: Rotund God of Wealth
scene_ro5_bat3_3.description: Even if it did work out for him, where was he going to hawk his goods? Best not get involved in stuff that might end up complicated.

scene_ro5_bat3_4.title: Rotund God of Wealth
scene_ro5_bat3_4.description: Raidian steps up and has a chat with him, getting one of his free gifts without a hitch. You give it a try. Doesn't taste half bad.

scene_ro5_bat4_enter.title: Ducking Emperor
scene_ro5_bat4_enter.description: A duck swims amidst statues, artifacts, and geists, going on and on about his 'grand' dream of transforming this place into the most popular tourist spot ever: more entertainment facilities, more singers and dancers and actors, and even more interactive stuff... This really is...

scene_ro5_bat4_1.title: Ducking Emperor
scene_ro5_bat4_1.description: Just as you are about to attack, the duck suddenly stuffs a bundle of coupons into your hand, as if trying to insinuate he has a connection with Yi. Considering he was so kind as to give them to you, you decide to let him off the hook for now.

scene_ro5_bat4_2.title: Ducking Emperor
scene_ro5_bat4_2.description: You've run into the duck's underlings before, and you've seen how easily he lies to the people here. You can't let him escape.

scene_ro5_bat4_3.title: Ducking Emperor
scene_ro5_bat4_3.description: You don't know why, but all of a sudden, you feel like what he says sounds real feasible. 'Paradise Garden' is a one-of-a-kind idea, and you join his army of investors.

scene_ro5_bat4_4.title: Ducking Emperor
scene_ro5_bat4_4.description: Oho, the duck's lackeys are all here too, alongside a bunch of geists running amok. Time to settle all our debts, here and now. None of them are getting away.

scene_ro5_bat5_enter.title: She Witnesses
scene_ro5_bat5_enter.description: Here, a life-sized statue of an Anasa is enshrined, her bearing solemn, her eyes shut tight. In front of the statue, there is a delicate sacrificial altar, adorned with an incense burner and several varieties of fruit, all alluring.

scene_ro5_bat5_1.title: She Witnesses
scene_ro5_bat5_1.description: The noise you make as you eat the offering rouses the 'statue', and the Anasa Bodhisattva sees your shameful behavior as soon as she opens her eyes. She smiles without anger as she waves her hand, sending a gust of black wind to scoop you up. Only once you have received your punishment will you be able to leave.

scene_ro5_bat5_2.title: She Witnesses
scene_ro5_bat5_2.description: Despite your riches, you still yearn for even rarer things. You climb up on the altar, unable to stop your obsession with the gleaming crown. But as your hand arcs through the air, the 'statue' awakens. She grabs your arm, then tosses you into a black wind soon after. You cannot tell where you are or where you are headed, the only sound you can hear a stern voice by your side: 'The greedy must be punished!'

scene_ro5_bat5_3.title: She Witnesses
scene_ro5_bat5_3.description: Whether Anasa Bodhisattvas or Tianshis of Yan, all worthy of being immortalized as a statue are erudites of profound learning. You respectfully pray for a blessing, then leave. Not long after, the 'statue' languidly awakens, dropping to the floor to stretch her limbs. After finishing her lunch atop the 'sacrificial altar', she returns to her bed to continue her contemplation.

scene_ro5_pick1_enter.title: 'Big Bob's Chain'
scene_ro5_pick1_enter.description: A Westerner has come to open up a shop, even writing his name out in Yanese. His only salesperson is a strange man covered in writhing tentacles, and their most popular service is moneylending... You can't get any more ridiculous than this.

scene_ro5_pick1_1.title: 'Big Bob's Chain'
scene_ro5_pick1_1.description: Cannot withdraws the money straight from the front desk, then hands it to you alongside a certificate, no collateral or guarantees needed. It seems there really are still things this good upon this land.

scene_ro5_pick1_2.title: 'Big Bob's Chain'
scene_ro5_pick1_2.description: From what you've heard, this shopkeeper 'whose name is Bob and whose surname is Big' has made many contributions to the business world in the West, and is now in the process of giving his store a local Yanese flavor. You know businesses in the West have a tradition of putting their owner's full name in their brand... but... 'Big Bob's Chain'... You're not sure which particular smarty-pants racked their brains to think up such a 'fine' name for him...

scene_ro5_pick1_3.title: 'Big Bob's Chain'
scene_ro5_pick1_3.description: You have heard of this man named Cannot, and you are unsure why he has shed his usual miserly demeanor and become so generous. The tin-can man is always willing to be pragmatic, and it seems this isn't his money anyway. Cannot quickly prepares your money and a certificate, sliding it over to you on a small tray.

scene_ro5_bat6_enter.title: Yaksha Collector
scene_ro5_bat6_enter.description: Oh, it's Cannot. You know him, the man who runs his own store while also working at 'Big Bob's Chain'. He's coming right for you... and you know what he wants...

scene_ro5_bat6_1.title: Yaksha Collector
scene_ro5_bat6_1.description: As a reward for your prompt repayment of the loan, Cannot gives you a tongbao imprinted with his portrait. Printing your own face upon coinage is not allowed by the imperial court, but since he might give you big discounts from now on... You decide to turn a blind eye.

scene_ro5_bat6_2.title: Yaksha Collector
scene_ro5_bat6_2.description: Since you decided to feign ignorance, Cannot does not feel the need to be polite with you. He has plenty of experience handling this sort of thing.

scene_ro5_bat6_3.title: Yaksha Collector
scene_ro5_bat6_3.description: After a few more pleasantries, Cannot returns to the shop. Whether he meant 'Big Bob's Chain' or his own little store, you do not know.

scene_ro5_bat6_4.title: Yaksha Collector
scene_ro5_bat6_4.description: As a reward for your prompt repayment of the loan, Cannot gives you a tongbao imprinted with his portrait. Printing your own face upon coinage is not allowed by the imperial court, but since he might give you big discounts from now on... You decide to turn a blind eye.

scene_ro5_bat7_enter.title: Garden of Harvest
scene_ro5_bat7_enter.description: During the Hundred Clan Rebellion, there was a hardworking peasant who tended his land all day long while his wife took their produce to sell in town, always fetching a good price. Upon seeing the quality of the land's yield, the local lord decided to seize it by force, driving the couple to their deaths and claiming it for himself. The next day, the crops broke through the soil, sending clods of dirt flying into the sky as the lord's entire family was swallowed up alive. Ever since, the crops took up hoes to plow and plant themselves, to this very day.

scene_ro5_bat7_1.title: Garden of Harvest
scene_ro5_bat7_1.description: Relics from the Hundred Clan Rebellion will definitely fetch a good price.

scene_ro5_bat7_2.title: Garden of Harvest
scene_ro5_bat7_2.description: The fruit this field bears is no doubt of highest quality.

scene_ro5_bat7_3.title: Garden of Harvest
scene_ro5_bat7_3.description: In that age, holding onto your family's land was not easy. Farmers treated their fields like their children, and in return, those fields were filial to the farmers. But ever since that day, where could these wandering geists go but the Garden of Grotesqueries?

scene_ro5_bat10_enter.title: Natural Redoubt
scene_ro5_bat10_enter.description: The Garden of Grotesqueries contains examples of every scenic sight you might see in Yan, so naturally that includes a place as remote and rugged as this. A moment of carelessness will send you plummeting off the cliff to your doom. To step on this road requires only courage, but to pass requires luck as well.

scene_ro5_bat10_1.title: Natural Redoubt
scene_ro5_bat10_1.description: You'll be able to save a lot of time going this way. Even if there are Durins trying to barge past you, so long as you walk true and look neither forward nor back, there is nothing to worry about.

scene_ro5_bat10_2.title: Natural Redoubt
scene_ro5_bat10_2.description: The rugged path has become utter chaos with the addition of photographers and Durins. The reason why old folks always say 'rough roads are hard to cross' is because narrow spaces are natural haunt spots for geists. The slightest hint of trouble can leave them with a mighty bloodthirst.

scene_ro5_bat10_3.title: Natural Redoubt
scene_ro5_bat10_3.description: The mission comes first. You look down into the bottomless ravine, then silently leave.

scene_ro5_bat10_4.title: Natural Redoubt
scene_ro5_bat10_4.description: There is a small signal flag left behind by the Sui Regulator on the cliffside walkway. You wave it, calling over one of your retainers.

scene_ro5_res1_enter.title: Seclusion
scene_ro5_res1_enter.description: Wild beasts—or rather, things shaped like beasts—are frolicking about the periphery of the Garden. Stone fowl are chased by literal cloudbeasts into the sky, while wooden burdenbeasts chew on fodder as they gaze at the copper fins in the pond. These creatures do not fear humans, some even greeting acquaintances with a nuzzle and a cry for food. Most of your team has been charmed by these friendly creatures. Maybe you can relax a bit too.

scene_ro5_res1_1.title: Seclusion
scene_ro5_res1_1.description: You spend some time playing with these fearless beasts. Were you not on an important mission, maybe you could have spent the entire afternoon here.

scene_ro5_res1_2.title: Seclusion
scene_ro5_res1_2.description: The animals seem to really like Raidian, gathering by her side. You lean over to stroke the adorable beasts. If you were not on an important mission, maybe you could have spent the entire afternoon here.

scene_ro5_res1_3.title: Seclusion
scene_ro5_res1_3.description: You frolic about with a peculiar beast, feeding it and rubbing its back. At least, until it ambles off, spitting out an inkstick as a gift before dissipating into the mist... It is only then that you realize it was no animal, but an ink spirit. Maybe you should count yourself lucky it didn't swallow you whole.

scene_ro5_res3_enter.title: Taotie Veranda
scene_ro5_res3_enter.description: There was once a strange beast in the southwest that feared the strong but harried the weak. Its greed was insatiable, until it was brought to heel by a hero who forced it to devour its own body, killing it amidst the mountains. Over time, this avatar of greed has taken on a new form, becoming an auspice of wealth carved everywhere. The most famous of these carvings is located in this long, open corridor in the Garden. Countless visitors pass through here, not only to pray for infinite wealth, but for the chance to chance upon priceless coins.

scene_ro5_res3_1.title: Taotie Veranda
scene_ro5_res3_1.description: Greed can never be stopped. You pick up the coin, but find yourself wanting more, and more, and more and more and more... This ever-growing desire is the geist corridor's favorite food.

scene_ro5_res3_3.title: Taotie Veranda
scene_ro5_res3_3.description: Strange matters most certainly involve geists. According to the Sui Regulator's recommendation, best not to come into contact with them.

scene_ro5_res3_2.title: Taotie Veranda
scene_ro5_res3_2.description: When there are no visitors around, the corridor seems more generous than usual. A few steps in and you can already see new coins scattered about. It appears it really wants you to take a coin with you.

scene_ro5_res4_enter.title: Rites of Flame
scene_ro5_res4_enter.description: The pavilion before you is full of dust, but marks on the floor tiles and candle wax atop the boards are signs of past use. When the Garden first came to be, the Sui Regulator and the Tianshi Bureaus had joint supervision. When the Candleholders and Tianshis completed the rite, they would often come here to rest. And so it is here that they first ascended and touched upon the borders of Sui's consciousness, which also marked a great leap in Yan's Feranmutology research.

scene_ro5_res4_1.title: Rites of Flame
scene_ro5_res4_1.description: Candles have been used as light sources since ancient Yan, the carriers of fire, and are important tools in the Sui Regulator's rites. Zuo Le lights a candle, and directs everyone's attention to its flame. The wispy smoke is faint, while the flame is steady, detaching the mind from the body and allowing one to sense outside influences upon their souls. With this preparation, they will retain their sense of self when taking on the name of Sui and ascending into the sky.

scene_ro5_res4_2.title: Rites of Flame
scene_ro5_res4_2.description: After a short rest, everyone gets back on the road.

scene_ro5_res4_3.title: Rites of Flame
scene_ro5_res4_3.description: The Arts Tianshis once used to battle the Feranmuts have become a vector through which Feranmuts can be understood. Leizi waves her sword to call upon lightning, lighting a brazier to expel the frigid air. The blaze burns fierce, and it grows fiercer by the second, as if it wants to engulf the entire building and everyone within it. If one can bear the might of nature, they will retain their sense of self when ascending beyond the clouds.

scene_ro5_relic1_enter.title: All Are Welcome
scene_ro5_relic1_enter.description: You see a stall off in the distance, surrounded by a massive and varied crowd of statues made of clay, stone, porcelain, and iron. The young Liberi manning the stall is selling them small silk bags. She spots you, then starts hawking her wares to you as you pass by: 'It's rare to see bigshots from the Sui Regulator here! How about a bag? You can find stuff that's pretty rare outside the Garden in them!'

scene_ro5_relic1_1.title: All Are Welcome
scene_ro5_relic1_1.description: You open the bag and examine the treasure within, stuffing it into your backpack soon after. The statues do not seem to fear humans, and to your surprise, they gather around you to ask how certain members of the Sui Regulator are doing. Some of the names they mention include higher-ups, while still more are members long since passed. Perhaps the only ones who still remember their smiling faces are these creations that time has no hold upon.

scene_ro5_relic1_2.title: All Are Welcome
scene_ro5_relic1_2.description: You wave your hand and the young Liberi stops bothering you, returning to her business with the statues.

scene_ro5_relic1_3.title: All Are Welcome
scene_ro5_relic1_3.description: You open the big bag, showing the statues the treasures within. As they discuss their thoughts on the relics, the young Liberi prepares a new big bag as she chats with you. Once, she was a peddler outside the Garden's walls, but now she comes and goes as she follows her two-pronged business strategy. When the Garden is open, she sells 'souvenirs' to visitors, but when it is closed, she sells human goods to the Garden's residents. As for the money she makes... You notice her tossing tongbao into her mouth like crackers.

scene_ro5_portal2_enter.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portal2_enter.description: One can see wooden pillars shaped like nails or rules all across the Garden, drained of all color. Their influence can be seen in their monochrome surroundings. One need only stand within this zone to lose your grip on your senses, and for your consciousness to transcend your body. If you take it one step further—

scene_ro5_portal2_1.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portal2_1.description: You sense your consciousness expand... ascend... break through the clouds... gaze down at the earth... like the Feranmut of eld.

scene_ro5_portal2_2.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portal2_2.description: A candle is lit. One of your retainers is prepared to watch the candle.

scene_ro5_portal2_3.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portal2_3.description: You should not enter strange places when not adequately prepared.

scene_ro5_portal2_4.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portal2_4.description: Through the combined power of the Sui proxies, you see the imagined awakening of a god within the ever-spinning instrument.

scene_ro5_portal3_enter.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portal3_enter.description: One can see wooden pillars shaped like nails or rules all across the Garden, drained of all color. Their influence can be seen in their monochrome surroundings. scene_ro5_portal4_4.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portal4_4.description: Through the combined power of the Sui proxies, you see the imagined awakening of a god within the ever-spinning instrument.

scene_ro5_res5a_enter.title: Lone Angler
scene_ro5_res5a_enter.description: The river's surface is calm, and an old man sits at the shore, angling. His bamboo basket is empty, and there is no bait upon his hook, but it seems that is no obstacle to always having a catch on the line. Seeing you approach, he offers you a seat. 'This angling of mine attracts no fins. When the hook is cast, it is myself that I catch.' Seeing the doubt on your face, he offers you the rod. 'If you do not believe, why not try it yourself? The first cast will need bait. Do you have anything suitable?'

scene_ro5_res5a_1.title: Lone Angler
scene_ro5_res5a_1.description: The old man kneads the coupon into a ball and wedges it on the hook. You throw out the line, and feel yourself lurch as everything spins around you. It is at this moment that you learn what 'angling to catch yourself' means.

scene_ro5_res5a_2.title: Lone Angler
scene_ro5_res5a_2.description: You have important matters to attend to, and should not dilly-dally here. You bid farewell to the old man and leave.

scene_ro5_res5a_3.title: Lone Angler
scene_ro5_res5a_3.description: Raidian takes out some candy she has on her, which the old man wedges onto the hook. You throw out the line, and feel yourself lurch as everything spins around you. It is at this moment that you learn what 'angling to catch yourself' means.

scene_ro5_wait1_enter.title: Liu'er
scene_ro5_wait1_enter.description: Liu'er is a minor official at the Sui Regulator's Chamber of Geists, whose main duty is to analyze and conduct R&D on all sorts of geists and ceremonial devices for your party. She has pacified many waregeists, using them to further her exploration and renovation of the Garden to great effect. But as for actually using her inventions, which have received mixed reviews... You have your reservations. They always cost a pretty penny... Oh, she's here... What's that chunk of wood she's holding?

scene_ro5_wait1_1.title: Liu'er
scene_ro5_wait1_1.description: After obediently handing over the money, she tells you this geist will work best in Sui's consciousness. She can't say what kind of effect it would have, but since you've already taken it... Well, we'll see it when we see it.

scene_ro5_wait1_2.title: Liu'er
scene_ro5_wait1_2.description: One person who once accepted one of Liu'er's geists goes blind during the day, while another could only taste garlic from then on. To avoid any potential disaster, you tactfully decline her offer.

scene_ro5_camp2_enter.title: Hall of Candles
scene_ro5_camp2_enter.description: This building near the entrance of the Garden is a place where Yanese tourists pay their respects and pray for good luck. They light joss sticks and candles to pray, leaving rising spirals of smoke when they leave. But when the Garden closes, this becomes the headquarters of the Sui Regulator's Garden Management. Under candles from all across Yan, Candleholders light their own candles to reaffirm their commitment to their duty and rekindle their spirits.

scene_ro5_camp2_1.title: Hall of Candles
scene_ro5_camp2_1.description: After gazing at the candlelight for a long while, you leave.

scene_ro5_camp2_2.title: Hall of Candles
scene_ro5_camp2_2.description: The bestial Sui will awaken. Crystalized rage drips from the spike, idling by emotion's side, waiting for the moment to crush your heart.

scene_ro5_camp2_3.title: Hall of Candles
scene_ro5_camp2_3.description: So long as you pay attention to the shifts in mood, you are confident that with this monster they call 'ceaseless', you will be able to perceive the principles behind Sui's ability to transcend causality.

scene_ro5_end2_enter.title: The Finishing Stroke
scene_ro5_end2_enter.description: The Sui Regulator's ceremony should have ended at Jianzi Shrine, but you pass through the hall and set foot on Yi's heavenly stairway, descending into the bowels of the earth until you reach the Tomb of Sui. Around you is scattered rubble resembling displaced characters and discarded blocks of type. You take out the enigma left by Wang, and toss it into the mausoleum.

scene_ro5_end2_1.title: The Finishing Stroke
scene_ro5_end2_1.description: The weiqi board amidst clouds as heaven, the blocks of type as the earth. Warp and weft meets longitude and latitude, complementing one another, and creating another entrance into the Tomb besides its great gate. Thoughts ungrounded are confused, ideals unactioned are vacuous. You must enter this place that refuses humanity, and record what transpires here.

scene_ro5_sala2_enter.title: Heroes of Nanwu
scene_ro5_sala2_enter.description: This arena comes from the martial arts ring in the middle of Nanwu City's bazaar. Nanwu has been a trade hub since ancient times, and has nurtured many families of martial artists and escorts. In order to claim first place at the annual Gathering of Heroes, every martial arts school and escort agency sent their most skilled disciples to compete. Nowadays, even though the competition has taken on more pageantry, the Gathering of Heroes is still the embodiment of the martial spirit of the Nanwu people.

scene_ro5_sala2_1.title: Heroes of Nanwu
scene_ro5_sala2_1.description: Since it is the Gathering of Heroes, there are not only singles here. Find a good partner, and step into the arena.

scene_ro5_sala2_2.title: Heroes of Nanwu
scene_ro5_sala2_2.description: You have important matters to attend to, and it'd be better not to get mixed up with this rowdy crowd.

scene_ro5_sala2_3.title: Heroes of Nanwu
scene_ro5_sala2_3.description: Before ascending to the arena, candles are lit before a grand audience of your peers. It is clear how solemn this competition will be. The victor will be acclaimed by the entire city; the loser will slink off in the darkness.

scene_ro5_rest3_enter.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest3_enter.description: Traversing the Garden to see its sights inevitably leads to tired legs. This pavilion has been set up for tourists to rest and recuperate. With the breeze flitting past your face and majestic sights ahead, no matter how rugged the road ahead may be, at least you will be able to catch your breath here without worry.

scene_ro5_rest3_1.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest3_1.description: With the pavilion as your pillow, the land as your couch, and a pleasant dream, all your doubts fade away.

scene_ro5_rest3_2.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest3_2.description: A few pre-prepared meals are spread out on a stone table. Everyone gets a bowl of rice and their choice of several dishes, perfectly paired with soup and cakes. Not the most sumptuous of meals, but it's filling, enough to give you strength for the road ahead.

scene_ro5_rest3_3.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest3_3.description: You reassign duties amongst your team. This way, you can command them even more effectively.

scene_ro5_rest3_4.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest3_4.description: While you may not have much, you have all the essentials. The ceremony may be crude, but you need only to follow the steps properly and with sincerity to light a candle in your heart.

scene_ro5_rest3_5.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest3_5.description: You sit in a circle, sharing tales of your hometowns.

scene_ro5_rest3_6.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest3_6.description: By waving this flag, the Sui Regulator will promptly send backup to the designated meeting point.

scene_ro5_rest3_7.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest3_7.description: The pavilion provides emergency first aid kits for tourists to use, able to quickly handle any injury.

scene_ro5_rest3_8.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest3_8.description: The Tianshi Bureaus have developed a unique formation for Tianshis entering the Garden of Grotesqueries, allowing them to step into Sui's consciousness from several safe areas in the Garden. This is one of those areas.

scene_ro5_rest3_9.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest3_9.description: You sense your consciousness expand... ascend... break through the clouds... gaze down at the earth... like the Feranmut of eld.

scene_ro5_rest3_10.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest3_10.description: After readjusting your command style, you can easily command an even larger party.

scene_ro5_rest4_10.description: After readjusting your command style, you can easily command an even larger party.

scene_ro5_trash0_enter.title: View
scene_ro5_trash0_enter.description: Your body is as Sui's, your eyes looking towards the earth. Of all the things between the four corners of the land, what do you espy?

scene_ro5_trash0_1.title: View
scene_ro5_trash0_1.description: Sight begets thought, thought begets desire, desire begets matter, matter begets sight.

scene_ro5_trash0_2.title: View
scene_ro5_trash0_2.description: With eyes shut and unseeing, even the truth shall become nothingness.

scene_ro5_trash0_3.title: View
scene_ro5_trash0_3.description: As the fire dies and the embers diminish, things have changed, forms have warped.

scene_ro5_trash0_4.title: View
scene_ro5_trash0_4.description: As the fire dies and the embers diminish, nothing seems to have changed.

scene_ro5_bosslokk_enter.title: A Game of Weiqi
scene_ro5_bosslokk_enter.description: The whole of Yan split horizontally and vertically, divided by nineteen against nineteen lines, where truth and lie, black and white meet. The entirety of the land bound within a square. Before you arrived, Liu'er had been studying the board for quite a while via the elm butterfly. Unfortunately, she has only a passing understanding of weiqi, so she has not seen the secrets of this board. You look at it, noticing the game has only just started. This is obviously one of the tricks Wang left in the Garden, and the opponent he has chosen this time is you.

scene_ro5_bosslokk_1.title: A Game of Weiqi
scene_ro5_bosslokk_1.description: Playing a game against the one who set up this mysterious game in the first place? Without even thinking, you flip the board. It spins through the air, each revolution revealing the strategy against you: one that lives amongst the mountains but is still obsessed with the battle atop the board shall never become his successor. Only by playing a strange move will there be space for the next step. The board clatters to the ground, revealing another grid of lines. A set of movable type, in its center a block of type with 'Ji' and 'Ye' carved onto it.

scene_ro5_bosslokk_2.title: A Game of Weiqi
scene_ro5_bosslokk_2.description: You decide to take the board and movable type, slowly playing a game with a player unseen.

scene_ro5_bosslokk_3.title: A Game of Weiqi
scene_ro5_bosslokk_3.description: After a hundred moves, the board suddenly shatters, leaving behind only a treasure in its center and a floor covered in splinters. Victory had not been decided yet. Perhaps he had gotten tired of you, or perhaps the moment you placed that stone, you lost your right to continue, having been utterly defeated.

scene_ro5_heaven1_enter.title: Amber
scene_ro5_heaven1_enter.description: A giant chunk of amber juts out of the shoreline of the eastern sea. Men cannot approach it, storms cannot shift it. It follows a cycle of four hundred years in a day: a hundred years of spewing smoke, a hundred years of tears, a hundred years of twisted scars, then a hundred years encased in stone, before it loops back around again.

scene_ro5_heaven1_1.title: Amber
scene_ro5_heaven1_1.description: By fire burned, by water drowned, by metal scarred, by earth buried. Every four hundred years, a three-legged fowlchick perches atop an uncracked egg.

scene_ro5_heaven1_2.title: Amber
scene_ro5_heaven1_2.description: In great amber's bones of stone, a universe of its own.

scene_ro5_heaven1_3.title: Amber
scene_ro5_heaven1_3.description: A strange piece of curious rock, thousands of years without shift or shock.

scene_ro5_heaven1_4.title: Amber
scene_ro5_heaven1_4.description: In great amber's bones of stone, a universe of its own.

scene_ro5_heaven3_enter.title: Butterfly of Elm
scene_ro5_heaven3_enter.description: A butterfly made of elmwood stops not too far from you, its front feet clinging tightly to an inkstick. You assume it to be one of the Garden's geists, but it opens its mouth, and you hear Liu'er's voice. She has finished researching Shuo's military treatise. According to her, this inkstick can be used 'to remember the forgotten and reveal vestiges of the past'. But only once she has flown to your side does she realize she forgot to finish carving the inkstick. Though she can use the butterfly to do so, the expenses... Even one as wealthy as she would balk at the price.

scene_ro5_heaven3_1.title: Butterfly of Elm
scene_ro5_heaven3_1.description: The elm butterfly uses its mouthparts to carve a coiled Sui into the inkstick. The moment the eyes are carved, the 'bestial Sui' sheds its inky form and soars into the sky, while the butterfly etches itself into the ink. Soon, you have an undamaged inkstick. Half a day of tinkering about, and this is the result? You have no idea what Liu'er even did. You look at the 'Sui' gathering Its strength at the horizon's edge, and your heart shudders.

scene_ro5_heaven3_2.title: Butterfly of Elm
scene_ro5_heaven3_2.description: The Sui Regulator are sticklers for the rules, and Liu'er's rash actions will not do. But you also know she is a stubborn one, and after hearing her incessant 'pleading', you decide to use whatever you have left on hand to help her out, and seize this opportunity for the sake of her research.

scene_ro5_heaven3_3.title: Butterfly of Elm
scene_ro5_heaven3_3.description: The Sui Regulator are sticklers for the rules, and Liu'er's rash actions will not do. You remove the Sui Regulator's badge from the butterfly, protecting that foolish girl's spirit and sending her safely back to the surface. Research and breakthroughs aren't necessities, after all. Her mind cannot be allowed to get lost here.

scene_ro5_heaven3_4.title: Butterfly of Elm
scene_ro5_heaven3_4.description: Though the elm butterfly stalls a few times, it is ultimately able to carve a coiled Sui into the inkstick. The moment the eyes are carved, the 'bestial Sui' sheds its inky form and soars into the sky, while the butterfly etches itself into the ink. Soon, you have an undamaged inkstick. Half a day of tinkering about, and this is the result? You have no idea what Liu'er even did. You look at the 'Sui' gathering Its strength at the horizon's edge, and your heart shudders.

scene_ro5_heaven3_5.title: Butterfly of Elm
scene_ro5_heaven3_5.description: The Sui Regulator are sticklers for the rules, and Liu'er's rash actions will not do. But you also know she is a stubborn one, and after hearing her incessant 'pleading', you decide to use whatever you have left on hand to help her out, and seize this opportunity for the sake of her research.

scene_ro5_heaven4_enter.title: Advice
scene_ro5_heaven4_enter.description: A Feranmut flies towards you, with scales of teal and a mane of pink. Where he passes, clouds gather and rains concentrate, interweaving into a canopy. Upon the ground, plants grow with wild abandon, as if carved beams stretching out to touch the clouds. All things, whether natural or artificial, take on new forms when by his side. He circles about for a while before landing in front of you. When he speaks, he speaks with the words of man, asking if you require his aid. You hear not the voice of a stranger, but that of the master of the Garden of Grotesqueries.

scene_ro5_heaven4_1.title: Advice
scene_ro5_heaven4_1.description: A cloud that turned into a fowlbeast alights atop his horn for a moment, swiftly metamorphosing once more into a pondfin before slipping away into the waters crowding the sky. He can use external tools to help you stay here, and also teach you ways to slow the banishment of your consciousness back to the surface. Of course, you have to give something.

scene_ro5_heaven4_2.title: Advice
scene_ro5_heaven4_2.description: He has never been good at bargaining, so naturally, he does not understand the need for haggling. However, what kind of person would walk up and ask for half of someone else's money?

scene_ro5_heaven4_3.title: Advice
scene_ro5_heaven4_3.description: He has never been good at bargaining, so naturally, he does not understand the need for haggling. However, what kind of person would walk up and ask for something so illusory?

scene_ro5_heaven4_4.title: Advice
scene_ro5_heaven4_4.description: The pondfin that swam away earlier suddenly returns, transforming into a ring before your very eyes and slipping onto your finger. You feel your thoughts become much clearer.

scene_ro5_heaven4_5.title: Advice
scene_ro5_heaven4_5.description: Although he wishes to render you assistance, he is still a Sui proxy. You cannot risk beseeching him for aid, and you absolutely cannot fulfill his unreasonable requests.

scene_ro5_heaven4_6.title: Advice
scene_ro5_heaven4_6.description: He has never been good at bargaining, so naturally, he does not understand the need for haggling. However, what kind of person would walk up and ask for something so illusory?

scene_ro5_heaven4_7.title: Advice
scene_ro5_heaven4_7.description: He has never been good at bargaining, so naturally, he does not understand the need for haggling. However, what kind of person would walk up and ask for all of someone else's money?!

scene_ro5_heaven4_8.title: Advice
scene_ro5_heaven4_8.description: He teaches you a few mnemonics, then invites you to fly with him a while. After some soaring, you feel your body become much lighter.

scene_ro5_heaven5_enter.title: An 'Accumulation' of Life
scene_ro5_heaven5_enter.description: Mo Yi retains her human form here, the bestial Sui seeming to have no effect on her. She knows you cannot enter these doors, so she receives you at the schoolhouse's edge. She likes it here, for no matter if you are man, beast, or geist, you will appear as your truest self. And the first step in communication is frank honesty. 'I need some tongbao to feed the geists. Perhaps you are willing to make a donation?'

scene_ro5_heaven5_1.title: An 'Accumulation' of Life
scene_ro5_heaven5_1.description: You never really trusted this member of the Shanhaizhong, so you take off into the sky, leaving her on the ground below.

scene_ro5_heaven5_2.title: An 'Accumulation' of Life
scene_ro5_heaven5_2.description: 'Mr. Pu spent half his life educating geists on how to live amongst humanity, how to take on human forms, hold a job, earn a wage. Perhaps, as the years pass by, there really will be something that can absorb his teachings, become an apprentice in all earnestness, join the Tianshi Bureaus, visit the great academy, and become a teacher in their own right.' Mo Yi says this as she looks at the copper coins on the ground.

scene_ro5_heaven5_3.title: An 'Accumulation' of Life
scene_ro5_heaven5_3.description: 'When it comes to imitation, I feel as though geists are much more eager to excel in that field than we are. I am unsure if they will ever understand the difference between copying and learning.' Mo Yi picks up the copper coins on the ground, then merges them into one before returning it to you.

scene_ro5_heaven5_4.title: An 'Accumulation' of Life
scene_ro5_heaven5_4.description: 'The accumulation of Sui's spirit is a condition for them becoming geists, yes, but if that were the only condition, the entire land would be full of them.' The coins fall onto the floor. It seems they have gained a life of their own, unable to hold back from piling up on top of one another, as if one body. 'All things have a temperament. Whether or not they become geists is up to them.'

scene_ro5_heaven5_5.title: An 'Accumulation' of Life
scene_ro5_heaven5_5.description: Mo Yi takes out a length of string, and the coin geists smoothly slide onto it. 'I return these geists to their original master. I hope you raise them well.'

scene_ro5_heaven5_6.title: An 'Accumulation' of Life
scene_ro5_heaven5_6.description: 'You often say geists are strange, wicked, and cruel, but look at these coins scattered across the ground. How could so many creatures be born straight onto such an askew path?' She says it is to feed them, but the geists seem to be much more interested in seeking companionship in the coins. 'All things have a place that can house them.'

scene_ro5_heaven5_7.title: An 'Accumulation' of Life
scene_ro5_heaven5_7.description: After a while, a few coins come to life, while a few fall onto the ground. It is the fallen ones that Mo Yi returns to you, alongside an offer of her own coupon. It seems she does not require one to enter the Garden.

scene_ro5_heaven5_8.title: An 'Accumulation' of Life
scene_ro5_heaven5_8.description: Through this union of tongbao, you can see the geists within the schoolhouse hard at their studies. Their understanding of humanity is much like our understanding of them: superficial, even after half a year of study.

scene_ro5_heaven5_9.title: An 'Accumulation' of Life
scene_ro5_heaven5_9.description: Although strung together on the same string, the coin geists each have a mind of their own, as though they were a medley of people from across the land. It would be nice if they became unified, but all you can do is try to coordinate them as you hold onto the string.

scene_ro5_heaven5_10.title: An 'Accumulation' of Life
scene_ro5_heaven5_10.description: The three coins stand atop Mo Yi's palm and relate their many experiences. A long while later, a novel about the supernatural named Three Coins appeared all over the city.

scene_ro5_heaven7_enter.title: Old Slyfeather
scene_ro5_heaven7_enter.description: You have met with Feranmuts, but you have never seen such a huge fowlbeast before. Flames cling to its feathers, sonic booms unable to keep up with its afterimage. It circles around you a few times until your hair has been curled from the heat, before dexterously landing on an ancient tree in front of you, watching you like you were a worm. 'Aren't the things in this garden a right pain in the ass, youngster?' It sizes you up, its eyes locking onto your purse. 'I've got plenty of treasures for taming geists, so giving you one won't be an issue. You interested?'

scene_ro5_heaven7_1.title: Old Slyfeather
scene_ro5_heaven7_1.description: You have a general idea of her identity, so you lower your guard, never expecting that old rascal to snatch your purse as she tosses over the treasure, flying off without a trace. Luckily, the flames burned a hole in the corner of the purse, and some of your money falls out in drips and drabs, accompanied with a few words fading into the distance: 'There's not a geist in the land who wouldn't run away at the sight of my baby, youngster, so use it well! Once you're done with the ceremony, I'll give you your purse back.'

scene_ro5_heaven7_2.title: Old Slyfeather
scene_ro5_heaven7_2.description: As they say, 'beware the suddenly kind', even if they're an old friend. As she tosses over the treasure, you subconsciously guard your purse, though she still manages to snag a handful of coins, flying away behind you. 'Now that's a smart youngster!' She seems happy, chirping away. 'That's how the kids at the Sui Regulator should be! I'm gonna go buy myself something to eat first. Once you're done with the ceremony, remember to drop by the Tianshi Bureaus to give that back to me.' Before the sound even reaches your ears, she is gone.

scene_ro5_heaven7_3.title: Old Slyfeather
scene_ro5_heaven7_3.description: Since this is the Old Tianshi's treasure, it probably works as advertised, but you lost a lot of coin for no reason getting it this way. No wonder people always say 'to be old and alive means you're a...' You look around you, the faint crackling of fire still audible. You decide the last word is better left unsaid.

scene_ro5_heaven8_enter.title: Hundred Clan Rebellion
scene_ro5_heaven8_enter.description: The earth is torn asunder by battle, forces and factions split from one another as tyrants spring up by the second. You stand high up in the clouds, looking down upon the earth. You are well-acquainted with this period of history, having read the textbooks countless times before, but it is only once you have seen it in such a real way that you know of the joys and sorrows it contained.

scene_ro5_heaven8_1.title: Hundred Clan Rebellion
scene_ro5_heaven8_1.description: You use your influence to support the heroes you know well, hoping they can have a happy ending.

scene_ro5_heaven8_2.title: Hundred Clan Rebellion
scene_ro5_heaven8_2.description: A gout of flame burns from the ships linked with iron chains to the eight hundred li army camp, burning down the cities and the capital, searing away scrolls and hallways. The Hundred Clan Rebellion was born in the fires of Yan, and in the fires of Yan it ended. This has long since been its conclusion. What is unclear is if the brilliant strategies of the nobility will be enough to cover up the weeping of the common people as they suffer.

scene_ro5_heaven8_3.title: Hundred Clan Rebellion
scene_ro5_heaven8_3.description: History is like smoke. You cannot use your influence to dictate an ending, but by interacting with these historical figures, you become more knowledgeable in having the right person in the right position. You wonder if the Feranmut who, like you, chose a man to grant victory, also felt this wellspring of arrogance and pride in Its heart?

scene_ro5_heaven11_enter.title: Uninvited Guest
scene_ro5_heaven11_enter.description: Your sudden arrival startles a Feranmut putting ink onto the canvas of the land. This is her painting, and she never invited you in! ...Perhaps you should apologize to her.

scene_ro5_heaven11_1.title: Uninvited Guest
scene_ro5_heaven11_1.description: She does not immediately accept your gift, but she does not decline it either. After a long hesitation, the mountains fade away, and the mists converge into the form of a human. Dusk says this was something she left behind for the doddering elders of Yan's seal, but since it ended up in your hands, she'll have to see this job through after all. 'So, what do you want?' She tries to hide her impatience as best as she can.

scene_ro5_heaven11_2.title: Uninvited Guest
scene_ro5_heaven11_2.description: You seem to have stumbled here via some painting scroll or the other in the Garden. Dusk knows that Yi has some of her works in his collection, so she is not too surprised, but she has no love for the people of the Sui Regulator. She allows you to stay here to rest, but this does not mean she tolerates your presence. No, she has long since moved on to another painting, disappearing without a trace.

scene_ro5_heaven11_3.title: Uninvited Guest
scene_ro5_heaven11_3.description: Dusk does her best to not let her mood interfere with fulfilling your vague request, turning back to enter her scrollery. After who-knows-how-many springs and autumns, she emerges, throwing a scroll at you before expelling you from the painting with a flick of her brush.

scene_ro5_heaven11_4.title: Uninvited Guest
scene_ro5_heaven11_4.description: She does not immediately accept your gift, but she does not decline it either. After a long hesitation, the mountains fade away, and the mists converge into the form of a human. Dusk says this was something she left behind for the doddering elders of Yan's seal, but since it ended up in your hands, she'll have to see this job through after all. 'So, what do you want?' She tries to hide her impatience as best as she can.

scene_ro5_double6_enter.title: Prayer for Protection
scene_ro5_double6_enter.description: Every sacrifice a dispelment, every resolution a diminishment. Humanity fears calamity, so they are always thinking of ways to attain peace of mind. This is a good place for such attainment: water gathers in the center, flowing into the courtyard from four sides. There is also a great urn installed, where wealth and positivity gathers without fear of exposure or leakage. Within it there is a white lotus. While the mud at its bottom is turbid, its water is crystal-clear, like sweet dew. If you were to drink some, no doubt it would be of benefit to you.

scene_ro5_double6_1.title: Prayer for Protection
scene_ro5_double6_1.description: The water in the urn is incredibly bitter, but you as soon as you swallow, the budding lotus seems to awaken, shaking and stirring as its double-petaled flower blooms. A crimson drop of dew slides down the petals, and you quickly cup your hands to catch it. As it falls onto the palm of your hand, you feel like something is not right.

scene_ro5_double6_2.title: Prayer for Protection
scene_ro5_double6_2.description: The water may be clear, but it is extremely bitter. You also smell a faint rankness to it. The lotus flower with no name gently stirs, but shows no signs of blooming.

scene_ro5_double6_3.title: Prayer for Protection
scene_ro5_double6_3.description: You take what you have gotten. As you look at the urn again, you notice a bud poking up through the water, shyly swaying towards you.

scene_ro5_double6_4.title: Prayer for Protection
scene_ro5_double6_4.description: Every sacrifice a dispelment, every resolution a diminishment. Humanity fears calamity, so they are always thinking of ways to attain peace of mind. This is a good place for such attainment: water gathers in the center, flowing into the courtyard from four sides. There is also a great urn installed, where wealth and positivity gathers without fear of exposure or leakage. Within it there is a white lotus. While the mud at its bottom is turbid, its water is crystal-clear, like sweet dew. If you were to drink some, no doubt it would be of benefit to you.

scene_ro5_double6_6.title: Prayer for Protection
scene_ro5_double6_6.description: You carefully put away what you got. Looking at the urn once more, only the surface of the water is perfectly clear. It's a shame there are thick layers of silt blocking your view. It is hard to say what is hidden within those depths.

scene_ro5_double6_5.title: Prayer for Protection
scene_ro5_double6_5.description: You drink another mouthful of water, enduring the bitterness. The water bubbles as if it were boiling, and after a brief moment, a lotus leaf the size of a wheel breaks out of the water, and with a crack, its stalk breaks, falling right into your lap.

scene_ro5_double6_7.title: Prayer for Protection
scene_ro5_double6_7.description: You have paid a price, and received a fair harvest for it. The fact that these things may be of good use to you in the future soothes you somewhat. 'Does this count as a prayer for protection?', you ask your companions with a hoarse throat. They can't really say for sure either.

scene_ro5_double6_8.title: Prayer for Protection
scene_ro5_double6_8.description: You drink a mouthful of the water, and its bitterness numbs the back of your throat. Even after waiting a while, you see no movement from the waters of the urn. Just as you are about to leave, there is an ear-piercing scrape from the jar, and soon, two items slowly emerge from the water.

scene_ro5_double6_9.title: Prayer for Protection
scene_ro5_double6_9.description: You are pleasantly surprised, leaning forward to see if there are more treasures hidden within the silt, but the sudden appearance of a deathly-pale face in your reflection sends you stumbling backwards. Only after your companions' cry of alarm do you realize you have lost all sensation in your mouth, and you can barely speak.

scene_ro5_double6_10.title: Prayer for Protection
scene_ro5_double6_10.description: This time, you stick your entire head into the urn, taking big gulps of the water. The urn suddenly begins to shake violently, and with an indistinct sigh, the urn splits in two, its lotus withering in seconds. Undeterred, you sift through the silt, eventually finding two oddly-shaped items. You only have the strength to take one, though.

scene_ro5_double6b_enter.title: Prayer for Protection
scene_ro5_double6b_enter.description: The thing within the urn is known as the 'Sigh'. A lotus stalk grows from its back, while its body is buried in the depths of the pot. It can only live within bloodstained mud from the riverbank, and prefers stillness over movement, drawing rarities to its side. The master of the Garden did not bank on it actually attracting any rarities, only wanting to admire its pure-white lotus flower. The Sigh enjoys feeding on emotion, whether it is the heroism of a warrior making a sacrifice to survive, or the fear the distressed feel after making such a sacrifice. If men draw too close and it devours too much greed, it will die from ecstasy, spilling the rarities in its belly with a sigh. The master of the garden once noted: 'This is all but a sigh.'

scene_ro5_ent2_enter.title: Sow Cause, Reap Consequence
scene_ro5_ent2_enter.description: An indigo-maned Feranmut lies coiled around a vast paddy field. A light rain falls from the heavens, intermingled with tiny wishes. They fall upon the earth, take root and sprout into all sorts of things. Upon seeing you, she shifts her tail, granting you an entrance.

scene_ro5_ent2_1.title: Sow Cause, Reap Consequence
scene_ro5_ent2_1.description: As you leave the field, Shu closes the entrance behind you. Causality is a loop. The hopeful causes you planted have grown into all sorts of consequences. But have you ever wondered whose causes sown allowed you to 'come across' this harvest?

scene_ro5_ent2_2.title: Sow Cause, Reap Consequence
scene_ro5_ent2_2.description: The wish falls onto the soil, sprouting lush branches and leaves. The Feranmut helps you harvest this wish, transforming it into items you can use.

scene_ro5_ent2_3.title: Sow Cause, Reap Consequence
scene_ro5_ent2_3.description: There is still space in the paddy, and you can still plant some hope, but it seems overly-flippant wishes will not bear fruit here.

scene_ro5_ent2_4.title: Sow Cause, Reap Consequence
scene_ro5_ent2_4.description: The wish falls onto the soil, sprouting branches of gold and leaves of jade. The Feranmut helps you prune this wish, and after some careful sorting, turns it into a rare piece of art.

scene_ro5_ent2_5.title: Sow Cause, Reap Consequence
scene_ro5_ent2_5.description: There is still space in the paddy, and you can still plant some hope, but it seems overly-flippant wishes will not bear fruit here.

scene_ro5_ent2_6.title: Sow Cause, Reap Consequence

scene_ro5_ent3_enter.title: Resonant Words
scene_ro5_ent3_enter.description: Amidst the mist, a Feranmut flits and flickers, in a state somewhere between swimming through the sky, reclining against a hill, and lying prone on the ground. A giant wine cup is wedged between some mountains, drink spilling from it like a waterfall. She sees you, and turns the cup your way. After three rounds, she feels things have become a bit dull, so suggests tossing some coins to amuse yourselves.

scene_ro5_ent3_1.title: Resonant Words
scene_ro5_ent3_1.description: Seeing you slowly walk away into the distance, Ling drains her cup dry, then vanishes into the mists.

scene_ro5_ent3_2.title: Resonant Words
scene_ro5_ent3_2.description: The coins fall into the cup, and the Feranmut roils and staggers before picking it up high. She turns her head askew to glance at you, and bids you make your guess. 'How flows the river? Be it orderly? Be it pointed? Be it clustered?'

scene_ro5_ent3_3.title: Resonant Words
scene_ro5_ent3_3.description: The coins fall, and you guessed true. Ling gives a hearty laugh before fading away, leaving only the cup, filled to the brim with treasures.

scene_ro5_ent3_4.title: Resonant Words
scene_ro5_ent3_4.description: The coins fall, far from how you had predicted they would. You have no choice but to concede.

scene_ro5_ent3_5.title: Resonant Words
scene_ro5_ent3_5.description: The coins fall, and you guessed true. In high spirits, Ling lines up a selection of rewards, and allows you to choose.

scene_ro5_ent3_6.title: Resonant Words
scene_ro5_ent3_6.description: The coins fall, and you guessed true. Ling swishes her tail a few times, then spirals up into the sky. Here, time and space is split in twain, and from the bowels of history appear a pair of relics.

scene_ro5_ent3_7.title: Resonant Words
scene_ro5_ent3_7.description: All befuddlement leaves with Ling as she departs, but the things she left for you are as real as real can be. Perhaps only a moment later, or in a hundred years, you will still be making merry with her.

scene_ro5_ent3_8.title: Resonant Words
scene_ro5_ent3_8.description: Seeing you slowly walk away into the distance, Ling drains her cup dry, then vanishes into the mists.

scene_ro5_ent3_9.title: Resonant Words
scene_ro5_ent3_9.description: You are not sure why, but just as you were getting ready to leave, time winds back a few minutes, back to the moment the Feranmut lifted up the wine cup. Her movements show no hesitation, and she gazes at you as if to say: 'Another round?'

scene_ro5_bat9_enter.title: Guest from the Sea
scene_ro5_bat9_enter.description: Yi 'keeps' a strange Seaborn, one that fancies itself a 'strategist', analyzing games all day long. It invites you all to be its opponent.

scene_ro5_bat9_1.description: 'The state of play, I, decide.' The Seaborn makes it known.

scene_ro5_bat9_2.description: It sees you refuse it, but it does not anger, instead shooting out a hard piece of chitin and wishing you fair travels. It is obvious it copied this way of interacting with people from Yi.

scene_ro5_double3b_enter.title: Stamp Collection
scene_ro5_double3b_enter.description: Everywhere across the Garden are seals tourists can use to add to their stamp collections, but this one is very unique. Every time you enter the Garden, it seems to change. There was once a slacker who went in and out to get stamps, who ended up discovering only nine combinations of three primary components and three secondary. You see the characters shift with the feng shui of the land, every change on them a change in the earth itself. With this stamp, this small parcel of the world will be of your use. You gently poke at the seal's primary component, then adjust it to be—

scene_ro5_double3b_4.title: Stamp Collection
scene_ro5_double3b_4.description: The adjustment is complete. Without your prompting, the seal invokes change across the entire Garden, ultimately turning into the character atop the seal.

scene_ro5_trash1_enter.title: View

scene_ro5_trash1_1.title: View
scene_ro5_trash1_1.description: Sight begets thought, thought begets desire, desire begets matter, matter begets sight.

scene_ro5_trash1_2.title: View
scene_ro5_trash1_2.description: With eyes shut and unseeing, even the truth shall become nothingness.

scene_ro5_trash1_3.title: View
scene_ro5_trash1_3.description: As the fire dies and the embers diminish, things have changed, forms have warped.

scene_ro5_trash1_4.title: View
scene_ro5_trash1_4.description: As the fire dies and the embers diminish, nothing seems to have changed.

scene_ro5_lokk12_1.description: The tangled chaos becomes orderly matter. Although you do not recognize these characters, you can guess that their meaning should be—

scene_ro5_portal5_enter.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portal5_enter.description: One can see wooden pillars shaped like nails or rules all across the Garden, drained of all color. Their influence can be seen in their monochrome surroundings. One need only stand within this zone to lose your grip on your senses, and for your consciousness to transcend your body. If you take it one step further—

scene_ro5_portal5_1.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portal5_1.description: You sense your consciousness expand... ascend... break through the clouds... gaze down at the earth... like the Feranmut of eld.

scene_ro5_portal5_2.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portal5_2.description: A candle is lit. One of your retainers is prepared to watch the candle.

scene_ro5_portal5_3.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portal5_3.description: You should not enter strange places when not adequately prepared.

scene_ro5_portal5_4.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portal5_4.description: Through the combined power of the Sui proxies, you see the imagined awakening of a god within the ever-spinning instrument.
