scene_ro5_rest2_enter.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest2_enter.description: Traversing the Garden to see its sights inevitably leads to tired legs. This pavilion has been set up for tourists to rest and recuperate. With the breeze flitting past your face and majestic sights ahead, no matter how rugged the road ahead may be, at least you will be able to catch your breath here without worry.

scene_ro5_rest2_1.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest2_1.description: With the pavilion as your pillow, the land as your couch, and a pleasant dream, all your doubts fade away.

scene_ro5_rest2_2.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest2_2.description: A few pre-prepared meals are spread out on a stone table. Everyone gets a bowl of rice and their choice of several dishes, perfectly paired with soup and cakes. Not the most sumptuous of meals, but it's filling, enough to give you strength for the road ahead.

scene_ro5_rest2_3.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest2_3.description: You reassign duties amongst your team. This way, you can command them even more effectively.

scene_ro5_rest2_4.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest2_4.description: While you may not have much, you have all the essentials. The ceremony may be crude, but you need only to follow the steps properly and with sincerity to light a candle in your heart.

scene_ro5_rest2_5.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest2_5.description: You sit in a circle, sharing tales of your hometowns.

scene_ro5_rest2_6.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest2_6.description: By waving this flag, the Sui Regulator will promptly send backup to the designated meeting point.

scene_ro5_rest2_7.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest2_7.description: The pavilion provides emergency first aid kits for tourists to use, able to quickly handle any injury.

scene_ro5_rest2_8.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest2_8.description: The Tianshi Bureaus have developed a unique formation for Tianshis entering the Garden of Grotesqueries, allowing them to step into Sui's consciousness from several safe areas in the Garden. This is one of those areas.

scene_ro5_rest2_9.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest2_9.description: You sense your consciousness expand... ascend... break through the clouds... gaze down at the earth... like the Feranmut of eld.

scene_ro5_rest2_10.title: In the Rest Pavilion
scene_ro5_rest2_10.description: After readjusting your command style, you can easily command an even larger party.

scene_ro5_res6_enter.title: Times Change
scene_ro5_res6_enter.description: The Hours of Sui appear one after the other in the Garden of Grotesqueries, where these intangible concepts eventually condense into reality under their creator's influence. Due to forming at different moments in time, every crystal has a unique shape. The Chamber of Geists has already developed uses for several of these crystals, which may be of aid to you during the rite.

scene_ro5_res6_1.title: Times Change
scene_ro5_res6_1.description: The officials of the Chamber of Geists quickly find the crystal you seek. You need only use the tongbao of the Garden to cleanse it, and you shall obtain the crystallized Hour of Sui.

scene_ro5_res6_2.title: Times Change
scene_ro5_res6_2.description: The officials of the Chamber of Geists quickly find the crystal you seek. You need only use the tongbao of the Garden to cleanse it, and you shall obtain the crystallized Hour of Sui.

scene_ro5_res6_3.title: Times Change
scene_ro5_res6_3.description: The officials of the Chamber of Geists quickly find the crystal you seek. You need only use the tongbao of the Garden to cleanse it, and you shall obtain the crystallized Hour of Sui.

scene_ro5_res6_4.title: Times Change
scene_ro5_res6_4.description: The breath of Sui marring the tongbao draws forth the power contained within the crystal. It now acts as its corresponding Sui proxy, rendering you aid over the course of the rite.

scene_ro5_res6_5.title: Times Change
scene_ro5_res6_5.description: You try to use the crystallized Hour of Sui, but there is no response. Perhaps you will only be able to truly draw upon its power inside Sui's remnant consciousness.

scene_ro5_res6_6.title: Times Change
scene_ro5_res6_6.description: Though you were not able to receive the Chamber of Geists's latest innovations, you still obtained a treasure. It was not a visit for nothing.

scene_ro5_res6_7.title: Times Change
scene_ro5_res6_7.description: The breath of Sui marring the tongbao draws forth the Hour contained within the crystal! It seems the Chamber of Geists does not understand these crystal Hours as thoroughly as they said they did... As their research is not yet complete, they can only offer you another tool to show their support.

scene_ro5_res6_8.title: Times Change
scene_ro5_res6_8.description: The breath of Sui marring the tongbao draws forth the power contained within the crystal. It now acts as its corresponding Sui proxy, rendering you aid over the course of the rite.

scene_ro5_res6_9.title: Times Change
scene_ro5_res6_9.description: The breath of Sui marring the tongbao draws forth the power contained within the crystal. It now acts as its corresponding Sui proxy, rendering you aid over the course of the rite.

scene_ro5_portalboss_enter.title: Where Then Meets Now
scene_ro5_portalboss_enter.description: In the depths of the Tomb of Sui, the boundary between Sui's remnant consciousness and reality is thin. Here, it is as if you need only desire to pierce the veil and submerge yourself into Sui's memories, and it shall be done. With your experiences in the remnant consciousness, this is hardly a challenge.

scene_ro5_portalboss_1.title: Where Then Meets Now
scene_ro5_portalboss_1.description: For a moment, you vividly feel like the entirety of the Tomb of Sui is your slumbering body, but soon, the chains of army camps around you and the distant shadows of Feranmuts pull you out of your confusion. You have entered Sui's memories of the great wild hunt.

scene_ro5_portalboss_2.title: Where Then Meets Now
scene_ro5_portalboss_2.description: A candle is lit in the Tomb of Sui. One of your retainers is prepared to watch the candle.

scene_ro5_portalboss_3.title: Where Then Meets Now
scene_ro5_portalboss_3.description: Through the combined power of the Sui proxies, you see the imagined awakening of a god within the ever-spinning instrument.

scene_ro5_end3_enter.title: Heaven-Blessed Hunt
scene_ro5_end3_enter.description: Ahead lies the end of the scroll's search, the place where Sui's remnant consciousness and the Tomb of Sui come together. Even Candleguests will lose their ability to discern reality from illusion. Only those seekers who have received the scroll's blessing will be able to go with you, to experience the final memory of the battle between humanity and Sui.

scene_ro5_end3_1.title: Heaven-Blessed Hunt
scene_ro5_end3_1.description: If you manage to defeat Sui's former friends and foes in Its memories, if you influence, perhaps even change Its memories, wouldn't the problems brought along by the bestial Sui in reality be easily solved? You are unsure, but now, you face down two towering Feranmuts.

scene_ro5_lokksp_enter.title: For Tomorrow
scene_ro5_lokksp_enter.description: This army camp in Sui's memories is in perfect order. People hone their skills and polish their swords, preparing to face the last two Feranmuts within Yan aside from Sui.

scene_ro5_lokksp_1.title: For Tomorrow
scene_ro5_lokksp_1.description: You know the scroll is spread out towards where the pair of Feranmuts are, so you select some suitable retainers to join Yan's scouts. Before they depart, you notice one of the scouts turns his head back, back to where Sui sits, Its shadow covering part of the camp, along with the scouting party. You clearly see him look at Its head before immediately breaking eye contact. With flurried steps, he leaves Sui's shadow.

scene_ro5_lokksp_2.title: For Tomorrow
scene_ro5_lokksp_2.description: The many artifacts within the camp's storehouses are spontaneous donations of Yan's commoners. Accept their contributions, remember the price they paid, and live to see final victory.

scene_ro5_marketsp_enter.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_marketsp_enter.description: You copy Its form, you copy Its spirit, but to the Sui proxies, it is as if you tried to draw a Feline and ended up with a Perro. It's completely wrong. Maybe you can ask them to help you make some improvements.

scene_ro5_marketsp_1.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_marketsp_1.description: Whether or not further drawing makes the resemblance better or worse is not set in stone. So long as you are satisfied, then perhaps anything will do.

scene_ro5_marketsp_2.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_marketsp_2.description: Since you have expended your time, the taciturn lawmaker begins to speak, clarifying definitions for you. You suddenly notice a mass of floating objects by your side. These priceless objects are very likely to be the precursors to all sorts of modern geists.

scene_ro5_marketsp_3.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_marketsp_3.description: Since you have expended your time, the wandering young doctor heals your wounds. With the boundless energy coursing through your body, you perceive the life force of the Feranmut with newfound clarity.

scene_ro5_marketsp_4.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_marketsp_4.description: Since you have expended your time, the master of the Garden steadies your form. You had wanted to ask Yi if you really are impervious to harm now, but when you consider the fate of Sui, the answer is obvious.

scene_ro5_marketsp_5.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_marketsp_5.description: Since you have expended your time, the merchant in the remnant consciousness braids mane for you. After pacing about a few rounds, you really do feel what can only be described as a Feranmut's arrogance welling up in you.

scene_ro5_marketsp_6.title: Finishing Touch
scene_ro5_marketsp_6.description: Since you have expended your time... Suddenly, a shower of weiqi stones falls from the sky, striking at your thoughts. You do not see any sight of that Sui proxy, but the fallen stones merge together, becoming a rare treasure. You may never know what gambits Wang has hidden on the board, just as how humanity could never guess at what Sui was thinking.

scene_ro5_portalcopper_enter.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portalcopper_enter.description: One can see wooden pillars shaped like nails or rules all across the Garden, drained of all color. Their influence can be seen in their monochrome surroundings. One need only stand within this zone to lose your grip on your senses, and for your consciousness to transcend your body. If you take it one step further—

scene_ro5_portalcopper_1.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portalcopper_1.description: You sense your consciousness expand... ascend... break through the clouds... gaze down at the earth... like the Feranmut of eld.

scene_ro5_portalcopper_2.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portalcopper_2.description: A candle is lit. One of your retainers is prepared to watch the candle.

scene_ro5_portalcopper_3.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portalcopper_3.description: You should not enter strange places when not adequately prepared.

scene_ro5_portalcopper_4.title: Suppressing the Earth
scene_ro5_portalcopper_4.description: Through the combined power of the Sui proxies, you see the imagined awakening of a god within the ever-spinning instrument.

scene_ro5_ticket_enter.title: Money-Minded Liu
scene_ro5_ticket_enter.description: When you step into Liu'er's hidden workshop, she is pondering the mysteries of the Tongbao. She appears to have been expecting you, inviting you to look at the results of her research. She does not ask for payment this time, but glances at your coin coffer from time to time.

scene_ro5_ticket_1.title: Money-Minded Liu
scene_ro5_ticket_1.description: Liu'er takes out a Dayan Tongbao and shows it to you, clasping it tight in her hands as she mumbles something. For a moment, you seem to see people behind her whispering. She throws the Tongbao into the air, and at the exact moment everyone's eyes are dazzled by the lantern light, the Tongbao turns into a signal flag that falls before you. You ask her to teach you the trick, but she evades the topic as she pulls her arm back into her sleeve. Considering the geists hiding in the shadows and the bulge in her sleeve, you have a good idea of what's going on.

scene_ro5_ticket_3.title: Money-Minded Liu
scene_ro5_ticket_3.description: Liu'er appears to know something is behind her. She begins talking aloud, speaking of secrets that happened during the development of the Waking Tower, disturbances in time, and how she has been having more and more fleeting dreams of glory these days. In the end, she asks you what the person behind her looks like. You look at the graceful, floral shadow behind her. It lifts a finger to its lips, urging you to stay silent. After giving Liu'er's hair a gentle stroke, it vanishes into thin air.

scene_ro5_ticket_2.title: Money-Minded Liu
scene_ro5_ticket_2.description: Liu'er takes the coffer from you as you teach her how to toss the Tongbao. As the coins fly through the air, you clearly see the shadow of a flower touch them. As you return them to the coffer after they fall, you find inside a silk bag, along with a bundle of signal flags.

scene_ro5_ticket_4.title: Money-Minded Liu
scene_ro5_ticket_4.description: Liu'er takes the coffer from you as you teach her how to toss the Tongbao. As the coins fly through the air, you clearly see the shadow of risk take them. As you return them to the coffer after the shadow tossed them once more, you notice the signal flags in your pocket are gone. On the signal flag inside your coffer, their whereabouts have been clearly written.

scene_ro5_ticket_5.title: Money-Minded Liu
scene_ro5_ticket_5.description: Liu'er suddenly turns her head, but sees nothing behind her. As she does so, the shadow of risk appears behind you, giving you a light pat on the shoulder that says you should treasure your friendship with her. Before Liu'er can turn her head back, the shadow has left the workshop. When you ask her what happened, she takes the device out of her sleeve while telling the hidden geists to come out, before giving you a rare 'I don't know'.

scene_ro5_ticket_6.title: Money-Minded Liu
scene_ro5_ticket_6.description: Liu'er takes the coffer from you as you teach her how to toss the Tongbao. As the coins fly through the air, you clearly see the shadow of balance freeze them in place. But the moment passes, and they fall once more. As you return them to the coffer, you find inside a signal flag, along with a few taels of silver.

scene_ro5_ticket_7.title: Money-Minded Liu
scene_ro5_ticket_7.description: Having been steeped in Sui's qi for so long, someone as perceptive as Liu'er definitely knows what the shadow behind her is, but in regards to such spirits, the Sui Regulator is agreed on one thing: if you see yourself, your future is fixed. This is why, despite her curiosity, she dares not turn her head. But the shadow of balance has its own way of giving her an answer: she straightens the collar of her past self, pats her badge, then vanishes into thin air.

scene_ro5_gild1_enter.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_gild1_enter.description: The coin falls to the floor and you ready yourself to do it once more—

scene_ro5_gild1_1.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_gild1_1.description: Your interest wanes, and you put the Tongbao back into your coffer.

scene_ro5_gild1_2.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_gild1_2.description: When you pick it up again, your prior thoughts have already etched themselves deep onto the Tongbao. You weigh it in your hand, and another thought springs to mind—

scene_ro5_gild1_3.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_gild1_3.description: When you pick it up again, your prior thoughts have already etched themselves deep onto the Tongbao. You weigh it in your hand, and another thought springs to mind—

scene_ro5_gild1_4.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_gild1_4.description: Your interest wanes, and you put the Tongbao back into your coffer.

scene_ro5_gild1_5.title: Meeting a Friend
scene_ro5_gild1_5.description: When you pick it up again, your prior thoughts have already etched themselves deep onto the Tongbao.

scene_ro5_swpp1_enter.title: Circled Square
scene_ro5_swpp1_enter.description: Traces of humanity left over the eons are scattered across the land like tongbao. Sometimes they thrive, sometimes they decline. You look at the coins in your pouch. If you just happened to toss them, how would time change them?

scene_ro5_swpp1_3.title: Circled Square
scene_ro5_swpp1_3.description: The coin falls upon the earth, and the land transforms—

scene_ro5_swpp1_1.title: Circled Square
scene_ro5_swpp1_1.description: When you pick up the coin once more, time has imbued it with a whole new meaning. You place it in your pouch and weigh it. You're not sure why, but it seems heavier than before.

scene_ro5_swpp1_2.title: Circled Square
scene_ro5_swpp1_2.description: The coin falls upon the earth, and the years go by—

scene_ro5_swpp1_4.title: Circled Square
scene_ro5_swpp1_4.description: The coin falls upon the earth and forms mountains. Time flickers, mounts shift and ravines flatten—

scene_ro5_swpp1_5.title: Circled Square
scene_ro5_swpp1_5.description: The eras of humanity flowing by have been hidden in these many tongbao. They fall into the mortal realm, jingling and jangling, and when the dust settles, they all sport a trace of divinity. You see them clearly, but you do not know what this scene looks like in the eyes of Sui.

scene_ro5_swpp1_6.title: Circled Square
scene_ro5_swpp1_6.description: The coin falls upon the earth, and the years go by—

scene_ro5_swpp1_7.title: Circled Square
scene_ro5_swpp1_7.description: The coin falls upon the earth and forms a temple, maintained over the years by generations to come—

scene_ro5_swpp1_8.title: Circled Square
scene_ro5_swpp1_8.description: The coin falls upon the earth and forms an academy, filled with the rustling of books, unending over the years—

scene_ro5_swpp1_9.title: Circled Square
scene_ro5_swpp1_9.description: The coin falls upon the earth and forms a paradise, one of beauteous sights, unchanging despite a thousand years. Upon closer examination, the coin—

scene_ro5_swpp1_10.title: Circled Square
scene_ro5_swpp1_10.description: The coin falls upon the earth, and the years go by—

scene_ro5_end4_enter.title: Strategizing
scene_ro5_end4_enter.description: All sorts of variables are in play in the awakening of Sui, and Wang must have an answer for all such possibilities. The slightest change in Its thoughts requires a rectification of said answer. As he is factoring in humanity as another one of his stones, it is only right that he let them in on his plans.

scene_ro5_end4_1.title: Strategizing
scene_ro5_end4_1.description: Within the indelible shadows of the Tomb, Sui's subconscious creates an ever-shifting reality to tear through Wang's net.

scene_ro5_end4_3.title: Strategizing
scene_ro5_end4_3.description: As Sui's thoughts become more clear, Wang immediately makes his move, turning all variables into constants and preventing humanity from being eroded away by Sui's evolution. However, the plan must be brought to fruition by the hands of man. He now looks to you all.

scene_ro5_end4_2.title: Strategizing
scene_ro5_end4_2.description: As Sui's thoughts become more clear, a familiar yet unfamiliar face appears. Wang restrains all the factors still in flux, allowing you to focus on the dread foe before you.

scene_ro5_spband_4.title: Joined at the hip
scene_ro5_spband_4.description: The case opens, and the scroll inside shoots out in all directions like a mass of writhing tentacles. The retainer holding the case is enwrapped before disappearing, drawn into the deepest depths of the Tomb of Sui. This scroll is a bridge, gestated in the past of Sui and humanity, born in the present of Sui proxies and humanity, and it is here that it shall begin seeking the future of Sui and humanity. The case and scroll have affixed themselves here, and from now on, you can send retainers into the place the scroll is searching for whenever you wish.

scene_ro5_spband_5.title: Joined at the hip
scene_ro5_spband_5.description: When you step into Liu'er's hidden workshop, she is pondering the mysteries of the Tongbao. She appears to have been expecting you, inviting you to look at the results of her research. She does not ask for payment this time, but glances at your coin coffer from time to time.

scene_ro5_spband_6.title: Joined at the hip
scene_ro5_spband_6.description: Liu'er takes out a Dayan Tongbao and shows it to you, clasping it tight in her hands as she mumbles something. For a moment, you seem to see people behind her whispering. She throws the Tongbao into the air, and at the exact moment everyone's eyes are dazzled by the lantern light, the Tongbao turns into a signal flag that falls before you. You ask her to teach you the trick, but she evades the topic as she pulls her arm back into her sleeve. Considering the geists hiding in the shadows and the bulge in her sleeve, you have a good idea of what's going on.

scene_ro5_spband_7.title: Joined at the hip
scene_ro5_spband_7.description: Liu'er takes the coffer from you as you teach her how to toss the Tongbao. As the coins fly through the air, you clearly see the shadow of a flower touch them. As you return them to the coffer after they fall, you find inside a silk bag, along with a bundle of signal flags.

scene_ro5_spband_8.title: Joined at the hip
scene_ro5_spband_8.description: Liu'er appears to know something is behind her. She begins talking aloud, speaking of secrets that happened during the development of the Waking Tower, disturbances in time, and how she has been having more and more fleeting dreams of glory these days. In the end, she asks you what the person behind her looks like. You look at the graceful, floral shadow behind her. It lifts a finger to its lips, urging you to stay silent. After giving Liu'er's hair a gentle stroke, it vanishes into thin air.

scene_ro5_spband_9.title: Joined at the hip
scene_ro5_spband_9.description: Liu'er takes the coffer from you as you teach her how to toss the Tongbao. As the coins fly through the air, you clearly see the shadow of risk take these mundane treasures. As you return them to the coffer after the shadow tossed them once more, you notice the signal flags in your pocket are gone. On the signal flag inside your coffer, their whereabouts have been clearly written.

scene_ro5_spband_10.title: Joined at the hip
scene_ro5_spband_10.description: Liu'er takes the coffer from you as you teach her how to toss the Tongbao. As the coins fly through the air, you clearly see the shadow of balance freeze these mundane treasures in place. But the moment passes, and they fall once more. As you return them to the coffer, you find inside a signal flag, along with a few taels of silver.

scene_ro5_spband_11.title: Joined at the hip
scene_ro5_spband_11.description: Liu'er suddenly turns her head, but sees nothing behind her. As she does so, the shadow of risk appears behind you, giving you a light pat on the shoulder that says you should treasure your friendship with her. Before Liu'er can turn her head back, the shadow has left the workshop. When you ask her what happened, she takes the device out of her sleeve while telling the hidden geists to come out, before giving you a rare 'I don't know'.

scene_ro5_spband_12.title: Joined at the hip
scene_ro5_spband_12.description: Having been steeped in Sui's qi for so long, someone as perceptive as Liu'er definitely knows what the shadow behind her is, but in regards to such spirits, the Sui Regulator is agreed on one thing: if you see yourself, your future is fixed. This is why, despite her curiosity, she dares not turn her head. But the shadow of balance has its own way of giving her an answer: she straightens the collar of her past self, pats her badge, then vanishes into thin air.

scene_ro5_spband_13.title: Joined at the hip
scene_ro5_spband_13.description: He is a Sui proxy, the master builder Yi, but he is also the 'Mr. Yi' who has zero resistance to the allure of fine wares. You need only offer him something he fancies, and he shall be generous in return.

scene_ro5_spband_14.title: Joined at the hip
scene_ro5_spband_14.description: Traversing the Garden to see its sights inevitably leads to tired legs. This pavilion has been set up for tourists to rest and recuperate. With the breeze flitting past your face and majestic sights ahead, no matter how rugged the road ahead may be, at least you will be able to catch your breath here without worry.

scene_ro5_spband_15.title: Joined at the hip
scene_ro5_spband_15.description: With the pavilion as your pillow, the land as your couch, and a pleasant dream, all your doubts fade away.

scene_ro5_spband_16.title: Joined at the hip
scene_ro5_spband_16.description: The pavilion provides emergency first aid kits for tourists to use, able to quickly handle any injury.

scene_ro5_spband_17.title: Joined at the hip
scene_ro5_spband_17.description: A few pre-prepared meals are spread out on a stone table. Everyone gets a bowl of rice and their choice of several dishes, perfectly paired with soup and cakes. Not the most sumptuous of meals, but it's filling, enough to give you strength for the road ahead.

scene_ro5_spband_18.title: Joined at the hip
scene_ro5_spband_18.description: Yi weighs the tenacious luck in his hand, believing that rather than acting restrained, he would much rather put it all on the line like you have.

scene_ro5_spband_21.title: Joined at the hip
scene_ro5_spband_21.description: Yi and Ji are incessantly quarreling over who owns a box of treasure. Since you are here, they foist the box onto you to end their argument.

scene_ro5_spband_19.title: Joined at the hip
scene_ro5_spband_19.description: The masters regarded as lamp-holders regularly patrol every corner of the Garden. When you apply for their help, they will lead one of your retainers up ahead, traveling to parts of the Garden you have not yet explored.

scene_ro5_spband_22.title: Joined at the hip
scene_ro5_spband_22.description: The Tongbao you offered allowed Yi to receive a new treasure from Ji, so he lends you a helping hand before turning back to his older brother to discuss dividends from sales in the Garden.

scene_ro5_spband_20.title: Joined at the hip

scene_ro5_spband_30.description: Yi weighs the ordinary luck in his hand. For this, he is willing to give you a fair price.

ENTERTAINMENT.description: Indulging in life's simpler pleasures helps combat the monotony and hardships of your long journey ahead.

UNKNOWN.name: Dense Fog

WISH.name: Wish Fulfilled

SACRIFICE.name: Lost and Found
SACRIFICE.description: What things are worth, I shall weigh.

BATTLE_SHOP.description: He may be a foreigner, but he understands Yanese etiquette well enough.

STORY.name: Prophecy
STORY.description: Think first, then act. There is no turning back.

content: Good morning, good afternoon, and good night.
You give me the Originium, and I give you the goods. Don't worry too much about the details.
We are old friends, but business is business.
Why am I helping you? Think of it as an investment.
Buy short, sell long. Getting more with less. We dabble in the same business, you and I.
This isn't scavenging, I just took a treasure that nobody else wanted.
You want to hear a story? Sure, my friend, but good tales don't come cheap.
We meet again, friend. What are you buying this time?
Long time no see, my dear old friend. I'm glad you're still alive and kicking.
All the stores in the garden are rip-offs? Hardly. What I value most is honesty.
What do you fancy? Supplies for survival, treasures that ward off evil, or perhaps... some Yanese secrets?
You need manpower? I got you. No need to hesitate.
'Friendship' is expensive, priceless even.
This is way cheaper than looking everywhere for a Messenger.
You guys at Rhodes Island have all sorts of weirdos, huh...
I know, I know, everyone has their own business to attend to.
You need some help, but that help's not going to be free.
Can I have a look-see at Rhodes Island's aircraft? No? Too bad.
The Tianshis of Yan are good picks. When your goals are aligned, they show up uninvited. Not that they're easy to invite, even with coin.
Being able to come here is proof enough of their strength.
If you meet anyone overly-friendly, remember to give them a firm handshake, see if it's warm or not.
Who would you like to visit the Garden with? Would you like the trip to be more exciting, or more... bone-chilling?
Don't worry. Spending money can make the world turn 'round.
Don't be picky, it wasn't easy gathering all this scrap.
A fully armed society must surely be a civilized society.
What's this thing good for? Why, buy it and find out!
What's different about blessed goods? If you're a believer, buy them. If you're not, best don't touch them.
Try throwing some spare change into the pond, nothing bad's going to happen. Most of the time.
Once I bought a whole crate of Honey Biscuits, but a Perro girl made off with all of them.
Doing business in Yan is all about emotion, but talking about money's damaging to relationships. Ah, what a dilemma!
When shopping in the Garden of Grotesqueries, get used to taking the 'strange' in stride.
Relax, I've already inspected them. This is an 'it', not a 'he'... Or at least, it should be.
Here, you can either see the truth, or ignore falsities. Which do you choose?
Be prepared for anything. Better safe than sorry, friend.
This little thing is equal parts worthless and terrifying...
What's this thing for? Good question, I don't know either.
Give it a try, maybe it'll just change your fate!
What effect does it have? All I can say is, trust that it has one, friend.
Maybe you really do need this good fortune.
A cure for regret might not make things any better, but at least it gives you a chance.
What you are buying is not good fortune, friend, for that has always been yours.
Do not fear change, for change is the first step to success.
Check out this new toy. The Prospective Investment System. Use your extra riches to pave the way for the future.
Farsightedness is a good thing to have. You can buy unlimited possibilities with money. It's a good thing, my friend.
This is the wealth management system the Yanese love the most. A full pantry means no worries!
You're an optimistic one. Try your hand at investing in the future, then! You won't regret it, friend.
Don't let the spending get to you. You don't need the cash now, and this will come in handy later.
Just the time to thank the great foresight of your past self, am I right, friend?
Investment buys you wealth. Fine, it's not that simple, but it's what everyone likes.
Your small investments here and there eventually help you overcome all difficulties. It's a good thing.
There's a withdrawal limit, but I'm willing to free up some space to bring you more practical goods. Thanks for always being so understanding, my friend.
Your investment reserves have gone up, friend. It's a good thing.
With your investment reserves, you can set out on your adventures with confidence.
Wonderful! Your next adventure will go much more smoothly. Probably.
Ah, I can see right away you are a cautious one. Maybe a little too cautious.
I will take only a small commission for your future adventure investments. It's a fair deal.
There's a saying in Yan: 'Plan ahead, or plan to fail.' The Yanese have a point.
I got myself some new trinkets. You'll love them.
You should invest in your upcoming adventures!
Thank you for your support, friend. Let's keep working together.
The value of my wares will go down if you leave too many fingerprints on them, my friend.
Hand me the Originium Ingots first, you can touch that all you like.
Don't like my wares? Prices giving you second thoughts?
Oh, do be careful. You break it, you buy it.
Good choice.
A steal, isn't it?
Thank you for your patronage. Do have a look at the rest too.

ro5_ending_1.name: Orderly Placation
ro5_ending_1.desc: The Garden of Grotesqueries's Placation ceremony is repeated year after year, and the duties of the Candleholders passed on from generation to generation. Like the garden, this finely honed sword shall seal the bestial Sui in its prison.

ro5_ending_2.name: Scroll of Scars
ro5_ending_2.desc: One is missing from the twelve. What he saw in the hall does not remain, but the message lingers: She is not gone.
ro5_ending_2.changeEndingDesc: Perhaps someone will show you the path of history from past to present with this inkstick.

ro5_ending_3.name: Black-White Abstrusity
ro5_ending_3.desc: The Placation ceremony was introduced to the Tomb of Sui, just as other events set into action by man, but it was Wang who laid the groundwork. To what end does his game of chess lead?
ro5_ending_3.changeEndingDesc: You have fallen into Wang's game.

ro5_ending_4.name: Out of Nothingness
ro5_ending_4.desc: After having witnessed a facet of the great wild hunt within the Sui's consciousness, the wordless scroll leaves a shallow blot of ink. From this, it can turn into words, to books, to teachings, to people.
ro5_ending_4.changeEndingDesc: You have broken the barriers of reality and the consciousness of the Sui.

ro5_ending_5.name: No Regrets
ro5_ending_5.desc: With the token of the proxies' future entrusted to humanity as they leave the Tomb, Wang can now give his full focus to extinguishing all of Sui's wild fantasies within the finite infinite.
ro5_ending_5.changeEndingDesc: With Wang's strategies, you cut through the rebirth of Sui, the flames of destruction, and the imagination of proxies.

battleLoadingTips.tip: Yan—Located in the northeast parts of Terra. With limited contact with the rest of Terra, this nation has evolved its own unique culture and history.
Garden of Grotesqueries—A vast, beautiful garden located near the Yanese capital of Baizao. Many parts of the garden remain closed to visitors.
Bestial Sui—Fallen into a slumber after its defeat by Yan. Its remains are buried in an underground tomb, but remnants of its divine consciousness continue to affect the land.

Placation—Yanese ritual that involves climbing to the peak of the Garden of Grotesqueries and attacking the Proxy of Sui. The personnel who carry out the ritual are typically selected from the Sui Regulator.
Hour of Sui—The authority of the twelve Sui Proxies manifested through the influence of Sui's divine consciousness, affecting the Garden like the passage of time during the ritual process.
During your initial recruitment, you can recruit your friends' Operators via Support Recruitment
Operators recruited via 'Temporary Recruitment' will not consume Hope. Do not miss the opportunity
'Hope' can be used to Recruit or Promote Operators
Combining different collectibles can lead to unexpected results
Training more Operators and developing the possibilities between them can grant you a greater advantage during combat
The abilities of the first Operators you recruit are equivalent to Elite 1
Only Candleguests can be deployed in Sui's Remnant Consciousness.
Sui's Remnant Consciousness exploration progress is retained in this session.
You can choose to conserve Recruitment Vouchers and use them later in a Pathfinder node, spending less Hope and turning recruited Operators into Candleguests immediately.
You can choose to re-toss coins in the coin coffer. Try it out if you are not happy with the current results.
Each coin toss increases the cost of the next one. Cost is reset when you reach a new floor.
You can obtain Tongbao from battles and events, and they can greatly impact your exploration.
The coin coffer can hold a limited number of Tongbao. Obtaining new Tongbao requires you to discard an old one from your coin coffer.
A new Hour of Sui will be triggered when you enter certain floors. Be prepared.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_1.name: Blunt Claws - Training
rogue_5_relic_legacy_1.description: A formidable set of equipment to provide strength, an indomitable heart to press forward bravely.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_1.usage: Immediately Promote a Vanguard Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_2.name: Bend Spears - Training
rogue_5_relic_legacy_2.description: Some people use swords because they don't know how to use crossbows or Arts. Others use swords because that's all they need.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_2.usage: Immediately Promote a Guard Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_3.name: Iron Guard - Training
rogue_5_relic_legacy_3.description: Scars symbolize glory, but who will remember the soldiers who were cut a bit too deeply?
rogue_5_relic_legacy_3.usage: Immediately Promote a Defender Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_4.name: Fatal Bolts - Training
rogue_5_relic_legacy_4.description: 'Either you learn to control your fire power, or you learn to discern your target. Got it?'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_4.usage: Immediately Promote a Sniper Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_5.name: Broken Wand - Training
rogue_5_relic_legacy_5.description: 'After watching the 'performances' of certain casters, I decided to quietly put away the Leithanian textbook.'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_5.usage: Immediately Promote a Caster Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_6.name: Stalwart Aid - Training
rogue_5_relic_legacy_6.description: Their tactics are always diverse and colorful.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_6.usage: Immediately Promote a Supporter Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_7.name: Healer's Path - Training
rogue_5_relic_legacy_7.description: When the day comes that everyone is a doctor capable of curing the disease known as life, we will no longer need doctors.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_7.usage: Immediately Promote a Medic Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_8.name: Rusted Blade - Training
rogue_5_relic_legacy_8.description: When conducting live combat drills with Specialist Operators, please be prepared to be 'beaten up thoroughly before you are prepared.'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_8.usage: Immediately Promote a Specialist Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_9.name: Game Room Admin Access Card
rogue_5_relic_legacy_9.description: With this, you have become master over Rhodes Island's entertainment privileges. Please exercise caution when processing the various strange applications from the operators... and remember to lock the door every day.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_9.usage: Immediately Promote an Operator (Does not require Hope)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_10.name: Miss.Christine Petting Ticket
rogue_5_relic_legacy_10.usage: Immediately Promote 2 Operators (Does not require Hope)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_11.name: Antique Casting
rogue_5_relic_legacy_11.description: 'Harken, the forge of the sky, awaits five earthborn metals'... Even though it can be used for all kinds of work, nobody understands its exact mechanism.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_11.usage: Immediately Promote 3 Operators (Does not require Hope)
rogue_5_relic_legacy_11.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, promote a total of 35 Operators

rogue_5_relic_legacy_12.name: Hot Water Kettle
rogue_5_relic_legacy_12.description: Some people often use the hot water kettle in the Rhodes Island Office to cook instant noodles in the middle of the night. That's not a very healthy lifestyle...

rogue_5_relic_legacy_13.name: Vanilla Soda
rogue_5_relic_legacy_13.description: Bolívar's cheap specialty drink dates back hundreds of years. It is mixed with a variety of spices, and is known for not being very good.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_13.usage: Increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.2/s

rogue_5_relic_legacy_14.name: Dreaming Essence
rogue_5_relic_legacy_14.description: Supposedly the Banshees make their aromatics only for their beloved. A single drop is enough to enchant just about anyone, bringing out any artist's inspiration and creativity.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_14.usage: Increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.5/s

rogue_5_relic_legacy_15.name: Victory Horn
rogue_5_relic_legacy_15.description: Blow the horn, cry out, and scatter our foes with its roar!
rogue_5_relic_legacy_15.usage: Increases the duration of single-instance status effects such as stun, cold, or freeze by 100%

rogue_5_relic_legacy_16.name: Therapy Tape
rogue_5_relic_legacy_16.description: He tried to stop you from listening. He said it was dangerous. He said you should not stay. Do you understand now? You are listening to his song.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_16.usage: Increases the duration of single-instance status effects such as stun, cold, or freeze by 150%
rogue_5_relic_legacy_16.unlockCondDesc: Complete a battle while having at least 3 Supporter Operators in Squad

rogue_5_relic_legacy_17.name: 'Avenger'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_17.description: A gift from Theresis and set up by Theresa, this is the very first weapon that Ascalon received after her inaugural mission as part of the Military Council.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_18.name: 'Brilliant Lament'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_18.description: His blood yet flows. He has never left this place.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_20.name: Military Mirror Armor
rogue_5_relic_legacy_20.description: This mirror armor used to be able to withstand most attacks to the chest, but with the fall of Gaul, such archaic forms of armor have become museum pieces.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_21.name: Old Steam Armor
rogue_5_relic_legacy_21.description: Even this old, outdated steam armor seems to carry with it the resplendence of when the Victorian monarchs cast their glory across half the world.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_21.unlockCondDesc: Select 'Ground Breaching Squad' and complete your adventure

rogue_5_relic_legacy_22.name: Emperor's Favor
rogue_5_relic_legacy_22.description: A very sharp letter opener. It was one of the favorite possessions of the last Ursus emperor, and as such it was very rarely used to actually open letters.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_22.usage: All friendly melee units have +15% ATK

rogue_5_relic_legacy_23.name: Vieux Vanguard's Blade
rogue_5_relic_legacy_23.description: Prior to its downfall, Gaul first witnessed the sacrifices of its Vieux Vanguards.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_23.usage: All friendly melee units have +35% ATK
rogue_5_relic_legacy_23.unlockCondDesc: Select 'Tactical Assault Squad' and complete your adventure

rogue_5_relic_legacy_24.name: Necklace of the Presence
rogue_5_relic_legacy_24.description: Faith hangs ten centimeters above your heart, spoken words flow into your blood, and bullets slide into your magazine.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_24.usage: All friendly ranged units have +15% ATK

rogue_5_relic_legacy_25.name: Damaged Revolver Cylinder
rogue_5_relic_legacy_25.description: She never capitulated, even after enduring countless trials and tribulations. Her muzzle belched tongues of flame that burned like an angry sun, and the glow above her head was brighter than the daylight itself. Buried here is Outcast, our friend.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_25.usage: All friendly ranged units have +35% ATK
rogue_5_relic_legacy_25.unlockCondDesc: Select 'High Ground Breaching Squad' and complete your adventure

rogue_5_relic_legacy_26.name: Rhodes Island Tactical Transceiver
rogue_5_relic_legacy_26.description: Hang in there, help's on the way.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_26.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, recruit a total of 70 Operators

rogue_5_relic_legacy_27.name: Extra-Pungent Coffee Beans
rogue_5_relic_legacy_27.description: Coffee beans fed to a rare, peculiar-smelling fowlbeast and processed from its excrement. The unique aroma from gastric acid fermentation triples the beans' price.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_27.usage: Squad Size Limit +1, Deployment Limit +1, +1 Objective Shield

rogue_5_relic_legacy_28.name: Pitt's Assorted Fruits

rogue_5_relic_legacy_30.name: Lost Key
rogue_5_relic_legacy_30.description: 'Fellas, this key can open the treasure trove lost within the royal city of Kazdel. Hey, green-haired Feline! Watch that hooded slave of yours and keep those hands away from my map!'

rogue_5_relic_legacy_37.name: Gravity Defying Machine
rogue_5_relic_legacy_37.description: Nasti Lunorey's magnum opus lifted the Sarkaz from the land that had tormented them for thousands of years. Now, though they float in ethereal clouds, they remain firmly rooted in the sky.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_38.name: Lakebed Aegis
rogue_5_relic_legacy_38.description: Three decades ago, a child dropped his toy wooden shield into the lake. Three decades later, he bores through the frozen lake, retrieves his shield, and embarks on a hero's journey.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_38.usage: Objective Shield +1; all allied units gain +60% Max HP if you have any Objective Shield at the beginning of a battle
rogue_5_relic_legacy_38.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, enter a total of 40 non-combat nodes in Garden of Grotesqueries

rogue_5_relic_legacy_39.name: Children of the Walls
rogue_5_relic_legacy_39.description: The Children of Soil and Stone carefully taught the ancient city of Kazdel how to toughen itself and protect its people behind its walls. With the advent of a protracted peace, it was broken into many little pieces and turned into amulets for adventurers heading into unexplored lands.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_39.usage: Operators deployed on the 8 tiles surrounding the Objective Point gain +2 Block and +50% Max HP

rogue_5_relic_legacy_40.name: Supreme Ring
rogue_5_relic_legacy_40.description: In Leithanian mythology, he who holds the ring enjoys the vast riches of the entire world, but greed will also be his undoing.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_41.name: Golden Chalice
rogue_5_relic_legacy_41.description: Saints, knights, and believers. All of them are madmen. Dear God, even the chalice itself is made of pure gold!
rogue_5_relic_legacy_41.usage: For each 5 Originium Ingots in possession, all friendly units have +7 ASPD
rogue_5_relic_legacy_41.unlockCondDesc: Complete an ending with at least 20 Originium Ingots remaining

rogue_5_relic_legacy_42.name: Spinach Pack
rogue_5_relic_legacy_42.description: Many Cautus out there believe that popping the contents of this can into their mouths will grant them immense strength. The marketing's effectiveness is a classic success story in the industry.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_42.usage: All Operators have +60% ATK for one second after their skill becomes active

rogue_5_relic_legacy_43.name: Wrath of Siracusans
rogue_5_relic_legacy_43.description: The signature pasta dish of an 'authentic Siracusan restaurant' that once operated in the capital of Gaul. The dish's unique taste, and particularly its sauce—a blend of thick chocolate sauce and Originium Slug liver—earned the praise of many Gaulish nobles. Supposedly, though, this dish nearly caused a diplomatic crisis between Siracusa and Gaul.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_43.usage: All Operators have +100% ATK for one second after their skill becomes active
rogue_5_relic_legacy_43.unlockCondDesc: Clear [Steady Stream] without losing more than 3 Life Points

rogue_5_relic_legacy_44.name: Castle's Offspring
rogue_5_relic_legacy_44.description: With enough time, this box will become a whole new stage.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_44.usage: All Operators have +400 DEF and +30 RES 80 seconds after deployment

rogue_5_relic_legacy_45.name: Slave Hunter
rogue_5_relic_legacy_45.description: After obtaining Nasti's designs, the Sarkaz put them to use in war right away. They flew into the sky, dominating the Ancients with waves of wrath, and the never-ending war entered a new stage.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_45.usage: Units that become Levitated, Weightless, or are shifted will take 50% more damage for 10 seconds

rogue_5_relic_legacy_46.name: Timeworn Poetry Strips
rogue_5_relic_legacy_46.description: 'Drunk far beyond all mounts that list the realm, all beings take on souls as they demand.'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_46.usage: Summons have +30% HP, +30% ATK, and will no longer use Deployment slots

rogue_5_relic_legacy_47.name: Broken Wand - Undulation
rogue_5_relic_legacy_47.description: Tuned to the same frequency; together we'll play the melody.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_47.usage: For every Caster Operator on the field, all allied units deal +12% Arts damage (Stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_48.name: Blunt Claws - Predation
rogue_5_relic_legacy_48.description: The pack rumbles with hunger, waiting for a feast.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_48.usage: For every Vanguard Operator on the field, gain 1 DP every 3 seconds (Stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_49.name: Rusted Blade - Protraction
rogue_5_relic_legacy_49.description: If the host does not want guests, they'll never reach the door.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_49.usage: For every Specialist Operator on the field, all enemies have -5% Movement Speed (Stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_50.name: Bend Spears - Rending
rogue_5_relic_legacy_50.description: Those with power can always help each other to success.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_50.usage: For every Guard Operator on the field, all allied units gain +8% ATK (Stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_51.name: Fatal Bolts - Succession
rogue_5_relic_legacy_51.description: Hear the sound of the first arrow, as the last pierces the torso.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_51.usage: For every Sniper Operator on the field, all allied units gain ASPD +12 (Stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_52.name: Iron Guard - Rampart
rogue_5_relic_legacy_52.description: Gather sand to form a tower, and gaze upon enemies from above.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_52.usage: For every Defender Operator on the field, all allied units take 10% less Physical damage (Stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_53.name: Stalwart Aid - Linkup
rogue_5_relic_legacy_53.description: Hand in hand, shoulder to shoulder, brace yourselves, and look straight ahead.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_53.usage: For every Supporter Operator on the field, increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.2/s (Stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_54.name: Blunt Claws - Proficiency
rogue_5_relic_legacy_54.description: As operators who are often the first to head into battle, what they have been through is unfathomable.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_54.usage: The SP Cost of Vanguard Operators' skills -35%

rogue_5_relic_legacy_55.name: Blunt Claws - Burst
rogue_5_relic_legacy_55.description: He's already done all the reserve squad's work for them. What else do you expect?
rogue_5_relic_legacy_55.usage: Vanguard Operators gain +10 Starting SP and +10% ATK

rogue_5_relic_legacy_56.name: Bend Spears - Acuity
rogue_5_relic_legacy_56.description: 'This is the 7th blade you've broken this month.' 'But I cut down eight enemies this month.'

rogue_5_relic_legacy_57.name: Bend Spears - Bloodbath
rogue_5_relic_legacy_57.description: Soldiers who get bolder as time passes are rare. Most need some form of psychological counseling to alleviate the trauma of war.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_57.usage: Guard Operators restore 2 SP after each attack

rogue_5_relic_legacy_58.name: Bend Spears - Deathmatch
rogue_5_relic_legacy_58.description: I wouldn't really recommend learning those skills from Blaze.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_58.usage: Guard Operators have -40% DEF, but gain +40% ATK and ASPD +30

rogue_5_relic_legacy_59.name: Iron Guard - Invasion
rogue_5_relic_legacy_59.description: Defensive actions for the sake of teammates or strategic purposes often make people forget about their original aggressiveness.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_60.name: Iron Guard - Consolidation
rogue_5_relic_legacy_60.description: No matter how heavy fate's blow is, take it.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_60.usage: Defender Operators gain +40% HP, +40% DEF, and +20 RES

rogue_5_relic_legacy_61.name: Fatal Bolts - Precision
rogue_5_relic_legacy_61.description: In an era when Originium Arts were not as robust as they are now, Yan had a saying, 'a pierced willow leaf from a hundred paces,' to praise others for their mastery of archery.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_62.name: Fatal Bolts - Divine Speed
rogue_5_relic_legacy_62.description: It is said that the legendary archers of ancient Victoria can almost shoot a continuous stream of arrows.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_62.unlockCondDesc: Complete a battle while having at least 3 Sniper Operators in Squad

rogue_5_relic_legacy_63.name: Broken Wand - Arts Weaving

rogue_5_relic_legacy_64.name: Broken Wand - Concentration
rogue_5_relic_legacy_64.description: 'When a caster intends to go all out, they will display a completely different temperament — even if we're talking about something like Skyfire's grumpiness.'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_64.usage: Increases the SP regen rate of Caster Operators by +0.4/s

rogue_5_relic_legacy_65.name: Stalwart Aid - Diligence
rogue_5_relic_legacy_65.description: Operators tend to give it their all, even to tasks that might seem trivial. The reality is, those tasks are not trivial at all.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_65.usage: The SP Cost of Supporter Operators' skills -40%

rogue_5_relic_legacy_66.name: Healer's Path - Self-Treating
rogue_5_relic_legacy_66.description: Who says healers can't heal themselves? They simply pop some pills before continuing to help others.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_66.usage: Increases the SP regen rate of Medic Operators by +0.3/s

rogue_5_relic_legacy_67.name: Healer's Path - Keen Hands
rogue_5_relic_legacy_67.description: Compared to snatching a life from the grip of death, what's three days of coma afterward?

rogue_5_relic_legacy_68.name: Rusted Blade - Advancement
rogue_5_relic_legacy_68.description: There may be many means, but only one end.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_68.usage: Specialist Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP

rogue_5_relic_legacy_69.name: Rusted Blade - Execution
rogue_5_relic_legacy_69.description: An endless amount of rust to scrape off, and an endless amount of work.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_70.name: Rusted Blade - No Man's Land
rogue_5_relic_legacy_70.description: A shadow blinks, a faint sound stirs, and a life is taken. The audience is the next victim.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_70.usage: The Redeployment Time of Specialist Operators -35%

rogue_5_relic_legacy_71.name: Frozen Husk
rogue_5_relic_legacy_71.description: The warriors of Sami stationed in the Fjal Vetrtonn are often inspired by an illusion: As their life flows toward the earth, their originally frozen bodies become lighter and lighter.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_71.usage: Melee Operators gain ASPD +40 for 5 seconds after taking damage

rogue_5_relic_legacy_72.name: Ancient Fresco
rogue_5_relic_legacy_72.description: Walk out of the cave, and raise your head. This has never been right, even since antiquity.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_72.usage: When an enemy enters or is freed from Levitation and/or Weightless, they take 1000 Arts damage and are Silenced for 10 seconds

rogue_5_relic_legacy_73.name: Galleria Stellaria's Splendor
rogue_5_relic_legacy_73.description: At that moment, the light of truth shone onto the earth.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_73.usage: When an enemy enters or is freed from Levitation and/or Weightless, they take 2000 Arts damage and take 30% more damage for 10 seconds

rogue_5_relic_legacy_74.name: Ring of Thorns
rogue_5_relic_legacy_74.description: You were able to steady yourself while in a distorted fear. There is blood left on the thorns, and you don't know if it was you or the Snowpriest who was pricked by them. They will use whatever means they have, without batting an eye.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_74.usage: When Melee Operators are healed, they and Operators in the adjacent 4 tiles will recover 1 SP

rogue_5_relic_legacy_75.name: Polar Retrofit Package
rogue_5_relic_legacy_75.description: Proudly produced by the Volvort Kochinski Extreme Environment Equipment Testing Department. It can modify a variety of devices, adapting them for polar regions and increasing their effectiveness in cold environments.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_75.usage: When used, Support items will also be used simultaneously on the adjacent 4 tiles

rogue_5_relic_legacy_76.name: Frost Buck's Pauldron
rogue_5_relic_legacy_76.description: There are no signs of injuries on his body, only a pair of eyes drained of blood and tears.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_76.usage: All allied units gain ATK +40% and DEF +40% for 30 seconds when blocking 2 or more enemies
rogue_5_relic_legacy_76.unlockCondDesc: Complete a battle while having at least 3 Defender Operators in Squad

rogue_5_relic_legacy_77.name: Vinecreep Mortar Gunner
rogue_5_relic_legacy_77.description: It's no surprise such a fantastical weapon would appear when people from different cultures let down their guard and communicate with sincerity.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_77.usage: Enemies defeated while airborne will deal 5000 Physical damage to surrounding enemies
rogue_5_relic_legacy_77.unlockCondDesc: Select 'Tactical Ranged Squad' and complete your adventure

rogue_5_relic_legacy_78.name: Iron Guard - Moving Fortress
rogue_5_relic_legacy_78.description: Nobody can break through their defenses, and even fewer are able to escape from their assault. If every combatant has a mission, then that mission is to change the situation on the battlefield the moment they enter the fray.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_78.usage: Defender Operators have +100% ATK, +100% DEF, and +1 Block for 20 seconds after deployment
rogue_5_relic_legacy_78.unlockCondDesc: Complete a battle while having at least 3 Defender Operators in Squad

rogue_5_relic_legacy_79.name: 'Devotion'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_79.description: Since antiquity, this tribe has believed that they hold a truth about Sami: Everything originally had a voice, until 'It' spoke for all of them.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_79.usage: Ranged Operators deal 300 Arts damage to a random enemy within attack range with every attack or heal

rogue_5_relic_legacy_80.name: 'Unleashings'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_80.description: After several attempts by Touch, nature briefly opens up to you.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_80.usage: All Operators recover 1 SP every time they take damage or Elemental Injury

rogue_5_relic_legacy_81.name: Royal Brooch
rogue_5_relic_legacy_81.description: An ornament worn by Gaulish royalty, made from gold and inlaid with expensive Originium crystals. They are more than decoration: many of these brooches hide Originium circuits loaded with defensive Arts.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_81.usage: All allied units have +15 RES, and dodge one instance of damage after deployment

rogue_5_relic_legacy_82.name: String Puppet
rogue_5_relic_legacy_82.description: The more you struggle and try to break free, the tighter the strings get. Do you really think you are still thinking rationally?
rogue_5_relic_legacy_82.usage: Enemies receive 700 Arts damage per second when stunned, frozen, or bound

rogue_5_relic_legacy_83.name: 'Children's Puppet'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_83.description: A simple puppet made by Iberian children using trinkets found on the seacoast. Supposedly just holding it tight will give you much richer dreams.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_83.usage: Enemies receive 1400 Arts damage per second when stunned, frozen, or bound

rogue_5_relic_legacy_84.name: Bank of Gaul Check
rogue_5_relic_legacy_84.description: An extravagant checkbook plated in gold and silver. Can no longer be cashed.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_85.name: Healer's Path - Wellspring
rogue_5_relic_legacy_85.description: They are clear springs formed from flowing water, and they heal all that live.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_85.usage: For every Medic Operator on the field, all allies gain Redeployment Time -5% (Stacks up to 8 times)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_86.name: 'End of Times'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_86.description: As long as a new cycle has not been reached, there is still time to fix your mistakes.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_86.usage: For one time only, if you would fail any battle other than the final battle of the area or a Leader battle, you instead gain +1 Life Point and advance to the next step instead of concluding the exploration
rogue_5_relic_legacy_86.unlockCondDesc: In a single battle, lose a total of 8 Life Points (including mission failures)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_87.name: Coin Geists
rogue_5_relic_legacy_87.description: Eight coins turned into one geist, but they retain their own minds. Even when one grabs the thread binding them together, they may stay defiant.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_87.usage: When the battle begins, randomize all allied Operators' Deployment Cost

rogue_5_relic_legacy_88.name: Worn-out Group Photo
rogue_5_relic_legacy_88.description: Do you know someone in the photo?
rogue_5_relic_legacy_88.usage: All enemies have -4% HP and -8% DEF

rogue_5_relic_legacy_89.name: Rosmontis's Embrace
rogue_5_relic_legacy_89.usage: All enemies have -10% HP and -20% DEF

rogue_5_relic_legacy_90.name: 'The Whisperer in Darknight'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_90.description: A black vinyl. DO. NOT. TOUCH. IT.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_91.name: 'Profound Silence'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_91.description: A painting that depicts the greatest disaster in Iberian history. Its brushstrokes, colors, and images are all meaningless. 'The Ægir know. The Ægir know. The Ægir know.'

rogue_5_relic_legacy_92.name: Noxious Hemostatic Agent
rogue_5_relic_legacy_92.description: 'After fermentation, the body fluids of this Originium slug can be used to stop bleeding.' —'Rhodes Island Wilderness Survival Guide'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_92.usage: All allied units have +20% HP, and Candleguests gain an extra +10%

rogue_5_relic_legacy_93.name: Unknown Instrument
rogue_5_relic_legacy_93.description: Don't ask. It's for your own good.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_93.usage: All allied units have +50% HP, and Candleguests gain an extra +30%

rogue_5_relic_legacy_94.name: Live Rose
rogue_5_relic_legacy_94.description: Is it you who nourishes her, or is it she who protects you?
rogue_5_relic_legacy_94.usage: All allied units have +20% healing effectiveness

rogue_5_relic_legacy_95.name: White Flower Crown
rogue_5_relic_legacy_95.description: A floral veil used in Vampire rituals. Its once vibrant redness has been sucked empty, leaving only a pale white color.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_95.usage: All allied units have +30% healing effectiveness

rogue_5_relic_legacy_96.name: Stalwart Aid - Counter-Arts
rogue_5_relic_legacy_96.description: There are many ways to weaken an enemy's defensive capabilities: positional devices, armor-stripping Arts, marking weak points, and... giving them a stomachache.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_96.usage: Enemies within the attack range of Supporter Operators have -30% DEF and -30% RES

rogue_5_relic_legacy_97.name: Blunt Claws - Mastery
rogue_5_relic_legacy_97.description: 'When the darkly-clad enemies rushed towards me, there were only four words on my mind — they are done for.'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_97.usage: For 60 seconds after the start of battle, all Vanguards gain +100% ATK and DEF

rogue_5_relic_legacy_98.name: Blunt Claws - Advancement
rogue_5_relic_legacy_98.description: Plant a great stone within the waters. Split the waves and part the fog.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_98.usage: Vanguard Operators have -50% DP Cost and gain +60% HP

rogue_5_relic_legacy_99.name: Iron Guard - Advancement
rogue_5_relic_legacy_99.description: The shieldbearers formed a mountain range and became the earth. What they fight against are not enemies of flesh and blood. They fight against fate and injustice.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_99.usage: Defender Operators have -6 DP Cost and +40% HP

rogue_5_relic_legacy_100.name: Bend Spears - Advancement
rogue_5_relic_legacy_100.description: The soldiers stepped onto the battlefield, drew their blades, and met in battle.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_100.usage: Guard Operators have -3 DP Cost, gain +40% HP and 15% Physical Dodge

rogue_5_relic_legacy_101.name: Iron Guard - Impenetrable
rogue_5_relic_legacy_101.description: Every blow they endure will turn into anger and be returned severalfold.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_101.usage: Defender Operators restore 2 SP after being attacked, and Skill SP cost -20%

rogue_5_relic_legacy_102.name: Fatal Bolts - Advancement
rogue_5_relic_legacy_102.description: Load, aim, and fire. Destruction arrives as scheduled.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_102.usage: Sniper Operators have -2 DP Cost, gain +60% HP and +100 DEF

rogue_5_relic_legacy_103.name: Broken Wand - Advancement
rogue_5_relic_legacy_103.description: Let Arts dance around your fingertips. Call the wind and rain, unravel reality, and achieve your grand goals.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_103.usage: Caster Operators have -3 DP Cost, gain +60% HP and +10 RES

rogue_5_relic_legacy_104.name: Stalwart Aid - Advancement
rogue_5_relic_legacy_104.description: Whenever you're 'almost done' with a task, what you need at that moment is someone to help you with the 'almost' part.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_104.usage: Supporter Operators have -2 DP Cost, +40% HP and 15% Arts Dodge

rogue_5_relic_legacy_105.name: Stalwart Aid - Assistance
rogue_5_relic_legacy_105.description: Proper meals, correct paths, or simply having a heart-to-heart... Victory is won through these little things.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_105.usage: Allied units within the attack range of Supporter Operators gain +30% ATK

rogue_5_relic_legacy_106.name: Healer's Path - Advancement
rogue_5_relic_legacy_106.description: The desire to save lives is a virtue that mankind must applaud, for that is the support that keeps us alive.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_106.usage: Medic Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP

rogue_5_relic_legacy_107.name: Healer's Path - Restore Sanity
rogue_5_relic_legacy_107.description: Making one's body as solid as a nomadic city is a bit of a romanticized description, but our medics are ready to put that idea into practice.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_107.usage: Medic Operators have +20% healing effectiveness, and allied units within their attack range gain Resistance

rogue_5_relic_legacy_108.name: Fatal Bolts - Crossfire
rogue_5_relic_legacy_108.description: The dense crossfire also exposes snipers to great danger. The next battle boils down to a game of vision.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_109.name: Broken Wand - Malediction
rogue_5_relic_legacy_109.description: It is virtually impossible to identify when the Sarkaz first encountered Originium, and the origins of these ancient Arts have long been separated from actual reality and common sense.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_110.name: Antique Coins
rogue_5_relic_legacy_110.description: An ancient, rusty coin, weathered to the point where one can no longer identify its age. Things like these are all too common throughout Terra's barrens.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_111.name: Flawless Jadestone
rogue_5_relic_legacy_111.description: Even though it thrice brought the city to ruins, it yet shines radiantly in its flawless form. Even today, the Sargonian emperor in possession of the gem has yet to find another piece of jewelry matching its brilliance, leaving it with naught but gunsmoke for a companion.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_112.name: Glass Bird
rogue_5_relic_legacy_112.description: 'In this paradise of mine, the bird will sing forever and ever.'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_112.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, earn a total of 50 Hope.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_113.name: Weird Flute
rogue_5_relic_legacy_113.description: A weird-looking flute. Someone plays it day in and day out.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_114.name: Red Bow Tie
rogue_5_relic_legacy_114.description: The first present Phantom gave Miss.Christine. She is really fond of it.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_115.name: Blue Silk Scarf
rogue_5_relic_legacy_115.description: A lady's elegant scarf. Her appearance is a sign that it is safe here.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_116.name: Solo Music Box
rogue_5_relic_legacy_116.description: An old music box. The music does not play when the box is opened, nor does the figure inside show any signs it is about to move. There is not a peep, and no one is breaking out in dance. Before she begins her performances with Phantom, the lead actress stares blankly into the music box.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_117.name: Originium Iris
rogue_5_relic_legacy_117.description: A most extravagant bouquet of flowers. The troupe leader has handed flowers like these to the leads during countless curtain calls.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_117.unlockCondDesc: Complete an ending with at least 60 Max Hope

rogue_5_relic_legacy_118.name: Pure Gold Expedition
rogue_5_relic_legacy_118.description: The regent departed from the wastelands, and markets rose from beneath her dress like sprouts budding in the spring. The road of prosperity connected high mountains and dense forests, following her until she disappeared beyond the cliffs overlooking the western waves. —Ancient Sargon Fairy Tale
rogue_5_relic_legacy_118.usage: Hope +4, Squad Size Limit +1, Deployment Limit +1
rogue_5_relic_legacy_118.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, earn a total of 150 Hope

rogue_5_relic_legacy_119.name: Pried Open Toolbox

A tree branch that has withered and flourished.
When it is withered, it grows anew. When it is thriving in its fullest, it fades away yet again.
