rogue_5_relic_legacy_137.unlockCondDesc: Select 'Tactical Fortification Squad' and complete your adventure

rogue_5_relic_legacy_138.name: Royal Liqueur
rogue_5_relic_legacy_138.description: The fine wines of the extinct country, Gaul, have now become expensive, prime treasures for collectors. The place of production is now a part of Leithanien, but the technique has been lost.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_138.usage: +7 Starting SP, increases the SP regen rate of Offensive and Defensive Recovery skills by 1 SP per 1.5s

rogue_5_relic_legacy_139.name: Northwind Construct
rogue_5_relic_legacy_139.description: Though she often fails, she is still committed to helping those who would challenge their tragic fates.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_139.usage: When an Apparition enemy deals damage for the first time, inflict Fear on self for 5s
rogue_5_relic_legacy_139.unlockCondDesc: Win Emergency Op [Sparkling Shine] without losing Life Point

rogue_5_relic_legacy_140.name: Weave of Thorns and Leaves
rogue_5_relic_legacy_140.description: Those within this ring receive the favor of the thorns and leaves.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_140.usage: One random deployable Vagary Tile will grant Camouflage to allied units on its surrounding 8 tiles when an Operator is deployed on it

rogue_5_relic_legacy_141.name: Weave of Snow and Soil
rogue_5_relic_legacy_141.description: Those within this ring receive the attention of the snow and earth.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_141.usage: One random deployable Vagary Tile will grant 1 SP to all allied units deployed on other Vagary tiles when the Operator deployed on the marked tile uses a Offensive Recovery or Defensive Recovery skill

rogue_5_relic_legacy_142.name: Distant Home's Guide
rogue_5_relic_legacy_142.description: This ancient ring is actually said to be a special navigation device, used to find emergency supplies that the Ægir once secretly stashed in various spots across the ocean. Follow the ocean's currents, be guided by wind; your homeland will always continue to bestow gifts upon you.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_142.usage: One random deployable Vagary Tile will grant the Operator on it 1 SP and 3% HP recovery per second

rogue_5_relic_legacy_143.name: 'Numbness and Obscenity'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_143.description: A famous art piece and the final piece created by an insane Leithanian sculptor two hundred years ago. The sculptor was known for his extraordinary talent and his participation in multiple cruel homicides. However, historical records show that few people took notice of his work. He was instead known for his features and beauty.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_143.usage: All allied units have +5 RES and +10% Arts Dodge

rogue_5_relic_legacy_144.name: Designer's Ruler
rogue_5_relic_legacy_144.description: Carefully measured with data and experience, those who wear this armor are known to be several magnitudes luckier.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_144.usage: All allied units have +15% Physical Dodge, and gain +30% ATK for 6 seconds after dodging

rogue_5_relic_legacy_145.name: 'Arts Killer'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_145.description: Considering how Originium Arts and music go hand in hand in Leithanien, it's quite amazing someone came up with the bright idea of combating Arts with noise like this.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_145.usage: All friendly units have +15% Arts Dodge, and gain +30% ATK for 6 seconds after dodging

rogue_5_relic_legacy_146.name: 'Glorious Kazimierz'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_146.description: A Kazimierzian best-seller that adapts the deeds of the arena's brightest-shining knights into a novel. Nearl, who was exiled but returned to reclaim her laurels, occupies a considerable portion of its pages.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_146.usage: Operators gain +70 ASPD for 15 seconds after dodging
rogue_5_relic_legacy_146.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, win a total of 40 battles

rogue_5_relic_legacy_147.name: 'The Return'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_147.description: This Kazimierzian best-seller is said to be a collective creation by fans. 'Nearl' has already become an amalgamation of many ideals and fantasies. 'For her, exile was not an escape. She came back, and stood alone against the era's torrents.'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_147.usage: Operators gain +130% ATK for 15 seconds after dodging

rogue_5_relic_legacy_148.name: Celestial Dust
rogue_5_relic_legacy_148.description: She gently blows away the countless records of sunrises, moonsets, and the changing of the stars. Her life is blown away that easily.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_148.usage: Ranged Operators Levitate all enemies within attack range for 5 seconds when a skill is manually activated

rogue_5_relic_legacy_149.name: 'Blademace'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_149.description: A sword lodged in a stone. Was someone bored enough to do this?
rogue_5_relic_legacy_149.usage: All Operators have +3 DP Cost, but gain +20% ATK, DEF, and HP

rogue_5_relic_legacy_150.name: Cannot's Mark
rogue_5_relic_legacy_150.description: Some are willing to do favors for Cannot to maintain good terms, while others deserve the same treatment from Cannot.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_150.usage: When you clear a stage with this Collectible in possession, 60% of your Ingots will be invested into the Prospective Investment System (caps at 60 per run)
rogue_5_relic_legacy_150.unlockCondDesc: Invest a total of 250 Originium Ingots with the Prospective Investment System

rogue_5_relic_legacy_151.name: Smoky Candle
rogue_5_relic_legacy_151.description: An ash candle created from the Hall of Candles's fireworks. It dissipates when lit, but with the past seen in the fleeting smoke, it lights an eternal flame within one's heart.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_151.usage: Turns an Operator into a Candleguest

rogue_5_active_tool_1.name: Support Replenishment Station
rogue_5_active_tool_1.description: An emergency Portable Supply Station provided to field operators.
rogue_5_active_tool_1.usage: Bring a Portable Supply Station along to each battle

rogue_5_active_tool_2.name: Support Landmine Set
rogue_5_active_tool_2.description: An emergency set of Interference Mines provided to field operators.
rogue_5_active_tool_2.usage: Bring 3 Interference Mines along to each battle

rogue_5_active_tool_3.name: Support Mr. Boom
rogue_5_active_tool_3.description: An emergency Mr. Boom provided to field operators.
rogue_5_active_tool_3.usage: Bring 2 Mr. Booms along to each battle

rogue_5_active_tool_4.name: Support Escape Crane
rogue_5_active_tool_4.description: An emergency Snowsant's Safe Escape Crane provided to field operators.
rogue_5_active_tool_4.usage: Bring 2 Snowsant's Safe Escape Cranes along to each battle

rogue_5_active_tool_5.name: Support Riot Pile
rogue_5_active_tool_5.description: An emergency set of Riot Piles provided to field operators.
rogue_5_active_tool_5.usage: Bring 2 Riot Piles along to each battle

rogue_5_active_tool_6.name: Support Fog Machine
rogue_5_active_tool_6.description: An emergency Fog Machine provided to field operators that appears to be broken.
rogue_5_active_tool_6.usage: Bring a Broken Fog Machine along to each battle

rogue_5_relic_fight_1.name: Enlistment Order
rogue_5_relic_fight_1.description: An enlistment order from the museum collection, issued during the great hunt. It calls for members capable of infiltrating a Feranmut's lair, and attached is a list of names who have signed their lives away.
rogue_5_relic_fight_1.usage: Operators deployed on the 8 tiles surrounding an Incursion Point gain +100% ATK

rogue_5_relic_fight_2.name: 'Fist Classics 123'
rogue_5_relic_fight_2.description: Shuo's first collection of his thoughts on Kung Fu. It discusses three aspects: first, fist techniques; second, meaning; and third, the pugilist realm itself. It is said the language used is so cryptic that his students could not understand it, so he asked his younger sister for revisions.
rogue_5_relic_fight_2.usage: Operators gain +5% ATK whenever they use a skill (Stacks up to 40 times)

rogue_5_relic_fight_3.name: Geist Binding Rope
rogue_5_relic_fight_3.description: Geists do the Sui Regulators' bidding while constrained by these ropes. Be it pouring tea or watering plants, they excel at simple, repetitive work.
rogue_5_relic_fight_3.usage: Summons have -5 DP Cost, -25% Redeployment Time, and gain +30% ATK

rogue_5_relic_fight_4.name: 'Ah Meng'
rogue_5_relic_fight_4.description: During the calamity of the bestial Sui's awakening a century ago, the Sui Regulators used specially trained beckbeasts to track and eliminate geists. This ceramic sculpture commemorates the beckbeasts' sacrifice.

rogue_5_relic_fight_5.name: Evaluation Minister
rogue_5_relic_fight_5.description: An assessment support tool developed by Tianshi Bureau apprentices. You don't get anything even if you have the right answers. But when you're wrong... well, best to not even try.
rogue_5_relic_fight_5.usage: When an allied unit successfully Dodges or Resists damage, the next attack deals +100% damage

rogue_5_relic_fight_6.name: Borderbound Mirror
rogue_5_relic_fight_6.description: Mirrors like these often hung over windows and entrances of the Garden of Grotesqueries. When visitors run into unexpected danger, the realm within a mirror turns into an emergency shelter—until it shatters.
rogue_5_relic_fight_6.usage: Enemies' damage dealt on their first attack -90%

rogue_5_relic_fight_7.name: Everlasting Guiding Light
rogue_5_relic_fight_7.description: First-timers scaling the mount wield a burning candle to shield their minds from being submerged in the Sui's consciousness. As dark encroaches, the candle burns bright, anchoring their own consciousness on their path back to the present, throughout their long night. This is how they came to be known as 'Candleholders'.
rogue_5_relic_fight_7.usage: The first deployed Ground Operator gains +50% ATK, status resistance, and 50% Elemental Injury reduction until they are defeated or retreated
rogue_5_relic_fight_7.unlockCondDesc: Complete an ending with at least 80 Operators deployed in battle during the whole adventure

rogue_5_relic_fight_8.name: 'Firefly Booklight'
rogue_5_relic_fight_8.description: A plant from a scholar's hometown gradually withers by the academy window, but he cannot bear to dispose of it. The pot is eventually bereft of vegetation, but is surrounded by fireflies illuminating the pages of his books.
rogue_5_relic_fight_8.usage: When enemies are defeated, surrounding allied units recover 300 HP

rogue_5_relic_fight_9.name: Ink of Dawn and Dusk
rogue_5_relic_fight_9.description: Bubbles blown by the fin swimming within this scroll grant strange effects. The scroll's owner doesn't mind if they're touched, for they'll soon burst and vanish into the wind anyway.
rogue_5_relic_fight_9.usage: When a battle begins, obtain a random Tactical Prop for that battle

rogue_5_relic_fight_10.name: Chamber of Geists Ledger
rogue_5_relic_fight_10.description: Liu'er excitedly invites you to 'try' the Chamber of Geists' newest invention. You decline, citing your tight purse strings, but then you spot her casually scribbling on a ledger. Now, your excuse no longer stands.
rogue_5_relic_fight_10.usage: The DP Cost of Tactical Props, Summons, and Devices is reduced by 10

rogue_5_relic_fight_11.name: Toy Slingshot
rogue_5_relic_fight_11.description: A bronze slingshot born from the forge. When the rubber band is pulled, small copper companions huddle up into a surprising weighty ball, waiting to be launched. 'Here, have fun. It's not dangerous at all, no, it's just a toy.'
rogue_5_relic_fight_11.usage: When an Operator uses a skill, deals 30% of ATK as Arts damage to all enemies within Attack Range

rogue_5_relic_fight_12.name: 'A Jade Jue'
rogue_5_relic_fight_12.description: A jade pendant gifted by the master of the Garden of Grotesqueries. A friend you happened to make and are traveling with invites you to explore elsewhere, but you politely decline, and his face blinks into a different expression. He tries to pull you by force, only to flinch and withdraw as if scalded by something. You breathe a sigh of relief, and discover the now-cracked pendant on your waist.
rogue_5_relic_fight_12.usage: Operators on Vagary Tiles defeated for the first time will recover 30% HP instead of retreating

rogue_5_relic_fight_13.name: Snack Basket
rogue_5_relic_fight_13.description: A backpack-basket filled with snacks to be sold outside the garden was confiscated at the entrance. The staff awkwardly ask where the items came from, and after you answer honestly, they assure you all is well as they dash in the direction you pointed out with suspicious-looking tools in hand.
rogue_5_relic_fight_13.usage: All Operators gain +100% natural SP recovery, effect lasts until any Operator manually activates a skill

rogue_5_relic_fight_14.name: Old Sandal
rogue_5_relic_fight_14.description: An old straw sandal found under a bridge. The old man atop the bridge was waiting for you to return it, but once you get back, all you see is the other sandal. You mull it over, and recall how you recognize the old man's face from a certain painting...
rogue_5_relic_fight_14.usage: Summons deployed on Vagary Tiles take -50% Physical and Arts damage, and gain +50% ATK

rogue_5_relic_fight_15.name: Training Lightning Rod
rogue_5_relic_fight_15.description: Located on the Tianshi Bureau's mountain peak where Tianshis train their Lei Fa. Apprentices always start with the lightning rod until they're familiar with manipulating thunder. Within the Bureau, it also goes by 'Senior'.
rogue_5_relic_fight_15.usage: Operators gain +0.4/s SP recovery rate whenever they use a skill (Stacks up to 5 times)

rogue_5_relic_fight_16.name: Remnant Spring
rogue_5_relic_fight_16.description: What Xian came by and gifted a branch of spring?
rogue_5_relic_fight_16.usage: Enemies inflict Cold for 6 seconds on surrounding enemies when defeated

rogue_5_relic_fight_17.name: Walleye
rogue_5_relic_fight_17.description: Its consciousness still remains. Its steps stay trapped within the wall. It shields you from wind and calamity, and watches your departure.
rogue_5_relic_fight_17.usage: Allied Operators take 50% less Physical and Arts damage from sources outside their Attack Range

rogue_5_relic_fight_18.name: Fire Poking Stick
rogue_5_relic_fight_18.description: The Old Tianshi uses this wooden stick to clean up wicked spirits and overpower Feranmuts, but it spends most days quietly leaning on a kitchen corner wall, only getting picked up to stoke the flames.
rogue_5_relic_fight_18.usage: Operators' attacks on Apparition enemies deal additional Arts damage equal to 50% ATK

rogue_5_relic_bullet_1.name: Woodblock Prints
rogue_5_relic_bullet_1.description: Popular poems engraved on jujube wood. When aloof scholars spot poems they deem inferior circulating amongst the masses, they often scoff and sneer: 'Hmph. What a tragedy, a crime, to waste fine wood like that.'
rogue_5_relic_bullet_1.usage: After Operators use an ammo-type skill, gain +2% ATK every time they deal damage (Stacks to 30 times)

rogue_5_relic_bullet_2.name: Three Feet To All
rogue_5_relic_bullet_2.description: An ancient Yanese movable type printing press. A noble uses words as weapons, while villains... there was once a time when the printing house discovered the word block for 'not' was stolen right before they went to print a work, and the rebuttal text's meaning changed entirely, leaving one unsure whether to cry or not.
rogue_5_relic_bullet_2.usage: After Operators use an ammo-type skill, +100 ASPD for 15 second

rogue_5_relic_bullet_3.name: 'Yanese Dictionary'
rogue_5_relic_bullet_3.description: Yan's first ever common dictionary, compiled by a civilian writer after over a decade of work. The editor often sighed over how thin the volumes were despite the amount of text, and dedicated a tomb to rare characters that could not be included or recorded.
rogue_5_relic_bullet_3.usage: When Operators use an ammo-type skill and consume 70% of ammo for the first time, replenishes 30% of max ammo count

rogue_5_relic_bullet_4.name: 'Collection of Elegance'
rogue_5_relic_bullet_4.description: Yan's first poetry collection containing the most popular poems of the year it was published. Its immense popularity sparked a surge within the masses to copy the poems or write new ones, leading to a shortage of paper and ink.
rogue_5_relic_bullet_4.usage: When Operators use an ammo-type skill and consume 70% of ammo for the first time, replenishes 50% of max ammo count

rogue_5_relic_farmer_1.name: Yi Lock
rogue_5_relic_farmer_1.description: One of Yi's inventions, used by Ji to rake in a fortune. Both an ornament and education toy, and if you can comprehend its secrets, perhaps you will understand 'Sui' much better.
rogue_5_relic_farmer_1.usage: Two random deployable Vagary Tiles will grant 8 DP when Operators are deployed on them (Can be upgraded in Lost and Found)

rogue_5_relic_farmer_2.name: Complex Yi Lock
rogue_5_relic_farmer_2.description: A Yi lock, modified by its creator, now much more complicated. How the pieces lock in place no longer make much sense. However, grasp its secrets, and perhaps you will understand 'Sui' much, much better.
rogue_5_relic_farmer_2.usage: Five random deployable Vagary Tiles will grant 10 DP when Operators are deployed on them

rogue_5_relic_farmer_3.name: Mother Cauldron
rogue_5_relic_farmer_3.description: The nine provinces used nine cauldrons to represent them. As for how these cauldrons were even forged in the first place... 'The Mother Cauldron gave birth to them, duh!' Said a certain film master with a smile.
rogue_5_relic_farmer_3.usage: Operators on Vagary Tiles gain +10% ATK (Can be upgraded in Leisure, to a max of 10 levels)

rogue_5_relic_farmer_4.name: Delicate Bamboo
rogue_5_relic_farmer_4.description: A young bamboo shoot from Shu's treasured field. An effect sprouts with no cause, and grows a section every time the cycle repeats, until it has ten sections connected to one another, from start to end.
rogue_5_relic_farmer_4.usage: Operators on Vagary Tiles gain +10% HP (Can be upgraded in Leisure, to a max of 10 levels)

rogue_5_relic_farmer_5.name: 'Intro to Weiqi Openings'
rogue_5_relic_farmer_5.description: Why make that move within this space? The sound on the board ceases, a content game. The match is over... and times have changed.
rogue_5_relic_farmer_5.usage: 3 Broken Fog Machines will randomly spawn on the map on Vagary Tiles

rogue_5_relic_farmer_6.name: Brocade Banner
rogue_5_relic_farmer_6.description: Legends say the banner was used by the True Lung who ended the Hundred Clan Rebellion. As it waved in the air, hundreds of generals followed its call... But what holds power is not the banner itself. Rather, it's the collective determination of the people to stop war and make peace.
rogue_5_relic_farmer_6.usage: Each time an Operator on a Vagary Tile uses a skill, all other Operators on Vagary Tiles recover 1 SP

rogue_5_relic_explore_1.name: Ignited Beastkite
rogue_5_relic_explore_1.description: A kite based off a Feranmut. Candles set the ribbons alight, and it always burns, but the kite stays intact. Fly it on a regular day, and borrow its light to gain an extra step when you step into the Sui's consciousness.
rogue_5_relic_explore_1.usage: Obtain 1 Candle when entering Sui's Remnant Consciousness

rogue_5_relic_explore_2.name: 'Interdependent Luck'
rogue_5_relic_explore_2.description: If you encounter a half-completed poem inside the Garden of Grotesqueries, press this peach wood ornament over it. Minor disasters may be inevitable, but misfortune and fortune are interdependent. Never respond or complete a poem, EVER.
rogue_5_relic_explore_2.usage: Obtain 1 Coupon when a Risk Coin is added to Coin Coffer

rogue_5_relic_explore_3.name: Family Stir-Fry
rogue_5_relic_explore_3.description: Sky as lid, land as pot, with emotions of all variations sprinkled as seasoning on top. Humanity needs only eat well to live well.
rogue_5_relic_explore_3.usage: All Operators gain +20% HP and ATK; every Sui's Remnant Consciousness battle cleared increases effects by 10%

rogue_5_relic_explore_4.name: Rhodes Island Emergency Rescue Vehicle
rogue_5_relic_explore_4.description: No matter where your orders may send them—Elite Operators are sure to succeed!
rogue_5_relic_explore_4.usage: +2 Hope; Receive aid from a random Rhodes Island Elite Operator when fighting in Sui's Remnant Consciousness
rogue_5_relic_explore_4.unlockCondDesc: Select 'Tactical Destruction Squad' and complete your adventure

rogue_5_relic_explore_5.name: Wooden Lump
rogue_5_relic_explore_5.description: An ordinary geist object, which, as Liu'er says, is a treasure she found on the shores of the eastern. But apart from the warm wooden texture and refreshing, energizing fragrance, there doesn't seem to be anything special about it...
rogue_5_relic_explore_5.usage: On next visit to Sui's Remnant Consciousness, +2 Candles; Gain 10 Coupons after clearing all Retrieve and Legend nodes

rogue_5_relic_explore_6.name: Quickbeast Transport
rogue_5_relic_explore_6.description: Burdenbeast-drawn vehicles were popular when Yan's Chidao first opened. As the Chidao grew, faster and sturdier vehicles emerged, causing the once-common sight of galloping burdenbeasts to gradually disappear. The thrilling chance of being thrown to the ground at any moment was also slowly forgotten by the masses.
rogue_5_relic_explore_6.usage: For every Candleguest in your squad, all Candleguests gain +5 ASPD (Stacks up to 10 times)

rogue_5_relic_explore_7.name: Tzu-Wu Blade
rogue_5_relic_explore_7.description: An object condensed from the first Acute Hour of Sui, shaped as a weapon. With combat as whetstone, one can see keen fury within.
rogue_5_relic_explore_7.usage: Reveals all Turmoil nodes on the current or next Sui's Remnant Consciousness visit; grants -5% Redeployment Time to all Operators, and gains 1 stack for each completed Turmoil node, up to 6 stacks
rogue_5_relic_explore_7.shortUsage: Reveals all Turmoil nodes on the current or next Sui's Remnant Consciousness visit; grants -5% Redeployment Time, and gains 1 stack for each completed Turmoil, up to 6 stacks.

rogue_5_relic_explore_8.name: Wu-Shang Shuttle
rogue_5_relic_explore_8.description: An object condensed from the seventh Acute Hour of Sui, shaped as a shuttle. With links and weaves, one can see layered anxiety within.
rogue_5_relic_explore_8.usage: Reveals all Trade nodes on the current or next Sui's Remnant Consciousness visit; Trade nodes will offer discounted goods, and buying all stock in a shop grants a free chance to refresh stock
rogue_5_relic_explore_8.shortUsage: Reveals all Trade nodes on the current or next Sui's Remnant Consciousness visit; Trade nodes will offer discounted goods, and buying all stock in a shop will let you refresh stock for free once.

rogue_5_relic_explore_9.name: Shen-Chu Wheel
rogue_5_relic_explore_9.description: An object condensed from the ninth Acute Hour of Sui, shaped as a wheel. With curiosity as forge, one can see optimistic escapism within.
rogue_5_relic_explore_9.usage: +1 Hope, +3 Ingots, reveals all Leisure nodes on the current and next Sui's Remnant Consciousness visit; wondrous effects in some Leisure nodes

rogue_5_relic_explore_10.name: Hai-Shih Stove
rogue_5_relic_explore_10.description: An object condensed from the twelfth Acute Hour of Sui, shaped as a stove. With myriad bestial Sui deeds and mortal disputes all on the same land, why differentiate between the two?
rogue_5_relic_explore_10.usage: Wondrous effects in Retrieve nodes; +2 Candles after clearing all Retrieve nodes (only triggers once)

rogue_5_relic_explore_11.name: Yin-Shih Flask
rogue_5_relic_explore_11.description: An object condensed from the third Acute Hour of Sui, shaped as a flask. With tales as wine, one can see unrestrained freedom within.
rogue_5_relic_explore_11.usage: +2 Hope, reveals some Legend and Decision nodes on the current or next Sui's Remnant Consciousness visit; wondrous effects in some Legend nodes

rogue_5_relic_explore_12.name: Wei-Chien Rule
rogue_5_relic_explore_12.description: An object condensed from the eighth Acute Hour of Sui, shaped as a rule. With knowledge of construction, one can see obstructive amiability within.
rogue_5_relic_explore_12.usage: +6 Ingots; wondrous effects in Tavern nodes

rogue_5_relic_explore_13.name: Great Tomb Whistle
rogue_5_relic_explore_13.description: A wood whistle crafted from the Great Tomb Tree. When blown, one's consciousness drifts away from the body, while the whistle turns into fuel to light a steady fire inside the mind.
rogue_5_relic_explore_13.usage: After leaving this shop, immediately enter Sui's Remnant Consciousness and gain +3 Candles

rogue_5_relic_richg_1.name: Big Bob's Certificate
rogue_5_relic_richg_1.usage: For every 3 Ingots owned, +1 Starting DP

rogue_5_relic_richg_2.name: Round Woodwheel
rogue_5_relic_richg_2.description: Round boulders rolling down from the mounts shattered the Catastrophe-formed Originium clusters, providing people with their first inspiration for rapid movement.
rogue_5_relic_richg_2.usage: +5 Starting DP, with additional +10 for every Vanguard in Squad

rogue_5_relic_richg_3.name: Duo-Carrier Sedan
rogue_5_relic_richg_3.description: A chair and two rods separate people into two classes. Today, most sedan chairs are homed in museums, but how many people hold a desire within to be raised by others, overlooking from above?
rogue_5_relic_richg_3.usage: +15 cost limit; All Vanguard Operators gain +25% ATK and refund DP when deployed

rogue_5_relic_richg_4.name: Gallopbeast Chariot
rogue_5_relic_richg_4.description: A box with two wheels pulled by four gallopbeasts is surely faster than mortals walking on their own two legs—Is that so? Just look at the Khagan's Nightzmora troops. A chariot traveling at full speed still cannot keep up with how fast Terra develops.
rogue_5_relic_richg_4.usage: +30 cost limit, when DP is at 99 or higher, all units gain +50% HP and +1 Block

rogue_5_relic_richg_5.name: Rampart Burdenbeast
rogue_5_relic_richg_5.description: Stalwart warriors spread out and surround people gathered on burdenbeast backs as they journey toward a paradise free from any Catastrophes. This was the first 'nomadic city'.
rogue_5_relic_richg_5.usage: +15 cost limit, when DP is at 99 or higher, enemies on the surrounding 12 tiles around an Objective Point lose Invisibility and have -35% hit rate

rogue_5_relic_richg_6.name: 'Little Baizao'
rogue_5_relic_richg_6.description: A crystallization of war, Originium, and suffering.
rogue_5_relic_richg_6.usage: When an Operator is deployed, all enemies take True damage equivalent to a certain percentage of DP used; if 30 or more DP used, also inflicts Stun for 5s

rogue_5_relic_richg_7.name: 'Cangtong'
rogue_5_relic_richg_7.description: Lin Qingyan's sword makes no sound when unsheathed, its branch-like appearance concealing its true form. Drape thunder over, and it will surely cleave through wind and blaze, reaching its target in an flash.
rogue_5_relic_richg_7.usage: When DP reaches 99 or higher, all enemies take 3000 Arts damage and are Stunned for 2s every 10s

rogue_5_relic_blockg_1.name: Dark Red Mask
rogue_5_relic_blockg_1.description: The mask of an ancient Yanese hero. Records tell of his undying will so strong he even crossed a thousand li and vanquished a thousand foes to stay true to his sworn brotherhood.
rogue_5_relic_blockg_1.usage: All Operators take 50% less damage from enemies blocked by them, and deal 50% more damage to the blocked enemies

rogue_5_relic_blockg_2.name: Elder Mask
rogue_5_relic_blockg_2.description: The mask of an ancient Yanese hero. This is where the term 'Tianshi' comes from, as his profound wisdom spread to the House of Yan, achieving a millennium of peace before vanishing into thin air.
rogue_5_relic_blockg_2.usage: All enemies blocked by an Operator take 150% of the Operator's ATK as Arts damage every second, and lose 15% hit rate

rogue_5_relic_blockg_3.name: Charcoal Mask
rogue_5_relic_blockg_3.description: The mask of an ancient Yanese hero. Records tell of his courage and caution, and how his yells could split rivers into two.
rogue_5_relic_blockg_3.usage: Enemies blocked for the first time are inflicted with Fear for 5s

rogue_5_relic_blockg_4.name: Moon-Lady Mask
rogue_5_relic_blockg_4.description: The mask of a legendary Yanese character. The story of how she shed tears like a river in the search for her husband and flying to the moons has passed down the generations to the present day.
rogue_5_relic_blockg_4.usage: For every enemy blocked, Operators gain 10% Physical and Arts Dodge (Stacks up to 5 times)

rogue_5_relic_blockg_5.name: Screeching Blowgun
rogue_5_relic_blockg_5.description: If blood gets into this blowgun meant for sounding signals and warnings, the screeching, deafening sound it makes when fired sends anyone who hears it running at once.
rogue_5_relic_blockg_5.usage: When an Operator loses 30% HP, inflicts Fear on all enemies within Attack Range for 10s

rogue_5_relic_cardg_1.name: Four Corners Paint
rogue_5_relic_cardg_1.description: Dusk's special mix of pigments that also serves as her seal. When a brush is dipped into the palette, the four colors fuse and form into a scene.
rogue_5_relic_cardg_1.usage: For one time per battle, an Operator deployed with 4 Operators already on the field will gain +50% HP, +50% DEF, and +5 Block

rogue_5_relic_cardg_2.name: Four Seasons Brush
rogue_5_relic_cardg_2.description: Dusk's specially created brush that also serves as her seal. When she puts brush to parchment, the four seasons stay as-is.
rogue_5_relic_cardg_2.usage: For one time per battle, an Operator deployed with 4 Operators already on the field will gain status resistance, +50% ATK, and take 50% less Elemental Injury

rogue_5_relic_cardg_3.name: Soldier Shadow
rogue_5_relic_cardg_3.description: This shadow puppet was created to honor a soldier who defended the city. Legends say they led a party in a border defense for a hundred days, and when the city fell, they stood on its walls before the sands swallowed them up. When Yumen city was built, a commemorative state was also made.
rogue_5_relic_cardg_3.usage: Every time the rightmost Operator from the Deployment Waiting Zone is deployed, all deployed Operators gain a Barrier scaled to DP spent
rogue_5_relic_cardg_3.unlockCondDesc: Complete a battle while having at least 3 Defender Operators in Squad

rogue_5_relic_cardg_4.name: Craftsman Shadow
rogue_5_relic_cardg_4.description: This shadow puppet was created to honor a skilled artisan who dedicated their life to pursuing perfection. Villains coveted their skills, but not even money or physical suffering made them waver, only hoping their skills would remain unscathed. They later died in a bandit's den, and their works set alight, never to be passed down to further generations.
rogue_5_relic_cardg_4.usage: Every time the leftmost Operator from the Deployment Waiting Zone is deployed, all deployed Operators gain 100% of the DP spent as SP
rogue_5_relic_cardg_4.unlockCondDesc: Complete a battle while having at least 3 Supporter Operators in Squad

rogue_5_relic_cardg_5.name: Artist Shadow
rogue_5_relic_cardg_5.description: This shadow puppet was created to honor a legendary dancer. Legends tell of summoning mighty waves out of a river, and the beauty of spring drawn from forests with their dances. They dedicated their life to dance, but with age became injured and retired, leaving the mortal realm soon after. Countless dancers have copied their movements, but none have quite made it. What a shame.
rogue_5_relic_cardg_5.usage: The leftmost Operator in the Deployment Waiting Zone gains +10 Starting SP, +30 ASPD, and +30% ATK

rogue_5_relic_cardg_6.name: Merchant Shadow
rogue_5_relic_cardg_6.description: This shadow puppet was created to honor a legendary merchant. They once assembled a caravan of civilians to trade goods between cities in Catastrophe-prone areas, meeting the towns' urgent needs. When the Chidao was finally completed, they perished in an accident.
rogue_5_relic_cardg_6.usage: The rightmost Operator in the Deployment Waiting Zone gains +2 Block, +50% DEF, +50% Max HP, and refunds half the DP spent after deployment

rogue_5_relic_res_1.name: Deepwater Talisman
rogue_5_relic_res_1.description: The Sui Regulator trusts you, and approved your application to bring more Operators into the garden. Though, just as a creekfin enters a new river with caution, they hope newcomers will understand the importance of staying sharp.
rogue_5_relic_res_1.usage: In Garden of Grotesqueries, the first combat node on every floor will drop an extra Recruitment Voucher, Recruitment Voucher conservation limit +1

rogue_5_relic_res_2.name: Three-Legged Goldfowl
rogue_5_relic_res_2.description: The legs of this strange auspicious figure apparently refers to the two-sided coins of prosperity and decline, life and death, and flourish and decay; whichever leg touches a person first grants eternal blessing in that aspect. According to Sui Regulator research, while this creature appears to resemble a fowlbeast, it's unfortunately...
rogue_5_relic_res_2.usage: Upon acquisition, doubles one of the following resources randomly: Ingots, Hope, or Objective Shield

rogue_5_relic_raidian_1.name: Raidian's Handheld Console
rogue_5_relic_raidian_1.description: Stuffed with many carefully designed mini-games. You can always see a trace of the equipment Raidian uses daily in the protagonists, but no sign of her herself.
rogue_5_relic_raidian_1.usage: For every Summon on the field, all Summons gain +100 ATK and DEF (Stacks up to 10 times)

rogue_5_relic_speg_1.name: Bells of Agreement
rogue_5_relic_speg_1.description: After the inauguration ceremony, the new Candleholder went to meet his seniors—bells woven together with rope, with different techniques and colors—and after listening to the crisp bell chimes, the Candleholder ties a new link.
rogue_5_relic_speg_1.usage: For every Candleguest promoted via combat, all Candleguests +40% ATK; after deployment, -4% Redeployment Time and gain 4 DP (Stacks up to 4 times)

rogue_5_relic_speg_2.name: Strange Picky Statue
rogue_5_relic_speg_2.description: A shellbeast inside a pond that never does anything when coins are thrown at it. A naughty child throws trash that gets swallowed by the statue, sending the child into tears. The statue then reopens its mouth to spit out pretty pearls, sending the child into high spirits.
rogue_5_relic_speg_2.usage: Whenever you toss 3 Risk Coins, gain 3 Max Life Points and 3 Objective Shield

rogue_5_relic_speg_3.name: Varied Fortune
rogue_5_relic_speg_3.description: At dawn fowlbeasts cry, the sky a painting. Spring comes, and clouds cover sweet osmanthus. South wind blows winter, frost turned to flowers.
rogue_5_relic_speg_3.usage: Whenever you toss 3 Flower Coins, gain 8 Originium Ingots and 1 Hope

rogue_5_relic_speg_4.name: Brewed Realm
rogue_5_relic_speg_4.description: Cheap wine, fine liquor, all fine as long as you drink a ladle. Rush like a river, right into the gourd. A whole realm within, its taste's truly unique.
rogue_5_relic_speg_4.usage: For every Flower Coin in Coffer, all Operators +10% ATK and +20% HP
rogue_5_relic_speg_4.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, clear a total of 20 battles.

rogue_5_relic_speg_5.name: Remnant Flames And Dreams
rogue_5_relic_speg_5.description: Thunder bellows a sudden storm as war drums into the sky. Golden infantry rush forth from your dreams.
rogue_5_relic_speg_5.usage: Gain +15% Command EXP from battles for every Risk coin currently tossed
rogue_5_relic_speg_5.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, clear a total of 35 battles.

rogue_5_relic_speg_6.name: Metal Expedition Drum
rogue_5_relic_speg_6.description: A 'veteran' of the army. Once a messenger on the battlefield, it weathered hardships as it witnessed victory and defeat. Today more advanced communication methods have replaced it, but soldiers can still hear the morale-boosting drum beats before they head into battle.
rogue_5_relic_speg_6.usage: Operators gain +15% ATK with every coin toss (Stacks up to 10 times); if only Risk Coins tossed, adds an extra stack
rogue_5_relic_speg_6.unlockCondDesc: Across multiple adventures, clear a total of 50 battles.

rogue_5_relic_final_1.name: Cloud & Paint
rogue_5_relic_final_1.description: There are right and wrong moralities just as weiqi stones has black and white, but the Feranmut hardly cares. Change the realm with a cunning plan typed on paper, but you still require the Sui's will to enter the Tomb of Sui.
rogue_5_relic_final_1.usage: Operators lose 2% of Max HP for 60 seconds on deployment; Leads expedition in a different direction

rogue_5_relic_final_2.name: Unflinching Masterplan
rogue_5_relic_final_2.description: A square piece of wood, boasting a weiqi board on the top and a movable type plate on the back, perfectly supporting one another. The type cannot be used, for a block with 'Ji' and 'Ye' carved can be seen protruding, making it impossible for the frame to be pressed down.
rogue_5_relic_final_2.usage: Operators lose 50% SP on deployment; When carrying this Collectible, a special Operation option will appear in Pathfinder

rogue_5_relic_final_3.name: Ink of the Hidden Butterfly
rogue_5_relic_final_3.description: A creature researched by Liu'er, made from remnant rock of the Sui Tomb and martial tomes panned by Shuo. Originally Sui was carved on it, but Its form has faded, and now a butterfly is carved to take Its place. But the butterfly fears the Sui's might, so it is time to repel the Sui to appease it.
rogue_5_relic_final_3.usage: When carrying this Collectible, 'Body of Sui' will raid your party in battles

rogue_5_relic_final_4.name: Carved Inkstick Remnant
rogue_5_relic_final_4.description: A butterfly rests on the edge of the inkstick, and 'words' emerge from its multitude of layers. The missing sections are no longer readable, but the radicals and shapes of the other characters imply longing for a relative.
rogue_5_relic_final_4.usage: Every battle, a random Operator will have their DP Cost reduced to 0. When carrying this Collectible, can choose to lead expedition in a different direction in Prophecy

rogue_5_relic_final_5.name: Unsealed Case
rogue_5_relic_final_5.description: A box Yi left in the Sui's Remnant Consciousness. Name and decorations lost, bereft of carvings or markings.
rogue_5_relic_final_5.usage: Leader and Elite enemies gain +30% DEF and +20 ASPD; every Statuegeist remaining on the field when the stage ends will deplete 1 Life Point (min 1); wondrous effects in Scout nodes

rogue_5_relic_final_6.name: Inkless Scroll
rogue_5_relic_final_6.description: Humanity and Sui opened the box with their shared memories, and the long scroll searches for traces of where ink could have been.
rogue_5_relic_final_6.usage: +3 Hope, Dreadful Foe nodes in Jianzi Shrine will be more difficult; leads expedition in a different direction

rogue_5_relic_custog_1.name: 'Plucked Balance'
rogue_5_relic_custog_1.description: When both signs come together, what old tale do they tell?
rogue_5_relic_custog_1.usage: Melee Operators gain +35% HP and +35% ATK

rogue_5_relic_custog_2.name: 'Plucked Flower'
rogue_5_relic_custog_2.description: When both signs come together, what old tale do they tell?
rogue_5_relic_custog_2.usage: Melee Operators have +3 DP Cost, but gain +1 Block and +50% DEF

rogue_5_relic_custog_3.name: 'Plucked Risk'
rogue_5_relic_custog_3.description: When both signs come together, what old tale do they tell?
rogue_5_relic_custog_3.usage: All Melee Operators restore HP equal to 5% of their Max HP every second after deployment for 20s

rogue_5_relic_custog_4.name: 'Thrown Balance'
rogue_5_relic_custog_4.description: When both signs come together, what old tale do they tell?
rogue_5_relic_custog_4.usage: All Ranged Operators gain +25% HP and +25% ATK

rogue_5_relic_custog_5.name: 'Thrown Flower'
rogue_5_relic_custog_5.description: When both signs come together, what old tale do they tell?
rogue_5_relic_custog_5.usage: All Ranged Operators +2 DP Cost, but gain 2 layers of Shield when deployed

rogue_5_relic_custog_6.name: 'Thrown Risk'
rogue_5_relic_custog_6.description: When both signs come together, what old tale do they tell?
rogue_5_relic_custog_6.usage: All Ranged Operators gain status resistance and 15% Arts Dodge

rogue_5_relic_custog_7.name: 'Seen Balance'
rogue_5_relic_custog_7.description: When both signs come together, what old tale do they tell?
rogue_5_relic_custog_7.usage: When enemies become Weightless, -30% DEF and RES for 10s

rogue_5_relic_custog_8.name: 'Seen Flower'
rogue_5_relic_custog_8.description: When both signs come together, what old tale do they tell?
rogue_5_relic_custog_8.usage: On skill activation, Operators gain a Barrier equal to 10% of their Max HP that lasts for 10s (Does not stack)

rogue_5_relic_custog_9.name: 'Seen Risk'
rogue_5_relic_custog_9.description: When both signs come together, what old tale do they tell?
rogue_5_relic_custog_9.usage: Allied Operators deal 50% more Physical and Arts damage to Apparition enemies

rogue_5_relic_custog_10.name: 'Sui's Balance'
rogue_5_relic_custog_10.description: When both signs come together, what old tale do they tell?
rogue_5_relic_custog_10.usage: Candleguest Operators gain +50% ATK and DEF

rogue_5_relic_custog_11.name: 'Sui's Flower'
rogue_5_relic_custog_11.description: When both signs come together, what old tale do they tell?
rogue_5_relic_custog_11.usage: All Operators have +3 DP Cost, but Candleguest Operators gain +10% HP, ATK, and DEF for every Candleguest in the Squad

rogue_5_relic_custog_12.name: 'Sui's Risk'
rogue_5_relic_custog_12.description: When both signs come together, what old tale do they tell?
rogue_5_relic_custog_12.usage: Candleguests gain 100% ATK for 10s after deployment, duration increased by 5s for every Candleguest promoted via combat (Can be increased up to 15 times)

rogue_5_relic_return_1.name: Scout's Scope
rogue_5_relic_return_1.description: Lock on, aim, fire, and destroy the enemy's will to resist, all in the name of a better future that Scout will never see. Maybe you can do it for him.
rogue_5_relic_return_1.usage: Enemies take increased damage from allied units as range increases (max 100%)

rogue_5_relic_return_3.name: Great Banshee's Veil
rogue_5_relic_return_3.description: The former Lord of the Banshees always seemed amicable, as if that were her only side... until she pulled out her bone pen, sang softly, and impaled agonizing wails into the minds of every intruder.
rogue_5_relic_return_3.usage: All enemies take +10% Arts damage and +50% Elemental Injury

rogue_5_relic_return_4.name: Disaster's Origin
rogue_5_relic_return_4.description: The Sarkaz dug through the Targangils Prime Vein and Originium crystals spurted forth from Kazdel. Their fall was inevitable, so they wanted everything on this great land to be buried together with them.
rogue_5_relic_return_4.usage: All enemies take +20% Arts damage and +100% Elemental Injury

rogue_5_relic_return_5.name: Pure White Dance Shoes
rogue_5_relic_return_5.description: The Ursus dancer's steps are swift and elegant, her body moving as she wills.
rogue_5_relic_return_5.usage: Can deploy Ranged Operators on Low Ground tiles

rogue_5_relic_return_6.name: Ribbon of Honor
rogue_5_relic_return_6.description: Numerous actors have played this character, yet none of them were able to save the character's dearest friend.
rogue_5_relic_return_6.usage: All allied units have +100% ATK when blocking only 1 enemy

rogue_5_relic_return_7.name: Survivor Contract
rogue_5_relic_return_7.description: A very long contract, in which every term and condition is the result of experience, leaving no room for chance or sentiment. Satisfy them all to be the final survivor.
rogue_5_relic_return_7.usage: At the start of battle, a random Operator gains +20% ATK and DEF, plus an additional +20% at the end of each victorious battle

rogue_5_relic_return_8.name: Four-Leaf Clover Fossil
rogue_5_relic_return_8.description: A symbol of luck that Magallan found in a place all but devoid of life. The rock has no doubt experienced many violent changes of the lands, but it survived, giving those who come across it a small bit of lingering hope.
rogue_5_relic_return_8.usage: Gain an additional choice when a Collectible drops from a Wish Fulfilled node or after battle

rogue_5_relic_return_9.name: Fearless Blade
rogue_5_relic_return_9.description: Before Kazdel's gates he stood, an impregnable bulwark. Gaulish artilleries, Leithanian casters, and Victorian Knights all took their shots at him. Yet, even when the gates fell and the coalition retreated, the Goliath did not yield an inch.
rogue_5_relic_return_9.usage: When the battle begins, the Operator with the highest DP Cost gains +50% ATK and DEF

rogue_5_relic_return_12.name: Godmother's Token
rogue_5_relic_return_12.description: A laurel of bones, the token of Signora Sicilia. This symbol of order will smooth the turbulence of all desires, for conflict is not allowed. Genuine or counterfeit, it still demands you to kneel.

rogue_5_relic_return_13.name: Fissured Restraints
rogue_5_relic_return_13.description: It seems this sturdy band was once used to restrain something terrifying... Help...

rogue_5_relic_return_14.name: Living Woodplate
rogue_5_relic_return_14.description: Shamans know the formidable will to survive that trees possess, so when a warrior has a similar will, they invite the trees to be their armor.
rogue_5_relic_return_14.usage: All allied melee units gain a Barrier equal to 50% of their Max HP on deployment

rogue_5_relic_return_16.name: Snow Doe's Glove
rogue_5_relic_return_16.description: She shoots the last three arrows in her quiver at the Frozen Monstrosity, who used them to end her life.
rogue_5_relic_return_16.usage: All allied units gain ASPD +80 and obtain 50% Physical and Arts Dodge for 30s when blocking 3 or more enemies

rogue_5_relic_return_17.name: Roundstone Altar
rogue_5_relic_return_17.description: An offering made is returned with a reward. So simple it was, that people never questioned what they were sacrificing to.
rogue_5_relic_return_17.usage: Chance to permanently increase all allied units' ATK and DEF by 5% after a victorious battle (Stacks up to 10 times)

rogue_5_relic_return_18.name: Black Tulip
rogue_5_relic_return_18.description: Silence crushed the Iberians, so she knows she must speak up. If her words aren't sharp enough, her sword will speak for her.
rogue_5_relic_return_18.usage: Allied Operators gradually gain ATK when not using a skill, up to a maximum of +60% after 60s; bonus is reset when skill ends

rogue_5_relic_return_19.name: Emergency Stimulant
rogue_5_relic_return_19.description: An injection commonly used in Rim Billiton's local mines. Its strong active ingredient can stimulate the workers' senses and ensure their work efficiency in extreme environments. When life and their project both present their deadlines, sometimes the choice is simpler than one might think.
rogue_5_relic_return_19.usage: Operators gain ASPD as their HP decreases, up to +60 ASPD at 30% HP

rogue_5_relic_return_20.name: Old George's Nutri-Paste
rogue_5_relic_return_20.description: This poor-tasting fortified nutritional supplement was originally a 'dietary supplement' periodically provided to Columbian Pioneers, but after extensive marketing, it suddenly became a 'beauty product' beloved by nobles.
rogue_5_relic_return_20.usage: Operators gain ATK as their HP increases, up to +30% ATK at 100% HP

rogue_5_relic_return_21.name: Broken Wand - Absorb
rogue_5_relic_return_21.description: Consume the defeated as nourishment, and embark on an eternal path to victory.
rogue_5_relic_return_21.usage: Caster Operators recover 2 SP every time they deal damage to an enemy unit

rogue_5_relic_return_22.name: Iron Guard - Advance
rogue_5_relic_return_22.description: In exchange for an opportunity to attack, the shattered ranks made one more advance.
rogue_5_relic_return_22.usage: Defender Operators inflict Bind on all nearby enemies lasting 1s every 2s, and deal True damage equal to 100% of their ATK

rogue_5_copper_buff_B_02_a.description: Mounts at west. Cragged stones. Villains rise. Ill will hides.

rogue_5_relic_return_23.name: King's New Lance
rogue_5_relic_return_23.description: Beautiful wishes made in dire straits can bring hope, even if they are not necessarily the truth.
rogue_5_relic_return_23.usage: All allied Operators have +50 ASPD when at 1 Life Point

rogue_5_relic_return_24.name: King's Armor
rogue_5_relic_return_24.description: There used to be many golden display cases placed before the palace gates and in the square, displaying all sorts of treasures to admire. But now, it hurts just to think about such sights.
rogue_5_relic_return_24.usage: +3 Objective Shield, coverts all Life Points into Objective Shield, and -1 Life Point and +1 Objective Shield at the end of battle

rogue_5_relic_return_25.name: King's Legacy
rogue_5_relic_return_25.description: Grow up and face reality. Arm yourself with tenacity and confidence, while showing your friends tolerance and grace.
rogue_5_relic_return_25.usage: When at 1 Life Point, all Operators recover additional 1 SP and 3% of Max HP every 2s

rogue_5_relic_return_26.name: King's Crown
rogue_5_relic_return_26.description: O Nameless Kings, may you continue to bless Iberia, even though your kingdoms are no more.
rogue_5_relic_return_26.usage: All Operators gain +40% ATK when at 1 Life Point, or +80% if you have 3 or more King's Collectibles

rogue_5_relic_return_27.name: Sarkaz King's Regal Rest
rogue_5_relic_return_27.description: For those in this position, a peaceful sleep becomes eternal
rogue_5_relic_return_27.usage: All Operators gain +20% DEF and +10 RES when at full Life Points

rogue_5_relic_return_28.name: Sarkaz King's Torn Banner
rogue_5_relic_return_28.description: For those in this position, to struggle is to inevitably fall.
rogue_5_relic_return_28.usage: All Operators gain +50 ASPD when at full Life Points

rogue_5_relic_return_29.name: King of Sarkaz's Vessel
rogue_5_relic_return_29.description: For those in this position, prosperity is but an illusion.
rogue_5_relic_return_29.usage: All Operators gain +60% Max HP when at full Life Points, or +120% if you have collected 3 or more King of Sarkaz's Collectibles

rogue_5_relic_return_30.name: Hand of Buckler
rogue_5_relic_return_30.description: Drop by drop, bit by bit. It is unstoppable.
rogue_5_relic_return_30.usage: Decel Binder, Hexer, and Abjurer Operators' attacks deal additional Arts damage equal to 3% of the target's current HP

rogue_5_relic_return_31.name: Hand of Predation
rogue_5_relic_return_31.usage: Pioneer, Charger, and Tactician Operators gain +10% ATK and DEF on every skill activation (Stacks 10x)

rogue_5_relic_return_32.name: Hand of Rending
rogue_5_relic_return_32.usage: Reaper, Soloblade, and Fighter Operators ignore 70% of the target's DEF

rogue_5_relic_return_33.name: Hand of Undulation
rogue_5_relic_return_33.usage: Splash Caster, Chain Caster, and Mech-accord Caster Operators recover 2 SP each time they deal damage to an enemy unit

rogue_5_relic_return_34.name: Hand of Protraction
rogue_5_relic_return_34.description: Protracted battles, a home of carnage.
rogue_5_relic_return_34.usage: Ambusher, Merchant, and Geek Operators gain +25% ATK for every 30s they remain on the battlefield (Stacks 5x)

rogue_5_relic_return_35.name: Hand of Fireworks
rogue_5_relic_return_35.usage: Marksman, Loopshooter, and Sentry Protector Operators have a 25% chance when an attack hits to shoot an extra projectile, dealing 200% ATK as AoE Physical Damage
rogue_5_relic_return_35.shortUsage: Marksman, Loopshooter, and Sentry Protector Operators have a 25% chance when an attack hits to shoot an extra projectile, dealing 200% ATK as AoE Physical Damage

rogue_5_relic_legacy_152.name: Court Striking Block
rogue_5_relic_legacy_152.description: The brother of a certain judge made this piece of wood for her so that she would have something to smash when annoyed by obstinate criminals, allowing her to vent her frustration while also intimidating the courtroom.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_152.usage: Allied Operators +10% HP for each Balance Coin in Coffer (max +150%)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_153.name: Blaze's Chainsaw
rogue_5_relic_legacy_153.description: She drags herself into hell with her enemies, appraising each other's determination with heat. She has never failed.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_153.usage: Enemies take increased damage from allied units as distance is reduced (max 100%)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_154.name: Sawblade Bangle
rogue_5_relic_legacy_154.description: Surprise is the key to victory in close quarters.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_155.name: Old Millstone
rogue_5_relic_legacy_155.description: The beast that pulled the millstone was whipped, the man who pushed the millstone was berated, but it was the millstone that broke first. Now it turns by itself, whenever it hears a sound.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_156.name: Crowing Rooftop Figure
rogue_5_relic_legacy_156.description: The rooftop figure's call announces the time at the Garden of Grotesqueries. The staff put a great deal of effort into it so it can take flight quickly and let out a cry that reaches every corner of the garden.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_156.usage: Allied Operators gradually gain ASPD when not using a skill, up to a maximum of +40 after 40s; bonus is reset when skill ends

rogue_5_relic_legacy_157.name: Heaven Axe
rogue_5_relic_legacy_157.description: A lumberjack who lost his way in the Garden of Grotesqueries managed to cut a way through to Jianzi Shrine with nothing more than a blunt axe and sheer force of will. This old fellow, who hadn't the faintest idea what consciousness of the Sui even was, was later 'hired' as a staff member, and Yi added the axe he no longer needed to his collection.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_157.usage: Operators +60% ATK and HP, but -30% ATK and HP whenever you enter Sui's Remnant Consciousness (Stacks 2x)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_158.name: Yarn of Real and Unreal
rogue_5_relic_legacy_158.description: Yarn that Yi collected, which Ji is loath to use. After the real and unreal threads were tidied up, it was tossed into a corner of the Garden of Grotesqueries for the beasts to toy with.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_158.usage: Operator DEF +600 and RES +15 when there are other Operators in the 8 surrounding tiles

rogue_5_relic_legacy_159.name: Silk Knot
rogue_5_relic_legacy_159.description: Yi's wedding gift to a staff couple, made to unravel when either is unfaithful. The couple left a long time ago, but nothing has changed with the knot.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_159.usage: Operator Max HP +40% when there are other Operators in the 8 surrounding tiles

rogue_5_relic_legacy_160.name: Fragment of Ju's Order
rogue_5_relic_legacy_160.description: A piece of Ju's strange body, now part of the Baizao Museum collection. It was withdrawn from display and put into storage after a group of tourists marched out of the exhibition hall in perfect unison after viewing it.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_160.usage: Operator ATK +50%, bonus lost when skill is activated manually

rogue_5_relic_legacy_161.name: Fragment of Hou's Soil
rogue_5_relic_legacy_161.description: A piece of Hou's heavy body, once part of the Baizao Museum collection. It disappeared when the exhibition hall turned into a garden; perhaps the Feranmut has already become one with this newborn corner of nature.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_161.usage: When an Operator on a Vagary Tile uses a skill, all Operators +40% ATK for 30s

rogue_5_relic_legacy_162.name: Victory Guqin
rogue_5_relic_legacy_162.description: Only a brave warrior who came back from battle can make a sound with it. Each battle forms a music score that is preserved for commemoration. The body of the zither is red after hundreds of battles, but the music of victory lingers.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_162.usage: Allied Operators' ATK +15%, extra +5% whenever Life Point(s) lost (Stacks 17x)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_163.name: 'Panacea'
rogue_5_relic_legacy_163.description: The doctor developed this recipe to soothe the patient's pain and anxiety, giving them more time to tackle the root of the ailment. However, patients often believe it to be a miracle cure because it makes their pain vanish.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_163.usage: Operator +1200 DEF and +30 RES when affected by negative status (Cold, Frozen, Stun)

rogue_5_relic_legacy_164.name: Waking Tower
rogue_5_relic_legacy_164.description: The Hour of Sui is inexorable, but Liu'er came up with this tower that changes the Hour of Sui, with the help of the Sui proxies.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_165.name: Coin Platter
rogue_5_relic_legacy_165.description: If you are going to toss a coin, it had better make a sound. Created for such a purpose, this plate has somehow become one of the most discerning coin connoisseurs in the land.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_165.usage: +1 Hope on Flower Coin toss; +4 Ingots on Balance Coin toss; +1 Life Point on Risk Coin toss

rogue_5_relic_legacy_166.name: Little Ba'jie Sticker
rogue_5_relic_legacy_166.description: Sticker of the Garden of Grotesqueries mascot, often sold in a set with Tongbao. Sometimes throws out its friends that want to leave the Coin Coffer.

rogue_5_relic_legacy_167.name: Soldier's Edge
rogue_5_relic_legacy_167.description: Every member of the Imperial Guard is the product of both skill and luck. The same is true of their weapons.
rogue_5_relic_legacy_167.usage: Allied Operators +10% ATK for each Balance Coin in Coffer (max +150%)

rogue_5_relic_final_7.name: Memory Scope
rogue_5_relic_final_7.description: Created by Sui proxies for the purpose of fighting the bestial Sui. In its endless spinning, the myriad possibilities of Its awakening are revealed, allowing Wang to plan ahead.
rogue_5_relic_final_7.usage: When obtained, lose all Originium Ingots and Hope, and gain -50% Command Level EXP and Originium Ingots from battle. Special function in Wander into Wonderland
rogue_5_relic_final_7.shortUsage: When obtained, lose all Originium Ingots and Hope, and gain -50% Command Level EXP and Originium Ingots from battle. Special function in Wander into Wonderland

rogue_5_relic_final_8.name: 'Little Moji'
rogue_5_relic_final_8.description: Inkgeist fed with the Sui proxies' memories. Its movements are not particularly swift, but it assists with suppressing Sui's awakening consciousness in the infinite possibilities.
rogue_5_relic_final_8.usage: Reduce natural DP regeneration rate by 50%, leads expedition in a different direction. Special function in Tavern

rogue_5_relic_final_9.name: Merciless
rogue_5_relic_final_9.description: Strange object created when depicting the bestial Sui. Sui will not allow others to trample upon Its vessel, even if It has yet to awaken. Its body instinctively searches for premonitions of change.
rogue_5_relic_final_9.usage: All enemies HP and DEF +50%; 'Olden Pride' and some 'Body' segments gain ability to continuously summon enemies

rogue_5_relic_final_10.name: Ceaseless
rogue_5_relic_final_10.description: Strange object created when depicting the bestial Sui. Sui will not allow others to peruse Its memories and thoughts, even if It has yet to awaken. The extension of sensation staunchly obstructs all change.
rogue_5_relic_final_10.usage: All enemies ATK +30%; [Candleguests] and their summons -10% ATK and HP when fighting outside Sui's Remnant Consciousness, plus extra -10% upon entering a new floor, and extra -50% when entering 'Laiqu Point'
rogue_5_relic_final_10.shortUsage: All enemies ATK +30%; [Candleguests] and their summons have reduced ATK and HP when fighting outside Sui's Remnant Consciousness

constData.seedModeIntro:
I. Seeds are parameters used to generate random content in Integrated Strategies, affecting things such as the map and collectibles. Using the same seed allows you to generate expeditions with consistent content.
II. Using a seed will disable the unlocking of higher difficulties, medals, and ending badges.

rogue_3_chaos_1.name: De-quantification
rogue_3_chaos_1.functionDesc: Choosing to spend Hope or Originium Ingots and increasing your Collapse value in non-combat nodes will have a 25% chance to increase the cost by 1
rogue_3_chaos_1.desc: The boundaries between numbers in this area have become blurred. Humans have lost the ability to recognize natural numbers.

rogue_3_chaos_1_a.name: Intensified De-quantification
rogue_3_chaos_1_a.functionDesc: Choosing to spend Hope or Originium Ingots and increasing your Collapse value in non-combat nodes will have a 50% chance to increase the cost by 2
rogue_3_chaos_1_a.desc: The concept of numbers itself has become indistinct, and humans have completely lost the ability to use numbers at all.

rogue_3_chaos_2.name: Substantial Collapse
rogue_3_chaos_2.functionDesc: 4 instances of [Dominion] will appear in battle, allied units on affected tiles have -50 ASPD
rogue_3_chaos_2.desc: Isolated phenomena known as 'Dominion' have begun to appear frequently on the land.

rogue_3_chaos_2_a.name: Propagating Collapse
rogue_3_chaos_2_a.functionDesc: 8 instances of [Dominion] will appear in battle, allied units on affected tiles have -75 ASPD
rogue_3_chaos_2_a.desc: The 'Dominion' phenomena is currently spreading rapidly, with an efficiency already near atmospheric circulation itself.

rogue_3_chaos_3.name: Non-linear Movement
rogue_3_chaos_3.functionDesc: All [Collapsals] gain Max HP +15% and Movement Speed +15%
rogue_3_chaos_3.desc: The shortest distance between two points is not a straight line.

rogue_3_chaos_3_a.name: Non-linear Action
rogue_3_chaos_3_a.functionDesc: All [Collapsals] gain Max HP +20%, Movement Speed +20%, and ASPD +20
rogue_3_chaos_3_a.desc: The fastest path of descent is not a line between two points.

rogue_3_chaos_4.name: Emotional Entity
rogue_3_chaos_4.functionDesc: Enemies have a 5% chance to appear on the battlefield with +100% Max HP
rogue_3_chaos_4.desc: When inner emotional fluctuations become nourishment and a stimulant to the enemy...

rogue_3_chaos_4_a.name: Terrifying Entity
rogue_3_chaos_4_a.functionDesc: Enemies have a 10% chance to appear on the battlefield with +100% Max HP
rogue_3_chaos_4_a.desc: When innermost negative emotions become an actual monster...

rogue_3_chaos_5.name: Pan-Society Paradox
rogue_3_chaos_5.functionDesc: Rogue Trader's prices are increased by 25%
rogue_3_chaos_5.desc: The definition of society has been rewritten, and the value of social products has changed as a result.

rogue_3_chaos_5_a.name: Pan-Civilization Paradox
rogue_3_chaos_5_a.functionDesc: Rogue Trader's prices are increased by 50%, with the price of relatively Rare items increased by 100%
rogue_3_chaos_5_a.desc: The essence of civilization has been twisted, and the value of all products has become incapable of being explained with common sense.

rogue_3_chaos_6.name: Barometric Anomaly
rogue_3_chaos_6.functionDesc: Natural DP regeneration rate is reduced by 20%
rogue_3_chaos_6.desc: Atmospheric pressure is shifting within a range at random, and the movements of non-military crew become sluggish, unable to adapt to such fluctuations.

rogue_3_chaos_6_a.name: Barometric Disorder
rogue_3_chaos_6_a.functionDesc: Natural DP regeneration rate is reduced by 40%
rogue_3_chaos_6_a.desc: Atmospheric pressure no longer adheres to any rule, and all matter has unavoidably become redundant from individual distress.

rogue_3_chaos_7.name: Injury Trigger
rogue_3_chaos_7.functionDesc: All allied units lose 30% HP on deployment (Effect only triggers once before unit leaves the field)
rogue_3_chaos_7.desc: Life is the premise, and also the price for action.

rogue_3_chaos_7_a.name: Crisis Trigger
rogue_3_chaos_7_a.functionDesc: All allied units lose 60% HP on deployment (Effect only triggers once before unit leaves the field)
rogue_3_chaos_7_a.desc: Life is the premise for action, and will also soon become the premise for death.

rogue_3_chaos_8.name: Convergence Consumption
rogue_3_chaos_8.functionDesc: When Anti-Interference Index decreases, Max Life Points decreases by 1
rogue_3_chaos_8.desc: Whenever an instrument undergoes wear and tear, its user will feel the same kind of pain.

rogue_3_chaos_8_a.name: Convergence Deficiency
rogue_3_chaos_8_a.functionDesc: When Anti-Interference Index decreases, Max Life Points decreases by 2
rogue_3_chaos_8_a.desc: An instrument is like a part of the user's body, the wear and tear on the machine equivalent to the damage its user suffers.

rogue_3_chaos_9.name: Partial Cecity
rogue_3_chaos_9.functionDesc: Life Points and the HP of enemies on the battlefield are harder to discern
rogue_3_chaos_9.desc: Your brain begins to 'naturally' skip some information, and this makes you feel comfortable.

rogue_3_chaos_9_a.name: Complete Cecity
rogue_3_chaos_9_a.functionDesc: Life Points and the HP of enemies on the battlefield are harder to discern, and all enemies gain Max HP +10%
rogue_3_chaos_9_a.desc: If you can't see it, it doesn't exist. If it doesn't exist, you don't have to think about it. It feels truly great to be so carefree with nary a worry.

rogue_3_chaos_10.name: Image Corruption
rogue_3_chaos_10.functionDesc: Allied units are harder to discern
rogue_3_chaos_10.desc: The PRTS operation log is not reflecting any system errors, but for some reason the Operators have been removed from the image.

rogue_3_chaos_10_a.name: Image Blackout
rogue_3_chaos_10_a.functionDesc: Allied units are harder to discern, and Deployment Cost +1
rogue_3_chaos_10_a.desc: Even though the present situation has put a burden on your logistics work, PRTS insists that it is working normally, which is not normal.

moduleConsts.chaosNotMaxDescription: New Collapse level. More dangerous Paradigms will appear.

content: I have known of you for quite a while. I have wished to make your acquaintance ever since.
I acquired these goods from the far corners of the land. You can find anything you would like here, so please, take your time.
Not just anyone can come here. Why not choose something that interests you before you go?
I know my younger brothers and sisters have their criticisms of me, but please, treat them as jests.
Rest easy, business is built on a bedrock of mutual benefit. I have your best interests in mind.
Where there are people, there is business.
What is it you need? This store offers anything and everything. You need only say the word.
The prices I offer you are their true worth. I really do wish to be your friend, after all.
I just knew we would meet again.
I knew you would be back soon. Here, your tea.
I suppose it is time to make some merry.
Your operators are rather interesting. No wonder my siblings love going to yours.
If you do not doubt the people you hire, you will gain from their wisdom.
The one you seek, I shall invite. In the proper manner, of course. At ease, there have been no complications as of yet.
I have settled an account on your behalf. With the right person, you shall know only gain, never loss.
No need to stand there slack-jawed, everything you see in this store has its price. The question is, what do you have to offer?
A discerning mind who knows true worth. Customers like you are my favorite.
I made an agreement with the late merchant to sell their collection to good people. I would not display them for any old customer.
These look like they are from my younger brother's collectibles? You are overthinking things. Whilst you shop here, you will not be disturbed.
Appearances are not as they seem. Everything I sell you is the genuine article.
Dull, but practical.
Plan ahead for whatever contingency you may run into.
Those who remain calm in the chaos have surely planned ahead.
It has chosen you.
With the right price, even good fortune can be bought.
Its function? Try it for yourself. Divulging its key points to you would be dreadfully boring.
I shall give you some... special treatment.
Hold 'change' firmly in your hands, and you will master the way of survival here.
The road ahead is unknown, yet there is great joy in your heart... Then I wish you a pleasant return.
With these transactions, our bond can be considered beyond life and death.
These trades are strictly between you and me. Were others to offer the same 'remuneration' as you, I may not necessarily accept them.
Courting danger in such a manner... Your strategic mind will surely get along with a certain someone.
How very straightforward of you.
As I said before, this is a transaction of mutual benefit.
Now, we understand one another more.
